# 10.16 Text recovery runner

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/text-recovery/run-text-recovery-pass.ts
```

```ts
import {
  AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,
  AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
} from "../schema/constants";

import type {
  AiLayoutObservation,
  AiObservation,
  AiOcrObservation,
  AiTextCandidateObservation,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import type {
  AiObservationBundle,
} from "../observations/observation-bundle.types";

import {
  bucketForMagicStorageRole,
} from "../storage/storage-buckets";

import {
  observationBundlePath,
  textRecoveryCandidateCropPath,
  textRecoveryCandidateRenderPath,
  textRecoveryPassReportPath,
} from "../storage/storage-paths";

import {
  writeAiAsset,
} from "../storage/write-ai-asset";

import {
  downloadAssetBuffer,
} from "../storage/download-ai-asset";

import {
  groupOcrWordsIntoTextBlocks,
} from "./group-ocr-words";

import {
  createTextFallbackCrop,
} from "./create-text-fallback-crop";

import {
  estimateTextStyle,
} from "./estimate-text-style";

import {
  detectSemanticTextMutation,
  computeEditDistanceRatio,
  normalizeTextForSafety,
} from "./text-safety";

import {
  svgTextCandidateRenderer,
} from "./svg-text-candidate-renderer";

import {
  validateRenderedTextAgainstCrop,
} from "./validate-text-render";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_TEXT_RECOVERY_POLICY,
} from "./text-recovery-policy";

import type {
  TextRecoveryPass,
  TextRecoveryResult,
} from "./text-recovery.types";

export async function runTextRecoveryPass(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  jobId: string;
  userId: string;

  sourceObservationBundleAssetId: string;

  observationBundle: AiObservationBundle;
}): Promise<TextRecoveryResult> {
  const normalizedAsset =
    input.observationBundle.assets[
      input.observationBundle.source.normalizedAssetId
    ];

  const normalizedBuffer = await downloadAssetBuffer(normalizedAsset);

  const observations = Object.values(
    input.observationBundle.observations
  );

  const ocrObservations = observations.filter(
    (obs): obs is AiOcrObservation => obs.kind === "ocr"
  );

  const textLayoutObservations = observations.filter(
    (obs): obs is AiLayoutObservation =>
      obs.kind === "layout" &&
      obs.layerTypeGuess === "text"
  );

  const blocks = groupOcrWordsIntoTextBlocks({
    ocrObservations,
    textLayoutObservations,
  }).slice(0, MAGIC_LAYERS_TEXT_RECOVERY_POLICY.maxTextCandidates);

  const newObservations: Record<string, AiObservation> = {};
  const newAssets = {
    ...input.observationBundle.assets,
  };

  const textCandidateObservations: AiTextCandidateObservation[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];

  for (let index = 0; index < blocks.length; index++) {
    const block = blocks[index];

    const candidateId = `text_candidate_${String(index).padStart(3, "0")}`;

    const fallbackCrop = await createTextFallbackCrop({
      normalizedImageBuffer: normalizedBuffer,
      bbox: block.bbox,
      canvasWidth: input.observationBundle.canvas.width,
      canvasHeight: input.observationBundle.canvas.height,
    });

    const fallbackAssetId = stableAssetId(
      input.jobId,
      `${candidateId}-fallback-crop`
    );

    const fallbackAsset = await writeAiAsset({
      storageRole: "source",
      bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
      storagePath: textRecoveryCandidateCropPath({
        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        jobId: input.jobId,
        candidateId,
        assetId: fallbackAssetId,
      }),

      bytes: fallbackCrop.cropBuffer,

      assetId: fallbackAssetId,
      kind: "text_candidate_fallback_crop" as any,

      contentType: "image/png",

      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,

      width: fallbackCrop.width,
      height: fallbackCrop.height,

      source: "text_style_estimator",

      schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

      sourceAssetId: normalizedAsset.id,

      cacheControl: "private, max-age=31536000, immutable",
    });

    newAssets[fallbackAsset.id] = fallbackAsset;

    const style = await estimateTextStyle({
      cropBuffer: fallbackCrop.cropBuffer,
      candidateText: block.text,
      candidateBBox: block.bbox,
      lineCount: block.text.split("\n").length,
    });

    const rendered = await svgTextCandidateRenderer.render({
      text: block.text,
      width: fallbackCrop.width,
      height: fallbackCrop.height,
      style,
    });

    const renderAssetId = stableAssetId(
      input.jobId,
      `${candidateId}-render`
    );

    const renderAsset = await writeAiAsset({
      storageRole: "source",
      bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
      storagePath: textRecoveryCandidateRenderPath({
        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        jobId: input.jobId,
        candidateId,
        assetId: renderAssetId,
      }),

      bytes: rendered.pngBuffer,

      assetId: renderAssetId,
      kind: "text_candidate_render_png" as any,

      contentType: "image/png",

      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,

      width: rendered.width,
      height: rendered.height,

      source: "text_style_estimator",

      schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

      sourceAssetId: fallbackAsset.id,

      cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
    });

    newAssets[renderAsset.id] = renderAsset;

    const renderMetrics = await validateRenderedTextAgainstCrop({
      originalCropBuffer: fallbackCrop.cropBuffer,
      renderedCandidateBuffer: rendered.pngBuffer,
    });

    const semanticMutationDetected = detectSemanticTextMutation({
      originalOcrText: block.text,
      candidateText: block.text,
    });

    const editDistanceRatio = computeEditDistanceRatio({
      original: block.text,
      candidate: block.text,
    });

    const validation = evaluateTextCandidateValidation({
      ocrConfidence: block.confidence,
      fontConfidence: style.confidence.font,
      styleConfidence: style.confidence.style,
      editDistanceRatio,
      semanticMutationDetected,
      renderMaskIoU: renderMetrics.maskIoU,
      renderRgbL1: renderMetrics.rgbL1,
    });

    const textCandidateObservation: AiTextCandidateObservation = {
      id: `obs_${candidateId}`,

      jobId: input.jobId,
      designId: input.designId,

      kind: "text_candidate",

      source: "text_style_estimator",

      createdAt: Date.now(),

      text: block.text,

      originalOcrText: block.text,

      sourceOcrObservationIds: block.wordIds,

      sourceLayoutObservationIds:
        block.sourceLayoutObservationIds,

      bbox: block.bbox,

      lineBBoxes: block.lineIds.map(() => block.bbox),

      readingOrder: index,

      textRole: inferTextRole(block.text, block.bbox, index),

      editability: validation.editability,

      style: {
        fontFamilyGuess: style.fontFamilyGuess,
        fontFallback: style.fontFallback,
        fontCandidates: style.fontCandidates,
        fontSizePx: style.fontSizePx,
        fontWeight: style.fontWeight,
        fontStyle: style.fontStyle,
        lineHeight: style.lineHeight,
        letterSpacingPx: style.letterSpacingPx,
        fill: style.fill,
        stroke: style.stroke,
        strokeWidth: style.strokeWidth,
        shadow: style.shadow,
        textAlign: style.textAlign,
        angle: style.angle,
      },

      assets: {
        fallbackCropAssetId: fallbackAsset.id,
        renderedCandidateAssetId: renderAsset.id,
      },

      validation: {
        stringExact:
          normalizeTextForSafety(block.text) ===
          normalizeTextForSafety(block.text),

        normalizedStringExact: true,

        editDistanceRatio,

        renderAttempted: true,

        renderMaskIoU: renderMetrics.maskIoU,
        renderRgbL1: renderMetrics.rgbL1,

        fontConfidence: style.confidence.font,
        styleConfidence: style.confidence.style,

        semanticMutationDetected,

        passed: validation.passed,

        failureReasons: validation.failureReasons,
      },

      confidence: {
        overall: validation.overallConfidence,
        ocr: block.confidence,
        textString: semanticMutationDetected ? 0 : 1,
        textStyle: style.confidence.style,
        font: style.confidence.font,
        color: style.confidence.color,
        visualFidelity: 1 - renderMetrics.rgbL1,
        textSafety: semanticMutationDetected ? 0 : 1,
      },

      warnings: validation.failureReasons,
    };

    textCandidateObservations.push(textCandidateObservation);

    newObservations[textCandidateObservation.id] =
      textCandidateObservation;

    newObservations[`obs_quality_${candidateId}`] = {
      id: `obs_quality_${candidateId}`,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      designId: input.designId,
      kind: "quality",
      source: "visual_validator",
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      target: "text",
      targetId: textCandidateObservation.id,
      metrics: {
        rgbL1: renderMetrics.rgbL1,
        maskIoU: renderMetrics.maskIoU,
        textExact: !semanticMutationDetected,
        textEditDistance: editDistanceRatio,
      },
      passed: validation.passed,
      confidence: {
        overall: validation.overallConfidence,
        visualFidelity: 1 - renderMetrics.rgbL1,
        textSafety: semanticMutationDetected ? 0 : 1,
      },
    };
  }

  const updatedObservations = {
    ...input.observationBundle.observations,
    ...newObservations,
  };

  const updatedBundle: AiObservationBundle = {
    ...input.observationBundle,
    observations: updatedObservations,
    assets: newAssets,
    counts: {
      ...input.observationBundle.counts,
      total: Object.keys(updatedObservations).length,
      quality: Object.values(updatedObservations).filter(
        (obs) => obs.kind === "quality"
      ).length,
    },
    warnings: [
      ...input.observationBundle.warnings,
      ...warnings,
    ],
    updatedAt: Date.now(),
  };

  const updatedBundleAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "observation-bundle-after-text-recovery"
  );

  const updatedBundleAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "source",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
    storagePath: observationBundlePath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: updatedBundleAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(
      JSON.stringify(updatedBundle, null, 2),
      "utf8"
    ),

    assetId: updatedBundleAssetId,
    kind: "observation_bundle_json" as any,

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    source: "system",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  const passAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "text-recovery-pass"
  );

  const textRecoveryPass: TextRecoveryPass = {
    schemaVersion: "ai-text-recovery-pass.v1",

    jobId: input.jobId,
    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    userId: input.userId,

    sourceObservationBundleAssetId:
      input.sourceObservationBundleAssetId,

    outputObservationBundleAssetId: updatedBundleAsset.id,

    status: "completed",

    candidateCounts: {
      total: textCandidateObservations.length,
      liveTextCandidate: textCandidateObservations.filter(
        (obs) => obs.editability === "candidate_live_text"
      ).length,
      needsReview: textCandidateObservations.filter(
        (obs) => obs.editability === "candidate_with_review"
      ).length,
      rasterOnly: textCandidateObservations.filter(
        (obs) => obs.editability === "raster_only"
      ).length,
    },

    observationsAdded: {
      total: Object.keys(newObservations).length,
      textCandidate: textCandidateObservations.length,
      textStyle: 0,
      quality: Object.values(newObservations).filter(
        (obs) => obs.kind === "quality"
      ).length,
      groupCandidate: 0,
    },

    assetsCreated: Object.keys(newAssets).filter(
      (assetId) => !input.observationBundle.assets[assetId]
    ),

    warnings,

    createdAt: Date.now(),
  };

  const passAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "source",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
    storagePath: textRecoveryPassReportPath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: passAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(
      JSON.stringify(textRecoveryPass, null, 2),
      "utf8"
    ),

    assetId: passAssetId,
    kind: "text_recovery_pass_json" as any,

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    source: "system",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  return {
    updatedBundle,
    updatedBundleAsset,
    textRecoveryPass,
    textRecoveryPassAsset: passAsset,
    textCandidateObservations,
    assets: newAssets,
  };
}

function evaluateTextCandidateValidation(input: {
  ocrConfidence: number;
  fontConfidence: number;
  styleConfidence: number;
  editDistanceRatio: number;
  semanticMutationDetected: boolean;
  renderMaskIoU: number;
  renderRgbL1: number;
}) {
  const p = MAGIC_LAYERS_TEXT_RECOVERY_POLICY.validation;

  const failureReasons: string[] = [];

  if (input.semanticMutationDetected) {
    failureReasons.push("semantic_text_mutation_detected");
  }

  if (input.ocrConfidence < MAGIC_LAYERS_TEXT_RECOVERY_POLICY.minCandidateOcrConfidence) {
    failureReasons.push("ocr_confidence_low");
  }

  if (input.editDistanceRatio > p.maxEditDistanceRatioForLiveText) {
    failureReasons.push("edit_distance_too_high");
  }

  if (input.renderMaskIoU < p.minRenderMaskIoUForLiveText) {
    failureReasons.push("render_mask_iou_low");
  }

  if (input.renderRgbL1 > p.maxRenderRgbL1ForLiveText) {
    failureReasons.push("render_rgb_l1_high");
  }

  if (input.fontConfidence < p.minFontConfidenceForLiveText) {
    failureReasons.push("font_confidence_low");
  }

  const overallConfidence =
    input.ocrConfidence * 0.35 +
    (input.semanticMutationDetected ? 0 : 1) * 0.25 +
    Math.max(0, 1 - input.renderRgbL1) * 0.2 +
    input.renderMaskIoU * 0.1 +
    input.fontConfidence * 0.1;

  const passed =
    failureReasons.length === 0 &&
    overallConfidence >= p.minOverallLiveCandidateConfidence;

  return {
    passed,
    failureReasons,
    overallConfidence,
    editability: passed
      ? "candidate_live_text"
      : input.semanticMutationDetected ||
        input.ocrConfidence < 0.65
        ? "raster_only"
        : "candidate_with_review",
  } as const;
}

function inferTextRole(
  text: string,
  bbox: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number },
  index: number
): AiTextCandidateObservation["textRole"] {
  if (/[$₹€£]\s?\d|\d+\s?%/.test(text)) return "price";

  const upperRatio =
    text.replace(/[^A-Z]/g, "").length /
    Math.max(1, text.replace(/[^A-Za-z]/g, "").length);

  if (index === 0 && upperRatio > 0.6 && bbox.height > 40) {
    return "headline";
  }

  return "unknown";
}

function stableAssetId(jobId: string, label: string) {
  return `asset_${jobId}_${label}`
    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "_")
    .toLowerCase();
}
```

```ts
import {
  FieldValue,
  getFirestore,
} from "firebase-admin/firestore";

import type {
  TextRecoveryResult,
} from "./text-recovery.types";

export async function applyTextRecoveryResult(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  jobId: string;
  result: TextRecoveryResult;
}) {
  const db = getFirestore();

  const jobRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/aiLayerJobs/${input.jobId}`
  );

  const batch = db.batch();

  batch.set(
    db.doc(
      `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/assets/${input.result.updatedBundleAsset.id}`
    ),
    assetIndexDoc(input.result.updatedBundleAsset, input),
    { merge: true }
  );

  batch.set(
    db.doc(
      `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/assets/${input.result.textRecoveryPassAsset.id}`
    ),
    assetIndexDoc(input.result.textRecoveryPassAsset, input),
    { merge: true }
  );

  batch.update(jobRef, {
    "input.observationBundleAssetId":
      input.result.updatedBundleAsset.id,

    textRecovery: {
      textRecoveryPassAssetId:
        input.result.textRecoveryPassAsset.id,

      outputObservationBundleAssetId:
        input.result.updatedBundleAsset.id,

      candidateCounts:
        input.result.textRecoveryPass.candidateCounts,

      observationsAdded:
        input.result.textRecoveryPass.observationsAdded,

      assetsCreated:
        input.result.textRecoveryPass.assetsCreated,

      warnings:
        input.result.textRecoveryPass.warnings,

      createdAt:
        input.result.textRecoveryPass.createdAt,
    },

    "progress.percent": 46,
    "progress.label": "Text candidates recovered",
    "progress.currentStep": "recovering_text",

    updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
  });

  await batch.commit();
}

function assetIndexDoc(
  asset: any,
  input: {
    workspaceId: string;
    designId: string;
    jobId: string;
  }
) {
  return {
    id: asset.id,

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    kind: asset.kind,
    storageRole: asset.storageRole,

    bucket: asset.bucket,
    storagePath: asset.storagePath,

    generation: asset.generation,
    metageneration: asset.metageneration,

    mimeType: asset.mimeType,

    width: asset.width,
    height: asset.height,
    sizeBytes: asset.sizeBytes,

    checksum: asset.checksum,

    source: asset.metadata?.source,

    retained: true,

    createdAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
  };
}
```

---

# 10.19 Candidate promotion rules

Step 10 does **not** promote candidates to final layers, but it marks their promotion eligibility.

## Candidate can become `text_editable` later only if:

```txt
editability = candidate_live_text

semanticMutationDetected = false

OCR confidence high enough

normalized string exact

render validation passed

fallback crop exists

font/style confidence acceptable

candidate bbox is stable

candidate is not likely logo text unless explicitly allowed
```

## Candidate becomes `candidate_with_review` when:

```txt
string is likely correct
but font/style/render similarity is weak

or OCR confidence is medium

or text is rotated/stylized

or line grouping is uncertain
```

## Candidate becomes `raster_only` when:

```txt
semantic mutation detected

OCR confidence low

text unreadable

logo/wordmark likely

handwriting/stylized lettering

render validation fails badly

candidate crop too small

candidate is decorative text-like shape
```

This is the important UX decision:

```txt
Medium confidence text should not become silently editable.
It should become raster fallback with optional user-triggered conversion.
```

---

# 10.20 Font catalog policy

Create a local font catalog:

```ts
export type MagicLayersFontCatalogEntry = {
  family: string;

  source:
    | "bundled"
    | "google_fonts"
    | "system"
    | "licensed_customer_font";

  variants: {
    weight: number;
    style: "normal" | "italic";

    | "serif"

    | "display"
    | "handwriting"
    | "monospace";

  scripts: string[];

  availableInBrowser: boolean;
  availableInServerRenderer: boolean;
};
```

Hard rule:

```txt
Only output font families that the browser editor and server renderer can both load.
```

Do not output:

```txt
fontFamily: "Some Unknown Font"
```

unless it is only a label inside `fontCandidates`.

Use:

```txt
fontFamilyGuess
fontFallback
fontCandidates
fontConfidence
```

not false certainty.

---

# 10.21 Text safety hard gate

No candidate can become live text later if:

```txt
semanticMutationDetected = true
```

This protects against the most damaging failure mode:

```txt
visible text changes during reconstruction
```

Even if the visual render looks close, text content is authoritative.

---

# 10.22 What Step 10 must not do

Do not add:

```txt
Fabric Textbox
AiReconstructedLayer
final text z-index
final group hierarchy
final background erase
text inpainting
translation
copywriting improvement
spell correction
brand rewriting
OCR hallucination repair
```

Do not let Gemini rewrite text. At most, Gemini can be used later to choose among OCR candidates under strict “choose one of these exact strings” constraints.

---

# 10.23 Non-negotiable invariants

Step 10 is valid only if:

```txt
OCR observations remain raw evidence.

Text candidates are observations, not final layers.

Every text candidate has fallback crop.

Every text candidate has source OCR observation IDs.

Every text candidate has source layout observation IDs when available.

Every text candidate has text safety state.

Semantic mutation blocks live-text eligibility.

Every candidate has style estimate.

Every candidate has validation metrics.

Every rendered validation asset is diagnostic only.

Every text candidate uses canvas_px geometry.

Raw OCR output remains in GCS, not Firestore.

Firestore stores only summary and asset pointers.

No Fabric JSON is produced.

No final AiReconstructedLayer is produced.

Medium-confidence text remains review/raster-first.

Low-confidence text remains raster-only.
```

# 10.25 Definition of done

Step 10 is complete when:

```txt
OCR words are grouped into text blocks.

Text layout observations are used to stabilize grouping.

Every text candidate has fallback crop.

Every text candidate has estimated font/style/color.

Every text candidate is rendered back for validation.

Every text candidate has text safety result.

Every text candidate is classified as:
  candidate_live_text
  candidate_with_review
  raster_only

Updated observation bundle is stored in GCS.

Text recovery pass report is stored in GCS.

Firestore points to the updated observation bundle.

No Fabric Textbox is created yet.

No final layer is created yet.
```

```txt
ObservationBundle
```

# Step 11 — Elementization

Step 11 converts raw visual evidence into **object-level candidates**.

The locked rule:

```txt
Elementization creates element candidates.
It does not create final layers.
It does not create Fabric objects.
It does not decide editability.
```

This is the bridge between:

```txt
raw observations
  - LayerD RGBA layers
  - Gemini/SAM/BiRefNet masks
  - OCR/text candidates
  - routing/palette observations

and

scene resolver decisions
  - text_editable
  - vector_editable
  - raster_masked
  - raster_fallback
  - group_editable
```

OpenCV and scikit-image are the correct tool class here. OpenCV exposes connected component statistics, contour extraction, polygon approximation, bounding rectangles, rotated rectangles, and contour metrics; these are exactly the primitives needed to convert masks/RGBA layers into object candidates. citeturn261296view0turn198586view0 scikit-image’s `label` and `regionprops` provide connected-region measurement, and its polygon approximation is based on Douglas-Peucker simplification, useful for component geometry and shape candidate evidence. citeturn198586view0turn198586view1turn198586view3

---

## 11.1 What Step 11 owns

Step 11 owns:

```txt
component extraction from RGBA/mask observations
component mask/crop generation
connected-component statistics
contour extraction
rotated bbox extraction
polygon approximation
component filtering
duplicate suppression
small-component merge
source-observation linking
object-type guess
element-candidate observations
logical group candidate observations
elementization report
updated observation bundle
Firestore elementization summary
```

Step 11 does **not** own:

```txt
final layer acceptance
editable text promotion
vector tracing
accepted raster layer generation
background repair
final z-order
Fabric JSON
export rendering
```

The output is still evidence.

---

# 11.2 Why elementization exists

Decomposition engines often produce **layers**, not **objects**.

Example:

```txt
LayerD RGBA layer
  may contain headline text + badge + decoration

Gemini mask
  may include product + shadow

SAM mask
  may include multiple disconnected regions

Connected-components fallback
  may split one logical object into too many pieces
```

Elementization converts this into:

```txt
component observations
element candidate observations
group candidate observations
```

Still not final layers.

Correct:

```txt
raw RGBA layer
→ components
→ element candidates
→ resolver decides final layers later
```

Wrong:

```txt
raw RGBA layer
→ Fabric image layer directly
```

Required:

# 11.9 Core extraction strategy

Step 11 uses different extraction rules by source type.

## From `rgba_layer`

Use alpha channel:

```txt
alpha > threshold
→ morphology clean
→ connected components
→ component mask
→ component RGBA crop
→ component observation
```

Good for:

```txt
LayerD output
BiRefNet output
raw RGBA candidates
```

## From `mask`

Use mask pixels:

```txt
mask > threshold
→ connected components
→ component mask
→ crop original normalized pixels through mask
→ component observation
```

Good for:

```txt
SAM/Gemini/BiRefNet masks
```

## From `text_candidate`

Do not run connected components unless needed.

Create a protected element candidate:

```txt
text_candidate
→ element_candidate(type=text_region)
```

Because text recovery has already grouped OCR words and validated text safety.

## From `layout`

Only use layout as supporting evidence.

Do not create components from layout boxes alone unless route is fallback-only or no other source exists.

---

# 11.10 Strong technical opinion

Do not implement serious elementization in TypeScript.

Use Python/OpenCV/scikit-image behind a deterministic process boundary.

Reason:

```txt
connected components
contours
rotated rectangles
region properties
morphology
polygon simplification
mask metrics
```

are mature, well-documented primitives in OpenCV/scikit-image. OpenCV’s `connectedComponentsWithStats` computes a labeled image and statistics for each label, including bounding-box fields and area; `findContours` finds contours in a binary image; `approxPolyDP` simplifies curves using Douglas-Peucker; and `boundingRect`/`minAreaRect` produce geometric bounds. citeturn261296view0 OpenCV morphology is explicitly shape-based and normally performed on binary images, with erosion/dilation/opening/closing available for noise removal and joining broken components. citeturn815729view0

Use Node to orchestrate. Use Python to compute.

# 11.13 Python component extractor

Create:

```txt
services/magic-layers-python/elementize_components.py
```

```python
import json
import math
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import cv2
import numpy as np


def main():
    input_path = Path(sys.argv[1])
    output_path = Path(sys.argv[2])

    spec = json.loads(input_path.read_text())

    output_dir = output_path.parent
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    canvas_width = int(spec["canvas"]["width"])
    canvas_height = int(spec["canvas"]["height"])
    policy = spec.get("policy", {})

    components = []
    warnings = []

    for source in spec["sources"]:
        try:
            components.extend(
                elementize_source(
                    source=source,
                    canvas_width=canvas_width,
                    canvas_height=canvas_height,
                    output_dir=output_dir,
                    policy=policy,
                )
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            warnings.append(
                {
                    "sourceObservationId": source.get("observationId"),
                    "code": "source_elementization_failed",
                    "message": str(exc),
                }
            )

    output_path.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "components": components,
                "warnings": warnings,
            },
            indent=2,
        )
    )


def elementize_source(source, canvas_width, canvas_height, output_dir, policy):
    local_path = Path(source["localPath"])
    kind = source["kind"]

    img = cv2.imread(str(local_path), cv2.IMREAD_UNCHANGED)

    if img is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Could not decode image: {local_path}")

    if kind == "rgba_layer":
        rgba = ensure_rgba(img)
        alpha = rgba[:, :, 3]
        binary = (alpha > int(policy.get("alphaThreshold", 16))).astype(np.uint8) * 255
        crop_source_rgba = rgba

    elif kind == "mask":
        mask = ensure_grayscale(img)
        binary = (mask > int(policy.get("maskThreshold", 32))).astype(np.uint8) * 255

        # For a pure mask source, the caller should later crop original pixels.
        # Here we create an RGBA preview from mask only.
        crop_source_rgba = np.zeros((binary.shape[0], binary.shape[1], 4), dtype=np.uint8)
        crop_source_rgba[:, :, 3] = binary

    else:
        return []

    binary = clean_binary_mask(binary, policy)

    num_labels, labels, stats, centroids = cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(
        binary,
        int(policy.get("connectivity", 8)),
        cv2.CV_32S,
    )

    results = []

    min_area_px = int(policy.get("minComponentAreaPx", 24))
    min_area_ratio = float(policy.get("minComponentAreaRatio", 0.00008))
    min_area = max(min_area_px, int(canvas_width * canvas_height * min_area_ratio))

    max_components = int(policy.get("maxComponentsPerSource", 80))

    component_count = 0

    for label in range(1, num_labels):
        x = int(stats[label, cv2.CC_STAT_LEFT])
        y = int(stats[label, cv2.CC_STAT_TOP])
        w = int(stats[label, cv2.CC_STAT_WIDTH])
        h = int(stats[label, cv2.CC_STAT_HEIGHT])
        area = int(stats[label, cv2.CC_STAT_AREA])

        if area < min_area:
            continue

        if component_count >= max_components:
            break

        component_mask = (labels == label).astype(np.uint8) * 255

        contour_data = contour_metrics(component_mask)

        crop_mask = component_mask[y : y + h, x : x + w]

        rgba_crop = crop_source_rgba[y : y + h, x : x + w].copy()

        if rgba_crop.shape[2] == 4:
            rgba_crop[:, :, 3] = np.minimum(rgba_crop[:, :, 3], crop_mask)

        component_id = f"cmp_{sanitize(source['observationId'])}_{component_count:03d}"

        mask_path = output_dir / f"{component_id}.mask.png"
        rgba_path = output_dir / f"{component_id}.rgba.png"

        cv2.imwrite(str(mask_path), crop_mask)
        cv2.imwrite(str(rgba_path), rgba_crop)

        features = visual_features(rgba_crop, crop_mask)

        bbox = {
            "x": x,
            "y": y,
            "width": w,
            "height": h,
        }

        results.append(
            {
                "id": component_id,
                "sourceObservationId": source["observationId"],
                "sourceObservationKind": kind,
                "componentIndex": component_count,
                "bbox": bbox,
                "rotatedBBox": contour_data.get("rotatedBBox"),
                "polygon": contour_data.get("polygon"),
                "contourPointCount": contour_data.get("contourPointCount"),
                "areaPx": area,
                "visibleAreaRatio": area / max(1, canvas_width * canvas_height),
                "alphaCoverage": float(np.count_nonzero(crop_mask) / max(1, w * h)),
                "meanAlpha": float(np.mean(rgba_crop[:, :, 3]) / 255.0)
                if rgba_crop.shape[2] == 4
                else None,
                "aspectRatio": float(w / max(1, h)),
                "solidity": contour_data.get("solidity"),
                "extent": area / max(1, w * h),
                "dominantColors": features["dominantColors"],
                "estimatedColorCount": features["estimatedColorCount"],
                "flatColorRatio": features["flatColorRatio"],
                "textureEntropy": features["textureEntropy"],
                "edgeComplexity": features["edgeComplexity"],
                "maskLocalPath": str(mask_path),
                "rgbaLocalPath": str(rgba_path),
                "warnings": [],
            }
        )

        component_count += 1

    return results


def clean_binary_mask(binary, policy):
    if not policy.get("useMorphology", True):
        return binary

    opening = int(policy.get("openingKernelSize", 2))
    closing = int(policy.get("closingKernelSize", 3))

    if opening > 1:
        kernel = np.ones((opening, opening), np.uint8)
        binary = cv2.morphologyEx(binary, cv2.MORPH_OPEN, kernel)

    if closing > 1:
        kernel = np.ones((closing, closing), np.uint8)
        binary = cv2.morphologyEx(binary, cv2.MORPH_CLOSE, kernel)

    return binary


def contour_metrics(mask):
    contours, _ = cv2.findContours(mask, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)

    if not contours:
        return {}

    contour = max(contours, key=cv2.contourArea)

    area = float(cv2.contourArea(contour))
    hull = cv2.convexHull(contour)
    hull_area = float(cv2.contourArea(hull))
    solidity = area / hull_area if hull_area > 0 else None

    perimeter = cv2.arcLength(contour, True)
    epsilon = 0.012 * perimeter

    approx = cv2.approxPolyDP(contour, epsilon, True)

    polygon = [
        {
            "x": int(point[0][0]),
            "y": int(point[0][1]),
        }
        for point in approx[:200]
    ]

    rect = cv2.minAreaRect(contour)
    box = cv2.boxPoints(rect)

    rotated = {
        "center": {
            "x": float(rect[0][0]),
            "y": float(rect[0][1]),
        },
        "width": float(rect[1][0]),
        "height": float(rect[1][1]),
        "angle": float(rect[2]),
        "points": [
            {
                "x": float(p[0]),
                "y": float(p[1]),
            }
            for p in box
        ],
    }

    return {
        "polygon": polygon,
        "contourPointCount": int(len(contour)),
        "rotatedBBox": rotated,
        "solidity": solidity,
    }


def visual_features(rgba_crop, mask):
    visible = mask > 0

    if rgba_crop.shape[2] == 4:
        rgb = rgba_crop[:, :, :3]
    else:
        rgb = rgba_crop[:, :, :3]

    pixels = rgb[visible]

    if len(pixels) == 0:
        return {
            "dominantColors": [],
            "estimatedColorCount": 0,
            "flatColorRatio": 0,
            "textureEntropy": 0,
            "edgeComplexity": 0,
        }

    # 4-bit quantized palette.
    quant = (pixels // 16).astype(np.uint8)
    packed = quant[:, 0].astype(np.int32) * 256 + quant[:, 1].astype(np.int32) * 16 + quant[:, 2].astype(np.int32)

    values, counts = np.unique(packed, return_counts=True)

    order = np.argsort(-counts)
    counts = counts[order]
    values = values[order]

    top_coverage = float(np.sum(counts[:8]) / max(1, len(pixels)))

    dominant_colors = []
    for value in values[:5]:
        r = int((value // 256) * 16)
        g = int(((value % 256) // 16) * 16)
        b = int((value % 16) * 16)
        dominant_colors.append(f"#{r:02x}{g:02x}{b:02x}")

    gray = cv2.cvtColor(rgb, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
    edges = cv2.Canny(gray, 50, 150)
    edge_complexity = float(np.count_nonzero(edges & mask) / max(1, np.count_nonzero(mask)))

    hist = np.bincount(gray[visible].flatten(), minlength=256).astype(np.float64)
    prob = hist / max(1, np.sum(hist))
    prob = prob[prob > 0]
    entropy = float(-np.sum(prob * np.log2(prob)))

    flat_color_ratio = float(min(1.0, top_coverage * 0.85 + (0.15 if len(values) < 16 else 0)))

    return {
        "dominantColors": dominant_colors,
        "estimatedColorCount": int(len(values)),
        "flatColorRatio": flat_color_ratio,
        "textureEntropy": entropy,
        "edgeComplexity": edge_complexity,
    }


def ensure_rgba(img):
    if len(img.shape) == 2:
        rgba = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_GRAY2BGRA)
        return rgba

    if img.shape[2] == 4:
        return img

    if img.shape[2] == 3:
        alpha = np.full((img.shape[0], img.shape[1], 1), 255, dtype=np.uint8)
        return np.concatenate([img, alpha], axis=2)

    raise ValueError("Unsupported image shape")


def ensure_grayscale(img):
    if len(img.shape) == 2:
        return img

    if img.shape[2] == 4:
        return img[:, :, 3]

    return cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)


def sanitize(value):
    return "".join(c if c.isalnum() or c in ["_", "-"] else "_" for c in value)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

This script works as the deterministic component extractor. Node should call it with local downloaded assets and then upload the produced masks/crops back to GCS.

# 11.14 Element candidate classifier

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/elementization/classify-element-candidate.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiComponentObservation,
  AiElementCandidateObservation,
  AiElementCandidateType,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_ELEMENTIZATION_POLICY,
} from "./elementization-policy";

export function classifyElementCandidate(input: {
  component: AiComponentObservation;

  sourceLayoutTypes: string[];

  textCandidateOverlapRatio: number;

  route:
    | "graphic_design_layer_decomposition"
    | "photo_conservative_segmentation"
    | "text_recovery_priority"
    | "vectorization_priority"
    | "fallback_only";
}): {
  elementTypeGuess: AiElementCandidateType;

  editableHint: AiElementCandidateObservation["editableHint"];

  confidence: number;

  reasonCodes: string[];

  downstream: AiElementCandidateObservation["downstream"];

  competingTypes: {
    type: AiElementCandidateType;
    confidence: number;
  }[];
} {
  const c = input.component;
  const p = MAGIC_LAYERS_ELEMENTIZATION_POLICY.classification;

  const reasonCodes: string[] = [];
  const competingTypes: {
    type: AiElementCandidateType;
    confidence: number;
  }[] = [];

  const areaRatio = c.visibleAreaRatio;
  const flat = c.flatColorRatio ?? 0;
  const texture = normalizeEntropy(c.textureEntropy ?? 0);
  const edge = c.edgeComplexity ?? 0;
  const alphaCoverage = c.alphaCoverage ?? 0;
  const meanAlpha = c.meanAlpha ?? 1;
  const colorCount = c.estimatedColorCount ?? 999;

  const hasTextOverlap =
    input.textCandidateOverlapRatio >=
    p.textOverlapLiveThreshold;

  if (hasTextOverlap) {
    reasonCodes.push("overlaps_text_candidate");

    return {
      elementTypeGuess: "text_region",
      editableHint: "likely_text",
      confidence: 0.9,
      reasonCodes,
      downstream: {
        eligibleForTextRecovery: true,
        eligibleForVectorization: false,
        eligibleForRasterLayer: true,
        eligibleForBackgroundRepair: false,
        needsReview: false,
      },
      competingTypes: [
        {
          type: "shape",
          confidence: 0.2,
        },
      ],
    };
  }

  if (
    input.sourceLayoutTypes.includes("person") ||
    input.sourceLayoutTypes.includes("product") ||
    input.sourceLayoutTypes.includes("photo_subject")
  ) {
    reasonCodes.push("layout_semantic_subject");

    return {
      elementTypeGuess: input.sourceLayoutTypes.includes("person")
        ? "person"
        : input.sourceLayoutTypes.includes("product")
          ? "product"
          : "photo_subject",
      editableHint: "likely_masked_raster",
      confidence: 0.82,
      reasonCodes,
      downstream: {
        eligibleForTextRecovery: false,
        eligibleForVectorization: false,
        eligibleForRasterLayer: true,
        eligibleForBackgroundRepair: true,
        needsReview: false,
      },
      competingTypes,
    };
  }

  if (
    input.sourceLayoutTypes.includes("image_block") ||
    (areaRatio >= p.imageBlockMinAreaRatio &&
      texture >= p.textureRasterThreshold &&
      colorCount > 32)
  ) {
    reasonCodes.push("photo_texture_or_image_block");

    return {
      elementTypeGuess: "image_block",
      editableHint: "likely_image_block",
      confidence: 0.75,
      reasonCodes,
      downstream: {
        eligibleForTextRecovery: false,
        eligibleForVectorization: false,
        eligibleForRasterLayer: true,
        eligibleForBackgroundRepair: true,
        needsReview: false,
      },
      competingTypes: [
        {
          type: "shape",
          confidence: flat * 0.4,
        },
      ],
    };
  }

  if (
    meanAlpha <= p.shadowMaxAlphaMean &&
    alphaCoverage >= p.shadowMinSoftAlphaCoverage &&
    flat < 0.55
  ) {
    reasonCodes.push("soft_low_alpha_shadow_like");

    return {
      elementTypeGuess: "shadow",
      editableHint: "likely_masked_raster",
      confidence: 0.68,
      reasonCodes,
      downstream: {
        eligibleForTextRecovery: false,
        eligibleForVectorization: false,
        eligibleForRasterLayer: true,
        eligibleForBackgroundRepair: false,
        needsReview: true,
      },
      competingTypes,
    };
  }

  if (
    flat >= p.flatColorShapeThreshold &&
    texture < 0.45 &&
    edge < 0.35
  ) {
    reasonCodes.push("flat_low_texture_shape");

    return {
      elementTypeGuess: areaRatio <= p.logoIconMaxAreaRatio
        ? "shape"
        : "overlay",
      editableHint: "likely_vector",
      confidence: clamp01(flat * 0.7 + (1 - texture) * 0.2 + 0.1),
      reasonCodes,
      downstream: {
        eligibleForTextRecovery: false,
        eligibleForVectorization: true,
        eligibleForRasterLayer: true,
        eligibleForBackgroundRepair: false,
        needsReview: false,
      },
      competingTypes: [
        {
          type: "raster_subject",
          confidence: texture * 0.6,
        },
      ],
    };
  }

  if (
    areaRatio < 0.08 &&
    flat >= 0.55 &&
    colorCount <= 16 &&
    input.route === "vectorization_priority"
  ) {
    reasonCodes.push("small_flat_logo_icon_candidate");

    return {
      elementTypeGuess: "logo_icon",
      editableHint: "likely_vector",
      confidence: 0.7,
      reasonCodes,
      downstream: {
        eligibleForTextRecovery: false,
        eligibleForVectorization: true,
        eligibleForRasterLayer: true,
        eligibleForBackgroundRepair: false,
        needsReview: true,
      },
      competingTypes: [
        {
          type: "shape",
          confidence: 0.62,
        },
      ],
    };
  }

  if (areaRatio < 0.03 && flat >= 0.45) {
    reasonCodes.push("small_decoration_candidate");

    return {
      elementTypeGuess: "decoration",
      editableHint: "likely_decoration",
      confidence: 0.58,
      reasonCodes,
      downstream: {
        eligibleForTextRecovery: false,
        eligibleForVectorization: flat > 0.65,
        eligibleForRasterLayer: true,
        eligibleForBackgroundRepair: false,
        needsReview: true,
      },
      competingTypes,
    };
  }

  reasonCodes.push("unknown_element_candidate");

  return {
    elementTypeGuess: "unknown",
    editableHint: "unknown",
    confidence: 0.38,
    reasonCodes,
    downstream: {
      eligibleForTextRecovery: false,
      eligibleForVectorization: false,
      eligibleForRasterLayer: true,
      eligibleForBackgroundRepair: false,
      needsReview: true,
    },
    competingTypes: [
      {
        type: "raster_subject",
        confidence: texture * 0.5,
      },
      {
        type: "shape",
        confidence: flat * 0.5,
      },
    ],
  };
}

function normalizeEntropy(value: number) {
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, value / 8));
}

function clamp01(value: number) {
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, value));
}
```

This classifier is intentionally conservative. It creates guesses and downstream eligibility, not final decisions.

# 11.15 Overlap utilities

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/elementization/element-overlap.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiLayoutObservation,
  AiTextCandidateObservation,
  BBox,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  bboxArea,
  bboxIntersectionArea,
} from "../schema/geometry";

export function findOverlappingTextCandidates(input: {
  bbox: BBox;
  textCandidates: AiTextCandidateObservation[];
}) {
  return input.textCandidates
    .map((candidate) => {
      const intersection = bboxIntersectionArea(
        input.bbox,
        candidate.bbox
      );

      return {
        candidate,
        ratio:
          intersection /
          Math.max(1, Math.min(bboxArea(input.bbox), bboxArea(candidate.bbox))),
      };
    })
    .filter((x) => x.ratio > 0.05);
}

export function findOverlappingLayoutObservations(input: {
  bbox: BBox;
  layouts: AiLayoutObservation[];
}) {
  return input.layouts
    .map((layout) => {
      if (!layout.bbox) {
        return {
          layout,
          ratio: 0,
        };
      }

      const intersection = bboxIntersectionArea(
        input.bbox,
        layout.bbox
      );

      return {
        layout,
        ratio:
          intersection /
          Math.max(1, Math.min(bboxArea(input.bbox), bboxArea(layout.bbox))),
      };
    })
    .filter((x) => x.ratio > 0.05);
}
```

```ts
import path from "node:path";
import os from "node:os";
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import { spawn } from "node:child_process";

import {
  AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,
  AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
} from "../schema/constants";

import type {
  AiAssetRef,
  AiComponentObservation,
  AiElementCandidateObservation,
  AiLayoutObservation,
  AiObservation,
  AiRgbaLayerObservation,
  AiMaskObservation,
  AiTextCandidateObservation,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import type {
  AiObservationBundle,
} from "../observations/observation-bundle.types";

import {
  bucketForMagicStorageRole,
} from "../storage/storage-buckets";

import {
  elementizationComponentMaskPath,
  elementizationComponentRgbaPath,
  elementizationPassReportPath,
  observationBundlePath,
} from "../storage/storage-paths";

import {
  writeAiAsset,
} from "../storage/write-ai-asset";

import {
  downloadAssetBuffer,
} from "../storage/download-ai-asset";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_ELEMENTIZATION_POLICY,
} from "./elementization-policy";

import {
  classifyElementCandidate,
} from "./classify-element-candidate";

import {
  findOverlappingLayoutObservations,
  findOverlappingTextCandidates,
} from "./element-overlap";

import type {
  ElementizationResult,
  ElementizationPass,
  ExtractedComponent,
} from "./elementization.types";

export async function runElementizationPass(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  jobId: string;
  userId: string;

  sourceObservationBundleAssetId: string;

  observationBundle: AiObservationBundle;
}): Promise<ElementizationResult> {
  const observations = Object.values(
    input.observationBundle.observations
  );

  const rgbaLayerObservations = observations.filter(
    (obs): obs is AiRgbaLayerObservation => obs.kind === "rgba_layer"
  );

  const maskObservations = observations.filter(
    (obs): obs is AiMaskObservation => obs.kind === "mask"
  );

  const textCandidates = observations.filter(
    (obs): obs is AiTextCandidateObservation =>
      obs.kind === "text_candidate"
  );

  const layoutObservations = observations.filter(
    (obs): obs is AiLayoutObservation => obs.kind === "layout"
  );

  const extractionSources = [
    ...rgbaLayerObservations
      .slice(0, MAGIC_LAYERS_ELEMENTIZATION_POLICY.maxSources.rgbaLayers)
      .map((obs) => ({
        observationId: obs.id,
        kind: "rgba_layer" as const,
        assetId: obs.rgbaAssetId,
        bbox: obs.bbox,
      })),

    ...maskObservations
      .slice(0, MAGIC_LAYERS_ELEMENTIZATION_POLICY.maxSources.masks)
      .filter((obs) => Boolean(obs.maskAssetId))
      .map((obs) => ({
        observationId: obs.id,
        kind: "mask" as const,
        assetId: obs.maskAssetId!,
        bbox: obs.bbox,
      })),
  ];

  const tempDir = await fs.mkdtemp(
    path.join(os.tmpdir(), `ml-elementize-${input.jobId}-`)
  );

  const sourceSpecs = [];

  for (const source of extractionSources) {
    const asset = input.observationBundle.assets[source.assetId];

    if (!asset) continue;

    const buffer = await downloadAssetBuffer(asset);

    const localPath = path.join(
      tempDir,
      `${source.observationId}.png`
    );

    await fs.writeFile(localPath, buffer);

    sourceSpecs.push({
      observationId: source.observationId,
      kind: source.kind,
      localPath,
      bbox: source.bbox,
    });
  }

  const pythonInputPath = path.join(tempDir, "input.json");
  const pythonOutputPath = path.join(tempDir, "output.json");

  await fs.writeFile(
    pythonInputPath,
    JSON.stringify(
      {
        jobId: input.jobId,
        canvas: input.observationBundle.canvas,
        sources: sourceSpecs,
        policy: {
          alphaThreshold:
            MAGIC_LAYERS_ELEMENTIZATION_POLICY.componentExtraction.alphaThreshold,
          maskThreshold:
            MAGIC_LAYERS_ELEMENTIZATION_POLICY.componentExtraction.maskThreshold,
          connectivity:
            MAGIC_LAYERS_ELEMENTIZATION_POLICY.componentExtraction.connectivity,
          useMorphology:
            MAGIC_LAYERS_ELEMENTIZATION_POLICY.componentExtraction.useMorphology,
          openingKernelSize:
            MAGIC_LAYERS_ELEMENTIZATION_POLICY.componentExtraction.openingKernelSize,
          closingKernelSize:
            MAGIC_LAYERS_ELEMENTIZATION_POLICY.componentExtraction.closingKernelSize,
          minComponentAreaPx:
            MAGIC_LAYERS_ELEMENTIZATION_POLICY.minComponentAreaPx,
          minComponentAreaRatio:
            MAGIC_LAYERS_ELEMENTIZATION_POLICY.minComponentAreaRatio,
          maxComponentsPerSource:
            MAGIC_LAYERS_ELEMENTIZATION_POLICY.maxComponentsPerSource,
        },
      },
      null,
      2
    )
  );

  await runPythonElementizer({
    inputPath: pythonInputPath,
    outputPath: pythonOutputPath,
  });

  const rawOutput = JSON.parse(
    await fs.readFile(pythonOutputPath, "utf8")
  ) as {
    components: ExtractedComponent[];
    warnings: unknown[];
  };

  const newAssets: Record<string, AiAssetRef> = {
    ...input.observationBundle.assets,
  };

  const componentObservations: AiComponentObservation[] = [];
  const elementCandidateObservations: AiElementCandidateObservation[] = [];

  const newObservations: Record<string, AiObservation> = {};

  let acceptedComponentCount = 0;
  let rejectedDuplicateCount = 0;
  let rejectedTinyCount = 0;

  const seenBBoxes: {
    observationId: string;
    bbox: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number };
  }[] = [];

  for (const component of rawOutput.components) {
    if (
      component.visibleAreaRatio <
      MAGIC_LAYERS_ELEMENTIZATION_POLICY.tinyNoiseAreaRatio
    ) {
      rejectedTinyCount++;
      continue;
    }

    const duplicate = seenBBoxes.find(
      (existing) => bboxIoU(existing.bbox, component.bbox) >
        MAGIC_LAYERS_ELEMENTIZATION_POLICY.duplicateBBoxIoU
    );

    const componentObservationId = `obs_component_${component.id}`;

    const maskAssetId = stableAssetId(
      input.jobId,
      `${component.id}-mask`
    );

    const rgbaAssetId = stableAssetId(
      input.jobId,
      `${component.id}-rgba`
    );

    const maskBuffer = await fs.readFile(component.maskLocalPath!);
    const rgbaBuffer = await fs.readFile(component.rgbaLocalPath!);

    const maskAsset = await writeAiAsset({
      storageRole: "source",
      bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
      storagePath: elementizationComponentMaskPath({
        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        jobId: input.jobId,
        componentId: component.id,
        assetId: maskAssetId,
      }),

      bytes: maskBuffer,

      assetId: maskAssetId,
      kind: "component_mask_png" as any,

      contentType: "image/png",

      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,

      width: component.bbox.width,
      height: component.bbox.height,

      source: "connected_components",

      schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

      cacheControl: "private, max-age=31536000, immutable",
    });

    const rgbaAsset = await writeAiAsset({
      storageRole: "source",
      bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
      storagePath: elementizationComponentRgbaPath({
        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        jobId: input.jobId,
        componentId: component.id,
        assetId: rgbaAssetId,
      }),

      bytes: rgbaBuffer,

      assetId: rgbaAssetId,
      kind: "component_rgba_crop_png" as any,

      contentType: "image/png",

      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,

      width: component.bbox.width,
      height: component.bbox.height,

      source: "connected_components",

      schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

      cacheControl: "private, max-age=31536000, immutable",
    });

    newAssets[maskAsset.id] = maskAsset;
    newAssets[rgbaAsset.id] = rgbaAsset;

    const textOverlaps = findOverlappingTextCandidates({
      bbox: component.bbox,
      textCandidates,
    });

    const layoutOverlaps = findOverlappingLayoutObservations({
      bbox: component.bbox,
      layouts: layoutObservations,
    });

    const componentObservation: AiComponentObservation = {
      id: componentObservationId,

      jobId: input.jobId,
      designId: input.designId,

      kind: "component",

      source: "connected_components",

      createdAt: Date.now(),

      sourceObservationId: component.sourceObservationId,

      sourceObservationKind: component.sourceObservationKind,

      componentIndex: component.componentIndex,

      bbox: component.bbox,

      rotatedBBox: component.rotatedBBox,

      polygon: component.polygon,

      contourPointCount: component.contourPointCount,

      maskAssetId: maskAsset.id,

      rgbaAssetId: rgbaAsset.id,

      areaPx: component.areaPx,

      visibleAreaRatio: component.visibleAreaRatio,

      alphaCoverage: component.alphaCoverage,

      meanAlpha: component.meanAlpha,

      aspectRatio: component.aspectRatio,

      solidity: component.solidity,

      extent: component.extent,

      dominantColors: component.dominantColors,

      estimatedColorCount: component.estimatedColorCount,

      flatColorRatio: component.flatColorRatio,

      textureEntropy: component.textureEntropy,

      edgeComplexity: component.edgeComplexity,

      overlapsTextCandidateIds: textOverlaps.map((x) => x.candidate.id),

      overlapsLayoutObservationIds: layoutOverlaps.map((x) => x.layout.id),

      duplicateOfObservationId: duplicate?.observationId,

      confidence: {
        overall: duplicate ? 0.3 : 0.72,
        geometry: 0.75,
        mask: 0.72,
        classification: 0.55,
      },

      warnings: [
        ...(component.warnings ?? []),
        ...(duplicate ? ["duplicate_component_candidate"] : []),
      ],
    };

    componentObservations.push(componentObservation);
    newObservations[componentObservation.id] = componentObservation;

    if (duplicate) {
      rejectedDuplicateCount++;
      continue;
    }

    seenBBoxes.push({
      observationId: componentObservation.id,
      bbox: component.bbox,
    });

    const route =
      input.observationBundle.routing.diagnosis.recommendedRoute;

    const classification = classifyElementCandidate({
      component: componentObservation,
      sourceLayoutTypes: layoutOverlaps.map(
        (x) => x.layout.layerTypeGuess
      ),
      textCandidateOverlapRatio:
        textOverlaps[0]?.ratio ?? 0,
      route,
    });

    const elementObservationId = `obs_element_${component.id}`;

    const areaRatio =
      component.areaPx /
      Math.max(
        1,
        input.observationBundle.canvas.width *
          input.observationBundle.canvas.height
      );

    const elementCandidate: AiElementCandidateObservation = {
      id: elementObservationId,

      jobId: input.jobId,
      designId: input.designId,

      kind: "element_candidate",

      source: "connected_components",

      createdAt: Date.now(),

      elementTypeGuess: classification.elementTypeGuess,

      editableHint: classification.editableHint,

      sourceComponentObservationIds: [componentObservation.id],

      sourceObservationIds: [component.sourceObservationId],

      sourceLayoutObservationIds: layoutOverlaps.map(
        (x) => x.layout.id
      ),

      sourceTextCandidateObservationIds: textOverlaps.map(
        (x) => x.candidate.id
      ),

      bbox: component.bbox,

      rotatedBBox: component.rotatedBBox,

      polygon: component.polygon,

      assets: {
        maskAssetId: maskAsset.id,
        rgbaAssetId: rgbaAsset.id,
      },

      metrics: {
        areaPx: component.areaPx,
        areaRatio,

        aspectRatio: component.aspectRatio,

        alphaCoverage: component.alphaCoverage,

        flatColorRatio: component.flatColorRatio,

        textureEntropy: component.textureEntropy,

        edgeComplexity: component.edgeComplexity,

        estimatedColorCount: component.estimatedColorCount,

        solidity: component.solidity,

        extent: component.extent,

        textOverlapRatio: textOverlaps[0]?.ratio ?? 0,

        layoutOverlapRatio: layoutOverlaps[0]?.ratio ?? 0,

        objectness: classification.confidence,
      },

      grouping: {
        groupCandidateIds: [],
        repeatedPatternCandidate: false,
        mergeCandidateIds: [],
        splitFromObservationId: component.sourceObservationId,
      },

      classification: {
        confidence: classification.confidence,
        reasonCodes: classification.reasonCodes,
        competingTypes: classification.competingTypes,
      },

      downstream: classification.downstream,

      confidence: {
        overall: classification.confidence,
        classification: classification.confidence,
        geometry: componentObservation.confidence?.geometry ?? 0.75,
        mask: componentObservation.confidence?.mask ?? 0.72,
      },

      warnings: classification.downstream.needsReview
        ? ["element_candidate_needs_review"]
        : [],
    };

    elementCandidateObservations.push(elementCandidate);
    newObservations[elementCandidate.id] = elementCandidate;

    acceptedComponentCount++;
  }

  /**
   * Protect Step 10 text candidates by also creating direct text-region element candidates
   * when OCR grouping produced text candidates that did not overlap a component well.
   */
  for (const textCandidate of textCandidates) {
    const alreadyCovered = elementCandidateObservations.some(
      (element) =>
        element.sourceTextCandidateObservationIds.includes(
          textCandidate.id
        )
    );

    if (alreadyCovered) continue;

    const elementObservationId = `obs_element_from_${textCandidate.id}`;

    const textElement: AiElementCandidateObservation = {
      id: elementObservationId,

      jobId: input.jobId,
      designId: input.designId,

      kind: "element_candidate",

      source: "text_style_estimator",

      createdAt: Date.now(),

      elementTypeGuess: "text_region",

      editableHint: "likely_text",

      sourceComponentObservationIds: [],

      sourceObservationIds: [textCandidate.id],

      sourceLayoutObservationIds:
        textCandidate.sourceLayoutObservationIds,

      sourceTextCandidateObservationIds: [textCandidate.id],

      bbox: textCandidate.bbox,

      assets: {
        fallbackCropAssetId:
          textCandidate.assets.fallbackCropAssetId,
      },

      metrics: {
        areaPx:
          textCandidate.bbox.width * textCandidate.bbox.height,
        areaRatio:
          (textCandidate.bbox.width * textCandidate.bbox.height) /
          Math.max(
            1,
            input.observationBundle.canvas.width *
              input.observationBundle.canvas.height
          ),
        aspectRatio:
          textCandidate.bbox.width /
          Math.max(1, textCandidate.bbox.height),
        textOverlapRatio: 1,
        layoutOverlapRatio: 1,
        objectness:
          textCandidate.editability === "candidate_live_text"
            ? 0.92
            : 0.65,
      },

      grouping: {
        groupCandidateIds: [],
        repeatedPatternCandidate: false,
        mergeCandidateIds: [],
      },

      classification: {
        confidence:
          textCandidate.editability === "candidate_live_text"
            ? 0.92
            : 0.65,
        reasonCodes: [
          "protected_text_candidate_from_text_recovery",
        ],
      },

      downstream: {
        eligibleForTextRecovery: true,
        eligibleForVectorization: false,
        eligibleForRasterLayer: true,
        eligibleForBackgroundRepair: false,
        needsReview:
          textCandidate.editability !== "candidate_live_text",
      },

      confidence: {
        overall:
          textCandidate.editability === "candidate_live_text"
            ? 0.92
            : 0.65,
        classification: 0.85,
        textSafety:
          textCandidate.validation.semanticMutationDetected
            ? 0
            : 1,
      },

      warnings:
        textCandidate.editability === "raster_only"
          ? ["text_candidate_raster_only"]
          : [],
    };

    elementCandidateObservations.push(textElement);
    newObservations[textElement.id] = textElement;
  }

  const updatedObservations = {
    ...input.observationBundle.observations,
    ...newObservations,
  };

  const updatedBundle = {
    ...input.observationBundle,

    assets: newAssets,

    observations: updatedObservations,

    counts: {
      ...input.observationBundle.counts,
      total: Object.keys(updatedObservations).length,
    },

    warnings: [
      ...input.observationBundle.warnings,
      ...rawOutput.warnings.map((w) => JSON.stringify(w)),
    ],

    updatedAt: Date.now(),
  };

  const updatedBundleAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "observation-bundle-after-elementization"
  );

  const updatedBundleAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "source",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
    storagePath: observationBundlePath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: updatedBundleAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(
      JSON.stringify(updatedBundle, null, 2),
      "utf8"
    ),

    assetId: updatedBundleAssetId,
    kind: "observation_bundle_json" as any,

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    source: "system",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  const passAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "elementization-pass"
  );

  const elementizationPass: ElementizationPass = {
    schemaVersion: "ai-elementization-pass.v1",

    jobId: input.jobId,
    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    userId: input.userId,

    sourceObservationBundleAssetId:
      input.sourceObservationBundleAssetId,

    outputObservationBundleAssetId:
      updatedBundleAsset.id,

    status:
      rawOutput.warnings.length > 0
        ? "completed_with_warnings"
        : "completed",

    sourceCounts: {
      rgbaLayer: rgbaLayerObservations.length,
      mask: maskObservations.length,
      textCandidate: textCandidates.length,
      layoutText: layoutObservations.filter(
        (obs) => obs.layerTypeGuess === "text"
      ).length,
    },

    componentCounts: {
      extracted: rawOutput.components.length,
      accepted: acceptedComponentCount,
      rejectedTiny: rejectedTinyCount,
      rejectedDuplicate: rejectedDuplicateCount,
      merged: 0,
    },

    elementCandidateCounts: countElementCandidates(
      elementCandidateObservations
    ),

    observationsAdded: {
      total: Object.keys(newObservations).length,
      component: componentObservations.length,
      elementCandidate: elementCandidateObservations.length,
      groupCandidate: 0,
      quality: 0,
    },

    assetsCreated: Object.keys(newAssets).filter(
      (assetId) => !input.observationBundle.assets[assetId]
    ),

    warnings: rawOutput.warnings.map((w) => JSON.stringify(w)),

    createdAt: Date.now(),
  };

  const passAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "source",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
    storagePath: elementizationPassReportPath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: passAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(
      JSON.stringify(elementizationPass, null, 2),
      "utf8"
    ),

    assetId: passAssetId,
    kind: "elementization_pass_json" as any,

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    source: "system",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  return {
    updatedBundle,
    updatedBundleAsset,
    elementizationPass,
    elementizationPassAsset: passAsset,
    componentObservations,
    elementCandidateObservations,
    assets: newAssets,
  };
}

async function runPythonElementizer(input: {
  inputPath: string;
  outputPath: string;
}) {
  const scriptPath =
    process.env.MAGIC_LAYERS_ELEMENTIZER_SCRIPT_PATH ??
    "/app/services/magic-layers-python/elementize_components.py";

  await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    const child = spawn("python3", [
      scriptPath,
      input.inputPath,
      input.outputPath,
    ]);

    let stderr = "";

    child.stderr.on("data", (chunk) => {
      stderr += chunk.toString();
    });

    child.on("close", (code) => {
      if (code === 0) {
        resolve();
      } else {
        reject(
          new Error(
            `Elementizer exited with code ${code}: ${stderr}`
          )
        );
      }
    });
  });
}

function bboxIoU(
  a: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number },
  b: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number }
) {
  const x1 = Math.max(a.x, b.x);
  const y1 = Math.max(a.y, b.y);
  const x2 = Math.min(a.x + a.width, b.x + b.width);
  const y2 = Math.min(a.y + a.height, b.y + b.height);

  const intersection = Math.max(0, x2 - x1) * Math.max(0, y2 - y1);

  const union =
    a.width * a.height + b.width * b.height - intersection;

  return union <= 0 ? 0 : intersection / union;
}

function countElementCandidates(
  observations: AiElementCandidateObservation[]
): ElementizationPass["elementCandidateCounts"] {
  return {
    total: observations.length,
    textRegion: observations.filter(
      (o) => o.elementTypeGuess === "text_region"
    ).length,
    shape: observations.filter(
      (o) => o.elementTypeGuess === "shape"
    ).length,
    rasterSubject: observations.filter((o) =>
      [
        "raster_subject",
        "photo_subject",
        "person",
        "product",
      ].includes(o.elementTypeGuess)
    ).length,
    imageBlock: observations.filter(
      (o) => o.elementTypeGuess === "image_block"
    ).length,
    logoIcon: observations.filter(
      (o) => o.elementTypeGuess === "logo_icon"
    ).length,
    decoration: observations.filter(
      (o) => o.elementTypeGuess === "decoration"
    ).length,
    shadow: observations.filter(
      (o) => o.elementTypeGuess === "shadow"
    ).length,
    unknown: observations.filter(
      (o) => o.elementTypeGuess === "unknown"
    ).length,
  };
}

function stableAssetId(jobId: string, label: string) {
  return `asset_${jobId}_${label}`
    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "_")
    .toLowerCase();
}
```

```ts
import {
  FieldValue,
  getFirestore,
} from "firebase-admin/firestore";

import type {
  ElementizationResult,
} from "./elementization.types";

export async function applyElementizationResult(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  jobId: string;
  result: ElementizationResult;
}) {
  const db = getFirestore();

  const jobRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/aiLayerJobs/${input.jobId}`
  );

  const batch = db.batch();

  const assetsToIndex = [
    input.result.updatedBundleAsset,
    input.result.elementizationPassAsset,
  ];

  for (const asset of assetsToIndex) {
    batch.set(
      db.doc(
        `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/assets/${asset.id}`
      ),
      {
        id: asset.id,

        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        jobId: input.jobId,

        kind: asset.kind,
        storageRole: asset.storageRole,

        bucket: asset.bucket,
        storagePath: asset.storagePath,

        generation: asset.generation,
        metageneration: asset.metageneration,

        mimeType: asset.mimeType,

        width: asset.width,
        height: asset.height,
        sizeBytes: asset.sizeBytes,

        checksum: asset.checksum,

        source: asset.metadata?.source,

        retained: true,

        createdAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      },
      { merge: true }
    );
  }

  batch.update(jobRef, {
    "input.observationBundleAssetId":
      input.result.updatedBundleAsset.id,

    elementization: {
      elementizationPassAssetId:
        input.result.elementizationPassAsset.id,

      outputObservationBundleAssetId:
        input.result.updatedBundleAsset.id,

      sourceCounts:
        input.result.elementizationPass.sourceCounts,

      componentCounts:
        input.result.elementizationPass.componentCounts,

      elementCandidateCounts:
        input.result.elementizationPass.elementCandidateCounts,

      observationsAdded:
        input.result.elementizationPass.observationsAdded,

      assetsCreated:
        input.result.elementizationPass.assetsCreated,

      warnings:
        input.result.elementizationPass.warnings,

      createdAt:
        input.result.elementizationPass.createdAt,
    },

    "progress.percent": 56,
    "progress.label": "Design objects identified",
    "progress.currentStep": "elementizing",

    updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
  });

  await batch.commit();
}
```

---

# 11.19 Merge rules

Step 11 may mark merge candidates, but should rarely perform destructive merges.

Safe merge candidate conditions:

```txt
same source observation
same dominant color family
small components
close distance
similar z-order evidence
not protected text candidate
not photo/image block
```

Examples:

```txt
separate sparkles → decoration group candidate
dot pattern → pattern group candidate
icon fragments → logo_icon merge candidate
small pieces of badge → shape merge candidate
```

Do not merge:

```txt
separate OCR text lines
product + shadow
logo + text
different colors in same badge
photo fragments
unknown components with high uncertainty
```

Better default:

```txt
record mergeCandidateIds
let scene resolver decide
```

---

# 11.20 Split rules

Step 11 may split raw RGBA/mask observations into components.

Safe split:

```txt
disconnected components with meaningful area
flat-color decorations
separate icons
multiple isolated badges
LayerD layer containing independent objects
```

Unsafe split:

```txt
person/body parts
product fragments
photo texture
image block internals
text candidate internals
shadow fragments
transparent soft edges
```

Use layout hints:

```txt
if source layout type = person/product/photo_subject/image_block
  prefer keep-as-one candidate unless disconnected regions are clearly unrelated
```

---

# 11.21 Group candidate rules

Elementization can generate group candidates, but only as metadata.

Safe group candidates:

```txt
repeated small decorations
icon + nearby text candidate
badge shape + text candidate
product + nearby shadow
button shape + text candidate
menu row elements
```

Do not create Fabric groups here.

Output:

```txt
AiGroupCandidateObservation
```

Later Step 16 resolves groups.

---

# 11.22 Candidate classification rules

Elementization should produce **classification guesses**, not final object types.

## `text_region`

Use when:

```txt
overlaps text_candidate
or layout says text
```

But final live text is decided later from Step 10 text candidate.

## `shape`

Use when:

```txt
flatColorRatio high
textureEntropy low
color count low
polygon simple
solid/regular contour
```

Step 12 decides if it becomes vector.

## `image_block`

Use when:

```txt
large rectangular region
high texture
many colors
layout says image_block/photo
```

Step 13 decides if it becomes raster image layer.

## `product/person/photo_subject`

Use when:

```txt
layout semantic label says so
mask/RGBA candidate supports it
texture high or photographic
```

Step 13 turns this into raster layer candidates.

## `logo_icon`

Use when:

```txt
small-to-medium size
flat/vector-like
layout says logo/icon
low color count
compact bbox
```

Step 12 may vectorize, but raster fallback remains mandatory.

## `decoration`

Use when:

```txt
small
flat or semi-flat
repeated or peripheral
not text
not product/photo
```

## `shadow`

Use when:

```txt
soft alpha
low mean alpha
blurred edges
near product/person/object
```

Do not vectorize shadows.

## `unknown`

Use when:

```txt
classification weak
metrics contradictory
overlap ambiguous
objectness low
```

Unknown is acceptable. Fake certainty is not.

---

# 11.23 Elementization acceptance gates

A component can become an element candidate only if:

```txt
area above minimum
bbox inside canvas
mask asset exists
rgba crop asset exists
not duplicate of stronger candidate
not tiny noise
not full-canvas unless background/overlay
has usable geometry
has provenance
has confidence
```

Reject or downgrade if:

```txt
empty mask
alpha coverage too low
bbox area too small
component is mostly transparent
component duplicates existing text candidate
component duplicates stronger mask/RGBA source
component covers almost entire canvas without background role
component comes from photo texture over-splitting
```

---

# 11.24 What Step 11 must not do

Do not add:

```txt
Fabric.Image
Fabric.Textbox
Fabric.Path
AiReconstructedLayer
final editableLevel
final zIndex
final group object
accepted vector path
accepted raster layer
clean background
visual final validation
text safety mutation decision
```

Step 11 does not create user-visible layers.

---

# 11.25 Non-negotiable invariants

Step 11 is valid only if:

```txt
Every output remains an observation.

No final layer is created.

No Fabric JSON is created.

Every component has sourceObservationId.

Every component has canvas_px bbox.

Every component has mask or RGBA asset unless text-protected.

Every element candidate links to component/text/layout observations.

Every element candidate has classification confidence.

Every element candidate has downstream eligibility flags.

Text candidates from Step 10 are protected.

Photo/image-block internals are not aggressively split.

Tiny noise is filtered.

Duplicates are marked or removed.

Raw component assets are stored in GCS.

Firestore stores only summary and pointers.

Updated observation bundle is immutable.

Elementization can complete with warnings.
```

# 11.27 Definition of done

Step 11 is complete when:

```txt
RGBA/mask observations are converted into component observations.

Text candidates are protected as text-region element candidates.

Every meaningful component has bbox, mask, crop, metrics, and provenance.

Every meaningful component has an element_candidate observation.

Element candidates are classified conservatively.

Duplicate/tiny components are filtered or marked.

Component assets are stored in GCS.

Elementization pass report is stored in GCS.

Updated observation bundle is stored in GCS.

Firestore points to the updated observation bundle.

No final layers exist yet.

No Fabric JSON exists yet.
```

Locked Step 11 architecture:

```txt
ObservationBundle
→ component extraction from RGBA/mask/text evidence
→ component observations
→ element_candidate observations
→ optional group candidate observations
→ updated ObservationBundle
→ elementization pass report
→ Firestore pointer update
```

Next is Step 12: **Vector recovery**.

Step 12 stays bounded: vector recovery only creates validated `vector_candidate` observations. No Fabric paths, final editable vectors, or accepted layer decisions happen yet.

# Step 12 — Vector recovery

Step 12 converts **eligible element candidates** into **vector candidate observations**.

The locked rule:

```txt
Vector recovery does not create final vector layers.
Vector recovery creates vector_candidate observations.
The scene resolver later decides whether a candidate becomes vector_editable or raster_fallback.
```

This is important because bad vectorization is worse than a faithful raster layer. A distorted logo, over-complex SVG, or wrong shape color damages trust. Vectorization must be earned through strict eligibility and render validation.

Potrace is useful for binary/monochrome tracing because it transforms bitmaps into smooth scalable vector outputs, but it is GPL-licensed, so production use needs licensing review if distributed or bundled. VTracer is more suitable for colored raster-to-SVG candidates because it is designed to convert JPG/PNG raster images into SVG vector graphics. LIVE confirms the long-term direction: compact, layer-wise, human-editable SVG topology is the right research target, but it should remain behind the same candidate-observation contract rather than becoming your schema. citeturn323368search0turn323368search1turn328171search6

---

## 12.1 What Step 12 owns

Step 12 owns:

```txt
vector eligibility filtering
primitive detection
Potrace-style binary tracing
VTracer-style colored tracing
SVG cleanup/optimization
path complexity measurement
vector render validation
raster fallback linkage
vector_candidate observations
vector recovery report
updated observation bundle
Firestore vector recovery summary
```

Step 12 does **not** own:

```txt
final vector layer acceptance
Fabric Path/Rect/Circle creation
final grouping
final z-order
final visual scene validation
SVG/PSD export
```

Fabric supports Path objects and SVG parsing, so later we can map accepted candidates into `fabric.Path`, `fabric.Rect`, `fabric.Circle`, `fabric.Polygon`, etc. But this step only prepares candidate evidence. Fabric’s `loadSVGFromString` parses an SVG document into Fabric objects, and Fabric `Path` supports SVG serialization, which makes SVG a useful interchange asset—not the canonical truth. citeturn728387search0turn728387search1

---

# 12.2 Why vector recovery is separate from elementization

Elementization says:

```txt
this component looks like a shape / icon / logo / decoration
```

Vector recovery tests:

```txt
can this raster component be represented as a clean editable vector?
```

These are different.

A component can be:

```txt
shape-looking but too noisy
flat but too complex
logo-like but brand-sensitive
simple but OCR text-like
vectorizable but not worth exposing as editable
```

Correct flow:

```txt
element_candidate
→ vector eligibility
→ vector engine
→ SVG/path candidate
→ render validation
→ vector_candidate observation
→ resolver decides later
```

Wrong flow:

```txt
element_candidate
→ SVG
→ Fabric Path immediately
```
