# 12.9 Eligibility rules

A candidate may enter vector recovery only if:

```txt
element_candidate.downstream.eligibleForVectorization = true

element type is:
  shape
  logo_icon
  decoration
  overlay

not:
  text_region
  person
  product
  photo_subject
  image_block
  shadow
  unknown with low confidence

flatColorRatio high enough

textureEntropy low enough

estimatedColorCount within limit

bbox area not tiny

bbox area not near full canvas unless overlay/background-like

fallback raster asset exists
```

This is the core vectorization safety rule:

```txt
Vectorize obvious design primitives.
Do not vectorize semantic photographs, text, or brand-critical logos unless validation is strong.
```

---

# 12.10 Engine decision tree

Use this order:

```txt
1. Primitive detector
2. Potrace
3. VTracer
4. Raster fallback
```

## Primitive detector first

Use when geometry is obvious:

```txt
rectangle
rounded rectangle
circle
ellipse
line
polygon
```

This is better than SVG tracing because the result becomes clean Fabric primitives later.

Example:

```txt
badge circle → fabric.Circle later
button rectangle → fabric.Rect later
divider line → fabric.Line later
star polygon → fabric.Polygon or Path later
```

## Potrace second

Use when:

```txt
binary or monochrome shape
clean mask
low color count
logo/icon-like silhouette
```

Potrace takes bitmap input and outputs scalable vector formats such as SVG/PDF; its own documentation describes the conversion from bitmap to smooth scalable output. It is not the right engine for full-color illustrations. citeturn323368search0

## VTracer third

Use when:

```txt
colored flat component
few dominant colors
icon/illustration/decorative shape
Potrace would lose color information
```

VTracer is designed for raster-to-SVG conversion from JPG/PNG and can handle colored high-resolution scans, unlike binary-only Potrace workflows. citeturn323368search8

## Raster fallback

Use when:

```txt
path count too high
render diff too high
color mismatch too high
component is text-like
component is photo-like
logo vector confidence is weak
```

# 12.12 Vector candidate eligibility helper

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/vector-recovery/vector-eligibility.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiElementCandidateObservation,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_VECTOR_RECOVERY_POLICY,
} from "./vector-recovery-policy";

export function isEligibleForVectorRecovery(
  element: AiElementCandidateObservation
): {
  eligible: boolean;
  reasonCodes: string[];
} {
  const reasons: string[] = [];
  const p = MAGIC_LAYERS_VECTOR_RECOVERY_POLICY;

  if (!element.downstream.eligibleForVectorization) {
    return {
      eligible: false,
      reasonCodes: ["element_not_marked_vector_eligible"],
    };
  }

  if (
    [
      "text_region",
      "person",
      "product",
      "photo_subject",
      "image_block",
      "shadow",
    ].includes(element.elementTypeGuess)
  ) {
    return {
      eligible: false,
      reasonCodes: [`reject_${element.elementTypeGuess}`],
    };
  }

  const areaRatio = element.metrics.areaRatio;

  if (areaRatio < p.minCandidateAreaRatio) {
    return {
      eligible: false,
      reasonCodes: ["area_too_small"],
    };
  }

  if (areaRatio > p.maxCandidateAreaRatio) {
    return {
      eligible: false,
      reasonCodes: ["area_too_large_for_vector_recovery"],
    };
  }

  const flatColorRatio = element.metrics.flatColorRatio ?? 0;
  const textureEntropy = element.metrics.textureEntropy ?? 999;
  const edgeComplexity = element.metrics.edgeComplexity ?? 999;
  const colorCount = element.metrics.estimatedColorCount ?? 999;

  if (flatColorRatio < p.eligibility.minFlatColorRatio) {
    reasons.push("flat_color_ratio_low");
  }

  if (textureEntropy > p.eligibility.maxTextureEntropy) {
    reasons.push("texture_entropy_high");
  }

  if (edgeComplexity > p.eligibility.maxEdgeComplexity) {
    reasons.push("edge_complexity_high");
  }

  if (colorCount > p.eligibility.maxEstimatedColorCountForVTracer) {
    reasons.push("estimated_color_count_too_high");
  }

  return {
    eligible: reasons.length === 0,
    reasonCodes: reasons.length ? reasons : ["vector_eligible"],
  };
}
```

# 12.13 Primitive detection

Primitive detection should run before tracing.

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/vector-recovery/detect-vector-primitive.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiElementCandidateObservation,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_VECTOR_RECOVERY_POLICY,
} from "./vector-recovery-policy";

export type DetectedVectorPrimitive =
  | {
      detected: true;
      primitive:
        | "rect"
        | "rounded_rect"
        | "circle"
        | "ellipse"
        | "line"
        | "polygon";
      confidence: number;
      reasonCodes: string[];
    }
  | {
      detected: false;
      reasonCodes: string[];
    };

export function detectVectorPrimitive(
  element: AiElementCandidateObservation
): DetectedVectorPrimitive {
  const p = MAGIC_LAYERS_VECTOR_RECOVERY_POLICY.primitiveDetection;

  const aspectRatio = element.metrics.aspectRatio;
  const solidity = element.metrics.solidity ?? 0;
  const extent = element.metrics.extent ?? 0;
  const polygonPoints = element.polygon?.length ?? 999;
  const flat = element.metrics.flatColorRatio ?? 0;

  if (
    extent >= p.minRectangularity &&
    solidity >= 0.88 &&
    flat > 0.7
  ) {
    return {
      detected: true,
      primitive: "rect",
      confidence: 0.9,
      reasonCodes: ["high_extent_rectangular_component"],
    };
  }

  const circularity = estimateCircularity({
    area: element.metrics.areaPx,
    bboxWidth: element.bbox.width,
    bboxHeight: element.bbox.height,
  });

  if (
    circularity >= p.minCircularity &&
    aspectRatio > 0.75 &&
    aspectRatio < 1.35
  ) {
    return {
      detected: true,
      primitive: "circle",
      confidence: 0.86,
      reasonCodes: ["high_circularity_component"],
    };
  }

  if (
    circularity >= 0.68 &&
    (aspectRatio <= 0.75 || aspectRatio >= 1.35)
  ) {
    return {
      detected: true,
      primitive: "ellipse",
      confidence: 0.78,
      reasonCodes: ["ellipse_like_component"],
    };
  }

  if (
    (aspectRatio > 8 || aspectRatio < 0.125) &&
    extent > 0.72
  ) {
    return {
      detected: true,
      primitive: "line",
      confidence: 0.8,
      reasonCodes: ["thin_high_aspect_component"],
    };
  }

  if (
    polygonPoints <= p.maxPolygonPoints &&
    polygonPoints >= 3 &&
    flat > 0.65
  ) {
    return {
      detected: true,
      primitive: "polygon",
      confidence: 0.72,
      reasonCodes: ["simple_polygon_component"],
    };
  }

  return {
    detected: false,
    reasonCodes: ["no_simple_primitive_detected"],
  };
}

function estimateCircularity(input: {
  area: number;
  bboxWidth: number;
  bboxHeight: number;
}) {
  const radiusApprox =
    Math.min(input.bboxWidth, input.bboxHeight) / 2;

  const idealArea = Math.PI * radiusApprox * radiusApprox;

  return idealArea > 0
    ? Math.min(1, input.area / idealArea)
    : 0;
}
```

This is intentionally conservative. A rectangle candidate is better as a future `fabric.Rect` than as a noisy SVG path.

# 12.15 SVG/path metrics

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/vector-recovery/vector-metrics.ts
```

```ts
export function computeSvgMetrics(svg: string) {
  const pathCount = (svg.match(/<path\b/g) ?? []).length;

  const dAttributes = [...svg.matchAll(/\sd="([^"]+)"/g)].map(
    (match) => match[1]
  );

  const commandCount = dAttributes.reduce((sum, d) => {
    return sum + (d.match(/[MmLlHhVvCcSsQqTtAaZz]/g) ?? []).length;
  }, 0);

  const pointCount = dAttributes.reduce((sum, d) => {
    return sum + (d.match(/-?\d*\.?\d+/g) ?? []).length / 2;
  }, 0);

  const colorCount = new Set(
    [...svg.matchAll(/#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}/g)].map((m) =>
      m[0].toLowerCase()
    )
  ).size;

  return {
    pathCount,
    commandCount,
    pointCount: Math.round(pointCount),
    estimatedColorCount: colorCount,
    fileSizeBytes: Buffer.byteLength(svg, "utf8"),
  };
}

export function computePathComplexityScore(input: {
  pathCount: number;
  commandCount: number;
  pointCount: number;
  fileSizeBytes: number;
  bboxAreaRatio: number;
}) {
  const pathScore = Math.min(1, input.pathCount / 80);
  const commandScore = Math.min(1, input.commandCount / 3000);
  const pointScore = Math.min(1, input.pointCount / 5000);
  const fileScore = Math.min(1, input.fileSizeBytes / (200 * 1024));

  return (
    pathScore * 0.3 +
    commandScore * 0.3 +
    pointScore * 0.25 +
    fileScore * 0.15
  );
}
```

The SVG path syntax is standardized around the `<path>` element and its path data commands. That makes path-count and command-count good practical complexity proxies before Fabric import. citeturn728387search2turn728387search33

# 12.16 SVG optimization

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/vector-recovery/optimize-svg.ts
```

```ts
import { optimize } from "svgo";

export function optimizeVectorSvg(svg: string): {
  optimizedSvg: string;
  warnings: string[];
} {
  const result = optimize(svg, {
    multipass: true,
    plugins: [
      "preset-default",
      {
        name: "removeDimensions",
        active: false,
      },
      {
        name: "convertPathData",
        params: {
          floatPrecision: 3,
        },
      },
    ],
  });

  if ("data" in result) {
    return {
      optimizedSvg: result.data,
      warnings: [],
    };
  }

  return {
    optimizedSvg: svg,
    warnings: ["svgo_optimization_failed"],
  };
}
```

Keep `viewBox` and coordinate fidelity. Do not let optimization strip geometry required for later Fabric placement.

# 12.17 Vector render validation

Vector candidate validation should render the SVG back to PNG and compare against the source component crop.

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/vector-recovery/validate-vector-render.ts
```

```ts
import sharp from "sharp";

export type VectorRenderValidationMetrics = {
  rgbL1: number;
  maskIoU: number;
  geometryFitScore: number;
};

export async function renderSvgToPng(input: {
  svg: string;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}): Promise<Buffer> {
  return sharp(Buffer.from(input.svg))
    .resize(input.width, input.height, {
      fit: "fill",
    })
    .png()
    .toBuffer();
}

export async function validateVectorRender(input: {
  sourceRgbaBuffer: Buffer;
  renderedVectorPng: Buffer;
}): Promise<VectorRenderValidationMetrics> {
  const source = await sharp(input.sourceRgbaBuffer)
    .ensureAlpha()
    .raw()
    .toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });

  const rendered = await sharp(input.renderedVectorPng)
    .resize(source.info.width, source.info.height, {
      fit: "fill",
    })
    .ensureAlpha()
    .raw()
    .toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });

  let rgbDiff = 0;
  let rgbCount = 0;

  let maskIntersection = 0;
  let maskUnion = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < source.data.length; i += 4) {
    const sourceAlpha = source.data[i + 3] > 16;
    const renderedAlpha = rendered.data[i + 3] > 16;

    if (sourceAlpha && renderedAlpha) {
      maskIntersection++;
    }

    if (sourceAlpha || renderedAlpha) {
      maskUnion++;
    }

    if (sourceAlpha || renderedAlpha) {
      rgbDiff +=
        Math.abs(source.data[i] - rendered.data[i]) / 255 +
        Math.abs(source.data[i + 1] - rendered.data[i + 1]) / 255 +
        Math.abs(source.data[i + 2] - rendered.data[i + 2]) / 255;

      rgbCount += 3;
    }
  }

  const maskIoU = maskUnion > 0 ? maskIntersection / maskUnion : 0;
  const rgbL1 = rgbCount > 0 ? rgbDiff / rgbCount : 1;

  return {
    rgbL1,
    maskIoU,
    geometryFitScore: maskIoU * 0.75 + (1 - rgbL1) * 0.25,
  };
}
```

Render validation is the gate that prevents noisy SVGs from becoming editable vectors.

# 12.18 Engine adapters

## Primitive SVG adapter

```ts
// src/lib/magic-layers/vector-recovery/primitive-vector-engine.ts

import type {
  VectorEngineInput,
  VectorEngineOutput,
} from "./vector-engine.types";

import {
  detectVectorPrimitive,
} from "./detect-vector-primitive";

import {
  computeSvgMetrics,
} from "./vector-metrics";

export async function runPrimitiveVectorEngine(
  input: VectorEngineInput
): Promise<VectorEngineOutput | null> {
  const detected = detectVectorPrimitive(input.element);

  if (!detected.detected) {
    return null;
  }

  const bbox = input.element.bbox;

  const fill =
    input.element.metrics.estimatedColorCount === 1
      ? input.element.classification.reasonCodes.includes("flat_low_texture_shape")
        ? "#000000"
        : "#000000"
      : "#000000";

  let svg = "";

  switch (detected.primitive) {
    case "rect":
      svg = `
        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
             width="${bbox.width}" height="${bbox.height}"
             viewBox="0 0 ${bbox.width} ${bbox.height}">
          <rect x="0" y="0" width="${bbox.width}" height="${bbox.height}" fill="${fill}" />
        </svg>
      `;
      break;

    case "circle": {
      const r = Math.min(bbox.width, bbox.height) / 2;

      svg = `
        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
             width="${bbox.width}" height="${bbox.height}"
             viewBox="0 0 ${bbox.width} ${bbox.height}">
          <circle cx="${bbox.width / 2}" cy="${bbox.height / 2}" r="${r}" fill="${fill}" />
        </svg>
      `;
      break;
    }

    case "ellipse":
      svg = `
        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
             width="${bbox.width}" height="${bbox.height}"
             viewBox="0 0 ${bbox.width} ${bbox.height}">
          <ellipse cx="${bbox.width / 2}" cy="${bbox.height / 2}"
                   rx="${bbox.width / 2}" ry="${bbox.height / 2}" fill="${fill}" />
        </svg>
      `;
      break;

    case "line":
      svg = `
        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
             width="${bbox.width}" height="${bbox.height}"
             viewBox="0 0 ${bbox.width} ${bbox.height}">
          <line x1="0" y1="${bbox.height / 2}"
                x2="${bbox.width}" y2="${bbox.height / 2}"
                stroke="${fill}" stroke-width="${Math.max(1, Math.min(bbox.width, bbox.height))}" />
        </svg>
      `;
      break;

    case "polygon": {
      const points =
        input.element.polygon
          ?.map((p) => `${p.x - bbox.x},${p.y - bbox.y}`)
          .join(" ") ?? "";

      svg = `
        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
             width="${bbox.width}" height="${bbox.height}"
             viewBox="0 0 ${bbox.width} ${bbox.height}">
          <polygon points="${points}" fill="${fill}" />
        </svg>
      `;
      break;
    }

    default:
      return null;
  }

  const metrics = computeSvgMetrics(svg);

  return {
    engine: "primitive_detector",
    svg,
    primitive: detected.primitive,
    fill,
    metrics,
    warnings: detected.reasonCodes,
  };
}
```

The fill color here is deliberately placeholder-level. In production, use the component’s dominant color from Step 11. Do not infer color from SVG output alone.

---

## Potrace adapter

Use Potrace only on binary masks or monochrome crops.

```ts
// src/lib/magic-layers/vector-recovery/potrace-vector-engine.ts

import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import os from "node:os";
import sharp from "sharp";

import type {
  VectorEngineInput,
  VectorEngineOutput,
} from "./vector-engine.types";

import {
  computeSvgMetrics,
} from "./vector-metrics";

export async function runPotraceVectorEngine(
  input: VectorEngineInput
): Promise<VectorEngineOutput | null> {
  if (!input.sourceMaskBuffer) return null;

  const tempDir = await fs.mkdtemp(
    path.join(os.tmpdir(), `ml-potrace-${input.candidateId}-`)
  );

  const pbmPath = path.join(tempDir, "input.pbm");
  const svgPath = path.join(tempDir, "output.svg");

  await sharp(input.sourceMaskBuffer)
    .threshold(128)
    .toFormat("pbm")
    .toFile(pbmPath);

  await runCommand("potrace", [
    pbmPath,
    "--svg",
    "--output",
    svgPath,
  ]);

  const svg = await fs.readFile(svgPath, "utf8");
  const metrics = computeSvgMetrics(svg);

  return {
    engine: "potrace",
    svg,
    primitive: metrics.pathCount > 1 ? "compound_path" : "path",
    metrics,
    warnings: [],
  };
}

function runCommand(command: string, args: string[]) {
  return new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    const child = spawn(command, args);

    let stderr = "";

    child.stderr.on("data", (chunk) => {
      stderr += chunk.toString();
    });

    child.on("close", (code) => {
      if (code === 0) resolve();
      else reject(new Error(`${command} failed: ${stderr}`));
    });
  });
}
```

Licensing note: keep Potrace out of any browser/client bundle. Use it only as a replaceable server-side process after legal review.

---

## VTracer adapter

```ts
// src/lib/magic-layers/vector-recovery/vtracer-vector-engine.ts

import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import os from "node:os";

import type {
  VectorEngineInput,
  VectorEngineOutput,
} from "./vector-engine.types";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_VECTOR_RECOVERY_POLICY,
} from "./vector-recovery-policy";

import {
  computeSvgMetrics,
} from "./vector-metrics";

export async function runVTracerVectorEngine(
  input: VectorEngineInput
): Promise<VectorEngineOutput | null> {
  const tempDir = await fs.mkdtemp(
    path.join(os.tmpdir(), `ml-vtracer-${input.candidateId}-`)
  );

  const inputPath = path.join(tempDir, "input.png");
  const outputPath = path.join(tempDir, "output.svg");

  await fs.writeFile(inputPath, input.sourceRgbaBuffer);

  const p = MAGIC_LAYERS_VECTOR_RECOVERY_POLICY.vtracer;

  await runCommand("vtracer", [
    "--input",
    inputPath,
    "--output",
    outputPath,
    "--colormode",
    "color",
    "--hierarchical",
    "stacked",
    "--filter_speckle",
    String(p.filterSpeckle),
    "--color_precision",
    String(p.colorPrecision),
    "--corner_threshold",
    String(p.cornerThreshold),
    "--segment_length",
    String(p.segmentLength),
    "--splice_threshold",
    String(p.spliceThreshold),
  ]);

  const svg = await fs.readFile(outputPath, "utf8");
  const metrics = computeSvgMetrics(svg);

  return {
    engine: "vtracer",
    svg,
    primitive: metrics.pathCount > 1 ? "compound_path" : "path",
    metrics,
    warnings: [],
  };
}

function runCommand(command: string, args: string[]) {
  return new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    const child = spawn(command, args);

    let stderr = "";

    child.stderr.on("data", (chunk) => {
      stderr += chunk.toString();
    });

    child.on("close", (code) => {
      if (code === 0) resolve();
      else reject(new Error(`${command} failed: ${stderr}`));
    });
  });
}
```

Keep engine adapters behind process boundaries. That lets you swap VTracer, Potrace, LIVE-style research models, or proprietary vectorizers without changing the reconstruction schema.

# 12.19 Vector candidate validation decision

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/vector-recovery/evaluate-vector-candidate.ts
```

```ts
import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_VECTOR_RECOVERY_POLICY,
} from "./vector-recovery-policy";

export function evaluateVectorCandidate(input: {
  pathCount: number;
  commandCount: number;
  pointCount: number;
  fileSizeBytes: number;
  pathComplexityScore: number;

  renderMaskIoU: number;
  renderRgbL1: number;
  geometryFitScore: number;

  isLogoLike: boolean;
}) {
  const p = MAGIC_LAYERS_VECTOR_RECOVERY_POLICY;
  const failures: string[] = [];

  if (input.pathComplexityScore > p.optimization.maxPathComplexityScore) {
    failures.push("path_complexity_too_high");
  }

  if (input.fileSizeBytes > p.optimization.maxOptimizedSvgBytes) {
    failures.push("optimized_svg_too_large");
  }

  if (input.renderMaskIoU < p.validation.minMaskIoUForVectorEditable) {
    failures.push("render_mask_iou_low");
  }

  if (input.renderRgbL1 > p.validation.maxRgbL1ForVectorEditable) {
    failures.push("render_rgb_l1_high");
  }

  if (input.geometryFitScore < p.validation.minGeometryFitScore) {
    failures.push("geometry_fit_low");
  }

  if (input.isLogoLike && failures.length > 0) {
    failures.push("logo_like_candidate_requires_stronger_validation");
  }

  const confidence =
    (1 - input.pathComplexityScore) * 0.25 +
    input.renderMaskIoU * 0.35 +
    (1 - input.renderRgbL1) * 0.25 +
    input.geometryFitScore * 0.15;

  const passed =
    failures.length === 0 &&
    confidence >= p.validation.minOverallVectorConfidence;

  return {
    passed,
    confidence,
    failureReasons: failures,
    recommendedFallback: passed
      ? "vector_editable"
      : confidence >= 0.62
        ? "manual_review"
        : "raster_fallback",
  } as const;
}
```

For logo-like candidates, be stricter. Bad logo vectorization is brand damage.

# 12.20 Vector recovery runner

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/vector-recovery/run-vector-recovery-pass.ts
```

```ts
import {
  AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,
  AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
} from "../schema/constants";

import type {
  AiElementCandidateObservation,
  AiObservation,
  AiVectorCandidateObservation,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import type {
  AiObservationBundle,
} from "../observations/observation-bundle.types";

import {
  bucketForMagicStorageRole,
} from "../storage/storage-buckets";

import {
  observationBundlePath,
  vectorRecoveryOptimizedSvgPath,
  vectorRecoveryPassReportPath,
  vectorRecoveryRawSvgPath,
  vectorRecoveryRenderPreviewPath,
} from "../storage/storage-paths";

import {
  writeAiAsset,
} from "../storage/write-ai-asset";

import {
  downloadAssetBuffer,
} from "../storage/download-ai-asset";

import {
  isEligibleForVectorRecovery,
} from "./vector-eligibility";

import {
  runPrimitiveVectorEngine,
} from "./primitive-vector-engine";

import {
  runPotraceVectorEngine,
} from "./potrace-vector-engine";

import {
  runVTracerVectorEngine,
} from "./vtracer-vector-engine";

import {
  optimizeVectorSvg,
} from "./optimize-svg";

import {
  computePathComplexityScore,
  computeSvgMetrics,
} from "./vector-metrics";

import {
  renderSvgToPng,
  validateVectorRender,
} from "./validate-vector-render";

import {
  evaluateVectorCandidate,
} from "./evaluate-vector-candidate";

import type {
  VectorRecoveryPass,
  VectorRecoveryResult,
} from "./vector-recovery.types";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_VECTOR_RECOVERY_POLICY,
} from "./vector-recovery-policy";

export async function runVectorRecoveryPass(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  jobId: string;
  userId: string;

  sourceObservationBundleAssetId: string;

  observationBundle: AiObservationBundle;
}): Promise<VectorRecoveryResult> {
  const observations = Object.values(input.observationBundle.observations);

  const elementCandidates = observations.filter(
    (obs): obs is AiElementCandidateObservation =>
      obs.kind === "element_candidate"
  );

  const eligibleElements = elementCandidates
    .map((element) => ({
      element,
      eligibility: isEligibleForVectorRecovery(element),
    }))
    .filter((x) => x.eligibility.eligible)
    .slice(0, MAGIC_LAYERS_VECTOR_RECOVERY_POLICY.maxVectorCandidates);

  const newAssets = {
    ...input.observationBundle.assets,
  };

  const newObservations: Record<string, AiObservation> = {};
  const vectorCandidateObservations: AiVectorCandidateObservation[] = [];

  let attempted = 0;
  let primitiveCount = 0;
  let potraceCount = 0;
  let vtracerCount = 0;
  let failedCount = 0;
  let skipped = elementCandidates.length - eligibleElements.length;

  const warnings: string[] = [];

  for (let index = 0; index < eligibleElements.length; index++) {
    const element = eligibleElements[index].element;

    const candidateId = `vector_candidate_${String(index).padStart(3, "0")}`;

    const sourceRgbaAssetId = element.assets.rgbaAssetId;
    const sourceMaskAssetId = element.assets.maskAssetId;

    if (!sourceRgbaAssetId) {
      skipped++;
      warnings.push(`missing_rgba_asset_for_${element.id}`);
      continue;
    }

    const sourceRgbaAsset =
      input.observationBundle.assets[sourceRgbaAssetId];

    const sourceMaskAsset = sourceMaskAssetId
      ? input.observationBundle.assets[sourceMaskAssetId]
      : undefined;

    if (!sourceRgbaAsset) {
      skipped++;
      warnings.push(`source_rgba_asset_not_found_${sourceRgbaAssetId}`);
      continue;
    }

    const sourceRgbaBuffer = await downloadAssetBuffer(sourceRgbaAsset);

    const sourceMaskBuffer = sourceMaskAsset
      ? await downloadAssetBuffer(sourceMaskAsset)
      : undefined;

    attempted++;

    let engineOutput =
      await runPrimitiveVectorEngine({
        candidateId,
        element,
        sourceRgbaBuffer,
        sourceMaskBuffer,
        canvas: input.observationBundle.canvas,
      });

    if (engineOutput) {
      primitiveCount++;
    }

    if (!engineOutput && sourceMaskBuffer) {
      try {
        engineOutput = await runPotraceVectorEngine({
          candidateId,
          element,
          sourceRgbaBuffer,
          sourceMaskBuffer,
          canvas: input.observationBundle.canvas,
        });

        if (engineOutput) potraceCount++;
      } catch (error) {
        warnings.push(`potrace_failed_${element.id}`);
      }
    }

    if (!engineOutput) {
      try {
        engineOutput = await runVTracerVectorEngine({
          candidateId,
          element,
          sourceRgbaBuffer,
          sourceMaskBuffer,
          canvas: input.observationBundle.canvas,
        });

        if (engineOutput) vtracerCount++;
      } catch (error) {
        warnings.push(`vtracer_failed_${element.id}`);
      }
    }

    if (!engineOutput) {
      failedCount++;
      continue;
    }

    const rawSvgAssetId = stableAssetId(
      input.jobId,
      `${candidateId}-raw-svg`
    );

    const rawSvgAsset = await writeAiAsset({
      storageRole: "source",
      bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
      storagePath: vectorRecoveryRawSvgPath({
        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        jobId: input.jobId,
        candidateId,
        assetId: rawSvgAssetId,
      }),

      bytes: Buffer.from(engineOutput.svg, "utf8"),

      assetId: rawSvgAssetId,
      kind: "vector_candidate_svg" as any,

      contentType: "image/svg+xml",

      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,

      source: "vectorizer",

      schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

      sourceAssetId: sourceRgbaAsset.id,

      cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
    });

    newAssets[rawSvgAsset.id] = rawSvgAsset;

    const optimized = optimizeVectorSvg(engineOutput.svg);

    const optimizedSvgMetrics = computeSvgMetrics(
      optimized.optimizedSvg
    );

    const optimizedSvgAssetId = stableAssetId(
      input.jobId,
      `${candidateId}-optimized-svg`
    );

    const optimizedSvgAsset = await writeAiAsset({
      storageRole: "source",
      bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
      storagePath: vectorRecoveryOptimizedSvgPath({
        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        jobId: input.jobId,
        candidateId,
        assetId: optimizedSvgAssetId,
      }),

      bytes: Buffer.from(optimized.optimizedSvg, "utf8"),

      assetId: optimizedSvgAssetId,
      kind: "vector_candidate_optimized_svg" as any,

      contentType: "image/svg+xml",

      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,

      source: "vectorizer",

      schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

      sourceAssetId: rawSvgAsset.id,

      cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
    });

    newAssets[optimizedSvgAsset.id] = optimizedSvgAsset;

    const renderedPng = await renderSvgToPng({
      svg: optimized.optimizedSvg,
      width: element.bbox.width,
      height: element.bbox.height,
    });

    const renderMetrics = await validateVectorRender({
      sourceRgbaBuffer,
      renderedVectorPng: renderedPng,
    });

    const renderAssetId = stableAssetId(
      input.jobId,
      `${candidateId}-render`
    );

    const renderAsset = await writeAiAsset({
      storageRole: "source",
      bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
      storagePath: vectorRecoveryRenderPreviewPath({
        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        jobId: input.jobId,
        candidateId,
        assetId: renderAssetId,
      }),

      bytes: renderedPng,

      assetId: renderAssetId,
      kind: "vector_candidate_render_png" as any,

      contentType: "image/png",

      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,

      width: element.bbox.width,
      height: element.bbox.height,

      source: "visual_validator",

      schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

      sourceAssetId: optimizedSvgAsset.id,

      cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
    });

    newAssets[renderAsset.id] = renderAsset;

    const bboxAreaRatio =
      (element.bbox.width * element.bbox.height) /
      Math.max(
        1,
        input.observationBundle.canvas.width *
          input.observationBundle.canvas.height
      );

    const pathComplexityScore = computePathComplexityScore({
      pathCount: optimizedSvgMetrics.pathCount,
      commandCount: optimizedSvgMetrics.commandCount,
      pointCount: optimizedSvgMetrics.pointCount,
      fileSizeBytes: optimizedSvgMetrics.fileSizeBytes,
      bboxAreaRatio,
    });

    const evaluation = evaluateVectorCandidate({
      pathCount: optimizedSvgMetrics.pathCount,
      commandCount: optimizedSvgMetrics.commandCount,
      pointCount: optimizedSvgMetrics.pointCount,
      fileSizeBytes: optimizedSvgMetrics.fileSizeBytes,
      pathComplexityScore,
      renderMaskIoU: renderMetrics.maskIoU,
      renderRgbL1: renderMetrics.rgbL1,
      geometryFitScore: renderMetrics.geometryFitScore,
      isLogoLike: element.elementTypeGuess === "logo_icon",
    });

    const vectorObservation: AiVectorCandidateObservation = {
      id: `obs_${candidateId}`,

      jobId: input.jobId,
      designId: input.designId,

      kind: "vector_candidate",

      source: "vectorizer",

      createdAt: Date.now(),

      sourceElementCandidateId: element.id,

      sourceComponentObservationIds:
        element.sourceComponentObservationIds,

      sourceAssetIds: [
        sourceRgbaAsset.id,
        ...(sourceMaskAsset ? [sourceMaskAsset.id] : []),
      ],

      engine: engineOutput.engine,

      primitive: engineOutput.primitive,

      bbox: element.bbox,

      rotatedBBox: element.rotatedBBox,

      pathData: engineOutput.pathData,

      points: engineOutput.points,

      svgAssetId: rawSvgAsset.id,

      optimizedSvgAssetId: optimizedSvgAsset.id,

      renderedPreviewAssetId: renderAsset.id,

      fallbackRasterAssetId: sourceRgbaAsset.id,

      fill: engineOutput.fill,

      stroke: engineOutput.stroke,

      strokeWidth: engineOutput.strokeWidth,

      metrics: {
        pathCount: optimizedSvgMetrics.pathCount,
        commandCount: optimizedSvgMetrics.commandCount,
        pointCount: optimizedSvgMetrics.pointCount,
        fileSizeBytes: optimizedSvgMetrics.fileSizeBytes,
        estimatedColorCount: optimizedSvgMetrics.estimatedColorCount,
        flatColorRatio: element.metrics.flatColorRatio,
        textureEntropy: element.metrics.textureEntropy,
        edgeComplexity: element.metrics.edgeComplexity,
        bboxAreaRatio,
        pathComplexityScore,
        simplificationRatio:
          engineOutput.metrics.fileSizeBytes > 0
            ? optimizedSvgMetrics.fileSizeBytes /
              engineOutput.metrics.fileSizeBytes
            : undefined,
      },

      validation: {
        renderAttempted: true,
        renderMaskIoU: renderMetrics.maskIoU,
        renderRgbL1: renderMetrics.rgbL1,
        geometryFitScore: renderMetrics.geometryFitScore,
        passed: evaluation.passed,
        failureReasons: evaluation.failureReasons,
      },

      editability: {
        eligibleForVectorEditable: evaluation.passed,
        needsReview:
          evaluation.recommendedFallback === "manual_review",
        recommendedFallback: evaluation.recommendedFallback,
      },

      confidence: {
        overall: evaluation.confidence,
        vector: evaluation.confidence,
        visualFidelity: 1 - renderMetrics.rgbL1,
        geometry: renderMetrics.geometryFitScore,
        color: 1 - renderMetrics.rgbL1,
        pathSimplicity: 1 - pathComplexityScore,
      },

      warnings: [
        ...optimized.warnings,
        ...engineOutput.warnings,
        ...evaluation.failureReasons,
      ],
    };

    vectorCandidateObservations.push(vectorObservation);
    newObservations[vectorObservation.id] = vectorObservation;

    newObservations[`obs_quality_${candidateId}`] = {
      id: `obs_quality_${candidateId}`,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      designId: input.designId,
      kind: "quality",
      source: "visual_validator",
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      target: "vector",
      targetId: vectorObservation.id,
      metrics: {
        rgbL1: renderMetrics.rgbL1,
        maskIoU: renderMetrics.maskIoU,
        renderDiff: renderMetrics.rgbL1,
      },
      passed: evaluation.passed,
      confidence: {
        overall: evaluation.confidence,
        visualFidelity: 1 - renderMetrics.rgbL1,
        vector: evaluation.confidence,
      },
    };
  }

  const updatedObservations = {
    ...input.observationBundle.observations,
    ...newObservations,
  };

  const updatedBundle = {
    ...input.observationBundle,
    assets: newAssets,
    observations: updatedObservations,
    counts: {
      ...input.observationBundle.counts,
      total: Object.keys(updatedObservations).length,
      vectorCandidate:
        Object.values(updatedObservations).filter(
          (obs) => obs.kind === "vector_candidate"
        ).length,
      quality:
        Object.values(updatedObservations).filter(
          (obs) => obs.kind === "quality"
        ).length,
    },
    warnings: [
      ...input.observationBundle.warnings,
      ...warnings,
    ],
    updatedAt: Date.now(),
  };

  const updatedBundleAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "observation-bundle-after-vector-recovery"
  );

  const updatedBundleAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "source",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
    storagePath: observationBundlePath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: updatedBundleAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(
      JSON.stringify(updatedBundle, null, 2),
      "utf8"
    ),

    assetId: updatedBundleAssetId,
    kind: "observation_bundle_json" as any,

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    source: "system",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  const passAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "vector-recovery-pass"
  );

  const vectorRecoveryPass: VectorRecoveryPass = {
    schemaVersion: "ai-vector-recovery-pass.v1",

    jobId: input.jobId,
    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    userId: input.userId,

    sourceObservationBundleAssetId:
      input.sourceObservationBundleAssetId,

    outputObservationBundleAssetId:
      updatedBundleAsset.id,

    status:
      warnings.length > 0
        ? "completed_with_warnings"
        : "completed",

    candidateCounts: {
      eligibleElements: eligibleElements.length,
      attempted,
      vectorCandidate: vectorCandidateObservations.filter(
        (obs) => obs.editability.eligibleForVectorEditable
      ).length,
      needsReview: vectorCandidateObservations.filter(
        (obs) => obs.editability.needsReview
      ).length,
      rasterFallback: vectorCandidateObservations.filter(
        (obs) =>
          obs.editability.recommendedFallback === "raster_fallback"
      ).length,
      skipped,
    },

    engineCounts: {
      primitiveDetector: primitiveCount,
      potrace: potraceCount,
      vtracer: vtracerCount,
      failed: failedCount,
    },

    observationsAdded: {
      total: Object.keys(newObservations).length,
      vectorCandidate: vectorCandidateObservations.length,
      quality: Object.values(newObservations).filter(
        (obs) => obs.kind === "quality"
      ).length,
    },

    assetsCreated: Object.keys(newAssets).filter(
      (assetId) => !input.observationBundle.assets[assetId]
    ),

    warnings,

    createdAt: Date.now(),
  };

  const passAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "source",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
    storagePath: vectorRecoveryPassReportPath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: passAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(
      JSON.stringify(vectorRecoveryPass, null, 2),
      "utf8"
    ),

    assetId: passAssetId,
    kind: "vector_recovery_pass_json" as any,

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    source: "system",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  return {
    updatedBundle,
    updatedBundleAsset,
    vectorRecoveryPass,
    vectorRecoveryPassAsset: passAsset,
    vectorCandidateObservations,
    assets: newAssets,
  };
}

function stableAssetId(jobId: string, label: string) {
  return `asset_${jobId}_${label}`
    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "_")
    .toLowerCase();
}
```

Remove `as any` once the asset enum is patched.

# 12.21 Firestore patch

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/vector-recovery/apply-vector-recovery-result.ts
```

```ts
import {
  FieldValue,
  getFirestore,
} from "firebase-admin/firestore";

import type {
  VectorRecoveryResult,
} from "./vector-recovery.types";

export async function applyVectorRecoveryResult(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  jobId: string;
  result: VectorRecoveryResult;
}) {
  const db = getFirestore();

  const jobRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/aiLayerJobs/${input.jobId}`
  );

  const batch = db.batch();

  const assetsToIndex = [
    input.result.updatedBundleAsset,
    input.result.vectorRecoveryPassAsset,
  ];

  for (const asset of assetsToIndex) {
    batch.set(
      db.doc(
        `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/assets/${asset.id}`
      ),
      {
        id: asset.id,

        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        jobId: input.jobId,

        kind: asset.kind,
        storageRole: asset.storageRole,

        bucket: asset.bucket,
        storagePath: asset.storagePath,

        generation: asset.generation,
        metageneration: asset.metageneration,

        mimeType: asset.mimeType,

        width: asset.width,
        height: asset.height,
        sizeBytes: asset.sizeBytes,

        checksum: asset.checksum,

        source: asset.metadata?.source,

        retained: true,

        createdAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      },
      { merge: true }
    );
  }

  batch.update(jobRef, {
    "input.observationBundleAssetId":
      input.result.updatedBundleAsset.id,

    vectorRecovery: {
      vectorRecoveryPassAssetId:
        input.result.vectorRecoveryPassAsset.id,

      outputObservationBundleAssetId:
        input.result.updatedBundleAsset.id,

      candidateCounts:
        input.result.vectorRecoveryPass.candidateCounts,

      engineCounts:
        input.result.vectorRecoveryPass.engineCounts,

      observationsAdded:
        input.result.vectorRecoveryPass.observationsAdded,

      assetsCreated:
        input.result.vectorRecoveryPass.assetsCreated,

      warnings:
        input.result.vectorRecoveryPass.warnings,

      createdAt:
        input.result.vectorRecoveryPass.createdAt,
    },

    "progress.percent": 64,
    "progress.label": "Vector candidates recovered",
    "progress.currentStep": "vectorizing",

    updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
  });

  await batch.commit();
}
```

Firestore stores only summary and pointers.

# 12.23 Candidate promotion rules

Step 12 does not promote candidates to final layers, but it marks promotion eligibility.

## Can become `vector_editable` later only if:

```txt
editability.eligibleForVectorEditable = true

validation.passed = true

fallbackRasterAssetId exists

pathComplexityScore acceptable

renderMaskIoU acceptable

renderRgbL1 acceptable

not a protected text region

not a photographic object

not a weak logo vectorization

optimizedSvgAssetId exists
```

## Must become raster fallback later when:

```txt
path count too high
command count too high
file size too high
render diff too high
mask IoU too low
component is logo-like but validation is weak
component is photo-like
component is text-like
```

## Needs review when:

```txt
visual match acceptable but path complexity high
logo/icon candidate is plausible but not strong
color mismatch small but visible
primitive detection and tracing disagree
```

This is the product-quality rule:

```txt
Do not expose a vector just because an SVG exists.
Expose it only when it is simpler, faithful, and useful.
```

---

# 12.24 Fabric mapping later

Accepted vector candidates will map later as:

```txt
primitive rect          → fabric.Rect
primitive rounded_rect  → fabric.Rect with rx/ry
primitive circle        → fabric.Circle
primitive ellipse       → fabric.Ellipse
primitive line          → fabric.Line
primitive polygon       → fabric.Polygon
path / compound_path    → fabric.Path or Fabric SVG import result
```

Do not store Fabric object data in Step 12. Store:

```txt
primitive
pathData
points
svgAssetId
optimizedSvgAssetId
bbox
validation
fallbackRasterAssetId
```

The final Fabric mapping belongs to Step 18.

---

# 12.25 Long-term vector strategy

Day-one:

```txt
primitive detector
Potrace for binary masks
VTracer for low-color components
SVGO cleanup
render validation
raster fallback
```

Long-term:

```txt
LIVE-style layer-wise vectorization
semantic simplification
font-aware logo/wordmark handling
path editability scoring
manual path simplification UI
user correction dataset
```

LIVE and newer semantic layered vectorization research both point toward compact, layered, human-editable vector forms rather than brute-force tracing. But for production, research-grade vectorization should remain a replaceable engine behind the vector_candidate contract. citeturn328171search6turn328171search29

# 12.27 Non-negotiable invariants

Step 12 is valid only if:

```txt
Every output remains an observation.

No final layer is created.

No Fabric JSON is created.

Only eligible element candidates are vectorized.

Text regions are protected.

Photo/image/product/person candidates are not vectorized.

Every vector candidate has raster fallback.

Every vector candidate has render validation metrics.

Every vector candidate has path complexity metrics.

Every vector candidate has provenance.

Every vector candidate uses canvas_px bbox.

Raw SVG and optimized SVG are stored in GCS.

Rendered validation PNG is stored in GCS.

Firestore stores only summary and pointers.

Path complexity can block vector editability.

Render mismatch can block vector editability.

Logo-like candidates require stronger validation.

SVG is treated as candidate asset, not canonical design truth.
```

# 12.29 Definition of done

Step 12 is complete when:

```txt
eligible element candidates are filtered.

primitive detector runs first.

Potrace adapter exists for binary/monochrome masks.

VTracer adapter exists for low-color raster components.

SVG output is optimized.

SVG output is rendered back to PNG.

render-vs-source validation metrics are computed.

path complexity metrics are computed.

vector_candidate observations are appended.

each vector candidate has raster fallback.

updated observation bundle is stored in GCS.

vector recovery pass report is stored in GCS.

Firestore points to the updated observation bundle.

No final vector layer exists yet.

No Fabric object exists yet.
```

→ vector recovery pass report

Step 13 turns mask and RGBA evidence into usable raster-layer candidates while preserving the boundary: these are not final Fabric layers yet.

# Step 13 — Raster layer generation

Step 13 converts eligible object evidence into **raster candidate assets**.

The locked rule:

```txt
Raster layer generation creates raster_candidate observations.
It does not create final layers.
It does not create Fabric objects.
It does not decide final z-order.
```

This is where photo subjects, products, people, image blocks, complex illustrations, shadows, raster text fallbacks, and failed vector candidates become reusable transparent PNG candidates.

PNG is the correct editor asset format here because it supports lossless raster storage and alpha transparency. The current PNG specification explicitly supports truecolor plus alpha, which is exactly what Fabric image layers need for masked cutouts. citeturn388833search2

---

## 13.1 What Step 13 owns

Step 13 owns:

```txt
raster candidate eligibility
mask normalization
RGBA cutout generation
crop-to-bbox generation
editor-resolution asset generation
export-resolution asset generation
mask asset generation
original crop fallback generation
alpha/edge quality metrics
raster_candidate observations
raster generation pass report
updated observation bundle
Firestore raster generation summary
```

Step 13 does **not** own:

```txt
clean background reconstruction
final layer acceptance
final z-order
group resolution
Fabric Image creation
Fabric JSON
full-scene visual validation
PSD/SVG/PDF export
```

Clean background reconstruction is Step 14. Scene acceptance is Step 17. Fabric generation is Step 18.

---

# 13.2 Why raster layer generation is separate

Elementization and decomposition give you evidence:

```txt
component mask
RGBA crop
text fallback crop
layout bbox
vector fallback
SAM/Gemini/BiRefNet mask
LayerD RGBA candidate
```

But the editor needs usable assets:

```txt
transparent PNG
known bbox
known natural asset size
known canvas placement
known alpha quality
known fallback crop
```

So Step 13 turns evidence into stable raster assets without claiming they are final design layers.

Correct:

```txt
element_candidate
→ raster_candidate asset + observation
→ scene resolver later decides final layer strategy
```

Wrong:

```txt
element_candidate
→ Fabric.Image immediately
```

# 13.8 Raster generation policy

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/raster-generation/raster-generation-policy.ts
```

```ts
export const MAGIC_LAYERS_RASTER_GENERATION_POLICY = {
  maxRasterCandidates: 120,

  minAreaRatio: 0.00005,

  maxAreaRatioWithoutBackgroundRole: 0.95,

  editorAsset: {
    maxLongEdge: 2048,
    pngCompressionLevel: 9,
    adaptiveFiltering: true,
  },

  exportAsset: {
    generateNow: true,

    /**
     * Day-one export asset uses normalized canvas resolution.
     * Later, generate export assets from original high-res using inverse transform.
     */
    maxLongEdge: 4096,

    pngCompressionLevel: 9,
    adaptiveFiltering: true,
  },

  mask: {
    threshold: 16,

    preserveSoftAlpha: true,

    minCoverage: 0.001,

    maxCoverageWithoutBackgroundRole: 0.95,

    featherRadiusPx: 0,

    erodePx: 0,

    dilatePx: 0,
  },

  crop: {
    paddingPx: 2,

    shadowPaddingPx: 12,

    minWidth: 2,
    minHeight: 2,
  },

  validation: {
    maxHaloRiskForMasked: 0.45,

    minCropTightness: 0.55,

    minObjectnessForMasked: 0.45,

    allowRectangularImageBlocks: true,

    allowTextRasterFallback: true,
  },
} as const;
```

Day one, do not over-refine masks here. The important thing is to generate stable, auditable raster candidates. Advanced alpha matting can be plugged in later before this step or inside this step under the same output contract.

# 13.9 Eligibility rules

A candidate can enter raster generation when:

```txt
element_candidate.downstream.eligibleForRasterLayer = true
or text_candidate.editability = raster_only / candidate_with_review
or vector_candidate.recommendedFallback = raster_fallback / manual_review
```

Generate raster candidates for:

```txt
person
product
photo_subject
image_block
decoration
shadow
overlay
unknown but useful
text raster fallback
shape/vector fallback
logo/icon raster fallback
```

Do not generate raster candidates for:

```txt
tiny noise
duplicate component
full-canvas candidate unless background/overlay-like
text candidate that already has strong live-text eligibility unless fallback is needed
vector candidate that passed strongly unless fallback is still required
```

Even when text/vector candidates are strong, keep fallback assets. But do not flood the scene resolver with unnecessary visible raster candidates.

---

# 13.10 Alpha and compositing rules

Use **straight alpha PNG** for editor assets.

Do not flatten candidate assets over white, black, transparent black, or reconstructed background.

Correct asset:

```txt
RGBA PNG
RGB = object color
A = object opacity
transparent outside mask
```

Wrong asset:

```txt
object precomposited over white
object precomposited over black
object with black halo around soft edge
full-canvas transparent PNG for every object
```

The W3C compositing spec describes simple alpha compositing with source-over behavior, which is the browser/canvas mental model you should preserve for later rendering. citeturn388833search1

PNG supports alpha channels, so the output format can carry this opacity data directly. citeturn388833search2

---

# 13.11 Raster source priority

Use this priority order:

```txt
1. text_candidate fallback crop
2. vector_candidate fallback raster asset
3. element_candidate component RGBA crop
4. element_candidate component mask + normalized image crop
5. raw RGBA layer observation
6. raw mask observation + normalized image crop
7. rectangular crop from normalized image
```

Meaning:

```txt
text fallback is protected
vector fallback preserves visual truth
RGBA crop is preferred if already good
mask + normalized crop is used when only mask exists
rectangular crop is last resort for image blocks/manual review
```

# 13.13 Core asset generation behavior

Sharp is suitable for this step because it supports region extraction, channel manipulation, alpha channel creation, and PNG output controls. Use `extract` for cropping; Sharp documents `extract` as cropping a region by `left`, `top`, `width`, and `height`. citeturn261680view0 Use `joinChannel` to attach an alpha channel to RGB data; Sharp documents that for sRGB, channel order is red, green, blue, alpha. citeturn261680view2 Use PNG output options for compression and adaptive filtering. citeturn261680view3

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/raster-generation/raster-asset-builder.ts
```

```ts
import sharp from "sharp";

import type {
  BBox,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_RASTER_GENERATION_POLICY,
} from "./raster-generation-policy";

export type BuiltRasterCandidateAssets = {
  editorPng: {
    buffer: Buffer;
    width: number;
    height: number;
  };

  exportPng?: {
    buffer: Buffer;
    width: number;
    height: number;
  };

  maskPng?: {
    buffer: Buffer;
    width: number;
    height: number;
  };

  fallbackCropPng: {
    buffer: Buffer;
    width: number;
    height: number;
  };

  cropBBox: BBox;

  alphaMetrics: {
    coverage: number;
    meanAlpha: number;
    edgeSoftness: number;
    transparentPixelRatio: number;
    haloRisk: number;
    edgeQuality: "high" | "medium" | "low" | "unknown";
    mode:
      | "binary_mask"
      | "soft_alpha"
      | "matte"
      | "rectangular_crop"
      | "source_rgba";
  };
};

export async function buildRasterCandidateAssets(input: {
  normalizedImageBuffer: Buffer;

  bbox: BBox;

  canvasWidth: number;
  canvasHeight: number;

  sourceRgbaBuffer?: Buffer;

  sourceMaskBuffer?: Buffer;

  role:
    | "photo_subject"
    | "person"
    | "product"
    | "image_block"
    | "logo_icon_raster"
    | "text_raster_fallback"
    | "shape_raster_fallback"
    | "decoration"
    | "shadow"
    | "overlay"
    | "unknown";
}): Promise<BuiltRasterCandidateAssets> {
  const cropBBox = paddedBBox({
    bbox: input.bbox,
    canvasWidth: input.canvasWidth,
    canvasHeight: input.canvasHeight,
    paddingPx:
      input.role === "shadow"
        ? MAGIC_LAYERS_RASTER_GENERATION_POLICY.crop.shadowPaddingPx
        : MAGIC_LAYERS_RASTER_GENERATION_POLICY.crop.paddingPx,
  });

  const fallbackCropPng = await extractNormalizedCrop({
    normalizedImageBuffer: input.normalizedImageBuffer,
    cropBBox,
  });

  let rgbaCrop: Buffer;
  let maskPng: BuiltRasterCandidateAssets["maskPng"];
  let alphaMode: BuiltRasterCandidateAssets["alphaMetrics"]["mode"];

  if (input.sourceRgbaBuffer) {
    rgbaCrop = await normalizeRgbaCrop(input.sourceRgbaBuffer);
    maskPng = await extractAlphaMaskFromRgba(rgbaCrop);
    alphaMode = "source_rgba";
  } else if (input.sourceMaskBuffer) {
    const normalizedMask = await normalizeMaskToCrop({
      maskBuffer: input.sourceMaskBuffer,
      width: cropBBox.width,
      height: cropBBox.height,
    });

    maskPng = normalizedMask;

    rgbaCrop = await applyMaskToCrop({
      cropBuffer: fallbackCropPng.buffer,
      maskBuffer: normalizedMask.buffer,
    });

    alphaMode = detectMaskMode(normalizedMask.buffer);
  } else {
    rgbaCrop = await sharp(fallbackCropPng.buffer)
      .ensureAlpha(1)
      .png({
        compressionLevel:
          MAGIC_LAYERS_RASTER_GENERATION_POLICY.editorAsset
            .pngCompressionLevel,
        adaptiveFiltering:
          MAGIC_LAYERS_RASTER_GENERATION_POLICY.editorAsset
            .adaptiveFiltering,
      })
      .toBuffer();

    maskPng = await createOpaqueMask({
      width: fallbackCropPng.width,
      height: fallbackCropPng.height,
    });

    alphaMode = "rectangular_crop";
  }

  const alphaMetrics = await measureAlphaMetrics({
    rgbaBuffer: rgbaCrop,
    mode: alphaMode,
  });

  const editorPng = await resizePngInsideLongEdge({
    buffer: rgbaCrop,
    maxLongEdge:
      MAGIC_LAYERS_RASTER_GENERATION_POLICY.editorAsset.maxLongEdge,
    compressionLevel:
      MAGIC_LAYERS_RASTER_GENERATION_POLICY.editorAsset
        .pngCompressionLevel,
    adaptiveFiltering:
      MAGIC_LAYERS_RASTER_GENERATION_POLICY.editorAsset
        .adaptiveFiltering,
  });

  const exportPng =
    MAGIC_LAYERS_RASTER_GENERATION_POLICY.exportAsset.generateNow
      ? await resizePngInsideLongEdge({
          buffer: rgbaCrop,
          maxLongEdge:
            MAGIC_LAYERS_RASTER_GENERATION_POLICY.exportAsset.maxLongEdge,
          compressionLevel:
            MAGIC_LAYERS_RASTER_GENERATION_POLICY.exportAsset
              .pngCompressionLevel,
          adaptiveFiltering:
            MAGIC_LAYERS_RASTER_GENERATION_POLICY.exportAsset
              .adaptiveFiltering,
        })
      : undefined;

  return {
    editorPng,
    exportPng,
    maskPng,
    fallbackCropPng,
    cropBBox,
    alphaMetrics,
  };
}

function paddedBBox(input: {
  bbox: BBox;
  canvasWidth: number;
  canvasHeight: number;
  paddingPx: number;
}): BBox {
  const x = Math.max(0, Math.floor(input.bbox.x - input.paddingPx));
  const y = Math.max(0, Math.floor(input.bbox.y - input.paddingPx));

  const right = Math.min(
    input.canvasWidth,
    Math.ceil(input.bbox.x + input.bbox.width + input.paddingPx)
  );

  const bottom = Math.min(
    input.canvasHeight,
    Math.ceil(input.bbox.y + input.bbox.height + input.paddingPx)
  );

  return {
    x,
    y,
    width: Math.max(
      MAGIC_LAYERS_RASTER_GENERATION_POLICY.crop.minWidth,
      right - x
    ),
    height: Math.max(
      MAGIC_LAYERS_RASTER_GENERATION_POLICY.crop.minHeight,
      bottom - y
    ),
  };
}

async function extractNormalizedCrop(input: {
  normalizedImageBuffer: Buffer;
  cropBBox: BBox;
}) {
  const {
    data,
    info,
  } = await sharp(input.normalizedImageBuffer, {
    failOn: "warning",
  })
    .extract({
      left: input.cropBBox.x,
      top: input.cropBBox.y,
      width: input.cropBBox.width,
      height: input.cropBBox.height,
    })
    .png({
      compressionLevel: 9,
      adaptiveFiltering: true,
    })
    .toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });

  return {
    buffer: data,
    width: info.width,
    height: info.height,
  };
}

async function normalizeRgbaCrop(buffer: Buffer): Promise<Buffer> {
  return sharp(buffer, { failOn: "warning" })
    .ensureAlpha()
    .png({
      compressionLevel: 9,
      adaptiveFiltering: true,
    })
    .toBuffer();
}

async function normalizeMaskToCrop(input: {
  maskBuffer: Buffer;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}) {
  const {
    data,
    info,
  } = await sharp(input.maskBuffer, { failOn: "warning" })
    .resize(input.width, input.height, {
      fit: "fill",
    })
    .greyscale()
    .png({
      compressionLevel: 9,
      adaptiveFiltering: true,
    })
    .toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });

  return {
    buffer: data,
    width: info.width,
    height: info.height,
  };
}

async function applyMaskToCrop(input: {
  cropBuffer: Buffer;
  maskBuffer: Buffer;
}): Promise<Buffer> {
  /**
   * Remove any existing alpha first; then join mask as the alpha channel.
   */
  return sharp(input.cropBuffer, { failOn: "warning" })
    .removeAlpha()
    .joinChannel(input.maskBuffer)
    .png({
      compressionLevel: 9,
      adaptiveFiltering: true,
    })
    .toBuffer();
}

async function extractAlphaMaskFromRgba(rgbaBuffer: Buffer) {
  const {
    data,
    info,
  } = await sharp(rgbaBuffer, { failOn: "warning" })
    .ensureAlpha()
    .extractChannel("alpha")
    .png({
      compressionLevel: 9,
      adaptiveFiltering: true,
    })
    .toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });

  return {
    buffer: data,
    width: info.width,
    height: info.height,
  };
}

async function createOpaqueMask(input: {
  width: number;
  height: number;
}) {
  const {
    data,
    info,
  } = await sharp({
    create: {
      width: input.width,
      height: input.height,
      channels: 1,
      background: { r: 255, g: 255, b: 255 },
    },
  })
    .png({
      compressionLevel: 9,
      adaptiveFiltering: true,
    })
    .toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });

  return {
    buffer: data,
    width: info.width,
    height: info.height,
  };
}

async function resizePngInsideLongEdge(input: {
  buffer: Buffer;
  maxLongEdge: number;
  compressionLevel: number;
  adaptiveFiltering: boolean;
}) {
  const metadata = await sharp(input.buffer).metadata();

  const width = metadata.width ?? 1;
  const height = metadata.height ?? 1;

  const longEdge = Math.max(width, height);

  const pipeline = sharp(input.buffer, { failOn: "warning" });

  if (longEdge > input.maxLongEdge) {
    pipeline.resize({
      width: input.maxLongEdge,
      height: input.maxLongEdge,
      fit: "inside",
      withoutEnlargement: true,
    });
  }

  const {
    data,
    info,
  } = await pipeline
    .png({
      compressionLevel: input.compressionLevel,
      adaptiveFiltering: input.adaptiveFiltering,
    })
    .toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });

  return {
    buffer: data,
    width: info.width,
    height: info.height,
  };
}

async function measureAlphaMetrics(input: {
  rgbaBuffer: Buffer;
  mode: BuiltRasterCandidateAssets["alphaMetrics"]["mode"];
}): Promise<BuiltRasterCandidateAssets["alphaMetrics"]> {
  const {
    data,
    info,
  } = await sharp(input.rgbaBuffer, { failOn: "warning" })
    .ensureAlpha()
    .raw()
    .toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });

  let visible = 0;
  let alphaSum = 0;
  let soft = 0;
  let transparent = 0;

  for (let i = 3; i < data.length; i += 4) {
    const a = data[i];

    alphaSum += a;

    if (a > 0) visible++;
    if (a === 0) transparent++;
    if (a > 0 && a < 255) soft++;
  }

  const pixelCount = info.width * info.height;

  const coverage = visible / Math.max(1, pixelCount);
  const meanAlpha = alphaSum / Math.max(1, pixelCount * 255);
  const edgeSoftness = soft / Math.max(1, visible);
  const transparentPixelRatio = transparent / Math.max(1, pixelCount);

  /**
   * Heuristic. Later replace with edge RGB decontamination + background-aware halo test.
   */
  const haloRisk =
    input.mode === "rectangular_crop"
      ? 0.8
      : edgeSoftness > 0.25
        ? 0.35
        : 0.18;

  const edgeQuality =
    haloRisk < 0.25
      ? "high"
      : haloRisk < 0.5
        ? "medium"
        : "low";

  return {
    mode: input.mode,
    coverage,
    meanAlpha,
    edgeSoftness,
    transparentPixelRatio,
    haloRisk,
    edgeQuality,
  };
}

function detectMaskMode(
  maskBuffer: Buffer
): BuiltRasterCandidateAssets["alphaMetrics"]["mode"] {
  /**
   * Lightweight default. More exact analysis is in measureAlphaMetrics.
   */
  return "soft_alpha";
}
```

This code intentionally avoids alpha matting hallucination. It normalizes and packages existing mask/RGBA evidence. If a later matte engine improves a mask, it should feed into this same builder.

# 13.14 Candidate selection

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/raster-generation/select-raster-candidates.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiElementCandidateObservation,
  AiTextCandidateObservation,
  AiVectorCandidateObservation,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_RASTER_GENERATION_POLICY,
} from "./raster-generation-policy";

export type RasterGenerationInputCandidate =
  | {
      kind: "element";
      element: AiElementCandidateObservation;
    }
  | {
      kind: "text_fallback";
      textCandidate: AiTextCandidateObservation;
    }
  | {
      kind: "vector_fallback";
      vectorCandidate: AiVectorCandidateObservation;
    };

export function selectRasterGenerationCandidates(input: {
  elementCandidates: AiElementCandidateObservation[];
  textCandidates: AiTextCandidateObservation[];
  vectorCandidates: AiVectorCandidateObservation[];
}): RasterGenerationInputCandidate[] {
  const selected: RasterGenerationInputCandidate[] = [];

  for (const element of input.elementCandidates) {
    if (!element.downstream.eligibleForRasterLayer) continue;

    if (
      element.metrics.areaRatio <
      MAGIC_LAYERS_RASTER_GENERATION_POLICY.minAreaRatio
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    if (
      element.metrics.areaRatio >
        MAGIC_LAYERS_RASTER_GENERATION_POLICY
          .maxAreaRatioWithoutBackgroundRole &&
      !["overlay", "background_fragment"].includes(element.elementTypeGuess)
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    selected.push({
      kind: "element",
      element,
    });
  }

  for (const textCandidate of input.textCandidates) {
    if (
      textCandidate.editability === "raster_only" ||
      textCandidate.editability === "candidate_with_review"
    ) {
      selected.push({
        kind: "text_fallback",
        textCandidate,
      });
    }
  }

  for (const vectorCandidate of input.vectorCandidates) {
    if (
      vectorCandidate.editability.recommendedFallback === "raster_fallback" ||
      vectorCandidate.editability.recommendedFallback === "manual_review"
    ) {
      selected.push({
        kind: "vector_fallback",
        vectorCandidate,
      });
    }
  }

  return selected.slice(
    0,
    MAGIC_LAYERS_RASTER_GENERATION_POLICY.maxRasterCandidates
  );
}
```

import type {
  AiElementCandidateObservation,
  AiRasterCandidateRole,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

export function rasterRoleFromElement(
  element: AiElementCandidateObservation
): AiRasterCandidateRole {
  switch (element.elementTypeGuess) {
    case "person":
      return "person";

    case "product":
      return "product";

    case "photo_subject":
    case "raster_subject":
      return "photo_subject";

    case "image_block":
      return "image_block";

    case "logo_icon":
      return "logo_icon_raster";

    case "text_region":
      return "text_raster_fallback";

    case "shape":
      return "shape_raster_fallback";

    case "decoration":
      return "decoration";

    case "shadow":
      return "shadow";

    case "overlay":
      return "overlay";

    default:
      return "unknown";
  }
}

# 13.16 Evaluation rules

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/raster-generation/evaluate-raster-candidate.ts
```

```ts
import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_RASTER_GENERATION_POLICY,
} from "./raster-generation-policy";

import type {
  AiRasterCandidateObservation,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

export function evaluateRasterCandidate(input: {
  role: AiRasterCandidateObservation["role"];

  alpha: AiRasterCandidateObservation["alpha"];

  metrics: AiRasterCandidateObservation["metrics"];

  hasMask: boolean;

  rectangularCrop: boolean;

  objectness: number;
}) {
  const p = MAGIC_LAYERS_RASTER_GENERATION_POLICY.validation;

  const failureReasons: string[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];

  if (input.alpha.coverage < MAGIC_LAYERS_RASTER_GENERATION_POLICY.mask.minCoverage) {
    failureReasons.push("alpha_coverage_too_low");
  }

  if (
    input.alpha.coverage >
      MAGIC_LAYERS_RASTER_GENERATION_POLICY.mask
        .maxCoverageWithoutBackgroundRole &&
    !["overlay"].includes(input.role)
  ) {
    warnings.push("candidate_covers_most_of_canvas");
  }

  if (input.metrics.cropTightness < p.minCropTightness) {
    warnings.push("crop_not_tight");
  }

  if (input.alpha.haloRisk > p.maxHaloRiskForMasked) {
    warnings.push("alpha_halo_risk");
  }

  if (input.objectness < p.minObjectnessForMasked) {
    warnings.push("objectness_low");
  }

  if (input.rectangularCrop && input.role !== "image_block") {
    warnings.push("rectangular_crop_without_mask");
  }

  const needsReview =
    warnings.length > 0 ||
    input.role === "unknown" ||
    input.rectangularCrop;

  const eligibleForRasterMasked =
    failureReasons.length === 0 &&
    input.hasMask &&
    !input.rectangularCrop;

  const eligibleForRasterFallback =
    failureReasons.length === 0;

  const recommendedStrategy =
    eligibleForRasterMasked && !needsReview
      ? "raster_masked"
      : eligibleForRasterFallback
        ? needsReview
          ? "manual_review"
          : "raster_fallback"
        : "raster_fallback";

  return {
    passed: failureReasons.length === 0,
    failureReasons,
    warnings,
    eligibleForRasterMasked,
    eligibleForRasterFallback,
    needsReview,
    recommendedStrategy,
  } as const;
}
```
