```ts
import {
  AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,
  AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
} from "../schema/constants";

import type {
  AiElementCandidateObservation,
  AiObservation,
  AiRasterCandidateObservation,
  AiTextCandidateObservation,
  AiVectorCandidateObservation,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import type {
  AiObservationBundle,
} from "../observations/observation-bundle.types";

import {
  bucketForMagicStorageRole,
} from "../storage/storage-buckets";

import {
  observationBundlePath,
  rasterCandidateEditorPngPath,
  rasterCandidateExportPngPath,
  rasterCandidateFallbackCropPath,
  rasterCandidateMaskPngPath,
  rasterGenerationPassReportPath,
} from "../storage/storage-paths";

import {
  writeAiAsset,
} from "../storage/write-ai-asset";

import {
  downloadAssetBuffer,
} from "../storage/download-ai-asset";

import {
  buildRasterCandidateAssets,
} from "./raster-asset-builder";

import {
  selectRasterGenerationCandidates,
} from "./select-raster-candidates";

import {
  rasterRoleFromElement,
} from "./raster-role-mapping";

import {
  evaluateRasterCandidate,
} from "./evaluate-raster-candidate";

import type {
  RasterGenerationPass,
  RasterGenerationResult,
} from "./raster-generation.types";

export async function runRasterGenerationPass(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  jobId: string;
  userId: string;

  sourceObservationBundleAssetId: string;

  observationBundle: AiObservationBundle;
}): Promise<RasterGenerationResult> {
  const observations = Object.values(input.observationBundle.observations);

  const elementCandidates = observations.filter(
    (obs): obs is AiElementCandidateObservation =>
      obs.kind === "element_candidate"
  );

  const textCandidates = observations.filter(
    (obs): obs is AiTextCandidateObservation =>
      obs.kind === "text_candidate"
  );

  const vectorCandidates = observations.filter(
    (obs): obs is AiVectorCandidateObservation =>
      obs.kind === "vector_candidate"
  );

  const selected = selectRasterGenerationCandidates({
    elementCandidates,
    textCandidates,
    vectorCandidates,
  });

  const normalizedAsset =
    input.observationBundle.assets[
      input.observationBundle.source.normalizedAssetId
    ];

  const normalizedImageBuffer = await downloadAssetBuffer(normalizedAsset);

  const newAssets = {
    ...input.observationBundle.assets,
  };

  const newObservations: Record<string, AiObservation> = {};
  const rasterCandidateObservations: AiRasterCandidateObservation[] = [];

  let masked = 0;
  let rectangularCrop = 0;
  let textRasterFallback = 0;
  let vectorFallback = 0;
  let needsReview = 0;
  let skipped = 0;

  let totalEditorBytes = 0;
  let totalExportBytes = 0;

  const warnings: string[] = [];

  for (let index = 0; index < selected.length; index++) {
    const candidateId = `raster_candidate_${String(index).padStart(3, "0")}`;

    const prepared = resolveRasterCandidateSource({
      candidate: selected[index],
      observationBundle: input.observationBundle,
    });

    if (!prepared) {
      skipped++;
      warnings.push(`raster_source_missing_${candidateId}`);
      continue;
    }

    const sourceRgbaBuffer = prepared.sourceRgbaAsset
      ? await downloadAssetBuffer(prepared.sourceRgbaAsset)
      : undefined;

    const sourceMaskBuffer = prepared.sourceMaskAsset
      ? await downloadAssetBuffer(prepared.sourceMaskAsset)
      : undefined;

    const built = await buildRasterCandidateAssets({
      normalizedImageBuffer,
      bbox: prepared.bbox,
      canvasWidth: input.observationBundle.canvas.width,
      canvasHeight: input.observationBundle.canvas.height,
      sourceRgbaBuffer,
      sourceMaskBuffer,
      role: prepared.role,
    });

    const editorAssetId = stableAssetId(
      input.jobId,
      `${candidateId}-editor`
    );

    const editorAsset = await writeAiAsset({
      storageRole: "assets",
      bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("assets"),
      storagePath: rasterCandidateEditorPngPath({
        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        jobId: input.jobId,
        candidateId,
        assetId: editorAssetId,
      }),

      bytes: built.editorPng.buffer,

      assetId: editorAssetId,
      kind: "raster_candidate_editor_png" as any,

      contentType: "image/png",

      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,

      width: built.editorPng.width,
      height: built.editorPng.height,

      source: "matting",

      schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

      sourceAssetId:
        prepared.sourceRgbaAsset?.id ??
        prepared.sourceMaskAsset?.id ??
        normalizedAsset.id,

      cacheControl: "private, max-age=31536000, immutable",
    });

    newAssets[editorAsset.id] = editorAsset;
    totalEditorBytes += built.editorPng.buffer.byteLength;

    let exportAssetId: string | undefined;

    if (built.exportPng) {
      exportAssetId = stableAssetId(
        input.jobId,
        `${candidateId}-export`
      );

      const exportAsset = await writeAiAsset({
        storageRole: "assets",
        bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("assets"),
        storagePath: rasterCandidateExportPngPath({
          workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
          designId: input.designId,
          jobId: input.jobId,
          candidateId,
          assetId: exportAssetId,
        }),

        bytes: built.exportPng.buffer,

        assetId: exportAssetId,
        kind: "raster_candidate_export_png" as any,

        contentType: "image/png",

        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        jobId: input.jobId,

        width: built.exportPng.width,
        height: built.exportPng.height,

        source: "matting",

        schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

        sourceAssetId: editorAsset.id,

        cacheControl: "private, max-age=31536000, immutable",
      });

      newAssets[exportAsset.id] = exportAsset;
      totalExportBytes += built.exportPng.buffer.byteLength;
    }

    let maskAssetId: string | undefined;

    if (built.maskPng) {
      maskAssetId = stableAssetId(
        input.jobId,
        `${candidateId}-mask`
      );

      const maskAsset = await writeAiAsset({
        storageRole: "assets",
        bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("assets"),
        storagePath: rasterCandidateMaskPngPath({
          workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
          designId: input.designId,
          jobId: input.jobId,
          candidateId,
          assetId: maskAssetId,
        }),

        bytes: built.maskPng.buffer,

        assetId: maskAssetId,
        kind: "raster_candidate_mask_png" as any,

        contentType: "image/png",

        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        jobId: input.jobId,

        width: built.maskPng.width,
        height: built.maskPng.height,

        source: "matting",

        schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

        sourceAssetId: editorAsset.id,

        cacheControl: "private, max-age=31536000, immutable",
      });

      newAssets[maskAsset.id] = maskAsset;
    }

    const fallbackAssetId = stableAssetId(
      input.jobId,
      `${candidateId}-fallback-crop`
    );

    const fallbackAsset = await writeAiAsset({
      storageRole: "assets",
      bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("assets"),
      storagePath: rasterCandidateFallbackCropPath({
        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        jobId: input.jobId,
        candidateId,
        assetId: fallbackAssetId,
      }),

      bytes: built.fallbackCropPng.buffer,

      assetId: fallbackAssetId,
      kind: "raster_candidate_fallback_crop" as any,

      contentType: "image/png",

      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,

      width: built.fallbackCropPng.width,
      height: built.fallbackCropPng.height,

      source: "system",

      schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

      sourceAssetId: normalizedAsset.id,

      cacheControl: "private, max-age=31536000, immutable",
    });

    newAssets[fallbackAsset.id] = fallbackAsset;

    const cropArea =
      built.cropBBox.width * built.cropBBox.height;

    const canvasArea =
      input.observationBundle.canvas.width *
      input.observationBundle.canvas.height;

    const cropTightness =
      built.alphaMetrics.coverage > 0
        ? Math.min(1, built.alphaMetrics.coverage / 0.92)
        : 0;

    const evaluation = evaluateRasterCandidate({
      role: prepared.role,
      alpha: built.alphaMetrics,
      metrics: {
        areaPx: cropArea,
        areaRatio: cropArea / Math.max(1, canvasArea),
        cropTightness,
        objectness: prepared.objectness,
      },
      hasMask: Boolean(maskAssetId),
      rectangularCrop: built.alphaMetrics.mode === "rectangular_crop",
      objectness: prepared.objectness,
    });

    if (maskAssetId) masked++;
    if (built.alphaMetrics.mode === "rectangular_crop") rectangularCrop++;
    if (prepared.role === "text_raster_fallback") textRasterFallback++;
    if (selected[index].kind === "vector_fallback") vectorFallback++;
    if (evaluation.needsReview) needsReview++;

    const rasterObservation: AiRasterCandidateObservation = {
      id: `obs_${candidateId}`,

      jobId: input.jobId,
      designId: input.designId,

      kind: "raster_candidate",

      source: "matting",

      createdAt: Date.now(),

      role: prepared.role,

      sourceElementCandidateId: prepared.sourceElementCandidateId,

      sourceComponentObservationIds:
        prepared.sourceComponentObservationIds,

      sourceTextCandidateObservationIds:
        prepared.sourceTextCandidateObservationIds,

      sourceVectorCandidateObservationIds:
        prepared.sourceVectorCandidateObservationIds,

      sourceMaskObservationIds:
        prepared.sourceMaskObservationIds,

      sourceObservationIds:
        prepared.sourceObservationIds,

      bbox: built.cropBBox,

      renderBounds: built.cropBBox,

      assets: {
        editorAssetId: editorAsset.id,
        exportAssetId,
        maskAssetId,
        fallbackCropAssetId: fallbackAsset.id,
        sourceRgbaAssetId: prepared.sourceRgbaAsset?.id,
        sourceMaskAssetId: prepared.sourceMaskAsset?.id,
      },

      placement: {
        canvasBBox: built.cropBBox,

        editorAssetWidth: built.editorPng.width,
        editorAssetHeight: built.editorPng.height,

        exportAssetWidth: built.exportPng?.width,
        exportAssetHeight: built.exportPng?.height,

        scaleEditorToCanvasX:
          built.cropBBox.width / Math.max(1, built.editorPng.width),
        scaleEditorToCanvasY:
          built.cropBBox.height / Math.max(1, built.editorPng.height),
      },

      alpha: built.alphaMetrics,

      metrics: {
        areaPx: cropArea,
        areaRatio: cropArea / Math.max(1, canvasArea),
        cropTightness,
        textureEntropy: prepared.textureEntropy,
        flatColorRatio: prepared.flatColorRatio,
        estimatedColorCount: prepared.estimatedColorCount,
        objectness: prepared.objectness,
      },

      editability: {
        eligibleForRasterMasked:
          evaluation.eligibleForRasterMasked,

        eligibleForRasterFallback:
          evaluation.eligibleForRasterFallback,

        canReplace:
          ["person", "product", "photo_subject", "image_block"].includes(
            prepared.role
          ),

        canCrop:
          prepared.role === "image_block" ||
          prepared.role === "photo_subject" ||
          prepared.role === "product",

        canEditMask:
          Boolean(maskAssetId) &&
          prepared.role !== "text_raster_fallback",

        needsReview: evaluation.needsReview,

        recommendedStrategy:
          evaluation.recommendedStrategy,
      },

      validation: {
        passed: evaluation.passed,
        failureReasons: evaluation.failureReasons,
        warnings: evaluation.warnings,
      },

      confidence: {
        overall:
          evaluation.passed && !evaluation.needsReview
            ? 0.82
            : evaluation.passed
              ? 0.64
              : 0.35,

        mask:
          maskAssetId ? 0.75 : 0.35,

        alpha:
          built.alphaMetrics.edgeQuality === "high"
            ? 0.85
            : built.alphaMetrics.edgeQuality === "medium"
              ? 0.65
              : 0.4,

        geometry: 0.8,

        visualFidelity: 0.82,

        classification: prepared.objectness,
      },

      warnings: evaluation.warnings,
    };

    rasterCandidateObservations.push(rasterObservation);
    newObservations[rasterObservation.id] = rasterObservation;

    newObservations[`obs_quality_${candidateId}`] = {
      id: `obs_quality_${candidateId}`,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      designId: input.designId,
      kind: "quality",
      source: "visual_validator",
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      target: "layer",
      targetId: rasterObservation.id,
      metrics: {
        maskIoU: undefined,
        renderDiff: undefined,
      },
      passed: evaluation.passed,
      confidence: {
        overall: rasterObservation.confidence.overall,
        mask: rasterObservation.confidence.mask,
        alpha: rasterObservation.confidence.alpha,
        visualFidelity:
          rasterObservation.confidence.visualFidelity,
      },
    };
  }

  const updatedObservations = {
    ...input.observationBundle.observations,
    ...newObservations,
  };

  const updatedBundle = {
    ...input.observationBundle,

    assets: newAssets,

    observations: updatedObservations,

    counts: {
      ...input.observationBundle.counts,
      total: Object.keys(updatedObservations).length,
      quality: Object.values(updatedObservations).filter(
        (obs) => obs.kind === "quality"
      ).length,
    },

    warnings: [
      ...input.observationBundle.warnings,
      ...warnings,
    ],

    updatedAt: Date.now(),
  };

  const updatedBundleAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "observation-bundle-after-raster-generation"
  );

  const updatedBundleAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "source",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
    storagePath: observationBundlePath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: updatedBundleAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(
      JSON.stringify(updatedBundle, null, 2),
      "utf8"
    ),

    assetId: updatedBundleAssetId,
    kind: "observation_bundle_json" as any,

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    source: "system",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  const passAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "raster-generation-pass"
  );

  const rasterGenerationPass: RasterGenerationPass = {
    schemaVersion: "ai-raster-generation-pass.v1",

    jobId: input.jobId,
    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    userId: input.userId,

    sourceObservationBundleAssetId:
      input.sourceObservationBundleAssetId,

    outputObservationBundleAssetId:
      updatedBundleAsset.id,

    status:
      warnings.length > 0
        ? "completed_with_warnings"
        : "completed",

    candidateCounts: {
      eligibleElements: selected.length,
      generated: rasterCandidateObservations.length,
      masked,
      rectangularCrop,
      textRasterFallback,
      vectorFallback,
      needsReview,
      skipped,
    },

    observationsAdded: {
      total: Object.keys(newObservations).length,
      rasterCandidate: rasterCandidateObservations.length,
      quality: Object.values(newObservations).filter(
        (obs) => obs.kind === "quality"
      ).length,
    },

    assetsCreated: Object.keys(newAssets).filter(
      (assetId) => !input.observationBundle.assets[assetId]
    ),

    totalEditorBytes,
    totalExportBytes,

    warnings,

    createdAt: Date.now(),
  };

  const passAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "source",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
    storagePath: rasterGenerationPassReportPath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: passAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(
      JSON.stringify(rasterGenerationPass, null, 2),
      "utf8"
    ),

    assetId: passAssetId,
    kind: "raster_generation_pass_json" as any,

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    source: "system",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  return {
    updatedBundle,
    updatedBundleAsset,
    rasterGenerationPass,
    rasterGenerationPassAsset: passAsset,
    rasterCandidateObservations,
    assets: newAssets,
  };
}
```

Remove `as any` after patching the asset enum.

---

# 13.18 Source resolver

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/raster-generation/resolve-raster-candidate-source.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiAssetRef,
  AiObservationBundle,
} from "../observations/observation-bundle.types";

import type {
  AiRasterCandidateRole,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import type {
  RasterGenerationInputCandidate,
} from "./select-raster-candidates";

import {
  rasterRoleFromElement,
} from "./raster-role-mapping";

export function resolveRasterCandidateSource(input: {
  candidate: RasterGenerationInputCandidate;
  observationBundle: AiObservationBundle;
}) {
  const {
    candidate,
    observationBundle,
  } = input;

  if (candidate.kind === "text_fallback") {
    const text = candidate.textCandidate;

    const fallbackAsset =
      observationBundle.assets[text.assets.fallbackCropAssetId];

    if (!fallbackAsset) return null;

    return {
      role: "text_raster_fallback" as AiRasterCandidateRole,

      bbox: text.bbox,

      sourceRgbaAsset: fallbackAsset,

      sourceMaskAsset: undefined,

      sourceElementCandidateId: undefined,

      sourceComponentObservationIds: [],

      sourceTextCandidateObservationIds: [text.id],

      sourceVectorCandidateObservationIds: [],

      sourceMaskObservationIds: [],

      sourceObservationIds: [text.id],

      objectness: text.confidence?.overall ?? 0.65,

      textureEntropy: undefined,
      flatColorRatio: undefined,
      estimatedColorCount: undefined,
    };
  }

  if (candidate.kind === "vector_fallback") {
    const vector = candidate.vectorCandidate;

    const fallbackAsset =
      observationBundle.assets[vector.fallbackRasterAssetId];

    if (!fallbackAsset) return null;

    return {
      role: "shape_raster_fallback" as AiRasterCandidateRole,

      bbox: vector.bbox,

      sourceRgbaAsset: fallbackAsset,

      sourceMaskAsset: undefined,

      sourceElementCandidateId:
        vector.sourceElementCandidateId,

      sourceComponentObservationIds:
        vector.sourceComponentObservationIds,

      sourceTextCandidateObservationIds: [],

      sourceVectorCandidateObservationIds: [vector.id],

      sourceMaskObservationIds: [],

      sourceObservationIds: [
        vector.id,
        vector.sourceElementCandidateId,
      ],

      objectness: vector.confidence?.overall ?? 0.55,

      textureEntropy: vector.metrics.textureEntropy,
      flatColorRatio: vector.metrics.flatColorRatio,
      estimatedColorCount: vector.metrics.estimatedColorCount,
    };
  }

  const element = candidate.element;

  const sourceRgbaAsset = element.assets.rgbaAssetId
    ? observationBundle.assets[element.assets.rgbaAssetId]
    : undefined;

  const sourceMaskAsset = element.assets.maskAssetId
    ? observationBundle.assets[element.assets.maskAssetId]
    : undefined;

  return {
    role: rasterRoleFromElement(element),

    bbox: element.bbox,

    sourceRgbaAsset,
    sourceMaskAsset,

    sourceElementCandidateId: element.id,

    sourceComponentObservationIds:
      element.sourceComponentObservationIds,

    sourceTextCandidateObservationIds:
      element.sourceTextCandidateObservationIds,

    sourceVectorCandidateObservationIds: [],

    sourceMaskObservationIds:
      element.assets.maskAssetId ? [element.assets.maskAssetId] : [],

    sourceObservationIds: [
      element.id,
      ...element.sourceObservationIds,
    ],

    objectness: element.metrics.objectness,

    textureEntropy: element.metrics.textureEntropy,
    flatColorRatio: element.metrics.flatColorRatio,
    estimatedColorCount: element.metrics.estimatedColorCount,
  };
}
```

Type imports may need adjustment in your codebase; keep the shape.

# 13.19 Firestore patch

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/raster-generation/apply-raster-generation-result.ts
```

```ts
import {
  FieldValue,
  getFirestore,
} from "firebase-admin/firestore";

import type {
  RasterGenerationResult,
} from "./raster-generation.types";

export async function applyRasterGenerationResult(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  jobId: string;
  result: RasterGenerationResult;
}) {
  const db = getFirestore();

  const jobRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/aiLayerJobs/${input.jobId}`
  );

  const batch = db.batch();

  const assetsToIndex = [
    input.result.updatedBundleAsset,
    input.result.rasterGenerationPassAsset,
  ];

  for (const asset of assetsToIndex) {
    batch.set(
      db.doc(
        `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/assets/${asset.id}`
      ),
      {
        id: asset.id,

        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        jobId: input.jobId,

        kind: asset.kind,
        storageRole: asset.storageRole,

        bucket: asset.bucket,
        storagePath: asset.storagePath,

        generation: asset.generation,
        metageneration: asset.metageneration,

        mimeType: asset.mimeType,

        width: asset.width,
        height: asset.height,
        sizeBytes: asset.sizeBytes,

        checksum: asset.checksum,

        source: asset.metadata?.source,

        retained: true,

        createdAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      },
      { merge: true }
    );
  }

  batch.update(jobRef, {
    "input.observationBundleAssetId":
      input.result.updatedBundleAsset.id,

    rasterGeneration: {
      rasterGenerationPassAssetId:
        input.result.rasterGenerationPassAsset.id,

      outputObservationBundleAssetId:
        input.result.updatedBundleAsset.id,

      candidateCounts:
        input.result.rasterGenerationPass.candidateCounts,

      observationsAdded:
        input.result.rasterGenerationPass.observationsAdded,

      assetsCreated:
        input.result.rasterGenerationPass.assetsCreated,

      totalEditorBytes:
        input.result.rasterGenerationPass.totalEditorBytes,

      totalExportBytes:
        input.result.rasterGenerationPass.totalExportBytes,

      warnings:
        input.result.rasterGenerationPass.warnings,

      createdAt:
        input.result.rasterGenerationPass.createdAt,
    },

    "progress.percent": 70,
    "progress.label": "Raster assets prepared",
    "progress.currentStep": "repairing_background",

    updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
  });

  await batch.commit();
}
```

Note: `progress.currentStep` can remain `"repairing_background"` only if you keep Step 13 inside the worker before Step 14. If you want stricter progress naming, add an internal substep:

```txt
repairing_background.raster_generation
```

Do not add a public job status unless the UI needs it.

---

# 13.20 Worker integration

Patch the worker between `vectorizing` and `repairing_background`.

You can implement Step 13 as the first internal substep of `repairing_background`, or add a hidden internal step. Keep the public job status list unchanged unless you want a UI-visible “Preparing raster assets” state.

```ts
await runStep(context, "repairing_background", async () => {
  const job = await loadMagicLayersJob(context);

  const observationBundleAssetId =
    job.input.observationBundleAssetId;

  const observationBundle =
    await loadObservationBundleFromAsset({
      workspaceId: context.workspaceId,
      designId: context.designId,
      assetId: observationBundleAssetId,
    });

  const rasterResult = await runRasterGenerationPass({
    workspaceId: context.workspaceId,
    designId: context.designId,
    jobId: context.jobId,
    userId: job.userId,

    sourceObservationBundleAssetId:
      observationBundleAssetId,

    observationBundle,
  });

  await applyRasterGenerationResult({
    workspaceId: context.workspaceId,
    designId: context.designId,
    jobId: context.jobId,
    result: rasterResult,
  });

  /**
   * Step 14 background reconstruction runs after this
   * using raster_candidate masks and bboxes.
   */
});
```

Alternative: introduce a worker-internal substep system:

```txt
repairing_background.prepare_raster_candidates
repairing_background.generate_clean_background
```

This keeps public progress simple.

---

# 13.21 Cache policy

Raster candidate assets are immutable.

Use:

```txt
raster_candidate_editor_png
  private, max-age=31536000, immutable

raster_candidate_export_png
  private, max-age=31536000, immutable

raster_candidate_mask_png
  private, max-age=31536000, immutable

raster_candidate_fallback_crop
  private, max-age=31536000, immutable

raster_generation_pass_json
  private, no-cache
```

Cloud Storage uses object `Cache-Control` metadata to decide whether and how long caches can store objects, so set it explicitly on upload. citeturn173503search0

---

# 13.22 Editor-resolution versus export-resolution

This rule is non-negotiable:

```txt
Fabric editor loads editorAssetId.
Server export prefers exportAssetId.
If exportAssetId is missing, server export falls back to editorAssetId.
```

Why:

```txt
editor must stay fast
browser memory must stay bounded
server export can use heavier assets
```

A raster candidate stores both natural asset size and canvas bbox:

```ts
placement: {
  canvasBBox: { x, y, width, height },

  editorAssetWidth,
  editorAssetHeight,

  scaleEditorToCanvasX,
  scaleEditorToCanvasY
}
```

Later Fabric mapping:

```ts
fabric.Image({
  src: editorAssetUrl,
  left: canvasBBox.x,
  top: canvasBBox.y,
  width: editorAssetWidth,
  height: editorAssetHeight,
  scaleX: canvasBBox.width / editorAssetWidth,
  scaleY: canvasBBox.height / editorAssetHeight
});
```

Do not force asset pixels to equal canvas bbox pixels. That kills performance flexibility.

---

# 13.23 Text raster fallback rule

Text raster fallback is mandatory when:

```txt
text_candidate.editability = raster_only
text_candidate.editability = candidate_with_review
text_candidate.validation.semanticMutationDetected = true
font confidence is low
render validation failed
```

Text raster fallback should remain visually faithful.

It should not be used to silently replace correct live text candidates. It is attached later as fallback or visible fallback depending on resolver decision.

---

# 13.24 Vector fallback rule

Vector recovery can fail safely because Step 13 preserves raster fallback.

Generate raster fallback when:

```txt
vector_candidate.editability.recommendedFallback = raster_fallback
vector_candidate.editability.recommendedFallback = manual_review
validation.passed = false
pathComplexityScore too high
logo-like vector candidate weak
```

This prevents over-vectorized trash from entering the editor.

---

# 13.25 Image-block rule

For `image_block`, rectangular crops are acceptable.

Example:

```txt
photo inside menu card
profile image inside design
product thumbnail region
poster image panel
```

For image blocks:

```txt
rectangular_crop is valid
canCrop = true
canReplace = true
needsReview = false if layout confidence is high
```

For non-image-block objects:

```txt
rectangular_crop = needsReview
```

---

# 13.26 Shadow rule

Shadows should stay raster.

Do not vectorize shadows.

Raster shadow candidates should have:

```txt
role = shadow
alpha.mode = soft_alpha or source_rgba
canReplace = false
canCrop = false
canEditMask = false or low priority
```

Later grouping may attach:

```txt
product + shadow
person + shadow
badge + shadow
```

But Step 13 only creates the shadow raster candidate.

# 13.27 Background interaction rule

Step 13 must not create clean background.

But it must prepare data for Step 14:

```txt
raster_candidate masks
raster_candidate bboxes
raster_candidate roles
raster_candidate confidence
```

Step 14 will combine selected foreground masks into a background removal mask and generate `background_candidate` observations.

Do not inpaint here.

# 13.28 Candidate acceptance gates

A raster candidate is valid only if:

```txt
editorAssetId exists
fallbackCropAssetId exists
bbox is inside canvas
placement scale is valid
asset dimensions are valid
alpha metrics exist
confidence exists
source observations are linked
source assets are linked
candidate role is assigned
validation state exists
```

Reject or downgrade if:

```txt
asset cannot be decoded
alpha coverage too low
candidate is duplicate
bbox area too small
bbox covers almost entire canvas without overlay/image-block role
mask dimensions invalid
transparent edge halo risk high
source component marked duplicate
text candidate has live-text eligibility and fallback is unnecessary as visible candidate
```

Do not add:

```txt
Fabric.Image
AiReconstructedLayer
final editableLevel
final zIndex
final group
background_clean.png
inpainting
mask hallucination
text editing
vector conversion
full-scene recomposition validation
```

Do not make final product decisions here.

# 13.30 Non-negotiable invariants

Step 13 is valid only if:

```txt
Every output remains an observation.

No final layer is created.

No Fabric JSON is created.

Every raster candidate has editor PNG.

Every raster candidate has fallback crop.

Every raster candidate has canvas bbox.

Every raster candidate has natural asset dimensions.

Every raster candidate has alpha metrics.

Every raster candidate has provenance.

Every raster candidate references source observations.

Every text raster fallback comes from protected text candidate evidence.

Every failed/weak vector candidate can fall back to raster.

Editor assets are cropped, not full-canvas transparent PNGs.

Export assets are separate or explicitly omitted.

All generated assets are immutable.

All generated assets are stored in GCS.

Firestore stores only summary and pointers.

Clean background is not generated here.

Scene resolver remains responsible for final acceptance.
```

## ChatGPT Response 024

<!-- assistant_message_ids: 68c1eedf-456f-43b9-bb36-5b7ddc0dfa01, a943367c-c0e0-41f8-8ac1-54166798ca86 -->

Step 14 makes editing useful but risky: moving objects needs a plausible background, yet repair must stay conservative, candidate-based, and strictly validated to avoid hallucinated content.

# Step 14 — Clean background reconstruction

Step 14 creates **background candidates** so that when the user moves a foreground object, text block, product, badge, or decoration, the canvas does not expose the original pixels underneath.

The locked rule:

```txt
Clean background reconstruction creates background_candidate observations.
It does not create the final background layer.
It does not create Fabric objects.
It does not decide final scene composition.
```

This step is high-risk because inpainting can hallucinate. So the default must be conservative:

```txt
Preserve original outside the repair mask exactly.
Repair only masked areas.
Prefer plausible texture/flat fill over creative generation.
Mark weak repairs as needsReview.
Always keep original reference fallback.
```

OpenCV’s `cv.inpaint` explicitly reconstructs selected masked regions from surrounding pixels and supports `INPAINT_NS` and `INPAINT_TELEA`; it is useful for local repair, scratches, small strokes, and edge continuation, not semantic design reconstruction. citeturn148117view0turn148117view1 LaMa is the stronger open research direction for larger mask inpainting because it was designed for large masks and high-resolution generalization. citeturn548609search4 Gemini Image / Nano Banana can do semantic masked editing, but in this pipeline it should be a **fallback repair engine**, not the default background truth engine. Google’s docs describe semantic masking as editing a specific part of an image while keeping the rest unchanged; still, our system must enforce this by compositing only inside the mask. citeturn597318view0 Also, do not build new background repair around Imagen now: Firebase docs state Imagen models are deprecated and shut down on **June 24, 2026**, with migration guidance toward Gemini Image / Nano Banana. citeturn597318view1

## 14.1 What Step 14 owns

Step 14 owns:

```txt
foreground-removal candidate selection
combined removal mask generation
mask dilation/feather policy
background repair engine selection
OpenCV repair adapter
LaMa repair adapter
optional Gemini Image repair adapter
palette-aware repair postprocessing

```

Step 14 does **not** own:

```txt

```

---

# 14.2 Why this step exists

Without clean background reconstruction:

```txt
User moves product → original product pixels remain underneath
User moves headline → duplicate text remains underneath
User moves badge → old badge ghost remains
User replaces subject → old subject hole remains
```

A layer editor without clean background is only partially editable.

But the clean background must not become a hallucinated redesign. Its job is narrow:

```txt
Make moved-layer areas plausible enough for editing.
Do not invent meaningful content.
Do not alter unmasked pixels.
Do not rewrite text.
Do not change logos.
Do not change visible design outside repair mask.
```

# 14.9 Foreground removal selection

Step 14 should remove only foreground candidates that are likely to become movable layers.

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/background-reconstruction/select-background-removal-candidates.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiRasterCandidateObservation,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_BACKGROUND_RECONSTRUCTION_POLICY,
} from "./background-reconstruction-policy";

export function selectBackgroundRemovalRasterCandidates(input: {
  rasterCandidates: AiRasterCandidateObservation[];
}) {
  const p = MAGIC_LAYERS_BACKGROUND_RECONSTRUCTION_POLICY.selection;

  return input.rasterCandidates
    .filter((candidate) => {
      if (
        (candidate.confidence?.overall ?? 0) <
        p.minRasterCandidateConfidence
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      if (candidate.validation.failureReasons.length > 0) {
        return false;
      }

      if (
        candidate.role === "unknown" &&
        !p.includeUnknownCandidates
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      if (candidate.role === "shadow" && !p.includeShadows) {
        return false;
      }

      if (candidate.role === "overlay" && !p.includeOverlays) {
        return false;
      }

      if (
        candidate.role === "image_block" &&
        !p.includeImageBlocks
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      if (
        [
          "person",
          "product",
          "photo_subject",
        ].includes(candidate.role) &&
        !p.includeProductsPeopleSubjects
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      if (
        candidate.role === "text_raster_fallback" &&
        !p.includeTextRasterFallbacks
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      if (
        candidate.role === "shape_raster_fallback" &&
        !p.includeVectorFallbacks
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      return true;
    })
    .slice(0, p.maxForegroundCandidates);
}
```

Key rule:

```txt
Do not remove uncertain objects from background.
```

A bad clean background hidden behind a movable layer is tolerable. A hallucinated background behind uncertain objects is not.

# 14.10 Combined removal mask

Step 14 creates a full-canvas mask from selected raster candidates.

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/background-reconstruction/build-background-removal-mask.ts
```

```ts
import sharp from "sharp";

import type {
  AiRasterCandidateObservation,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  downloadAssetBuffer,
} from "../storage/download-ai-asset";

import type {
  AiObservationBundle,
} from "../observations/observation-bundle.types";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_BACKGROUND_RECONSTRUCTION_POLICY,
} from "./background-reconstruction-policy";

export async function buildBackgroundRemovalMask(input: {
  observationBundle: AiObservationBundle;

  rasterCandidates: AiRasterCandidateObservation[];
}): Promise<{
  maskBuffer: Buffer;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  repairAreaRatio: number;
}> {
  const width = input.observationBundle.canvas.width;
  const height = input.observationBundle.canvas.height;

  let base = sharp({
    create: {
      width,
      height,
      channels: 3,
      background: { r: 0, g: 0, b: 0 },
    },
  });

  const overlays: sharp.OverlayOptions[] = [];

  for (const candidate of input.rasterCandidates) {
    const maskAsset = candidate.assets.maskAssetId
      ? input.observationBundle.assets[candidate.assets.maskAssetId]
      : undefined;

    let maskBuffer: Buffer;

    if (maskAsset) {
      maskBuffer = await downloadAssetBuffer(maskAsset);
    } else {
      maskBuffer = await createOpaqueRectMask({
        width: candidate.placement.editorAssetWidth,
        height: candidate.placement.editorAssetHeight,
      });
    }

    const resizedMask = await sharp(maskBuffer)
      .resize(
        candidate.bbox.width,
        candidate.bbox.height,
        { fit: "fill" }
      )
      .greyscale()
      .threshold(16)
      .png()
      .toBuffer();

    const whiteWithAlpha = await sharp({
      create: {
        width: candidate.bbox.width,
        height: candidate.bbox.height,
        channels: 3,
        background: { r: 255, g: 255, b: 255 },
      },
    })
      .joinChannel(resizedMask)
      .png()
      .toBuffer();

    overlays.push({
      input: whiteWithAlpha,
      left: candidate.bbox.x,
      top: candidate.bbox.y,
    });
  }

  const composed = await base
    .composite(overlays)
    .greyscale()
    .threshold(16)
    .png()
    .toBuffer();

  const dilated = await dilateMaskIfNeeded(composed);

  const repairAreaRatio = await computeMaskCoverageRatio({
    maskBuffer: dilated,
    width,
    height,
  });

  return {
    maskBuffer: dilated,
    width,
    height,
    repairAreaRatio,
  };
}

async function createOpaqueRectMask(input: {
  width: number;
  height: number;
}) {
  return sharp({
    create: {
      width: input.width,
      height: input.height,
      channels: 1,
      background: { r: 255, g: 255, b: 255 },
    },
  })
    .png()
    .toBuffer();
}

async function dilateMaskIfNeeded(maskBuffer: Buffer) {
  const px =
    MAGIC_LAYERS_BACKGROUND_RECONSTRUCTION_POLICY.mask.dilationPx;

  if (px <= 0) return maskBuffer;

  /**
   * Sharp does not expose full morphology.
   * This approximation uses blur + threshold.
   * For production-grade morphology, use OpenCV.
   */
  return sharp(maskBuffer)
    .blur(px)
    .threshold(12)
    .png()
    .toBuffer();
}

async function computeMaskCoverageRatio(input: {
  maskBuffer: Buffer;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}) {
  const raw = await sharp(input.maskBuffer)
    .resize(input.width, input.height, { fit: "fill" })
    .greyscale()
    .raw()
    .toBuffer();

  let nonZero = 0;

  for (const value of raw) {
    if (value > 0) nonZero++;
  }

  return nonZero / Math.max(1, input.width * input.height);
}
```

For production morphology, move dilation/closing/opening to OpenCV. Sharp blur-threshold is acceptable as a simple fallback but not the best final tool.

# 14.11 Engine selection

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/background-reconstruction/select-background-repair-engine.ts
```

```ts
import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_BACKGROUND_RECONSTRUCTION_POLICY,
} from "./background-reconstruction-policy";

export function selectBackgroundRepairEngine(input: {
  route:
    | "graphic_design_layer_decomposition"
    | "photo_conservative_segmentation"
    | "text_recovery_priority"
    | "vectorization_priority"
    | "fallback_only";

  repairAreaRatio: number;

  maxConnectedRepairAreaRatio?: number;

  flatColorRatio?: number;

  photoRegionRatio?: number;
}): {
  engine:
    | "none_original"
    | "opencv_telea"
    | "opencv_ns"
    | "lama"
    | "gemini_image_semantic_inpaint"
    | "solid_palette_fill";

  reasonCodes: string[];
} {
  const p = MAGIC_LAYERS_BACKGROUND_RECONSTRUCTION_POLICY;

  const reasons: string[] = [];

  if (input.route === "fallback_only") {
    return {
      engine: "none_original",
      reasonCodes: ["fallback_only_route"],
    };
  }

  if (input.repairAreaRatio < p.mask.minRepairAreaRatio) {
    return {
      engine: "none_original",
      reasonCodes: ["repair_area_too_small"],
    };
  }

  if (input.repairAreaRatio > p.mask.maxRepairAreaRatioForAnyRepair) {
    return {
      engine: "none_original",
      reasonCodes: ["repair_area_too_large_for_safe_background"],
    };
  }

  if (
    input.route === "vectorization_priority" &&
    (input.flatColorRatio ?? 0) > 0.75
  ) {
    return {
      engine: "solid_palette_fill",
      reasonCodes: ["flat_vector_design_palette_fill"],
    };
  }

  if (
    input.repairAreaRatio <= p.mask.maxRepairAreaRatioForOpenCv &&
    (input.maxConnectedRepairAreaRatio ?? input.repairAreaRatio) <=
      p.mask.maxConnectedRepairAreaRatioForOpenCv
  ) {
    return {
      engine:
        p.opencv.preferredMethod === "telea"
          ? "opencv_telea"
          : "opencv_ns",
      reasonCodes: ["small_local_repair_opencv"],
    };
  }

  if (p.engines.useLaMa) {
    return {
      engine: "lama",
      reasonCodes: ["medium_large_mask_lama"],
    };
  }

  if (
    p.engines.allowGenerativeSemanticRepair &&
    p.geminiImage.enabled &&
    p.geminiImage.allowedRoutes.includes(input.route) &&
    input.repairAreaRatio <= p.geminiImage.maxRepairAreaRatio
  ) {
    return {
      engine: "gemini_image_semantic_inpaint",
      reasonCodes: ["semantic_repair_allowed_for_photo_route"],
    };
  }

  return {
    engine: "none_original",
    reasonCodes: ["no_safe_background_engine_available"],
  };
}
```

Default hierarchy:

```txt
small local hole → OpenCV
medium/larger hole → LaMa
flat logo/icon design → palette fill
generative semantic repair → disabled by default
unsafe → original fallback
```

---

# 14.12 Force outside-mask preservation

This is non-negotiable.

Even if an engine mutates the whole image, we only keep pixels inside the repair mask.

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/background-reconstruction/force-mask-composite-background.ts
```

```ts
import sharp from "sharp";

export async function forceMaskCompositeBackground(input: {
  originalBuffer: Buffer;

  repairedBuffer: Buffer;

  maskBuffer: Buffer;

  width: number;

  height: number;
}): Promise<Buffer> {
  const normalizedRepair = await sharp(input.repairedBuffer)
    .resize(input.width, input.height, { fit: "fill" })
    .removeAlpha()
    .png()
    .toBuffer();

  const normalizedMask = await sharp(input.maskBuffer)
    .resize(input.width, input.height, { fit: "fill" })
    .greyscale()
    .png()
    .toBuffer();

  const repairWithAlpha = await sharp(normalizedRepair)
    .joinChannel(normalizedMask)
    .png()
    .toBuffer();

  return sharp(input.originalBuffer)
    .resize(input.width, input.height, { fit: "fill" })
    .composite([
      {
        input: repairWithAlpha,
        left: 0,
        top: 0,
      },
    ])
    .png({
      compressionLevel: 9,
      adaptiveFiltering: true,
    })
    .toBuffer();
}
```

This makes the clean background safe:

```txt
outside mask = original normalized image
inside mask = repaired candidate
```

# 14.13 OpenCV repair adapter

Create:

```txt
services/magic-layers-python/background_inpaint_opencv.py
```

```python
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import cv2
import numpy as np


def main():
    input_path = Path(sys.argv[1])
    output_path = Path(sys.argv[2])

    spec = json.loads(input_path.read_text())

    image = cv2.imread(spec["imagePath"], cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
    mask = cv2.imread(spec["maskPath"], cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)

    if image is None:
        raise ValueError("Could not read image")

    if mask is None:
        raise ValueError("Could not read mask")

    if mask.shape[:2] != image.shape[:2]:
        mask = cv2.resize(mask, (image.shape[1], image.shape[0]))

    mask = (mask > 0).astype(np.uint8) * 255

    radius = float(spec.get("radius", 3))
    method = spec.get("method", "telea")

    if method == "ns":
        flag = cv2.INPAINT_NS
    else:
        flag = cv2.INPAINT_TELEA

    repaired = cv2.inpaint(image, mask, radius, flag)

    cv2.imwrite(str(output_path), repaired)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

Node wrapper:

```ts
// src/lib/magic-layers/background-reconstruction/opencv-background-repair.ts

import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import os from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { spawn } from "node:child_process";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_BACKGROUND_RECONSTRUCTION_POLICY,
} from "./background-reconstruction-policy";

export async function runOpenCvBackgroundRepair(input: {
  imageBuffer: Buffer;
  maskBuffer: Buffer;
  method: "telea" | "ns";
}): Promise<Buffer> {
  const tempDir = await fs.mkdtemp(
    path.join(os.tmpdir(), "ml-bg-opencv-")
  );

  const imagePath = path.join(tempDir, "image.png");
  const maskPath = path.join(tempDir, "mask.png");
  const specPath = path.join(tempDir, "spec.json");
  const outputPath = path.join(tempDir, "output.png");

  await fs.writeFile(imagePath, input.imageBuffer);
  await fs.writeFile(maskPath, input.maskBuffer);

  await fs.writeFile(
    specPath,
    JSON.stringify(
      {
        imagePath,
        maskPath,
        method: input.method,
        radius:
          MAGIC_LAYERS_BACKGROUND_RECONSTRUCTION_POLICY.opencv.radius,
      },
      null,
      2
    )
  );

  const script =
    process.env.MAGIC_LAYERS_OPENCV_BACKGROUND_SCRIPT ??
    "/app/services/magic-layers-python/background_inpaint_opencv.py";

  await runPython(script, [specPath, outputPath]);

  return fs.readFile(outputPath);
}

function runPython(script: string, args: string[]) {
  return new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    const child = spawn("python3", [script, ...args]);

    let stderr = "";

    child.stderr.on("data", (chunk) => {
      stderr += chunk.toString();
    });

    child.on("close", (code) => {
      if (code === 0) resolve();
      else reject(new Error(`OpenCV background repair failed: ${stderr}`));
    });
  });
}
```

OpenCV repair is deterministic and cheap. It is best for small local gaps.

```ts
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import os from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { spawn } from "node:child_process";

export async function runLaMaBackgroundRepair(input: {
  imageBuffer: Buffer;
  maskBuffer: Buffer;
}): Promise<Buffer> {
  const tempDir = await fs.mkdtemp(
    path.join(os.tmpdir(), "ml-bg-lama-")
  );

  const imagePath = path.join(tempDir, "image.png");
  const maskPath = path.join(tempDir, "mask.png");
  const outputPath = path.join(tempDir, "output.png");

  await fs.writeFile(imagePath, input.imageBuffer);
  await fs.writeFile(maskPath, input.maskBuffer);

  const script =
    process.env.MAGIC_LAYERS_LAMA_BACKGROUND_SCRIPT ??
    "/app/services/magic-layers-python/background_inpaint_lama.py";

  await runPython(script, [
    "--image",
    imagePath,
    "--mask",
    maskPath,
    "--output",
    outputPath,
  ]);

  return fs.readFile(outputPath);
}

function runPython(script: string, args: string[]) {
  return new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    const child = spawn("python3", [script, ...args]);

    let stderr = "";

    child.stderr.on("data", (chunk) => {
      stderr += chunk.toString();
    });

    child.on("close", (code) => {
      if (code === 0) resolve();
      else reject(new Error(`LaMa background repair failed: ${stderr}`));
    });
  });
}
```

The actual LaMa Python script can use the official model/container. Keep it outside your TypeScript system. The TypeScript contract is:

```txt
image + mask → repaired image
```

Nothing else.

# 14.15 Gemini Image repair adapter

Use this only later, behind a flag.

Reason:

```txt
Generative repair can invent objects.
Generative repair can alter style.
Generative repair can alter text-like regions.
```

Adapter contract:

```ts
export async function runGeminiImageBackgroundRepair(input: {
  imageBuffer: Buffer;
  maskBuffer: Buffer;
  prompt: string;
}): Promise<Buffer> {
  /**
   * Keep this disabled by default.
   *
   * Prompt shape:
   * "Remove only the masked foreground objects. Fill the area with a plain
   * continuation of the existing background. Do not add text, symbols, logos,
   * people, products, objects, or decorative elements. Keep all unmasked pixels unchanged."
   *
   * Even after generation, force-mask-composite the result over the original.
   */
  throw new Error("Gemini Image background repair is disabled by policy");
}
```

Do not use Imagen for this; the current Firebase docs state Imagen is deprecated and shutting down. citeturn597318view1

# 14.16 Background quality evaluation

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/background-reconstruction/evaluate-background-candidate.ts
```

```ts
import sharp from "sharp";

export async function evaluateBackgroundCandidate(input: {
  originalBuffer: Buffer;

  cleanBackgroundBuffer: Buffer;

  maskBuffer: Buffer;

  width: number;

  height: number;

  repairAreaRatio: number;

  engine:
    | "none_original"
    | "opencv_telea"
    | "opencv_ns"
    | "lama"
    | "gemini_image_semantic_inpaint"
    | "solid_palette_fill";
}) {
  const outsideMutationRatio = await computeOutsideMaskMutationRatio(input);

  const seamScore = await estimateSeamScore(input);

  const hallucinationRisk =
    input.engine === "gemini_image_semantic_inpaint"
      ? 0.65
      : input.engine === "lama"
        ? input.repairAreaRatio > 0.35
          ? 0.42
          : 0.25
        : input.engine.startsWith("opencv")
          ? input.repairAreaRatio > 0.08
            ? 0.35
            : 0.18
          : 0.05;

  const warnings: string[] = [];
  const failureReasons: string[] = [];

  if (outsideMutationRatio > 0.00001) {
    failureReasons.push("outside_mask_mutation_detected");
  }

  if (input.repairAreaRatio > 0.38) {
    warnings.push("large_background_repair_area");
  }

  if (seamScore > 0.45) {
    warnings.push("visible_background_seam_risk");
  }

  if (hallucinationRisk > 0.35) {
    warnings.push("background_hallucination_risk");
  }

  const passed = failureReasons.length === 0;

  return {
    outsideMutationRatio,
    seamScore,
    hallucinationRisk,
    passed,
    needsReview:
      warnings.length > 0 ||
      input.repairAreaRatio > 0.38 ||
      hallucinationRisk > 0.35,
    warnings,
    failureReasons,
  };
}

async function computeOutsideMaskMutationRatio(input: {
  originalBuffer: Buffer;
  cleanBackgroundBuffer: Buffer;
  maskBuffer: Buffer;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}) {
  const original = await sharp(input.originalBuffer)
    .resize(input.width, input.height, { fit: "fill" })
    .removeAlpha()
    .raw()
    .toBuffer();

  const clean = await sharp(input.cleanBackgroundBuffer)
    .resize(input.width, input.height, { fit: "fill" })
    .removeAlpha()
    .raw()
    .toBuffer();

  const mask = await sharp(input.maskBuffer)
    .resize(input.width, input.height, { fit: "fill" })
    .greyscale()
    .raw()
    .toBuffer();

  let outside = 0;
  let changed = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < mask.length; i++) {
    if (mask[i] > 0) continue;

    outside++;

    const j = i * 3;

    const diff =
      Math.abs(original[j] - clean[j]) +
      Math.abs(original[j + 1] - clean[j + 1]) +
      Math.abs(original[j + 2] - clean[j + 2]);

    if (diff > 3) changed++;
  }

  return changed / Math.max(1, outside);
}

async function estimateSeamScore(input: {
  originalBuffer: Buffer;
  cleanBackgroundBuffer: Buffer;
  maskBuffer: Buffer;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}) {
  /**
   * First-pass seam heuristic:
   * compare edge gradient around the mask after repair.
   * Later replace with boundary-band SSIM / Lab delta.
   */
  const mask = await sharp(input.maskBuffer)
    .resize(input.width, input.height, { fit: "fill" })
    .greyscale()
    .blur(2)
    .raw()
    .toBuffer();

  const clean = await sharp(input.cleanBackgroundBuffer)
    .resize(input.width, input.height, { fit: "fill" })
    .greyscale()
    .raw()
    .toBuffer();

  let score = 0;
  let count = 0;

  for (let y = 1; y < input.height - 1; y++) {
    for (let x = 1; x < input.width - 1; x++) {
      const idx = y * input.width + x;

      const m = mask[idx];

      if (m < 16 || m > 240) continue;

      const gx =
        Math.abs(clean[idx + 1] - clean[idx - 1]) / 255;
      const gy =
        Math.abs(clean[idx + input.width] - clean[idx - input.width]) / 255;

      score += Math.max(gx, gy);
      count++;
    }
  }

  return count > 0 ? score / count : 0;
}
```

This is not final full-scene validation. Step 19 handles that. This only evaluates the background candidate.

# 14.18 Background reconstruction runner

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/background-reconstruction/run-background-reconstruction-pass.ts
```

```ts
import {
  AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,
  AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
} from "../schema/constants";

import type {
  AiBackgroundCandidateObservation,
  AiObservation,
  AiRasterCandidateObservation,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import type {
  AiObservationBundle,
} from "../observations/observation-bundle.types";

import {
  bucketForMagicStorageRole,
} from "../storage/storage-buckets";

import {
  backgroundCandidateCleanPngPath,
  backgroundRemovalMaskPath,
  backgroundReconstructionPassReportPath,
  observationBundlePath,
} from "../storage/storage-paths";

import {
  writeAiAsset,
} from "../storage/write-ai-asset";

import {
  downloadAssetBuffer,
} from "../storage/download-ai-asset";

import {
  selectBackgroundRemovalRasterCandidates,
} from "./select-background-removal-candidates";

import {
  buildBackgroundRemovalMask,
} from "./build-background-removal-mask";

import {
  selectBackgroundRepairEngine,
} from "./select-background-repair-engine";

import {
  runOpenCvBackgroundRepair,
} from "./opencv-background-repair";

import {
  runLaMaBackgroundRepair,
} from "./lama-background-repair";

import {
  forceMaskCompositeBackground,
} from "./force-mask-composite-background";

import {
  evaluateBackgroundCandidate,
} from "./evaluate-background-candidate";

import type {
  BackgroundReconstructionPass,
  BackgroundReconstructionResult,
} from "./background-reconstruction.types";

export async function runBackgroundReconstructionPass(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  jobId: string;
  userId: string;

  sourceObservationBundleAssetId: string;

  observationBundle: AiObservationBundle;
}): Promise<BackgroundReconstructionResult> {
  const observations = Object.values(input.observationBundle.observations);

  const rasterCandidates = observations.filter(
    (obs): obs is AiRasterCandidateObservation =>
      obs.kind === "raster_candidate"
  );

  const selectedForeground =
    selectBackgroundRemovalRasterCandidates({
      rasterCandidates,
    });

  const normalizedAsset =
    input.observationBundle.assets[
      input.observationBundle.source.normalizedAssetId
    ];

  const editorReferenceAsset =
    input.observationBundle.assets[
      input.observationBundle.source.editorReferenceAssetId
    ];

  const normalizedBuffer =
    await downloadAssetBuffer(normalizedAsset);

  const newAssets = {
    ...input.observationBundle.assets,
  };

  const newObservations: Record<string, AiObservation> = {};

  const width = input.observationBundle.canvas.width;
  const height = input.observationBundle.canvas.height;

  let removalMaskAssetId: string | undefined;
  let removalMaskBuffer: Buffer | undefined;
  let repairAreaRatio = 0;

  if (selectedForeground.length > 0) {
    const builtMask = await buildBackgroundRemovalMask({
      observationBundle: input.observationBundle,
      rasterCandidates: selectedForeground,
    });

    removalMaskBuffer = builtMask.maskBuffer;
    repairAreaRatio = builtMask.repairAreaRatio;

    const maskAssetId = stableAssetId(
      input.jobId,
      "background-removal-mask"
    );

    const maskAsset = await writeAiAsset({
      storageRole: "source",
      bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
      storagePath: backgroundRemovalMaskPath({
        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        jobId: input.jobId,
        assetId: maskAssetId,
      }),

      bytes: builtMask.maskBuffer,

      assetId: maskAssetId,
      kind: "background_removal_mask_png" as any,

      contentType: "image/png",

      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,

      width,
      height,

      source: "system",

      schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

      cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
    });

    removalMaskAssetId = maskAsset.id;
    newAssets[maskAsset.id] = maskAsset;
  }

  const route =
    input.observationBundle.routing.diagnosis.recommendedRoute;

  const engineSelection = selectBackgroundRepairEngine({
    route,
    repairAreaRatio,
    flatColorRatio:
      input.observationBundle.routing.diagnosis.flatColorRatio,
    photoRegionRatio:
      input.observationBundle.routing.diagnosis.photoRegionRatio,
  });

  let repairedBuffer = normalizedBuffer;
  let cleanBackgroundBuffer = normalizedBuffer;
  const engineWarnings: string[] = [];

  try {
    if (
      engineSelection.engine === "opencv_telea" ||
      engineSelection.engine === "opencv_ns"
    ) {
      repairedBuffer = await runOpenCvBackgroundRepair({
        imageBuffer: normalizedBuffer,
        maskBuffer: removalMaskBuffer!,
        method:
          engineSelection.engine === "opencv_ns"
            ? "ns"
            : "telea",
      });
    } else if (engineSelection.engine === "lama") {
      repairedBuffer = await runLaMaBackgroundRepair({
        imageBuffer: normalizedBuffer,
        maskBuffer: removalMaskBuffer!,
      });
    } else if (engineSelection.engine === "solid_palette_fill") {
      repairedBuffer = await runSolidPaletteFillRepair({
        imageBuffer: normalizedBuffer,
        maskBuffer: removalMaskBuffer!,
      });
    } else if (engineSelection.engine === "none_original") {
      repairedBuffer = normalizedBuffer;
    } else {
      engineWarnings.push("generative_background_repair_disabled");
      repairedBuffer = normalizedBuffer;
    }

    if (
      removalMaskBuffer &&
      engineSelection.engine !== "none_original"
    ) {
      cleanBackgroundBuffer = await forceMaskCompositeBackground({
        originalBuffer: normalizedBuffer,
        repairedBuffer,
        maskBuffer: removalMaskBuffer,
        width,
        height,
      });
    }
  } catch (error) {
    engineWarnings.push(
      `background_engine_failed:${
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : "unknown"
      }`
    );

    repairedBuffer = normalizedBuffer;
    cleanBackgroundBuffer = normalizedBuffer;
  }

  const cleanBackgroundAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "clean-background-candidate"
  );

  const cleanBackgroundAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "assets",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("assets"),
    storagePath: backgroundCandidateCleanPngPath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: cleanBackgroundAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: cleanBackgroundBuffer,

    assetId: cleanBackgroundAssetId,
    kind: "background_candidate_clean_png" as any,

    contentType: "image/png",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    width,
    height,

    source: "inpainting",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    sourceAssetId: normalizedAsset.id,

    cacheControl: "private, max-age=31536000, immutable",
  });

  newAssets[cleanBackgroundAsset.id] = cleanBackgroundAsset;

  const evaluation =
    removalMaskBuffer && engineSelection.engine !== "none_original"
      ? await evaluateBackgroundCandidate({
          originalBuffer: normalizedBuffer,
          cleanBackgroundBuffer,
          maskBuffer: removalMaskBuffer,
          width,
          height,
          repairAreaRatio,
          engine: engineSelection.engine,
        })
      : {
          outsideMutationRatio: 0,
          seamScore: 0,
          hallucinationRisk: 0,
          passed: true,
          needsReview: false,
          warnings: [],
          failureReasons: [],
        };

  const backgroundObservationId =
    "obs_background_candidate_clean";

  const backgroundObservation: AiBackgroundCandidateObservation = {
    id: backgroundObservationId,

    jobId: input.jobId,
    designId: input.designId,

    kind: "background_candidate",

    source: "inpainting",

    createdAt: Date.now(),

    engine: engineSelection.engine,

    sourceImageAssetId: normalizedAsset.id,

    cleanBackgroundAssetId: cleanBackgroundAsset.id,

    removalMaskAssetId,

    sourceRasterCandidateObservationIds:
      selectedForeground.map((candidate) => candidate.id),

    sourceTextCandidateObservationIds:
      selectedForeground.flatMap(
        (candidate) =>
          candidate.sourceTextCandidateObservationIds
      ),

    sourceElementCandidateObservationIds:
      selectedForeground
        .map((candidate) => candidate.sourceElementCandidateId)
        .filter((id): id is string => Boolean(id)),

    sourceVectorCandidateObservationIds:
      selectedForeground.flatMap(
        (candidate) =>
          candidate.sourceVectorCandidateObservationIds
      ),

    canvasBBox: {
      x: 0,
      y: 0,
      width,
      height,
    },

    repair: {
      attempted:
        engineSelection.engine !== "none_original" &&
        Boolean(removalMaskBuffer),

      repairAreaRatio,

      maskDilatedPx: 4,

      maskFeatheredPx: 0,

      outsideMaskPreserved: true,

      outsideMaskMutationRatio:
        evaluation.outsideMutationRatio,

      conservativeRepair:
        engineSelection.engine !==
        "gemini_image_semantic_inpaint",

      hallucinationRisk:
        evaluation.hallucinationRisk,

      engineWarnings,
    },

    metrics: {
      seamScore: evaluation.seamScore,
      visualFidelity: 1 - evaluation.seamScore,
      objectRemovalCompleteness:
        engineSelection.engine === "none_original" ? 0 : 0.75,
    },

    validation: {
      passed: evaluation.passed,
      needsReview: evaluation.needsReview,
      failureReasons: evaluation.failureReasons,
      warnings: [
        ...evaluation.warnings,
        ...engineWarnings,
      ],
    },

    fallback: {
      originalImageAssetId: normalizedAsset.id,
      editorReferenceAssetId: editorReferenceAsset.id,
    },

    confidence: {
      overall:
        evaluation.passed && !evaluation.needsReview
          ? 0.82
          : evaluation.passed
            ? 0.62
            : 0.35,

      backgroundRepair:
        evaluation.passed ? 0.75 : 0.3,

      visualFidelity: 1 - evaluation.seamScore,
    },

    warnings: [
      ...evaluation.warnings,
      ...engineWarnings,
    ],
  };

  newObservations[backgroundObservation.id] =
    backgroundObservation;

  newObservations["obs_quality_background_candidate"] = {
    id: "obs_quality_background_candidate",
    jobId: input.jobId,
    designId: input.designId,
    kind: "quality",
    source: "visual_validator",
    createdAt: Date.now(),

    target: "background",
    targetId: backgroundObservation.id,

    metrics: {
      renderDiff: evaluation.seamScore,
    },

    passed: evaluation.passed,

    confidence: {
      overall: backgroundObservation.confidence.overall,
      backgroundRepair:
        backgroundObservation.confidence.backgroundRepair,
      visualFidelity:
        backgroundObservation.confidence.visualFidelity,
    },
  };

  const updatedObservations = {
    ...input.observationBundle.observations,
    ...newObservations,
  };

  const updatedBundle = {
    ...input.observationBundle,

    assets: newAssets,

    observations: updatedObservations,

    counts: {
      ...input.observationBundle.counts,
      total: Object.keys(updatedObservations).length,
      quality: Object.values(updatedObservations).filter(
        (obs) => obs.kind === "quality"
      ).length,
    },

    warnings: [
      ...input.observationBundle.warnings,
      ...backgroundObservation.warnings,
    ],

    updatedAt: Date.now(),
  };

  const updatedBundleAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "observation-bundle-after-background-reconstruction"
  );

  const updatedBundleAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "source",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
    storagePath: observationBundlePath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: updatedBundleAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(
      JSON.stringify(updatedBundle, null, 2),
      "utf8"
    ),

    assetId: updatedBundleAssetId,
    kind: "observation_bundle_json" as any,

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    source: "system",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  const passAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "background-reconstruction-pass"
  );

  const pass: BackgroundReconstructionPass = {
    schemaVersion:
      "ai-background-reconstruction-pass.v1",

    jobId: input.jobId,
    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    userId: input.userId,

    sourceObservationBundleAssetId:
      input.sourceObservationBundleAssetId,

    outputObservationBundleAssetId:
      updatedBundleAsset.id,

    status:
      backgroundObservation.validation.warnings.length > 0
        ? "completed_with_warnings"
        : "completed",

    engine: {
      selected: engineSelection.engine,
      reasonCodes: engineSelection.reasonCodes,
    },

    mask: {
      sourceRasterCandidateCount:
        selectedForeground.length,

      removalMaskAssetId,

      repairAreaRatio,

      dilatedPx: 4,

      featheredPx: 0,
    },

    observationsAdded: {
      total: Object.keys(newObservations).length,
      backgroundCandidate: 1,
      quality: 1,
    },

    assetsCreated: Object.keys(newAssets).filter(
      (assetId) => !input.observationBundle.assets[assetId]
    ),

    warnings: backgroundObservation.warnings,

    createdAt: Date.now(),
  };

  const passAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "source",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
    storagePath: backgroundReconstructionPassReportPath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: passAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(pass, null, 2), "utf8"),

    assetId: passAssetId,
    kind: "background_reconstruction_pass_json" as any,

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    source: "system",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  return {
    updatedBundle,
    updatedBundleAsset,
    backgroundReconstructionPass: pass,
    backgroundReconstructionPassAsset: passAsset,
    backgroundCandidateObservation: backgroundObservation,
    assets: newAssets,
  };
}

async function runSolidPaletteFillRepair(input: {
  imageBuffer: Buffer;
  maskBuffer: Buffer;
}): Promise<Buffer> {
  /**
   * First-pass fallback:
   * return original. Later implement palette fill using dominant background colors.
   */
  return input.imageBuffer;
}

function stableAssetId(jobId: string, label: string) {
  return `asset_${jobId}_${label}`
    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "_")
    .toLowerCase();
}
```

Remove `as any` after patching the asset enum.

# 14.19 Firestore patch

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/background-reconstruction/apply-background-reconstruction-result.ts
```

```ts
import {
  FieldValue,
  getFirestore,
} from "firebase-admin/firestore";

import type {
  BackgroundReconstructionResult,
} from "./background-reconstruction.types";

export async function applyBackgroundReconstructionResult(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  jobId: string;
  result: BackgroundReconstructionResult;
}) {
  const db = getFirestore();

  const jobRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/aiLayerJobs/${input.jobId}`
  );

  const batch = db.batch();

  const assetsToIndex = [
    input.result.updatedBundleAsset,
    input.result.backgroundReconstructionPassAsset,
  ];

  for (const asset of assetsToIndex) {
    batch.set(
      db.doc(
        `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/assets/${asset.id}`
      ),
      {
        id: asset.id,

        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        jobId: input.jobId,

        kind: asset.kind,
        storageRole: asset.storageRole,

        bucket: asset.bucket,
        storagePath: asset.storagePath,

        generation: asset.generation,
        metageneration: asset.metageneration,

        mimeType: asset.mimeType,

        width: asset.width,
        height: asset.height,
        sizeBytes: asset.sizeBytes,

        checksum: asset.checksum,

        source: asset.metadata?.source,

        retained: true,

        createdAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      },
      { merge: true }
    );
  }

  batch.update(jobRef, {
    "input.observationBundleAssetId":
      input.result.updatedBundleAsset.id,

    backgroundReconstruction: {
      backgroundReconstructionPassAssetId:
        input.result.backgroundReconstructionPassAsset.id,

      outputObservationBundleAssetId:
        input.result.updatedBundleAsset.id,

      backgroundCandidateObservationId:
        input.result.backgroundCandidateObservation.id,

      cleanBackgroundAssetId:
        input.result.backgroundCandidateObservation.cleanBackgroundAssetId,

      removalMaskAssetId:
        input.result.backgroundCandidateObservation.removalMaskAssetId ?? null,

      engine:
        input.result.backgroundReconstructionPass.engine,

      mask:
        input.result.backgroundReconstructionPass.mask,

      validation:
        input.result.backgroundCandidateObservation.validation,

      repair:
        input.result.backgroundCandidateObservation.repair,

      warnings:
        input.result.backgroundCandidateObservation.warnings,

      createdAt:
        input.result.backgroundReconstructionPass.createdAt,
    },

    "progress.percent": 76,
    "progress.label": "Background candidate reconstructed",
    "progress.currentStep": "repairing_background",

    updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
  });

  await batch.commit();
}
```

Firestore stores only summary and pointers.

# 14.21 Background candidate acceptance rules

Step 14 does not accept final background, but it marks eligibility.

A background candidate can become final clean background later only if:

```txt
validation.passed = true
outsideMaskMutationRatio is near zero
cleanBackgroundAssetId exists
fallback original exists
repairAreaRatio is within policy
hallucinationRisk is acceptable
seamScore is acceptable
candidate is not from disabled generative engine
```

It must become review/fallback when:

```txt
repairAreaRatio is large
visible seam risk is high
engine failed
generative repair was used
text/logo areas were part of mask
background changed outside mask
candidate came from many low-confidence foreground candidates
```

It must fallback to original when:

```txt
outside-mask mutation detected
mask too large
repair engine unavailable
inpaint output corrupt
no safe foreground candidates exist
```

---

# 14.22 Important product rule

The first rendered design should still visually match the original.

The scene resolver will usually stack:

```txt
clean background candidate
+ raster/vector/text foreground candidates
```

If the foreground candidates are correct, the first render matches original.

If background repair is poor but hidden underneath foreground objects, the first render may still pass. The weakness becomes visible only when user moves objects. Therefore the UI should mark:

```txt
Clean background · generated · needs review
```

when `background_candidate.validation.needsReview = true`.

---

# 14.23 Route-specific behavior

## `graphic_design_layer_decomposition`

Default:

```txt
LaMa or OpenCV depending on mask size
palette-aware postprocess later
generative repair disabled
```

Risk:

```txt
poster backgrounds may contain flat colors, gradients, patterns, text, decorative shapes
```

Mitigation:

```txt
prefer conservative fill
keep original reference fallback
mark large repairs needsReview
```

## `photo_conservative_segmentation`

Default:

```txt
OpenCV for small local repairs
LaMa for medium repairs
Gemini Image optional later for large photo background cleanup
```

Risk:

```txt
photo background can tolerate texture synthesis better than poster text/logo areas
```

Mitigation:

```txt
force mask composite
review large repairs
do not alter foreground
```

## `text_recovery_priority`

Default:

```txt
very conservative
repair only behind text candidates that have raster/live layer candidates
mark as needsReview
```

Risk:

```txt
removing dense menu/document text can create unusable background
```

Mitigation:

```txt
do not remove low-confidence text
do not use semantic generative repair
```

## `vectorization_priority`

Default:

```txt
often no repair
solid palette fill when obvious
```

Risk:

```txt
logo/icon source may not need background reconstruction at all
```

Mitigation:

```txt
fallback to original/reference
```

## `fallback_only`

Default:

```txt
none_original
```

No repair.

---

# 14.24 What Step 14 must not do

Do not add:

```txt
Fabric background image
AiReconstructedLayer
final clean_background layer
final foreground removal decision
final z-order
full-scene validation
text semantic validation
new visual elements
creative background replacement
prompt-based redesign
```

Do not let background repair:

```txt
rewrite text
invent logos
invent objects
change unmasked pixels
change canvas size
replace whole image
remove low-confidence foreground
```

## ChatGPT Response 025

Step 15 treats z-order as constraint resolution rather than simple type sorting. The output remains ordering evidence, not final Fabric stacking.

Final stack acceptance stays in the scene resolver, so this step only prepares a candidate order for later consumption.

# Step 15 — Z-order resolver

Step 15 computes **stacking-order evidence** from all candidate observations.

The locked rule:

```txt
Z-order resolver does not create final layer zIndex.
Z-order resolver creates z_order observations and a z-order pass report.
The scene resolver later assigns final AiReconstructedLayer.zIndex.
```

This distinction matters. Fabric object order is the draw stack, and Fabric exposes explicit stack APIs like `insertAt`, `moveObjectTo`, `bringObjectForward`, and `sendObjectBackwards`. But Step 15 must not touch Fabric yet. It only prepares the ordering evidence that Step 17 will use. citeturn504806search4

LayerD gives strong ordering evidence for graphic designs because it repeatedly extracts unoccluded front layers. That means LayerD output is naturally useful as front-to-back evidence, but it still cannot be accepted blindly because the decomposition task is ill-posed and layer granularity can vary. citeturn288443search9turn288443search3

---

## 15.1 What Step 15 owns

Step 15 owns:

```txt
z-order candidate node creation
base stack-band scoring
pairwise ordering constraints
LayerD order evidence integration
Gemini zIndexGuess integration
text-over-shape constraints
subject-over-shadow constraints
foreground-over-background constraints
cycle detection
conflict resolution

z_order observations

```

Step 15 does **not** own:

```txt
final AiReconstructedLayer.zIndex
final layer acceptance
final group resolution
Fabric object order
Fabric JSON

```

---

# 15.2 Why z-order is not just sorting by object type

Simple sorting fails.

Bad rule:

```txt
background
shapes
photos
text
```

Why it fails:

```txt
text can be behind a translucent overlay
badge shape should be behind badge text
shadow should be below product but above background
logo may be above photo but below headline
image block may contain text-like pixels that should not be split
decorations can be behind or above product
LayerD order may conflict with semantic layout order
```

The correct model is:

```txt
candidate objects
+ pairwise constraints
+ class priors
+ source evidence
+ overlap evidence
+ conflict resolution
→ provisional stacking order
```

Canvas compositing is source-over by default: newly drawn content is composited over its backdrop. So final visual correctness depends directly on object order. The W3C compositing spec describes this source-over model as merging each rendered element with the backdrop. citeturn212494search1
