# 15.5 Patch Step 1 schema: enrich `AiZOrderObservation`

Patch the existing z-order observation to support both pairwise and global-order evidence.

```ts
export type AiZOrderEvidence =
  | "layerd_order"
  | "gemini_z_index_guess"
  | "class_priority"
  | "bbox_overlap"
  | "mask_overlap"
  | "containment"
  | "text_over_shape"
  | "shadow_under_subject"
  | "background_priority"
  | "manual_user"
  | "scene_resolver";

export type AiZOrderBand =
  | "locked_reference"
  | "background"
  | "clean_background"
  | "large_background_shape"
  | "decorative_back"
  | "image_block"
  | "shadow"
  | "photo_subject"
  | "product_person"
  | "shape"
  | "logo_icon"
  | "badge"
  | "text"
  | "overlay"
  | "unknown";

export type AiZOrderObservation = AiObservationBase & {
  kind: "z_order";

  mode:
    | "pairwise_relation"
    | "global_order"
    | "conflict"
    | "manual_override";

  /**
   * For pairwise relation:
   * frontObservationId is in front of backObservationId.
   */
  frontObservationId?: string;

  backObservationId?: string;

  relation?:
    | "in_front_of"
    | "behind"
    | "same_band"
    | "uncertain";

  /**
   * For global order:
   * bottom-to-top observation IDs.
   */
  orderedObservationIds?: string[];

  zIndexHints?: {
    observationId: string;

    provisionalOrder: number;

    band: AiZOrderBand;

    bandScore: number;

    localScore: number;

    confidence: number;

    reasonCodes: string[];
  }[];

  conflict?: {
    involvedObservationIds: string[];

    droppedConstraintIds: string[];

    reason: string;
  };

  evidence: AiZOrderEvidence[];

  weight: number;

  confidence: AiConfidence;

  warnings?: string[];
};
```

This keeps z-order auditable instead of hiding it inside a sort function.

```ts
export const MAGIC_LAYERS_Z_ORDER_POLICY = {
  /**
   * Lower band score = lower in stack.
   * Higher band score = visually in front.
   */
  bands: {
    locked_reference: -1000,

    background: -900,
    clean_background: -850,
    large_background_shape: -700,

    decorative_back: -500,

    image_block: -300,

    shadow: -120,

    photo_subject: 0,

    product_person: 100,

    shape: 180,

    logo_icon: 260,

    badge: 320,

    text: 420,

    overlay: 520,

    unknown: 40,
  },

  constraints: {
    hardBackgroundBelowEverything: true,

    hardLockedReferenceBottom: true,

    textOverShapeWeight: 0.85,

    shadowUnderSubjectWeight: 0.78,

    containmentWeight: 0.72,

    layerDOrderWeight: 0.8,

    geminiGuessWeight: 0.45,

    classPriorityWeight: 0.55,

    overlapClassPriorityWeight: 0.62,
  },

  overlap: {
    minBBoxIoUForConstraint: 0.03,

    minContainmentRatio: 0.72,

    maxPairs: 5000,
  },

  conflict: {
    dropWeakestCycleEdge: true,

    minKeptConstraintWeight: 0.2,

    maxDroppedConstraintRatioBeforeNeedsReview: 0.18,
  },

  ordering: {
    provisionalOrderStep: 10,
  },
} as const;
```

This policy should be conservative. Z-order errors are visible immediately in the first render.

---

# 15.10 Stack bands

Use stack bands to avoid nonsensical orders.

Bottom-to-top default:

```txt
locked_reference
background
clean_background
large_background_shape
decorative_back
image_block
shadow
photo_subject
product_person
shape
logo_icon
badge
text
overlay
unknown
```

Important caveat:

```txt
Bands are priors, not final truth.
Pairwise constraints can override bands when evidence is strong.
```

Examples:

```txt
button text over button shape
badge text over badge circle
shadow under product
logo over image block
foreground product over background decoration
overlay above subject when explicit overlay evidence exists
```

```ts
  AiBackgroundCandidateObservation,
  AiElementCandidateObservation,
  AiLayoutObservation,
  AiObservation,
  AiRasterCandidateObservation,
  AiTextCandidateObservation,
  AiVectorCandidateObservation,
  AiZOrderBand,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import type {
  ZOrderNode,
} from "./z-order.types";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_Z_ORDER_POLICY,
} from "./z-order-policy";

export function buildZOrderNodes(
  observations: AiObservation[]
): ZOrderNode[] {
  const nodes: ZOrderNode[] = [];

  for (const obs of observations) {
    if (obs.kind === "background_candidate") {
      nodes.push(backgroundNode(obs));
    }

    if (obs.kind === "raster_candidate") {
      nodes.push(rasterNode(obs));
    }

    if (obs.kind === "vector_candidate") {
      nodes.push(vectorNode(obs));
    }

    if (obs.kind === "text_candidate") {
      nodes.push(textNode(obs));
    }

    /**
     * Only include element candidates that do not already have a stronger
     * raster/vector/text candidate covering them.
     * The scene resolver will still de-duplicate later.
     */
    if (obs.kind === "element_candidate") {
      nodes.push(elementNode(obs));
    }

    /**
     * Layout observations are weak z-order support.
     * They should not become final layers on their own unless needed.
     */
    if (obs.kind === "layout" && obs.bbox) {
      nodes.push(layoutNode(obs));
    }
  }

  return dedupeNodes(nodes);
}

function backgroundNode(
  obs: AiBackgroundCandidateObservation
): ZOrderNode {
  return {
    observationId: obs.id,
    kind: "background_candidate",
    band: "clean_background",
    bbox: obs.canvasBBox,
    role: "clean_background",
    sourceObservationIds: [
      obs.id,
      ...obs.sourceRasterCandidateObservationIds,
    ],
    confidence: obs.confidence?.overall ?? 0.7,
    baseBandScore:
      MAGIC_LAYERS_Z_ORDER_POLICY.bands.clean_background,
    localScore: 0,
    reasonCodes: ["background_candidate_clean_background"],
  };
}

function rasterNode(
  obs: AiRasterCandidateObservation
): ZOrderNode {
  const band = rasterRoleToBand(obs.role);

  return {
    observationId: obs.id,
    kind: "raster_candidate",
    band,
    bbox: obs.bbox,
    role: obs.role,
    sourceObservationIds: obs.sourceObservationIds,
    confidence: obs.confidence?.overall ?? 0.6,
    baseBandScore:
      MAGIC_LAYERS_Z_ORDER_POLICY.bands[band],
    localScore: rasterLocalScore(obs),
    reasonCodes: [`raster_role_${obs.role}`],
  };
}

function vectorNode(
  obs: AiVectorCandidateObservation
): ZOrderNode {
  const band =
    obs.primitive === "rect" ||
    obs.primitive === "rounded_rect" ||
    obs.primitive === "circle" ||
    obs.primitive === "ellipse"
      ? "shape"
      : "logo_icon";

  return {
    observationId: obs.id,
    kind: "vector_candidate",
    band,
    bbox: obs.bbox,
    role: obs.primitive,
    sourceObservationIds: [
      obs.id,
      obs.sourceElementCandidateId,
      ...obs.sourceComponentObservationIds,
    ],
    confidence: obs.confidence?.overall ?? 0.6,
    baseBandScore:
      MAGIC_LAYERS_Z_ORDER_POLICY.bands[band],
    localScore: obs.editability.eligibleForVectorEditable ? 12 : 0,
    reasonCodes: [`vector_primitive_${obs.primitive}`],
  };
}

function textNode(
  obs: AiTextCandidateObservation
): ZOrderNode {
  return {
    observationId: obs.id,
    kind: "text_candidate",
    band: "text",
    bbox: obs.bbox,
    role: obs.textRole,
    sourceObservationIds: [
      obs.id,
      ...obs.sourceOcrObservationIds,
      ...obs.sourceLayoutObservationIds,
    ],
    confidence: obs.confidence?.overall ?? 0.7,
    baseBandScore:
      MAGIC_LAYERS_Z_ORDER_POLICY.bands.text,
    localScore:
      obs.editability === "candidate_live_text"
        ? 20
        : obs.editability === "candidate_with_review"
          ? 8
          : 0,
    reasonCodes: [`text_role_${obs.textRole}`],
  };
}

function elementNode(
  obs: AiElementCandidateObservation
): ZOrderNode {
  const band = elementTypeToBand(obs.elementTypeGuess);

  return {
    observationId: obs.id,
    kind: "element_candidate",
    band,
    bbox: obs.bbox,
    role: obs.elementTypeGuess,
    sourceObservationIds: [
      obs.id,
      ...obs.sourceObservationIds,
    ],
    confidence: obs.confidence?.overall ?? 0.45,
    baseBandScore:
      MAGIC_LAYERS_Z_ORDER_POLICY.bands[band],
    localScore: obs.metrics.objectness * 10,
    reasonCodes: [`element_type_${obs.elementTypeGuess}`],
  };
}

function layoutNode(
  obs: AiLayoutObservation
): ZOrderNode {
  const band = layoutTypeToBand(obs.layerTypeGuess);

  return {
    observationId: obs.id,
    kind: "layout",
    band,
    bbox: obs.bbox!,
    role: obs.layerTypeGuess,
    sourceObservationIds: [obs.id],
    geminiZIndexGuess: obs.zIndexGuess,
    confidence: obs.confidence?.overall ?? 0.4,
    baseBandScore:
      MAGIC_LAYERS_Z_ORDER_POLICY.bands[band],
    localScore: obs.zIndexGuess ?? 0,
    reasonCodes: [
      "layout_observation_weak_z_order_support",
    ],
  };
}

function rasterRoleToBand(
  role: AiRasterCandidateObservation["role"]
): AiZOrderBand {
  switch (role) {
    case "text_raster_fallback":
      return "text";

    case "person":
    case "product":
      return "product_person";

    case "photo_subject":
      return "photo_subject";

    case "image_block":
      return "image_block";

    case "logo_icon_raster":
      return "logo_icon";

    case "shape_raster_fallback":
      return "shape";

    case "decoration":
      return "decorative_back";

    case "shadow":
      return "shadow";

    case "overlay":
      return "overlay";

    default:
      return "unknown";
  }
}

function elementTypeToBand(
  type: AiElementCandidateObservation["elementTypeGuess"]
): AiZOrderBand {
  switch (type) {
    case "text_region":
      return "text";

    case "person":
    case "product":
      return "product_person";

    case "photo_subject":
    case "raster_subject":
      return "photo_subject";

    case "image_block":
      return "image_block";

    case "logo_icon":
      return "logo_icon";

    case "shape":
      return "shape";

    case "decoration":
      return "decorative_back";

    case "shadow":
      return "shadow";

    case "overlay":
      return "overlay";

    case "background_fragment":
      return "large_background_shape";

    default:
      return "unknown";
  }
}

function layoutTypeToBand(
  type: AiLayoutObservation["layerTypeGuess"]
): AiZOrderBand {
  switch (type) {
    case "background":
    case "clean_background":
      return "background";

    case "image_block":
      return "image_block";

    case "person":
    case "product":
      return "product_person";

    case "photo_subject":
      return "photo_subject";

    case "logo":
    case "icon":
      return "logo_icon";

    case "shape":
      return "shape";

    case "decoration":
      return "decorative_back";

    case "shadow":
      return "shadow";

    case "overlay":
      return "overlay";

    case "text":
      return "text";

    default:
      return "unknown";
  }
}

function rasterLocalScore(obs: AiRasterCandidateObservation) {
  if (obs.editability.recommendedStrategy === "raster_masked") {
    return 15;
  }

  if (obs.editability.recommendedStrategy === "manual_review") {
    return 4;
  }

  return 0;
}

function dedupeNodes(nodes: ZOrderNode[]): ZOrderNode[] {
  const seen = new Set<string>();

  const result: ZOrderNode[] = [];

  for (const node of nodes) {
    if (seen.has(node.observationId)) continue;

    seen.add(node.observationId);
    result.push(node);
  }

  return result;
}
```

# 15.12 Build z-order constraints

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/z-order/build-z-order-constraints.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiObservation,
  AiZOrderObservation,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  bboxArea,
  bboxIntersectionArea,
} from "../schema/geometry";

import type {
  ZOrderConstraint,
  ZOrderNode,
} from "./z-order.types";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_Z_ORDER_POLICY,
} from "./z-order-policy";

export function buildZOrderConstraints(input: {
  nodes: ZOrderNode[];
  observations: AiObservation[];
}): ZOrderConstraint[] {
  const constraints: ZOrderConstraint[] = [];

  constraints.push(...backgroundConstraints(input.nodes));

  constraints.push(...existingZOrderObservationConstraints(input.observations));

  constraints.push(...classBandConstraints(input.nodes));

  constraints.push(...overlapConstraints(input.nodes));

  constraints.push(...containmentConstraints(input.nodes));

  constraints.push(...textOverShapeConstraints(input.nodes));

  constraints.push(...shadowUnderSubjectConstraints(input.nodes));

  constraints.push(...geminiGuessConstraints(input.nodes));

  return dedupeConstraints(constraints);
}

function backgroundConstraints(nodes: ZOrderNode[]): ZOrderConstraint[] {
  const backgrounds = nodes.filter((node) =>
    ["background", "clean_background", "locked_reference"].includes(
      node.band
    )
  );

  const foregrounds = nodes.filter(
    (node) => !backgrounds.includes(node)
  );

  const constraints: ZOrderConstraint[] = [];

  for (const background of backgrounds) {
    for (const fg of foregrounds) {
      constraints.push({
        id: `constraint_background_${fg.observationId}_over_${background.observationId}`,
        frontObservationId: fg.observationId,
        backObservationId: background.observationId,
        evidence: "background_priority",
        weight: 1,
        confidence: Math.min(1, fg.confidence),
        reasonCodes: ["background_below_foreground"],
        hard: true,
      });
    }
  }

  return constraints;
}

function existingZOrderObservationConstraints(
  observations: AiObservation[]
): ZOrderConstraint[] {
  return observations
    .filter((obs): obs is AiZOrderObservation => obs.kind === "z_order")
    .filter(
      (obs) =>
        obs.mode === "pairwise_relation" &&
        obs.frontObservationId &&
        obs.backObservationId &&
        obs.relation === "in_front_of"
    )
    .map((obs) => ({
      id: `constraint_existing_${obs.id}`,
      frontObservationId: obs.frontObservationId!,
      backObservationId: obs.backObservationId!,
      evidence: obs.evidence[0] ?? "layerd_order",
      weight: obs.weight ?? 0.6,
      confidence: obs.confidence?.overall ?? 0.6,
      reasonCodes: ["existing_z_order_observation"],
      hard: false,
    }));
}

function classBandConstraints(nodes: ZOrderNode[]): ZOrderConstraint[] {
  const constraints: ZOrderConstraint[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < nodes.length; j++) {
      const a = nodes[i];
      const b = nodes[j];

      const diff = a.baseBandScore - b.baseBandScore;

      if (Math.abs(diff) < 100) continue;

      const front = diff > 0 ? a : b;
      const back = diff > 0 ? b : a;

      constraints.push({
        id: `constraint_band_${front.observationId}_over_${back.observationId}`,
        frontObservationId: front.observationId,
        backObservationId: back.observationId,
        evidence: "class_priority",
        weight:
          MAGIC_LAYERS_Z_ORDER_POLICY.constraints.classPriorityWeight,
        confidence: Math.min(front.confidence, back.confidence, 0.65),
        reasonCodes: [
          `band_${front.band}_above_${back.band}`,
        ],
        hard: false,
      });
    }
  }

  return constraints;
}

function overlapConstraints(nodes: ZOrderNode[]): ZOrderConstraint[] {
  const constraints: ZOrderConstraint[] = [];

  let pairCount = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < nodes.length; j++) {
      if (pairCount >= MAGIC_LAYERS_Z_ORDER_POLICY.overlap.maxPairs) {
        return constraints;
      }

      pairCount++;

      const a = nodes[i];
      const b = nodes[j];

      const intersection = bboxIntersectionArea(a.bbox, b.bbox);

      const minArea = Math.min(bboxArea(a.bbox), bboxArea(b.bbox));

      const overlapRatio = intersection / Math.max(1, minArea);

      if (
        overlapRatio <
        MAGIC_LAYERS_Z_ORDER_POLICY.overlap.minBBoxIoUForConstraint
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      if (a.baseBandScore === b.baseBandScore) continue;

      const front =
        a.baseBandScore > b.baseBandScore ? a : b;

      const back =
        a.baseBandScore > b.baseBandScore ? b : a;

      constraints.push({
        id: `constraint_overlap_${front.observationId}_over_${back.observationId}`,
        frontObservationId: front.observationId,
        backObservationId: back.observationId,
        evidence: "bbox_overlap",
        weight:
          MAGIC_LAYERS_Z_ORDER_POLICY.constraints
            .overlapClassPriorityWeight * overlapRatio,
        confidence: Math.min(front.confidence, back.confidence),
        reasonCodes: [
          "overlapping_candidates_class_priority",
          `overlap_ratio_${round(overlapRatio)}`,
        ],
        hard: false,
      });
    }
  }

  return constraints;
}

function containmentConstraints(nodes: ZOrderNode[]): ZOrderConstraint[] {
  const constraints: ZOrderConstraint[] = [];

  for (const inner of nodes) {
    for (const outer of nodes) {
      if (inner.observationId === outer.observationId) continue;

      const intersection = bboxIntersectionArea(inner.bbox, outer.bbox);
      const containment =
        intersection / Math.max(1, bboxArea(inner.bbox));

      if (
        containment <
        MAGIC_LAYERS_Z_ORDER_POLICY.overlap.minContainmentRatio
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      /**
       * Text/logo/icon inside a shape/card/badge likely sits above the container.
       */
      const innerLikelyFront = ["text", "logo_icon"].includes(inner.band);
      const outerLikelyBack = [
        "shape",
        "badge",
        "image_block",
        "large_background_shape",
      ].includes(outer.band);

      if (!innerLikelyFront || !outerLikelyBack) continue;

      constraints.push({
        id: `constraint_containment_${inner.observationId}_over_${outer.observationId}`,
        frontObservationId: inner.observationId,
        backObservationId: outer.observationId,
        evidence: "containment",
        weight:
          MAGIC_LAYERS_Z_ORDER_POLICY.constraints.containmentWeight,
        confidence: Math.min(inner.confidence, outer.confidence),
        reasonCodes: [
          "inner_text_or_icon_over_container",
          `containment_${round(containment)}`,
        ],
        hard: false,
      });
    }
  }

  return constraints;
}

function textOverShapeConstraints(nodes: ZOrderNode[]): ZOrderConstraint[] {
  const textNodes = nodes.filter((node) => node.band === "text");

  const shapeNodes = nodes.filter((node) =>
    ["shape", "badge", "large_background_shape"].includes(node.band)
  );

  const constraints: ZOrderConstraint[] = [];

  for (const text of textNodes) {
    for (const shape of shapeNodes) {
      const intersection = bboxIntersectionArea(text.bbox, shape.bbox);

      if (intersection <= 0) continue;

      constraints.push({
        id: `constraint_text_${text.observationId}_over_${shape.observationId}`,
        frontObservationId: text.observationId,
        backObservationId: shape.observationId,
        evidence: "text_over_shape",
        weight:
          MAGIC_LAYERS_Z_ORDER_POLICY.constraints.textOverShapeWeight,
        confidence: Math.min(text.confidence, shape.confidence),
        reasonCodes: ["text_overlapping_shape"],
        hard: false,
      });
    }
  }

  return constraints;
}

function shadowUnderSubjectConstraints(nodes: ZOrderNode[]): ZOrderConstraint[] {
  const shadows = nodes.filter((node) => node.band === "shadow");

  const subjects = nodes.filter((node) =>
    ["photo_subject", "product_person"].includes(node.band)
  );

  const constraints: ZOrderConstraint[] = [];

  for (const subject of subjects) {
    for (const shadow of shadows) {
      const intersection = bboxIntersectionArea(subject.bbox, shadow.bbox);

      if (intersection <= 0) continue;

      constraints.push({
        id: `constraint_subject_${subject.observationId}_over_shadow_${shadow.observationId}`,
        frontObservationId: subject.observationId,
        backObservationId: shadow.observationId,
        evidence: "shadow_under_subject",
        weight:
          MAGIC_LAYERS_Z_ORDER_POLICY.constraints.shadowUnderSubjectWeight,
        confidence: Math.min(subject.confidence, shadow.confidence),
        reasonCodes: ["subject_over_own_shadow_candidate"],
        hard: false,
      });
    }
  }

  return constraints;
}

function geminiGuessConstraints(nodes: ZOrderNode[]): ZOrderConstraint[] {
  const layoutNodes = nodes.filter(
    (node) => typeof node.geminiZIndexGuess === "number"
  );

  const constraints: ZOrderConstraint[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < layoutNodes.length; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < layoutNodes.length; j++) {
      const a = layoutNodes[i];
      const b = layoutNodes[j];

      if (a.geminiZIndexGuess === b.geminiZIndexGuess) continue;

      const front =
        (a.geminiZIndexGuess ?? 0) > (b.geminiZIndexGuess ?? 0)
          ? a
          : b;

      const back =
        front === a ? b : a;

      constraints.push({
        id: `constraint_gemini_${front.observationId}_over_${back.observationId}`,
        frontObservationId: front.observationId,
        backObservationId: back.observationId,
        evidence: "gemini_z_index_guess",
        weight:
          MAGIC_LAYERS_Z_ORDER_POLICY.constraints.geminiGuessWeight,
        confidence: Math.min(front.confidence, back.confidence, 0.55),
        reasonCodes: ["gemini_layout_z_index_guess"],
        hard: false,
      });
    }
  }

  return constraints;
}

function dedupeConstraints(
  constraints: ZOrderConstraint[]
): ZOrderConstraint[] {
  const bestByPair = new Map<string, ZOrderConstraint>();

  for (const constraint of constraints) {
    const key =
      `${constraint.frontObservationId}->${constraint.backObservationId}`;

    const existing = bestByPair.get(key);

    if (
      !existing ||
      constraint.weight * constraint.confidence >
        existing.weight * existing.confidence
    ) {
      bestByPair.set(key, constraint);
    }
  }

  return [...bestByPair.values()];
}

function round(value: number) {
  return Math.round(value * 1000) / 1000;
}
```

# 15.13 Resolve constraints into provisional order

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/z-order/resolve-z-order-constraints.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  ZOrderConstraint,
  ZOrderNode,
  ZOrderResolution,
} from "./z-order.types";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_Z_ORDER_POLICY,
} from "./z-order-policy";

export function resolveZOrderConstraints(input: {
  nodes: ZOrderNode[];
  constraints: ZOrderConstraint[];
}): ZOrderResolution {
  const nodesById = new Map(
    input.nodes.map((node) => [node.observationId, node])
  );

  let constraints = [...input.constraints];

  const dropped: string[] = [];
  const conflicts: ZOrderResolution["conflicts"] = [];

  /**
   * Weighted cycle breaking:
   * repeatedly drop the weakest non-hard edge in a detected cycle.
   */
  while (true) {
    const cycle = findCycle({
      nodeIds: input.nodes.map((node) => node.observationId),
      constraints,
    });

    if (!cycle) break;

    const cycleEdges = constraints.filter((constraint) =>
      cycle.edgeIds.includes(constraint.id)
    );

    const weakest = [...cycleEdges]
      .filter((edge) => !edge.hard)
      .sort(
        (a, b) =>
          a.weight * a.confidence - b.weight * b.confidence
      )[0];

    if (!weakest) {
      /**
       * Hard cycle means contradictory required constraints.
       * Drop the lowest-confidence hard edge anyway, but mark conflict.
       */
      const weakestHard = [...cycleEdges].sort(
        (a, b) =>
          a.weight * a.confidence - b.weight * b.confidence
      )[0];

      constraints = constraints.filter(
        (constraint) => constraint.id !== weakestHard.id
      );

      dropped.push(weakestHard.id);

      conflicts.push({
        involvedObservationIds: cycle.nodeIds,
        droppedConstraintIds: [weakestHard.id],
        reason: "hard_z_order_cycle_broken_by_lowest_confidence_edge",
      });

      continue;
    }

    constraints = constraints.filter(
      (constraint) => constraint.id !== weakest.id
    );

    dropped.push(weakest.id);

    conflicts.push({
      involvedObservationIds: cycle.nodeIds,
      droppedConstraintIds: [weakest.id],
      reason: "z_order_cycle_broken_by_weakest_soft_constraint",
    });
  }

  const orderedIds = stableTopologicalSort({
    nodes: input.nodes,
    constraints,
  });

  const hints = orderedIds.map((id, index) => {
    const node = nodesById.get(id)!;

    return {
      observationId: id,
      provisionalOrder:
        index * MAGIC_LAYERS_Z_ORDER_POLICY.ordering.provisionalOrderStep,
      band: node.band,
      bandScore: node.baseBandScore,
      localScore: node.localScore,
      confidence: node.confidence,
      reasonCodes: node.reasonCodes,
    };
  });

  const total = input.constraints.length;
  const used = constraints.length;

  const confidence =
    total === 0
      ? 0.5
      : Math.max(
          0,
          Math.min(
            1,
            used / total -
              conflicts.length * 0.03
          )
        );

  return {
    orderedObservationIds: orderedIds,
    hints,
    constraintsUsed: constraints.map((constraint) => constraint.id),
    constraintsDropped: dropped,
    conflicts,
    confidence,
  };
}

function stableTopologicalSort(input: {
  nodes: ZOrderNode[];
  constraints: ZOrderConstraint[];
}): string[] {
  const nodeIds = input.nodes.map((node) => node.observationId);

  const incoming = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  const outgoing = new Map<string, Set<string>>();

  for (const id of nodeIds) {
    incoming.set(id, new Set());
    outgoing.set(id, new Set());
  }

  /**
   * Constraint means: front is above back.
   * For bottom-to-top topological order:
   * back -> front.
   */
  for (const constraint of input.constraints) {
    if (
      !incoming.has(constraint.frontObservationId) ||
      !incoming.has(constraint.backObservationId)
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    outgoing
      .get(constraint.backObservationId)!
      .add(constraint.frontObservationId);

    incoming
      .get(constraint.frontObservationId)!
      .add(constraint.backObservationId);
  }

  const nodesById = new Map(
    input.nodes.map((node) => [node.observationId, node])
  );

  const ready = nodeIds
    .filter((id) => incoming.get(id)!.size === 0)
    .sort((a, b) => compareNodes(nodesById.get(a)!, nodesById.get(b)!));

  const result: string[] = [];

  while (ready.length) {
    const id = ready.shift()!;

    result.push(id);

    for (const next of outgoing.get(id) ?? []) {
      incoming.get(next)!.delete(id);

      if (incoming.get(next)!.size === 0) {
        ready.push(next);
        ready.sort((a, b) =>
          compareNodes(nodesById.get(a)!, nodesById.get(b)!)
        );
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Fallback: append any unresolved nodes by stable base score.
   */
  const unresolved = nodeIds.filter((id) => !result.includes(id));

  unresolved.sort((a, b) =>
    compareNodes(nodesById.get(a)!, nodesById.get(b)!)
  );

  return [...result, ...unresolved];
}

function compareNodes(a: ZOrderNode, b: ZOrderNode) {
  const scoreA = a.baseBandScore + a.localScore;
  const scoreB = b.baseBandScore + b.localScore;

  if (scoreA !== scoreB) return scoreA - scoreB;

  /**
   * Bigger objects often sit lower than smaller overlays/text.
   */
  const areaA = a.bbox.width * a.bbox.height;
  const areaB = b.bbox.width * b.bbox.height;

  if (areaA !== areaB) return areaB - areaA;

  return a.observationId.localeCompare(b.observationId);
}

function findCycle(input: {
  nodeIds: string[];
  constraints: ZOrderConstraint[];
}): null | {
  nodeIds: string[];
  edgeIds: string[];
} {
  const graph = new Map<string, { to: string; edgeId: string }[]>();

  for (const id of input.nodeIds) {
    graph.set(id, []);
  }

  for (const constraint of input.constraints) {
    graph.get(constraint.backObservationId)?.push({
      to: constraint.frontObservationId,
      edgeId: constraint.id,
    });
  }

  const visiting = new Set<string>();
  const visited = new Set<string>();
  const stack: { nodeId: string; edgeId?: string }[] = [];

  function dfs(nodeId: string): null | {
    nodeIds: string[];
    edgeIds: string[];
  } {
    visiting.add(nodeId);
    stack.push({ nodeId });

    for (const edge of graph.get(nodeId) ?? []) {
      if (visited.has(edge.to)) continue;

      if (visiting.has(edge.to)) {
        const start = stack.findIndex((entry) => entry.nodeId === edge.to);
        const cycleStack = stack.slice(start);

        return {
          nodeIds: cycleStack.map((entry) => entry.nodeId),
          edgeIds: [
            ...cycleStack
              .map((entry) => entry.edgeId)
              .filter((id): id is string => Boolean(id)),
            edge.edgeId,
          ],
        };
      }

      stack.push({ nodeId: edge.to, edgeId: edge.edgeId });
      const result = dfs(edge.to);
      if (result) return result;
      stack.pop();
    }

    visiting.delete(nodeId);
    visited.add(nodeId);
    stack.pop();

    return null;
  }

  for (const id of input.nodeIds) {
    if (visited.has(id)) continue;

    const result = dfs(id);
    if (result) return result;
  }

  return null;
}
```

This resolver produces bottom-to-top ordering. Later, Step 18 maps that into Fabric object order.

# 15.14 Create z-order observations


```ts
import type {
  AiZOrderObservation,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import type {
  ZOrderConstraint,
  ZOrderResolution,
} from "./z-order.types";

export function createZOrderObservations(input: {
  jobId: string;
  designId: string;

  resolution: ZOrderResolution;

  constraints: ZOrderConstraint[];
}): AiZOrderObservation[] {
  const now = Date.now();

  const observations: AiZOrderObservation[] = [];

  observations.push({
    id: "obs_z_order_global_resolved",

    jobId: input.jobId,
    designId: input.designId,

    kind: "z_order",

    source: "z_order_resolver",

    createdAt: now,

    mode: "global_order",

    orderedObservationIds: input.resolution.orderedObservationIds,

    zIndexHints: input.resolution.hints,

    evidence: [
      "class_priority",
      "bbox_overlap",
      "containment",
      "layerd_order",
      "gemini_z_index_guess",
      "background_priority",
    ],

    weight: 1,

    confidence: {
      overall: input.resolution.confidence,
      zIndex: input.resolution.confidence,
    },

    warnings:
      input.resolution.conflicts.length > 0
        ? ["z_order_conflicts_resolved"]
        : [],
  });

  for (const constraint of input.constraints) {
    if (!input.resolution.constraintsUsed.includes(constraint.id)) {
      continue;
    }

    observations.push({
      id: `obs_z_order_pair_${constraint.id}`,

      jobId: input.jobId,
      designId: input.designId,

      kind: "z_order",

      source: "z_order_resolver",

      createdAt: now,

      mode: "pairwise_relation",

      frontObservationId: constraint.frontObservationId,

      backObservationId: constraint.backObservationId,

      relation: "in_front_of",

      evidence: [constraint.evidence],

      weight: constraint.weight,

      confidence: {
        overall: constraint.confidence,
        zIndex: constraint.confidence,
      },

      warnings: [],
    });
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < input.resolution.conflicts.length; i++) {
    const conflict = input.resolution.conflicts[i];

    observations.push({
      id: `obs_z_order_conflict_${i}`,

      jobId: input.jobId,
      designId: input.designId,

      kind: "z_order",

      source: "z_order_resolver",

      createdAt: now,

      mode: "conflict",

      conflict,

      evidence: ["class_priority"],

      weight: 0,

      confidence: {
        overall: 0.4,
        zIndex: 0.4,
      },

      warnings: ["z_order_conflict"],
    });
  }

  return observations;
}
```

# 15.15 Z-order pass runner

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/z-order/run-z-order-resolution-pass.ts
```

```ts
import {
  AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,
  AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
} from "../schema/constants";

import type {
  AiObservation,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import type {
  AiObservationBundle,
} from "../observations/observation-bundle.types";

import {
  bucketForMagicStorageRole,
} from "../storage/storage-buckets";

import {
  observationBundlePath,
  zOrderResolutionPassReportPath,
} from "../storage/storage-paths";

import {
  writeAiAsset,
} from "../storage/write-ai-asset";

import {
  buildZOrderNodes,
} from "./build-z-order-nodes";

import {
  buildZOrderConstraints,
} from "./build-z-order-constraints";

import {
  resolveZOrderConstraints,
} from "./resolve-z-order-constraints";

import {
  createZOrderObservations,
} from "./create-z-order-observations";

import type {
  ZOrderResolutionPass,
  ZOrderResolutionResult,
} from "./z-order.types";

export async function runZOrderResolutionPass(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  jobId: string;
  userId: string;

  sourceObservationBundleAssetId: string;

  observationBundle: AiObservationBundle;
}): Promise<ZOrderResolutionResult> {
  const observations = Object.values(input.observationBundle.observations);

  const nodes = buildZOrderNodes(observations);

  const constraints = buildZOrderConstraints({
    nodes,
    observations,
  });

  const resolution = resolveZOrderConstraints({
    nodes,
    constraints,
  });

  const zOrderObservations = createZOrderObservations({
    jobId: input.jobId,
    designId: input.designId,
    resolution,
    constraints,
  });

  const qualityObservation: AiObservation = {
    id: "obs_quality_z_order_resolution",

    jobId: input.jobId,
    designId: input.designId,

    kind: "quality",

    source: "z_order_resolver",

    createdAt: Date.now(),

    target: "whole_scene",

    metrics: {
      zOrderConflictCount: resolution.conflicts.length,
    },

    passed:
      resolution.conflicts.length === 0 ||
      resolution.confidence >= 0.65,

    confidence: {
      overall: resolution.confidence,
      zIndex: resolution.confidence,
    },

    warnings:
      resolution.conflicts.length > 0
        ? ["z_order_conflicts_present"]
        : [],
  };

  const newObservations: Record<string, AiObservation> = {};

  for (const obs of zOrderObservations) {
    newObservations[obs.id] = obs;
  }

  newObservations[qualityObservation.id] = qualityObservation;

  const updatedObservations = {
    ...input.observationBundle.observations,
    ...newObservations,
  };

  const updatedBundle: AiObservationBundle = {
    ...input.observationBundle,

    observations: updatedObservations,

    counts: {
      ...input.observationBundle.counts,
      total: Object.keys(updatedObservations).length,
      quality: Object.values(updatedObservations).filter(
        (obs) => obs.kind === "quality"
      ).length,
    },

    warnings: [
      ...input.observationBundle.warnings,
      ...(resolution.conflicts.length > 0
        ? ["z_order_conflicts_resolved"]
        : []),
    ],

    updatedAt: Date.now(),
  };

  const updatedBundleAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "observation-bundle-after-z-order-resolution"
  );

  const updatedBundleAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "source",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
    storagePath: observationBundlePath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: updatedBundleAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(
      JSON.stringify(updatedBundle, null, 2),
      "utf8"
    ),

    assetId: updatedBundleAssetId,
    kind: "observation_bundle_json" as any,

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    source: "system",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  const passAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "z-order-resolution-pass"
  );

  const pass: ZOrderResolutionPass = {
    schemaVersion: "ai-z-order-resolution-pass.v1",

    jobId: input.jobId,
    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    userId: input.userId,

    sourceObservationBundleAssetId:
      input.sourceObservationBundleAssetId,

    outputObservationBundleAssetId:
      updatedBundleAsset.id,

    status:
      resolution.conflicts.length > 0
        ? "completed_with_warnings"
        : "completed",

    nodeCounts: {
      total: nodes.length,
      background: nodes.filter((node) =>
        ["background", "clean_background"].includes(node.band)
      ).length,
      raster: nodes.filter((node) => node.kind === "raster_candidate").length,
      vector: nodes.filter((node) => node.kind === "vector_candidate").length,
      text: nodes.filter((node) => node.kind === "text_candidate").length,
      element: nodes.filter((node) => node.kind === "element_candidate").length,
      unknown: nodes.filter((node) => node.band === "unknown").length,
    },

    constraintCounts: {
      total: constraints.length,
      hard: constraints.filter((constraint) => constraint.hard).length,
      soft: constraints.filter((constraint) => !constraint.hard).length,
      used: resolution.constraintsUsed.length,
      dropped: resolution.constraintsDropped.length,
      conflicts: resolution.conflicts.length,
    },

    observationsAdded: {
      total: Object.keys(newObservations).length,
      zOrder: zOrderObservations.length,
      quality: 1,
    },

    warnings:
      resolution.conflicts.length > 0
        ? ["z_order_conflicts_resolved"]
        : [],

    createdAt: Date.now(),
  };

  const passAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "source",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
    storagePath: zOrderResolutionPassReportPath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: passAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(pass, null, 2), "utf8"),

    assetId: passAssetId,
    kind: "z_order_resolution_pass_json" as any,

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    source: "z_order_resolver",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  return {
    updatedBundle,
    updatedBundleAsset,
    zOrderResolutionPass: pass,
    zOrderResolutionPassAsset: passAsset,
    zOrderObservations,
    resolution,
  };
}

function stableAssetId(jobId: string, label: string) {
  return `asset_${jobId}_${label}`
    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "_")
    .toLowerCase();
}
```

Remove `as any` once the asset enum is patched.

```ts
import {
  FieldValue,
  getFirestore,
} from "firebase-admin/firestore";

import type {
  ZOrderResolutionResult,
} from "./z-order.types";

export async function applyZOrderResolutionResult(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  jobId: string;
  result: ZOrderResolutionResult;
}) {
  const db = getFirestore();

  const jobRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/aiLayerJobs/${input.jobId}`
  );

  const batch = db.batch();

  const assetsToIndex = [
    input.result.updatedBundleAsset,
    input.result.zOrderResolutionPassAsset,
  ];

  for (const asset of assetsToIndex) {
    batch.set(
      db.doc(
        `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/assets/${asset.id}`
      ),
      {
        id: asset.id,

        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        jobId: input.jobId,

        kind: asset.kind,
        storageRole: asset.storageRole,

        bucket: asset.bucket,
        storagePath: asset.storagePath,

        generation: asset.generation,
        metageneration: asset.metageneration,

        mimeType: asset.mimeType,

        width: asset.width,
        height: asset.height,
        sizeBytes: asset.sizeBytes,

        checksum: asset.checksum,

        source: asset.metadata?.source,

        retained: true,

        createdAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      },
      { merge: true }
    );
  }

  batch.update(jobRef, {
    "input.observationBundleAssetId":
      input.result.updatedBundleAsset.id,

    zOrderResolution: {
      zOrderResolutionPassAssetId:
        input.result.zOrderResolutionPassAsset.id,

      outputObservationBundleAssetId:
        input.result.updatedBundleAsset.id,

      globalZOrderObservationId:
        "obs_z_order_global_resolved",

      orderedObservationIds:
        input.result.resolution.orderedObservationIds,

      confidence:
        input.result.resolution.confidence,

      conflicts:
        input.result.resolution.conflicts,

      constraintCounts:
        input.result.zOrderResolutionPass.constraintCounts,

      nodeCounts:
        input.result.zOrderResolutionPass.nodeCounts,

      warnings:
        input.result.zOrderResolutionPass.warnings,

      createdAt:
        input.result.zOrderResolutionPass.createdAt,
    },

    "progress.percent": 82,
    "progress.label": "Layer order resolved",
    "progress.currentStep": "resolving_scene",

    updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
  });

  await batch.commit();
}
```

Firestore stores only summary and pointers.

# 15.18 How Step 17 will use this

Step 17 will read:

```txt
obs_z_order_global_resolved
```

Then assign final layer zIndex only after deciding which candidates survive.

Example:

```txt
z-order resolver says:
  A, B, C, D, E

scene resolver keeps:
  B, D, E

final zIndex:
  B = 10
  D = 20
  E = 30
```

This prevents wasted final zIndexes for rejected candidates.

---

# 15.19 Manual override compatibility

Manual user order must later override AI order.

So Step 15 supports:

```ts
mode: "manual_override"
evidence: ["manual_user"]
weight: 1
confidence.overall: 1
```

When user drags layers in the panel later:

```txt
user order change
→ save Fabric order
→ store user correction event
→ optionally create manual z_order observation
```

Manual order is not part of first reconstruction yet, but the schema supports it.

---

# 15.20 Why not use Fabric order now

Fabric order should be generated only after scene resolution.

If Step 15 directly mutates Fabric:

```txt
candidate noise enters editor
duplicates get ordered
rejected layers still affect stack
manual repair becomes harder
scene resolver loses audit trail
```

Correct boundary:

```txt
Step 15 = provisional order evidence
Step 17 = final layer zIndex
Step 18 = Fabric object array order
```

Fabric’s own canvas APIs operate on object stack order, but those APIs belong to the editor/import layer, not the AI evidence layer. citeturn504806search4

---

# 15.21 Figma lesson

Figma also treats stacking order as a first-class layout concern. Its plugin API has an `itemReverseZIndex` property for auto-layout frames that changes the canvas stacking behavior, including a mode where the first layer draws on top. This reinforces the product rule: stacking order is not incidental metadata; it is part of the design scene graph. citeturn288443search7

For your system, that means:

```txt
z-order must be explicit, serialized, inspectable, and user-correctable
```

not inferred from array position alone.

---

# 15.22 Z-order acceptance gates

A z-order pass is valid only if:

```txt
at least one global_order z_order observation exists

every orderedObservationId exists in observation bundle

background_candidate is below foreground candidates unless explicit conflict

text candidates are above overlapping shape/background candidates unless conflict

shadow candidates are below associated product/person/photo candidates

LayerD order evidence is included when available

Gemini zIndexGuess is weak evidence, not hard truth

cycles are detected and resolved

dropped constraints are recorded

conflicts are recorded

confidence is computed

needsReview is derivable from conflict ratio/confidence
```

Mark as needs review when:

```txt
many constraints are dropped
global confidence is low
background is not lowest
text overlaps shape but is ordered behind it
shadow appears above subject
LayerD order conflicts heavily with semantic order
```

Do not add:

Do not treat:

```txt
Gemini zIndexGuess
```

as absolute truth. They are weighted evidence.

## ChatGPT Response 026

<!-- assistant_message_ids: c9057371-9657-4797-a461-af8020d0d4e3, f5c290c0-b491-4119-bd8a-41d86c4bb9e3 -->

Step 16 is where we preserve Canva-like usability without prematurely converting objects into Fabric groups. The key boundary is logical grouping now, editor grouping later.

# Step 16 — Group resolver

Step 16 creates **semantic group evidence**.

The locked rule:

```txt
Group resolver creates group_candidate observations.
It does not create final AiResolvedGroup records.
It does not create Fabric.Group objects.
It does not change Fabric object hierarchy.
```

This is a critical architectural boundary. Groups are useful for UX, but premature grouping can damage editability. Fabric groups have non-trivial interaction behavior; Fabric’s docs note that selecting objects inside groups depends on group interactivity/sub-target behavior, and some group interaction APIs are deprecated or changing. citeturn151478view0 Figma’s model also reinforces the caution: groups are always sized to fit their children, cannot be empty, and moving/resizing children can affect the parent group’s geometry. citeturn283623search0 SVG’s `<g>` is a real container for related graphics, and SVG group rendering creates a compositing group where children render in order; that is useful for export semantics, but not enough reason to mutate the editor hierarchy early. citeturn151478view1turn151478view2

So in our system:

```txt
Step 16 = logical grouping evidence
Step 17 = final resolved groups in AiReconstructionDocument
Step 18 = optional Fabric.Group only if editor UX supports it safely
```

---

## 16.1 What Step 16 owns

Step 16 owns:

```txt
semantic group candidate detection
spatial relation scoring
group role classification
group bbox computation
group z-order range computation
group confidence scoring
group conflict detection
group nesting hints
group_candidate observations
group resolution quality observations
group resolution pass report
updated observation bundle
Firestore group summary
```

Step 16 does **not** own:

```txt
final AiResolvedGroup
final AiReconstructedLayer.group
Fabric.Group
Fabric JSON
final zIndex
final layer acceptance
manual group editing
export grouping
```

---

# 16.2 Why grouping must be metadata-first

There are two different meanings of “group”:

```txt
semantic group
  button = shape + text
  price badge = circle + text
  product group = product + shadow
  logo lockup = icon + wordmark

editor group
  selected/moved/resized together as one object
  may affect child transforms
  may affect serialization
  may affect hit testing
```

They should not be collapsed too early.

Correct:

```txt
button evidence
→ group_candidate(role=button)
→ scene resolver decides final group
→ layer panel may display as group
→ Fabric objects remain individually editable unless user explicitly groups
```

Wrong:

```txt
button evidence
→ fabric.Group immediately
→ child text/shape becomes harder to edit
```

For day one, logical groups should power:

```txt
layer panel nesting
multi-select suggestions
restore/regenerate selected group
group-level naming
later export grouping
```

not immediate Fabric hierarchy.

```ts
export type AiGroupRole =
  | "button"
  | "badge"
  | "price_block"
  | "menu_item"
  | "logo_lockup"
  | "social_handle"
  | "headline_block"
  | "product_group"
  | "pattern"
  | "card"
  | "header"
  | "footer"
  | "unknown";

export type AiGroupEvidence =
  | "gemini_group_hint"
  | "spatial_containment"
  | "bbox_overlap"
  | "proximity"
  | "alignment"
  | "same_source_layer"
  | "same_color_palette"
  | "z_order_adjacency"
  | "text_role"
  | "shape_text_pair"
  | "icon_text_pair"
  | "shadow_subject_pair"
  | "repetition_pattern"
  | "layout_semantic_hint"
  | "manual_user";

export type AiGroupCandidateObservation = AiObservationBase & {
  kind: "group_candidate";

  role: AiGroupRole;

  childObservationIds: string[];

  childKinds: {
    observationId: string;

    kind:
      | "text_candidate"
      | "raster_candidate"
      | "vector_candidate"
      | "element_candidate"
      | "layout"
      | "group_candidate"
      | "unknown";

    semanticRole?: string;
  }[];

  sourceObservationIds: string[];

  sourceGroupCandidateIds: string[];

  bbox: BBox;

  zOrderRange: {
    minOrder: number;
    maxOrder: number;
  };

  evidence: {
    type: AiGroupEvidence;

    weight: number;

    confidence: number;

    reasonCodes: string[];
  }[];

  metrics: {
    childCount: number;

    areaRatio: number;

    bboxTightness: number;

    averageChildConfidence: number;

    spatialCohesion: number;

    alignmentScore?: number;

    containmentScore?: number;

    zOrderCohesion?: number;

    repeatedPatternScore?: number;
  };

  hierarchy: {
    parentGroupCandidateId?: string;

    childGroupCandidateIds: string[];

    nestingDepth: number;

    allowsNestedGroups: boolean;
  };

  editability: {
    eligibleForGroupEditable: boolean;

    recommendedEditorBehavior:
      | "metadata_group_only"
      | "select_as_group"
      | "fabric_group_later"
      | "manual_review"
      | "reject";

    lockedChildren: boolean;

    allowUngroup: boolean;
  };

  validation: {
    passed: boolean;

    needsReview: boolean;

    conflictWithGroupIds: string[];

    failureReasons: string[];

    warnings: string[];
  };
};
```

Group candidates remain observations. The final resolved groups are created in Step 17.

# 16.10 Group role rules

Step 16 should generate these group roles.

## `button`

Typical structure:

```txt
rounded_rect / rect / shape
+ text_candidate with role button_label or short text
```

Evidence:

```txt
text contained inside shape
text z-order above shape
bbox tightness high
shape is vector/raster shape candidate
```

## `badge`

Typical structure:

```txt
circle / rounded shape / sticker-like decoration
+ price/offer text
+ optional shadow/decoration
```

Evidence:

```txt
text inside badge shape
price/percentage text role
shape behind text
compact bbox
```

## `price_block`

Typical structure:

```txt
price text
+ nearby small body text
+ optional shape/background
```

Evidence:

```txt
text pattern contains currency/percent/number
nearby text lines
high alignment
```

## `menu_item`

Typical structure:

```txt
item name text
+ price text
+ optional divider line
+ optional image thumbnail
```

Evidence:

```txt
same horizontal row
text left, price right
baseline alignment
repeat pattern across rows
```

## `logo_lockup`

Typical structure:

```txt
logo/icon
+ wordmark text
```

Evidence:

```txt
logo/icon near text
same baseline/center alignment
compact bbox
usually top/bottom corner
```

## `social_handle`

Typical structure:

```txt
social icon
+ short handle text
```

Evidence:

```txt
icon near text
text starts with @ or looks like handle/URL
small compact group
```

## `headline_block`

Typical structure:

```txt
headline text
+ backing shape/decoration
+ subtitle optionally
```

Evidence:

```txt
large text
nearby subtitle
backing shape behind text
top/middle layout priority
```

## `product_group`

Typical structure:

```txt
product/person/photo_subject
+ shadow
+ offer badge
+ label maybe
```

Evidence:

```txt
shadow below product
badge overlaps product area
z-order adjacency
```

## `pattern`

Typical structure:

```txt
many repeated decorations
same size/color/shape
regular spacing
```

Evidence:

```txt
repetition score
same semantic type
similar bbox sizes
similar colors
```

# 16.11 Build group resolver nodes

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/groups/build-group-resolver-nodes.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiElementCandidateObservation,
  AiGroupCandidateObservation,
  AiLayoutObservation,
  AiObservation,
  AiRasterCandidateObservation,
  AiTextCandidateObservation,
  AiVectorCandidateObservation,
  AiZOrderObservation,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import type {
  GroupResolverNode,
} from "./group-resolution.types";

export function buildGroupResolverNodes(
  observations: AiObservation[]
): GroupResolverNode[] {
  const zOrderMap = extractGlobalZOrderMap(observations);

  const nodes: GroupResolverNode[] = [];

  for (const obs of observations) {
    if (obs.kind === "text_candidate") {
      nodes.push(textNode(obs, zOrderMap));
    }

    if (obs.kind === "raster_candidate") {
      nodes.push(rasterNode(obs, zOrderMap));
    }

    if (obs.kind === "vector_candidate") {
      nodes.push(vectorNode(obs, zOrderMap));
    }

    if (obs.kind === "element_candidate") {
      nodes.push(elementNode(obs, zOrderMap));
    }

    if (obs.kind === "layout" && obs.bbox) {
      nodes.push(layoutNode(obs, zOrderMap));
    }

    if (obs.kind === "group_candidate") {
      nodes.push(existingGroupNode(obs, zOrderMap));
    }
  }

  return dedupeNodes(nodes);
}

function textNode(
  obs: AiTextCandidateObservation,
  zOrderMap: Map<string, number>
): GroupResolverNode {
  return {
    observationId: obs.id,
    kind: "text_candidate",
    semanticType: "text",
    role: obs.textRole,
    bbox: obs.bbox,
    zOrder: zOrderMap.get(obs.id),
    confidence: obs.confidence?.overall ?? 0.7,
    sourceObservationIds: [
      obs.id,
      ...obs.sourceOcrObservationIds,
      ...obs.sourceLayoutObservationIds,
    ],
    properties: {
      isText: true,
      isShape: false,
      isIcon: false,
      isLogo: obs.textRole === "logo_text",
      isProduct: false,
      isPerson: false,
      isImageBlock: false,
      isShadow: false,
      isDecoration: false,
      textRole: obs.textRole,
    },
  };
}

function rasterNode(
  obs: AiRasterCandidateObservation,
  zOrderMap: Map<string, number>
): GroupResolverNode {
  return {
    observationId: obs.id,
    kind: "raster_candidate",
    semanticType: obs.role,
    role: obs.role,
    bbox: obs.bbox,
    zOrder: zOrderMap.get(obs.id),
    confidence: obs.confidence?.overall ?? 0.6,
    sourceObservationIds: obs.sourceObservationIds,
    properties: {
      isText: obs.role === "text_raster_fallback",
      isShape: obs.role === "shape_raster_fallback",
      isIcon: obs.role === "logo_icon_raster",
      isLogo: obs.role === "logo_icon_raster",
      isProduct: obs.role === "product",
      isPerson: obs.role === "person",
      isImageBlock: obs.role === "image_block",
      isShadow: obs.role === "shadow",
      isDecoration: obs.role === "decoration",
      rasterRole: obs.role,
    },
  };
}

function vectorNode(
  obs: AiVectorCandidateObservation,
  zOrderMap: Map<string, number>
): GroupResolverNode {
  const isShape =
    ["rect", "rounded_rect", "circle", "ellipse", "line", "polygon"].includes(
      obs.primitive
    );

  return {
    observationId: obs.id,
    kind: "vector_candidate",
    semanticType: obs.primitive,
    role: obs.primitive,
    bbox: obs.bbox,
    zOrder: zOrderMap.get(obs.id),
    confidence: obs.confidence?.overall ?? 0.6,
    sourceObservationIds: [
      obs.id,
      obs.sourceElementCandidateId,
      ...obs.sourceComponentObservationIds,
    ],
    properties: {
      isText: false,
      isShape,
      isIcon: !isShape,
      isLogo: false,
      isProduct: false,
      isPerson: false,
      isImageBlock: false,
      isShadow: false,
      isDecoration: !isShape,
      vectorPrimitive: obs.primitive,
    },
  };
}

function elementNode(
  obs: AiElementCandidateObservation,
  zOrderMap: Map<string, number>
): GroupResolverNode {
  return {
    observationId: obs.id,
    kind: "element_candidate",
    semanticType: obs.elementTypeGuess,
    role: obs.elementTypeGuess,
    bbox: obs.bbox,
    zOrder: zOrderMap.get(obs.id),
    confidence: obs.confidence?.overall ?? 0.45,
    sourceObservationIds: [
      obs.id,
      ...obs.sourceObservationIds,
    ],
    properties: {
      isText: obs.elementTypeGuess === "text_region",
      isShape: obs.elementTypeGuess === "shape",
      isIcon: obs.elementTypeGuess === "logo_icon",
      isLogo: obs.elementTypeGuess === "logo_icon",
      isProduct: obs.elementTypeGuess === "product",
      isPerson: obs.elementTypeGuess === "person",
      isImageBlock: obs.elementTypeGuess === "image_block",
      isShadow: obs.elementTypeGuess === "shadow",
      isDecoration: obs.elementTypeGuess === "decoration",
    },
  };
}

function layoutNode(
  obs: AiLayoutObservation,
  zOrderMap: Map<string, number>
): GroupResolverNode {
  return {
    observationId: obs.id,
    kind: "layout",
    semanticType: obs.layerTypeGuess,
    role: obs.roleHint,
    bbox: obs.bbox!,
    zOrder: zOrderMap.get(obs.id),
    confidence: obs.confidence?.overall ?? 0.4,
    sourceObservationIds: [obs.id],
    properties: {
      isText: obs.layerTypeGuess === "text",
      isShape: obs.layerTypeGuess === "shape",
      isIcon: obs.layerTypeGuess === "icon",
      isLogo: obs.layerTypeGuess === "logo",
      isProduct: obs.layerTypeGuess === "product",
      isPerson: obs.layerTypeGuess === "person",
      isImageBlock: obs.layerTypeGuess === "image_block",
      isShadow: obs.layerTypeGuess === "shadow",
      isDecoration: obs.layerTypeGuess === "decoration",
    },
  };
}

function existingGroupNode(
  obs: AiGroupCandidateObservation,
  zOrderMap: Map<string, number>
): GroupResolverNode {
  return {
    observationId: obs.id,
    kind: "group_candidate",
    semanticType: obs.role,
    role: obs.role,
    bbox: obs.bbox,
    zOrder: zOrderMap.get(obs.id),
    confidence: obs.confidence?.overall ?? 0.5,
    sourceObservationIds: [
      obs.id,
      ...obs.childObservationIds,
    ],
    properties: {
      isText: false,
      isShape: false,
      isIcon: false,
      isLogo: obs.role === "logo_lockup",
      isProduct: obs.role === "product_group",
      isPerson: false,
      isImageBlock: false,
      isShadow: false,
      isDecoration: obs.role === "pattern",
    },
  };
}

function extractGlobalZOrderMap(
  observations: AiObservation[]
): Map<string, number> {
  const map = new Map<string, number>();

  const global = observations.find(
    (obs): obs is AiZOrderObservation =>
      obs.kind === "z_order" &&
      obs.mode === "global_order" &&
      Array.isArray(obs.orderedObservationIds)
  );

  if (!global?.orderedObservationIds) return map;

  global.orderedObservationIds.forEach((id, index) => {
    map.set(id, index);
  });

  return map;
}

function dedupeNodes(nodes: GroupResolverNode[]) {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const result: GroupResolverNode[] = [];

  for (const node of nodes) {
    if (seen.has(node.observationId)) continue;

    seen.add(node.observationId);
    result.push(node);
  }

  return result;
}
```

# 16.12 Geometry and relation helpers

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/groups/group-geometry.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  BBox,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  bboxArea,
  bboxIntersectionArea,
} from "../schema/geometry";

export function unionBBoxes(boxes: BBox[]): BBox {
  const x1 = Math.min(...boxes.map((box) => box.x));
  const y1 = Math.min(...boxes.map((box) => box.y));
  const x2 = Math.max(...boxes.map((box) => box.x + box.width));
  const y2 = Math.max(...boxes.map((box) => box.y + box.height));

  return {
    x: x1,
    y: y1,
    width: x2 - x1,
    height: y2 - y1,
  };
}

export function containmentRatio(inner: BBox, outer: BBox): number {
  const intersection = bboxIntersectionArea(inner, outer);

  return intersection / Math.max(1, bboxArea(inner));
}

export function overlapRatio(a: BBox, b: BBox): number {
  const intersection = bboxIntersectionArea(a, b);

  return intersection / Math.max(1, Math.min(bboxArea(a), bboxArea(b)));
}

export function centerDistanceRatio(input: {
  a: BBox;
  b: BBox;
  canvasWidth: number;
  canvasHeight: number;
}): number {
  const ax = input.a.x + input.a.width / 2;
  const ay = input.a.y + input.a.height / 2;

  const bx = input.b.x + input.b.width / 2;
  const by = input.b.y + input.b.height / 2;

  const distance = Math.sqrt((ax - bx) ** 2 + (ay - by) ** 2);

  const diagonal = Math.sqrt(input.canvasWidth ** 2 + input.canvasHeight ** 2);

  return distance / Math.max(1, diagonal);
}

export function bboxTightness(input: {
  childBoxes: BBox[];
  groupBox: BBox;
}): number {
  const childArea = input.childBoxes.reduce(
    (sum, box) => sum + bboxArea(box),
    0
  );

  return Math.min(1, childArea / Math.max(1, bboxArea(input.groupBox)));
}

export function alignmentScore(a: BBox, b: BBox): number {
  const leftDelta = Math.abs(a.x - b.x);
  const rightDelta = Math.abs(a.x + a.width - (b.x + b.width));
  const centerXDelta = Math.abs(
    a.x + a.width / 2 - (b.x + b.width / 2)
  );

  const topDelta = Math.abs(a.y - b.y);
  const bottomDelta = Math.abs(a.y + a.height - (b.y + b.height));
  const centerYDelta = Math.abs(
    a.y + a.height / 2 - (b.y + b.height / 2)
  );

  const scale = Math.max(a.width, a.height, b.width, b.height, 1);

  const best =
    Math.min(
      leftDelta,
      rightDelta,
      centerXDelta,
      topDelta,
      bottomDelta,
      centerYDelta
    ) / scale;

  return Math.max(0, 1 - best * 8);
}

export function zOrderCohesion(
  zOrders: (number | undefined)[]
): number {
  const values = zOrders.filter(
    (value): value is number => typeof value === "number"
  );

  if (values.length <= 1) return 1;

  const min = Math.min(...values);
  const max = Math.max(...values);

  const span = max - min;

  return Math.max(0, 1 - span / Math.max(1, values.length + 4));
}
```
