# 16.13 Role-specific candidate generation

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/groups/generate-group-candidate-drafts.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiGroupRole,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import type {
  GroupCandidateDraft,
  GroupResolverNode,
} from "./group-resolution.types";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_GROUP_RESOLUTION_POLICY,
} from "./group-resolution-policy";

import {
  alignmentScore,
  bboxTightness,
  centerDistanceRatio,
  containmentRatio,
  overlapRatio,
  unionBBoxes,
  zOrderCohesion,
} from "./group-geometry";

export function generateGroupCandidateDrafts(input: {
  nodes: GroupResolverNode[];

  canvas: {
    width: number;
    height: number;
  };
}): GroupCandidateDraft[] {
  return [
    ...generateButtonGroups(input),
    ...generateBadgeGroups(input),
    ...generatePriceBlockGroups(input),
    ...generateMenuItemGroups(input),
    ...generateLogoLockupGroups(input),
    ...generateSocialHandleGroups(input),
    ...generateHeadlineBlockGroups(input),
    ...generateProductGroups(input),
    ...generatePatternGroups(input),
  ].slice(0, MAGIC_LAYERS_GROUP_RESOLUTION_POLICY.maxGroupCandidates);
}

function generateButtonGroups(input: {
  nodes: GroupResolverNode[];
  canvas: { width: number; height: number };
}): GroupCandidateDraft[] {
  const shapes = input.nodes.filter((node) => node.properties.isShape);
  const texts = input.nodes.filter((node) => node.properties.isText);

  const drafts: GroupCandidateDraft[] = [];

  for (const shape of shapes) {
    for (const text of texts) {
      const containment = containmentRatio(text.bbox, shape.bbox);

      if (containment < 0.55) continue;

      const align = alignmentScore(shape.bbox, text.bbox);

      const zOk =
        typeof shape.zOrder !== "number" ||
        typeof text.zOrder !== "number" ||
        text.zOrder > shape.zOrder;

      const score =
        containment * 0.42 +
        align * 0.28 +
        (zOk ? 0.18 : 0) +
        Math.min(shape.confidence, text.confidence) * 0.12;

      if (score < MAGIC_LAYERS_GROUP_RESOLUTION_POLICY.roles.button.minScore) {
        continue;
      }

      drafts.push({
        id: `group_button_${shape.observationId}_${text.observationId}`,
        role: "button",
        childObservationIds: [shape.observationId, text.observationId],
        score,
        reasonCodes: ["shape_contains_text", "button_candidate"],
        evidence: [
          {
            type: "shape_text_pair",
            weight: 0.9,
            confidence: score,
            reasonCodes: ["text_inside_shape"],
          },
          {
            type: "alignment",
            weight: 0.5,
            confidence: align,
            reasonCodes: ["button_text_aligned_with_shape"],
          },
        ],
      });
    }
  }

  return drafts;
}

function generateBadgeGroups(input: {
  nodes: GroupResolverNode[];
  canvas: { width: number; height: number };
}): GroupCandidateDraft[] {
  const shapes = input.nodes.filter(
    (node) =>
      node.properties.isShape ||
      node.semanticType === "circle" ||
      node.semanticType === "ellipse"
  );

  const texts = input.nodes.filter(
    (node) =>
      node.properties.isText &&
      ["price", "headline", "unknown"].includes(node.role ?? "unknown")
  );

  const drafts: GroupCandidateDraft[] = [];

  for (const shape of shapes) {
    const containedTexts = texts.filter(
      (text) => containmentRatio(text.bbox, shape.bbox) >= 0.35
    );

    if (!containedTexts.length) continue;

    const children = [shape, ...containedTexts.slice(0, 3)];

    const box = unionBBoxes(children.map((child) => child.bbox));

    const tightness = bboxTightness({
      childBoxes: children.map((child) => child.bbox),
      groupBox: box,
    });

    const priceLike = containedTexts.some((text) =>
      /[$₹€£]\s?\d|\d+\s?%/.test(text.role ?? "") ||
      text.role === "price"
    );

    const score =
      tightness * 0.28 +
      (priceLike ? 0.28 : 0.12) +
      averageConfidence(children) * 0.22 +
      zOrderCohesion(children.map((child) => child.zOrder)) * 0.22;

    if (score < MAGIC_LAYERS_GROUP_RESOLUTION_POLICY.roles.badge.minScore) {
      continue;
    }

    drafts.push({
      id: `group_badge_${shape.observationId}`,
      role: "badge",
      childObservationIds: children.map((child) => child.observationId),
      score,
      reasonCodes: ["shape_with_contained_offer_text"],
      evidence: [
        {
          type: "spatial_containment",
          weight: 0.75,
          confidence: tightness,
          reasonCodes: ["badge_children_contained"],
        },
        {
          type: "text_role",
          weight: 0.6,
          confidence: priceLike ? 0.9 : 0.5,
          reasonCodes: ["price_or_offer_text_in_badge"],
        },
      ],
    });
  }

  return drafts;
}

function generatePriceBlockGroups(input: {
  nodes: GroupResolverNode[];
  canvas: { width: number; height: number };
}): GroupCandidateDraft[] {
  const texts = input.nodes.filter((node) => node.properties.isText);

  const priceTexts = texts.filter(
    (node) => node.role === "price" || looksPriceLike(node.semanticType)
  );

  const drafts: GroupCandidateDraft[] = [];

  for (const price of priceTexts) {
    const nearbyTexts = texts.filter((text) => {
      if (text.observationId === price.observationId) return false;

      return (
        centerDistanceRatio({
          a: price.bbox,
          b: text.bbox,
          canvasWidth: input.canvas.width,
          canvasHeight: input.canvas.height,
        }) < 0.06
      );
    });

    if (!nearbyTexts.length) continue;

    const children = [price, ...nearbyTexts.slice(0, 4)];

    const align =
      nearbyTexts.reduce(
        (sum, text) => sum + alignmentScore(price.bbox, text.bbox),
        0
      ) / nearbyTexts.length;

    const score =
      0.35 +
      align * 0.25 +
      averageConfidence(children) * 0.25 +
      zOrderCohesion(children.map((child) => child.zOrder)) * 0.15;

    if (
      score <
      MAGIC_LAYERS_GROUP_RESOLUTION_POLICY.roles.priceBlock.minScore
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    drafts.push({
      id: `group_price_block_${price.observationId}`,
      role: "price_block",
      childObservationIds: children.map((child) => child.observationId),
      score,
      reasonCodes: ["price_text_with_nearby_text"],
      evidence: [
        {
          type: "text_role",
          weight: 0.8,
          confidence: 0.9,
          reasonCodes: ["price_text_detected"],
        },
        {
          type: "proximity",
          weight: 0.5,
          confidence: 0.75,
          reasonCodes: ["nearby_price_related_text"],
        },
      ],
    });
  }

  return drafts;
}

function generateMenuItemGroups(input: {
  nodes: GroupResolverNode[];
  canvas: { width: number; height: number };
}): GroupCandidateDraft[] {
  const texts = input.nodes.filter((node) => node.properties.isText);

  const priceTexts = texts.filter((node) => node.role === "price");

  const nonPriceTexts = texts.filter((node) => node.role !== "price");

  const drafts: GroupCandidateDraft[] = [];

  for (const nameText of nonPriceTexts) {
    for (const priceText of priceTexts) {
      const baselineDelta = Math.abs(
        nameText.bbox.y + nameText.bbox.height / 2 -
          (priceText.bbox.y + priceText.bbox.height / 2)
      );

      const tolerance =
        Math.max(nameText.bbox.height, priceText.bbox.height) * 0.9;

      if (baselineDelta > tolerance) continue;

      if (priceText.bbox.x <= nameText.bbox.x) continue;

      const horizontalGap =
        priceText.bbox.x - (nameText.bbox.x + nameText.bbox.width);

      if (horizontalGap < 0) continue;

      const score =
        0.32 +
        averageConfidence([nameText, priceText]) * 0.28 +
        (1 - baselineDelta / Math.max(1, tolerance)) * 0.25 +
        zOrderCohesion([nameText.zOrder, priceText.zOrder]) * 0.15;

      if (
        score <
        MAGIC_LAYERS_GROUP_RESOLUTION_POLICY.roles.menuItem.minScore
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      drafts.push({
        id: `group_menu_item_${nameText.observationId}_${priceText.observationId}`,
        role: "menu_item",
        childObservationIds: [
          nameText.observationId,
          priceText.observationId,
        ],
        score,
        reasonCodes: ["name_price_row_alignment"],
        evidence: [
          {
            type: "alignment",
            weight: 0.8,
            confidence: score,
            reasonCodes: ["menu_item_horizontal_text_pair"],
          },
        ],
      });
    }
  }

  return drafts;
}

function generateLogoLockupGroups(input: {
  nodes: GroupResolverNode[];
  canvas: { width: number; height: number };
}): GroupCandidateDraft[] {
  const logos = input.nodes.filter(
    (node) => node.properties.isLogo || node.properties.isIcon
  );

  const texts = input.nodes.filter((node) => node.properties.isText);

  const drafts: GroupCandidateDraft[] = [];

  for (const logo of logos) {
    for (const text of texts) {
      const distance = centerDistanceRatio({
        a: logo.bbox,
        b: text.bbox,
        canvasWidth: input.canvas.width,
        canvasHeight: input.canvas.height,
      });

      if (
        distance >
        MAGIC_LAYERS_GROUP_RESOLUTION_POLICY.proximity
          .iconTextMaxDistanceRatio
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      const align = alignmentScore(logo.bbox, text.bbox);

      const score =
        0.25 +
        (1 - distance / 0.06) * 0.26 +
        align * 0.22 +
        averageConfidence([logo, text]) * 0.27;

      if (
        score <
        MAGIC_LAYERS_GROUP_RESOLUTION_POLICY.roles.logoLockup.minScore
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      drafts.push({
        id: `group_logo_lockup_${logo.observationId}_${text.observationId}`,
        role: "logo_lockup",
        childObservationIds: [logo.observationId, text.observationId],
        score,
        reasonCodes: ["icon_or_logo_near_text"],
        evidence: [
          {
            type: "icon_text_pair",
            weight: 0.82,
            confidence: score,
            reasonCodes: ["logo_lockup_icon_text_proximity"],
          },
        ],
      });
    }
  }

  return drafts;
}

function generateSocialHandleGroups(input: {
  nodes: GroupResolverNode[];
  canvas: { width: number; height: number };
}): GroupCandidateDraft[] {
  const icons = input.nodes.filter((node) => node.properties.isIcon);
  const texts = input.nodes.filter((node) => node.properties.isText);

  const drafts: GroupCandidateDraft[] = [];

  for (const icon of icons) {
    for (const text of texts) {
      const distance = centerDistanceRatio({
        a: icon.bbox,
        b: text.bbox,
        canvasWidth: input.canvas.width,
        canvasHeight: input.canvas.height,
      });

      if (distance > 0.055) continue;

      const score =
        0.22 +
        (1 - distance / 0.055) * 0.34 +
        averageConfidence([icon, text]) * 0.24 +
        alignmentScore(icon.bbox, text.bbox) * 0.2;

      if (
        score <
        MAGIC_LAYERS_GROUP_RESOLUTION_POLICY.roles.socialHandle.minScore
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      drafts.push({
        id: `group_social_handle_${icon.observationId}_${text.observationId}`,
        role: "social_handle",
        childObservationIds: [icon.observationId, text.observationId],
        score,
        reasonCodes: ["small_icon_near_text"],
        evidence: [
          {
            type: "icon_text_pair",
            weight: 0.7,
            confidence: score,
            reasonCodes: ["social_handle_like_group"],
          },
        ],
      });
    }
  }

  return drafts;
}

function generateHeadlineBlockGroups(input: {
  nodes: GroupResolverNode[];
  canvas: { width: number; height: number };
}): GroupCandidateDraft[] {
  const headlines = input.nodes.filter(
    (node) => node.properties.isText && node.role === "headline"
  );

  const shapes = input.nodes.filter((node) => node.properties.isShape);
  const subtitles = input.nodes.filter(
    (node) => node.properties.isText && node.role === "subtitle"
  );

  const drafts: GroupCandidateDraft[] = [];

  for (const headline of headlines) {
    const backingShapes = shapes.filter(
      (shape) =>
        overlapRatio(headline.bbox, shape.bbox) > 0.15 ||
        containmentRatio(headline.bbox, shape.bbox) > 0.4
    );

    const nearbySubtitles = subtitles.filter(
      (subtitle) =>
        centerDistanceRatio({
          a: headline.bbox,
          b: subtitle.bbox,
          canvasWidth: input.canvas.width,
          canvasHeight: input.canvas.height,
        }) < 0.09
    );

    const children = [
      headline,
      ...backingShapes.slice(0, 2),
      ...nearbySubtitles.slice(0, 2),
    ];

    if (children.length < 2) continue;

    const score =
      0.28 +
      averageConfidence(children) * 0.28 +
      zOrderCohesion(children.map((child) => child.zOrder)) * 0.18 +
      bboxTightness({
        childBoxes: children.map((child) => child.bbox),
        groupBox: unionBBoxes(children.map((child) => child.bbox)),
      }) *
        0.26;

    if (
      score <
      MAGIC_LAYERS_GROUP_RESOLUTION_POLICY.roles.headlineBlock.minScore
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    drafts.push({
      id: `group_headline_block_${headline.observationId}`,
      role: "headline_block",
      childObservationIds: children.map((child) => child.observationId),
      score,
      reasonCodes: ["headline_with_related_shape_or_subtitle"],
      evidence: [
        {
          type: "text_role",
          weight: 0.7,
          confidence: headline.confidence,
          reasonCodes: ["headline_text_anchor"],
        },
        {
          type: "spatial_containment",
          weight: 0.45,
          confidence: score,
          reasonCodes: ["headline_block_spatial_cluster"],
        },
      ],
    });
  }

  return drafts;
}

function generateProductGroups(input: {
  nodes: GroupResolverNode[];
  canvas: { width: number; height: number };
}): GroupCandidateDraft[] {
  const subjects = input.nodes.filter(
    (node) =>
      node.properties.isProduct ||
      node.properties.isPerson ||
      node.semanticType === "photo_subject"
  );

  const shadows = input.nodes.filter((node) => node.properties.isShadow);

  const badges = input.nodes.filter(
    (node) => node.semanticType === "badge" || node.role === "badge"
  );

  const drafts: GroupCandidateDraft[] = [];

  for (const subject of subjects) {
    const relatedShadows = shadows.filter(
      (shadow) =>
        centerDistanceRatio({
          a: subject.bbox,
          b: shadow.bbox,
          canvasWidth: input.canvas.width,
          canvasHeight: input.canvas.height,
        }) < 0.08
    );

    const overlappingBadges = badges.filter(
      (badge) => overlapRatio(subject.bbox, badge.bbox) > 0.04
    );

    const children = [
      subject,
      ...relatedShadows.slice(0, 2),
      ...overlappingBadges.slice(0, 2),
    ];

    if (children.length < 2) continue;

    const score =
      0.3 +
      averageConfidence(children) * 0.26 +
      zOrderCohesion(children.map((child) => child.zOrder)) * 0.2 +
      bboxTightness({
        childBoxes: children.map((child) => child.bbox),
        groupBox: unionBBoxes(children.map((child) => child.bbox)),
      }) *
        0.24;

    if (
      score <
      MAGIC_LAYERS_GROUP_RESOLUTION_POLICY.roles.productGroup.minScore
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    drafts.push({
      id: `group_product_${subject.observationId}`,
      role: "product_group",
      childObservationIds: children.map((child) => child.observationId),
      score,
      reasonCodes: ["subject_with_shadow_or_badge"],
      evidence: [
        {
          type: "shadow_subject_pair",
          weight: 0.72,
          confidence: score,
          reasonCodes: ["subject_shadow_badge_cluster"],
        },
      ],
    });
  }

  return drafts;
}

function generatePatternGroups(input: {
  nodes: GroupResolverNode[];
  canvas: { width: number; height: number };
}): GroupCandidateDraft[] {
  const decorations = input.nodes.filter(
    (node) => node.properties.isDecoration || node.semanticType === "decoration"
  );

  if (decorations.length < 3) return [];

  const buckets = bucketByApproxSize(decorations);

  const drafts: GroupCandidateDraft[] = [];

  for (const [bucketId, children] of buckets.entries()) {
    if (children.length < 3) continue;

    const score =
      0.25 +
      averageConfidence(children) * 0.25 +
      repetitionScore(children) * 0.35 +
      zOrderCohesion(children.map((child) => child.zOrder)) * 0.15;

    if (
      score <
      MAGIC_LAYERS_GROUP_RESOLUTION_POLICY.roles.pattern.minScore
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    drafts.push({
      id: `group_pattern_${bucketId}`,
      role: "pattern",
      childObservationIds: children.map((child) => child.observationId),
      score,
      reasonCodes: ["repeated_decoration_pattern"],
      evidence: [
        {
          type: "repetition_pattern",
          weight: 0.85,
          confidence: score,
          reasonCodes: ["similar_decoration_repetition"],
        },
      ],
    });
  }

  return drafts;
}

function bucketByApproxSize(nodes: GroupResolverNode[]) {
  const map = new Map<string, GroupResolverNode[]>();

  for (const node of nodes) {
    const w = Math.round(node.bbox.width / 10) * 10;
    const h = Math.round(node.bbox.height / 10) * 10;
    const key = `${w}x${h}`;

    if (!map.has(key)) map.set(key, []);

    map.get(key)!.push(node);
  }

  return map;
}

function repetitionScore(nodes: GroupResolverNode[]) {
  if (nodes.length < 3) return 0;

  const xs = nodes.map((node) => node.bbox.x).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const ys = nodes.map((node) => node.bbox.y).sort((a, b) => a - b);

  const xSpread = xs[xs.length - 1] - xs[0];
  const ySpread = ys[ys.length - 1] - ys[0];

  const areaSpread = Math.sqrt(xSpread ** 2 + ySpread ** 2);

  return Math.min(1, nodes.length / 8 + Math.min(0.3, areaSpread / 2000));
}

function looksPriceLike(value?: string) {
  if (!value) return false;

  return /[$₹€£]|\d+\s?%|price/i.test(value);
}

function averageConfidence(nodes: GroupResolverNode[]) {
  return (
    nodes.reduce((sum, node) => sum + node.confidence, 0) /
    Math.max(1, nodes.length)
  );
}
```

# 16.14 Conflict resolution

Group drafts often overlap. The resolver must avoid contradictory groups.

Examples:

```txt
same shape + text may be both button and badge
same product + badge may be product_group and badge
same icon + text may be logo_lockup and social_handle
same text may belong to headline_block and button
```

Rule:

```txt
Prefer high-score specific groups.
Allow nesting only when roles are compatible.
Do not let one child belong to many flat groups unless one is parent/child.
```

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/groups/resolve-group-conflicts.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  GroupCandidateDraft,
} from "./group-resolution.types";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_GROUP_RESOLUTION_POLICY,
} from "./group-resolution-policy";

export function resolveGroupCandidateConflicts(
  drafts: GroupCandidateDraft[]
): {
  accepted: GroupCandidateDraft[];
  rejectedLowScore: GroupCandidateDraft[];
  rejectedConflict: GroupCandidateDraft[];
} {
  const rejectedLowScore = drafts.filter(
    (draft) =>
      draft.score <
      MAGIC_LAYERS_GROUP_RESOLUTION_POLICY.thresholds.minGroupScore
  );

  const candidates = drafts
    .filter(
      (draft) =>
        draft.score >=
        MAGIC_LAYERS_GROUP_RESOLUTION_POLICY.thresholds.minGroupScore
    )
    .sort((a, b) => {
      const rolePriorityDelta = rolePriority(b.role) - rolePriority(a.role);
      if (rolePriorityDelta !== 0) return rolePriorityDelta;

      return b.score - a.score;
    });

  const accepted: GroupCandidateDraft[] = [];
  const rejectedConflict: GroupCandidateDraft[] = [];

  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    const conflict = accepted.find((group) =>
      conflicts(candidate, group)
    );

    if (conflict) {
      if (isAllowedNestedGroup(candidate, conflict)) {
        accepted.push(candidate);
      } else {
        rejectedConflict.push(candidate);
      }

      continue;
    }

    accepted.push(candidate);
  }

  return {
    accepted,
    rejectedLowScore,
    rejectedConflict,
  };
}

function conflicts(a: GroupCandidateDraft, b: GroupCandidateDraft) {
  const aSet = new Set(a.childObservationIds);
  const bSet = new Set(b.childObservationIds);

  const shared = [...aSet].filter((id) => bSet.has(id));

  if (shared.length === 0) return false;

  const minSize = Math.min(aSet.size, bSet.size);

  const overlapRatio = shared.length / Math.max(1, minSize);

  return (
    overlapRatio >=
    MAGIC_LAYERS_GROUP_RESOLUTION_POLICY.thresholds
      .maxConflictOverlapRatio
  );
}

function isAllowedNestedGroup(
  child: GroupCandidateDraft,
  parent: GroupCandidateDraft
) {
  const allowedParentChildPairs = new Set([
    "product_group:badge",
    "headline_block:badge",
    "card:button",
    "card:price_block",
    "menu_item:price_block",
  ]);

  return allowedParentChildPairs.has(`${parent.role}:${child.role}`);
}

function rolePriority(role: GroupCandidateDraft["role"]) {
  switch (role) {
    case "button":
      return 100;

    case "badge":
      return 95;

    case "logo_lockup":
      return 90;

    case "social_handle":
      return 82;

    case "price_block":
      return 80;

    case "menu_item":
      return 75;

    case "headline_block":
      return 70;

    case "product_group":
      return 65;

    case "pattern":
      return 50;

    default:
      return 10;
  }
}
```

# 16.15 Create group observations

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/groups/create-group-candidate-observations.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiGroupCandidateObservation,
  AiObservation,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import type {
  GroupCandidateDraft,
  GroupResolverNode,
} from "./group-resolution.types";

import {
  bboxTightness,
  unionBBoxes,
  zOrderCohesion,
} from "./group-geometry";

export function createGroupCandidateObservations(input: {
  jobId: string;
  designId: string;

  drafts: GroupCandidateDraft[];

  rejectedConflictIds: string[];

  nodesById: Map<string, GroupResolverNode>;

  canvas: {
    width: number;
    height: number;
  };
}): AiGroupCandidateObservation[] {
  const now = Date.now();

  return input.drafts.map((draft): AiGroupCandidateObservation => {
    const children = draft.childObservationIds
      .map((id) => input.nodesById.get(id))
      .filter((node): node is GroupResolverNode => Boolean(node));

    const bbox = unionBBoxes(children.map((child) => child.bbox));

    const childConfs = children.map((child) => child.confidence);

    const averageChildConfidence =
      childConfs.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) /
      Math.max(1, childConfs.length);

    const tightness = bboxTightness({
      childBoxes: children.map((child) => child.bbox),
      groupBox: bbox,
    });

    const zCohesion = zOrderCohesion(children.map((child) => child.zOrder));

    const needsReview =
      draft.score < 0.78 ||
      input.rejectedConflictIds.includes(draft.id);

    return {
      id: `obs_group_candidate_${sanitizeId(draft.id)}`,

      jobId: input.jobId,
      designId: input.designId,

      kind: "group_candidate",

      source: "group_resolver",

      createdAt: now,

      role: draft.role,

      childObservationIds: draft.childObservationIds,

      childKinds: children.map((child) => ({
        observationId: child.observationId,
        kind: child.kind,
        semanticRole: child.role,
      })),

      sourceObservationIds: [
        ...new Set(
          children.flatMap((child) => child.sourceObservationIds)
        ),
      ],

      sourceGroupCandidateIds: children
        .filter((child) => child.kind === "group_candidate")
        .map((child) => child.observationId),

      bbox,

      zOrderRange: {
        minOrder: Math.min(
          ...children.map((child) => child.zOrder ?? 0)
        ),
        maxOrder: Math.max(
          ...children.map((child) => child.zOrder ?? 0)
        ),
      },

      evidence: draft.evidence,

      metrics: {
        childCount: children.length,

        areaRatio:
          (bbox.width * bbox.height) /
          Math.max(1, input.canvas.width * input.canvas.height),

        bboxTightness: tightness,

        averageChildConfidence,

        spatialCohesion: tightness,

        zOrderCohesion: zCohesion,
      },

      hierarchy: {
        childGroupCandidateIds: children
          .filter((child) => child.kind === "group_candidate")
          .map((child) => child.observationId),

        nestingDepth: 0,

        allowsNestedGroups: true,
      },

      editability: {
        eligibleForGroupEditable: draft.score >= 0.78,

        recommendedEditorBehavior:
          draft.score >= 0.78
            ? "select_as_group"
            : "metadata_group_only",

        lockedChildren: false,

        allowUngroup: true,
      },

      validation: {
        passed: true,

        needsReview,

        conflictWithGroupIds: [],

        failureReasons: [],

        warnings: needsReview
          ? ["group_candidate_needs_review"]
          : [],
      },

      confidence: {
        overall: draft.score,
        grouping: draft.score,
        classification: draft.score,
      },

      warnings: needsReview
        ? ["group_candidate_needs_review"]
        : [],
    };
  });
}

function sanitizeId(value: string) {
  return value.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "_").toLowerCase();
}
```

```ts
import {
  AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,
  AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
} from "../schema/constants";

import type {
  AiObservation,
  AiGroupRole,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import type {
  AiObservationBundle,
} from "../observations/observation-bundle.types";

import {
  bucketForMagicStorageRole,
} from "../storage/storage-buckets";

import {
  groupResolutionPassReportPath,
  observationBundlePath,
} from "../storage/storage-paths";

import {
  writeAiAsset,
} from "../storage/write-ai-asset";

import {
  buildGroupResolverNodes,
} from "./build-group-resolver-nodes";

import {
  generateGroupCandidateDrafts,
} from "./generate-group-candidate-drafts";

import {
  resolveGroupCandidateConflicts,
} from "./resolve-group-conflicts";

import {
  createGroupCandidateObservations,
} from "./create-group-candidate-observations";

import type {
  GroupResolutionPass,
  GroupResolutionResult,
} from "./group-resolution.types";

export async function runGroupResolutionPass(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  jobId: string;
  userId: string;

  sourceObservationBundleAssetId: string;

  observationBundle: AiObservationBundle;
}): Promise<GroupResolutionResult> {
  const observations = Object.values(input.observationBundle.observations);

  const nodes = buildGroupResolverNodes(observations).slice(0, 300);

  const drafts = generateGroupCandidateDrafts({
    nodes,
    canvas: input.observationBundle.canvas,
  });

  const resolved = resolveGroupCandidateConflicts(drafts);

  const nodesById = new Map(
    nodes.map((node) => [node.observationId, node])
  );

  const groupCandidateObservations =
    createGroupCandidateObservations({
      jobId: input.jobId,
      designId: input.designId,
      drafts: resolved.accepted,
      rejectedConflictIds: resolved.rejectedConflict.map(
        (draft) => draft.id
      ),
      nodesById,
      canvas: input.observationBundle.canvas,
    });

  const qualityObservation: AiObservation = {
    id: "obs_quality_group_resolution",

    jobId: input.jobId,
    designId: input.designId,

    kind: "quality",

    source: "group_resolver",

    createdAt: Date.now(),

    target: "whole_scene",

    metrics: {
      groupCandidateCount: groupCandidateObservations.length,
      groupConflictCount: resolved.rejectedConflict.length,
    } as any,

    passed:
      groupCandidateObservations.length > 0 ||
      drafts.length === 0,

    confidence: {
      overall:
        groupCandidateObservations.length > 0
          ? average(
              groupCandidateObservations.map(
                (obs) => obs.confidence?.overall ?? 0.5
              )
            )
          : 0.5,
      grouping:
        groupCandidateObservations.length > 0
          ? average(
              groupCandidateObservations.map(
                (obs) => obs.confidence?.overall ?? 0.5
              )
            )
          : 0.5,
    },

    warnings:
      resolved.rejectedConflict.length > 0
        ? ["group_conflicts_rejected"]
        : [],
  };

  const newObservations: Record<string, AiObservation> = {};

  for (const groupObservation of groupCandidateObservations) {
    newObservations[groupObservation.id] = groupObservation;
  }

  newObservations[qualityObservation.id] = qualityObservation;

  const updatedObservations = {
    ...input.observationBundle.observations,
    ...newObservations,
  };

  const updatedBundle: AiObservationBundle = {
    ...input.observationBundle,

    observations: updatedObservations,

    counts: {
      ...input.observationBundle.counts,
      total: Object.keys(updatedObservations).length,
      groupCandidate:
        Object.values(updatedObservations).filter(
          (obs) => obs.kind === "group_candidate"
        ).length,
      quality:
        Object.values(updatedObservations).filter(
          (obs) => obs.kind === "quality"
        ).length,
    },

    warnings: [
      ...input.observationBundle.warnings,
      ...(resolved.rejectedConflict.length > 0
        ? ["group_conflicts_rejected"]
        : []),
    ],

    updatedAt: Date.now(),
  };

  const updatedBundleAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "observation-bundle-after-group-resolution"
  );

  const updatedBundleAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "source",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
    storagePath: observationBundlePath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: updatedBundleAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(
      JSON.stringify(updatedBundle, null, 2),
      "utf8"
    ),

    assetId: updatedBundleAssetId,
    kind: "observation_bundle_json" as any,

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    source: "system",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  const passAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "group-resolution-pass"
  );

  const pass: GroupResolutionPass = {
    schemaVersion: "ai-group-resolution-pass.v1",

    jobId: input.jobId,
    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    userId: input.userId,

    sourceObservationBundleAssetId:
      input.sourceObservationBundleAssetId,

    outputObservationBundleAssetId:
      updatedBundleAsset.id,

    status:
      resolved.rejectedConflict.length > 0
        ? "completed_with_warnings"
        : "completed",

    nodeCounts: {
      total: nodes.length,
      text: nodes.filter((node) => node.kind === "text_candidate").length,
      raster: nodes.filter((node) => node.kind === "raster_candidate").length,
      vector: nodes.filter((node) => node.kind === "vector_candidate").length,
      element: nodes.filter((node) => node.kind === "element_candidate").length,
      layout: nodes.filter((node) => node.kind === "layout").length,
    },

    candidateCounts: {
      generated: drafts.length,
      accepted: groupCandidateObservations.length,
      rejectedLowScore: resolved.rejectedLowScore.length,
      rejectedConflict: resolved.rejectedConflict.length,
      needsReview: groupCandidateObservations.filter(
        (obs) => obs.validation.needsReview
      ).length,
    },

    roleCounts: countRoles(groupCandidateObservations),

    observationsAdded: {
      total: Object.keys(newObservations).length,
      groupCandidate: groupCandidateObservations.length,
      quality: 1,
    },

    warnings:
      resolved.rejectedConflict.length > 0
        ? ["group_conflicts_rejected"]
        : [],

    createdAt: Date.now(),
  };

  const passAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "source",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
    storagePath: groupResolutionPassReportPath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: passAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(pass, null, 2), "utf8"),

    assetId: passAssetId,
    kind: "group_resolution_pass_json" as any,

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    source: "group_resolver",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  return {
    updatedBundle,
    updatedBundleAsset,
    groupResolutionPass: pass,
    groupResolutionPassAsset: passAsset,
    groupCandidateObservations,
  };
}

function countRoles(observations: { role: AiGroupRole }[]) {
  const roles: AiGroupRole[] = [
    "button",
    "badge",
    "price_block",
    "menu_item",
    "logo_lockup",
    "social_handle",
    "headline_block",
    "product_group",
    "pattern",
    "card",
    "header",
    "footer",
    "unknown",
  ];

  const result = Object.fromEntries(
    roles.map((role) => [role, 0])
  ) as Record<AiGroupRole, number>;

  for (const obs of observations) {
    result[obs.role]++;
  }

  return result;
}

function average(values: number[]) {
  return values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / Math.max(1, values.length);
}

function stableAssetId(jobId: string, label: string) {
  return `asset_${jobId}_${label}`
    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "_")
    .toLowerCase();
}
```

Remove `as any` after patching the asset enum.

# 16.17 Firestore patch

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/groups/apply-group-resolution-result.ts
```

```ts
import {
  FieldValue,
  getFirestore,
} from "firebase-admin/firestore";

import type {
  GroupResolutionResult,
} from "./group-resolution.types";

export async function applyGroupResolutionResult(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  jobId: string;
  result: GroupResolutionResult;
}) {
  const db = getFirestore();

  const jobRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/aiLayerJobs/${input.jobId}`
  );

  const batch = db.batch();

  const assetsToIndex = [
    input.result.updatedBundleAsset,
    input.result.groupResolutionPassAsset,
  ];

  for (const asset of assetsToIndex) {
    batch.set(
      db.doc(
        `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/assets/${asset.id}`
      ),
      {
        id: asset.id,

        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        jobId: input.jobId,

        kind: asset.kind,
        storageRole: asset.storageRole,

        bucket: asset.bucket,
        storagePath: asset.storagePath,

        generation: asset.generation,
        metageneration: asset.metageneration,

        mimeType: asset.mimeType,

        width: asset.width,
        height: asset.height,
        sizeBytes: asset.sizeBytes,

        checksum: asset.checksum,

        source: asset.metadata?.source,

        retained: true,

        createdAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      },
      { merge: true }
    );
  }

  batch.update(jobRef, {
    "input.observationBundleAssetId":
      input.result.updatedBundleAsset.id,

    groupResolution: {
      groupResolutionPassAssetId:
        input.result.groupResolutionPassAsset.id,

      outputObservationBundleAssetId:
        input.result.updatedBundleAsset.id,

      candidateCounts:
        input.result.groupResolutionPass.candidateCounts,

      nodeCounts:
        input.result.groupResolutionPass.nodeCounts,

      roleCounts:
        input.result.groupResolutionPass.roleCounts,

      observationsAdded:
        input.result.groupResolutionPass.observationsAdded,

      warnings:
        input.result.groupResolutionPass.warnings,

      createdAt:
        input.result.groupResolutionPass.createdAt,
    },

    "progress.percent": 86,
    "progress.label": "Groups resolved",
    "progress.currentStep": "resolving_scene",

    updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
  });

  await batch.commit();
}
```

Firestore stores only summary and pointers.

# 16.19 How Step 17 will use group candidates

Step 17 will decide:

```txt
which group candidates survive
which groups become AiResolvedGroup[]
which groups appear in the layer panel
which groups are ignored
which groups become select-as-group metadata
```

Example:

```txt
group_candidate(button)

    vector_candidate rounded_rect
    text_candidate button_label

  AiResolvedGroup(role="button", childLayerIds=[shapeLayer, textLayer])
```

```txt

```

---

# 16.20 Fabric behavior later

Default later behavior should be:

```txt
Layer panel group nesting: yes
Multi-select group handle: yes
Fabric.Group object: no by default
```

Generate real `fabric.Group` only when your existing editor safely supports:

```txt
select group
edit child
ungroup
serialize
restore child transforms
maintain z-order inside group
autosave undo/redo
```

Fabric groups are powerful, but group interactivity and targeting have caveats; Fabric docs explicitly mention `subTargetCheck` requirements and deprecated interactivity behavior. citeturn151478view0

---

# 16.21 Group acceptance gates

A group candidate is valid only if:

```txt
childObservationIds exist
child count >= 2
child count <= maxChildrenPerGroup
bbox is inside canvas
group score >= threshold
evidence is explicit
role is assigned
confidence exists
conflicts are resolved
zOrderRange exists
no locked_reference child
no background_candidate child unless role supports it
no duplicate group conflict unless nested compatibility exists
```

Mark needs review when:

```txt
group score is medium
children overlap multiple possible groups
role is uncertain
z-order range is wide
child confidence is low
bbox tightness is poor
semantic role conflicts with geometry
```

Reject when:

```txt
empty group
single-child group
group mostly duplicates stronger group
group includes unrelated children
group includes background + foreground incorrectly
group contains too many candidates
group confidence below threshold
```

---

# 16.22 Group hierarchy rules

Allowed nesting:

```txt
product_group
  badge

headline_block
  badge

card
  button
  price_block

menu_item
  price_block
```

Avoid deep nesting:

```txt
max nesting depth = 2
```

Do not nest:

```txt
button inside button
badge inside badge
logo_lockup inside social_handle
pattern inside product_group unless explicit
```

Deep hierarchy makes manual editing worse.

# 16.23 What Step 16 must not do

Do not add:

```txt
Fabric.Group
Fabric JSON
AiResolvedGroup
final layer childLayerIds
final zIndex changes
final group lock state
final editor hierarchy
```

Do not physically reparent:

```txt
text under shape
shape under badge
product under group
```

Only record:

```txt
group_candidate evidence
```

# 16.24 Non-negotiable invariants

Step 16 is valid only if:

```txt
Every output remains an observation.

No final group is created.

No Fabric group is created.

No Fabric JSON is created.

Groups are semantic metadata first.

Every group candidate has role.

Every group candidate has childObservationIds.

Every group candidate has evidence.

Every group candidate has confidence.

Every group candidate has bbox.

Every group candidate has zOrderRange.

Every group candidate has validation state.

Conflicting groups are resolved or marked.

Nested groups are limited.

Groups do not contain locked reference.

Groups do not mutate child geometry.

Groups do not mutate z-order.

Updated observation bundle is immutable.

Firestore stores only summary and pointers.
```

## ChatGPT Response 027

<!-- assistant_message_ids: 58af0dee-3eb9-491e-805a-58ecdff0a4de, 4d7baa53-ed38-4b45-8ced-b2ed1af314d7 -->

Step 17 is the decision point where evidence becomes the first durable reconstruction document. It must stay deterministic, conservative, auditable, and still independent of Fabric.

# Step 17 — Scene resolver

Step 17 is the first point where the system produces the **canonical reconstructed design document**.

Everything before this was evidence:

```txt
routing
layout observations
OCR observations
decomposition observations
text candidates
element candidates
vector candidates
raster candidates
background candidates
z-order observations
group candidates
```

Step 17 converts that evidence into:

```txt
AiReconstructionDocument
```

The locked rule:

```txt
Scene resolver creates the canonical reconstruction document.
It does not create Fabric JSON.
It does not render final preview.
It does not export.
```

This boundary is important because graphic layer decomposition is inherently ambiguous. LayerD explicitly frames raster graphic decomposition as ill-posed, with multiple valid decompositions and arbitrary possible layer splits. So Step 17 must not pretend to recover the “true” original design file; it must choose the safest editable reconstruction from the evidence. citeturn646932search0turn646932search8

---

## 17.1 What Step 17 owns

Step 17 owns:

```txt
candidate arbitration
duplicate suppression
final layer strategy decision
final layer creation
fallback attachment
final zIndex assignment
final logical group creation
canonical AiReconstructionDocument creation
schema validation
invariant checks
scene resolution pass report
reconstruction document asset
Firestore reconstruction pointer update
```

Step 17 does **not** own:

```txt
Fabric JSON
Fabric object creation
visual recomposition validation
final text safety pass
server export
editor autosave
manual repair tools
```

Fabric remains a later projection. Fabric’s own docs require custom properties to be explicitly serialized, and its `type` field is for Fabric class serialization, not application logic. That supports our current boundary: the canonical truth must stay outside Fabric. citeturn664515search0turn664515search5

# 17.2 Scene resolver input

Step 17 consumes the latest observation bundle after Step 16.

Required:

```txt
job.input.observationBundleAssetId
source original asset
normalized asset
editor reference asset
canvas dimensions
routing diagnosis
all observations
all asset refs
```

Important observation kinds:

```txt
background_candidate
raster_candidate
vector_candidate
text_candidate
element_candidate
group_candidate
z_order
quality
routing
palette
layout
```

Step 17 must not read raw Gemini, OCR, LayerD, SAM, or inpainting outputs directly. It reads normalized observations only.

Step 17 outputs:

```txt
AiReconstructionDocument

```

It writes:

```txt
workspaces/{workspaceId}/designs/{designId}/magic-layers/jobs/{jobId}/manifests/{assetId}.reconstruction.json

workspaces/{workspaceId}/designs/{designId}/magic-layers/jobs/{jobId}/scene/{assetId}.scene-resolution-pass.json
```

It updates Firestore:

```txt
job.output.reconstructionAssetId

progress
```

It does **not** create:

```txt
AiFabricManifest
FabricRuntimeJson
Fabric objects
preview render
```

---

# 17.4 Scene resolver decision model

Step 17 makes five decisions.

```txt
1. Which background candidate becomes the background layer?

2. Which text candidates become editable text versus raster fallback?

3. Which vector candidates become vector-editable versus raster fallback?

4. Which raster candidates become raster layers?

5. Which group candidates become final logical groups?
```

The resolver must prefer:

```txt
visual fidelity
fallback availability
text safety
low hallucination risk
low duplicate count
simple editability
```

over:

```txt
maximum editability
maximum object count
aggressive vectorization
over-grouping
over-segmentation
```

```ts
import type {
  AiAssetRef,
  AiEditableLevel,
  AiLayerType,
  AiReconstructedLayer,
  AiReconstructionDocument,
  AiResolvedGroup,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import type {
  AiObservationBundle,
} from "../observations/observation-bundle.types";

export const AI_SCENE_RESOLUTION_PASS_SCHEMA_VERSION =
  "ai-scene-resolution-pass.v1" as const;

export type SceneResolutionPassStatus =
  | "completed"
  | "completed_with_warnings"
  | "failed";

export type SceneCandidateKind =
  | "locked_reference"
  | "background"
  | "text"
  | "vector"
  | "raster"
  | "group";

export type SceneLayerDecisionStrategy =
  | "use_locked_reference"
  | "use_clean_background"
  | "use_editable_text"
  | "use_vector"
  | "use_masked_raster"
  | "use_raster_fallback"
  | "reject_duplicate"
  | "reject_low_confidence"
  | "reject_superseded_by_text"
  | "reject_superseded_by_vector"
  | "reject_no_fallback"
  | "manual_review_required";

export type SceneCandidateDecision = {
  candidateObservationId: string;

  candidateKind: SceneCandidateKind;

  strategy: SceneLayerDecisionStrategy;

  accepted: boolean;

  outputLayerId?: string;

  reasonCodes: string[];

  confidence: number;

  fallbackAssetId?: string;

  needsReview: boolean;
};

export type SceneResolutionPass = {
  schemaVersion: typeof AI_SCENE_RESOLUTION_PASS_SCHEMA_VERSION;

  jobId: string;
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  userId: string;

  sourceObservationBundleAssetId: string;

  reconstructionDocumentAssetId: string;

  status: SceneResolutionPassStatus;

  decisionCounts: {
    totalCandidates: number;
    acceptedLayers: number;
    rejectedCandidates: number;
    acceptedTextEditable: number;
    acceptedVectorEditable: number;
    acceptedRasterMasked: number;
    acceptedRasterFallback: number;
    acceptedBackground: number;
    acceptedGroups: number;
    needsReviewLayers: number;
  };

  decisions: SceneCandidateDecision[];

  layerIds: string[];

  groupIds: string[];

  quality: {
    needsReview: boolean;
    warnings: string[];
  };

  warnings: string[];

  createdAt: number;
};

export type SceneResolutionResult = {
  reconstructionDocument: AiReconstructionDocument;

  reconstructionDocumentAsset: AiAssetRef;

  sceneResolutionPass: SceneResolutionPass;

  sceneResolutionPassAsset: AiAssetRef;

  layers: AiReconstructedLayer[];

  groups: AiResolvedGroup[];
};
```

# 17.9 Scene resolution policy

Important default:

```txt
allowCandidateWithReviewAsEditable = false
allowManualReviewVectorAsEditable = false
```

Medium-confidence candidates should not become editable automatically.

---

# 17.10 Candidate selection priority

The resolver should use this priority:

```txt
1. locked reference layer
2. clean background layer
3. live text candidates
4. accepted vector candidates
5. accepted raster candidates
6. raster fallbacks for rejected text/vector
7. unknown/manual-review raster candidates
8. logical groups
```

Duplicate suppression should use semantic priority:

```txt
live text beats text raster fallback
accepted vector beats shape raster fallback
raster candidate beats raw element candidate
background candidate beats full-canvas raster candidate
higher-confidence candidate beats lower-confidence duplicate
```

# 17.11 Build scene candidates

```ts
import type {
  AiBackgroundCandidateObservation,
  AiGroupCandidateObservation,
  AiObservation,
  AiRasterCandidateObservation,
  AiTextCandidateObservation,
  AiVectorCandidateObservation,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

export type SceneCandidate =
  | {
      kind: "background";
      observation: AiBackgroundCandidateObservation;
      confidence: number;
    }
  | {
      kind: "text";
      observation: AiTextCandidateObservation;
      confidence: number;
    }
  | {
      kind: "vector";
      observation: AiVectorCandidateObservation;
      confidence: number;
    }
  | {
      kind: "raster";
      observation: AiRasterCandidateObservation;
      confidence: number;
    }
  | {
      kind: "group";
      observation: AiGroupCandidateObservation;
      confidence: number;
    };

export function buildSceneCandidates(
  observations: AiObservation[]
): SceneCandidate[] {
  const result: SceneCandidate[] = [];

  for (const observation of observations) {
    if (observation.kind === "background_candidate") {
      result.push({
        kind: "background",
        observation,
        confidence: observation.confidence?.overall ?? 0,
      });
    }

    if (observation.kind === "text_candidate") {
      result.push({
        kind: "text",
        observation,
        confidence: observation.confidence?.overall ?? 0,
      });
    }

    if (observation.kind === "vector_candidate") {
      result.push({
        kind: "vector",
        observation,
        confidence: observation.confidence?.overall ?? 0,
      });
    }

    if (observation.kind === "raster_candidate") {
      result.push({
        kind: "raster",
        observation,
        confidence: observation.confidence?.overall ?? 0,
      });
    }

    if (observation.kind === "group_candidate") {
      result.push({
        kind: "group",
        observation,
        confidence: observation.confidence?.overall ?? 0,
      });
    }
  }

  return result;
}
```

# 17.12 Z-order lookup

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/scene-resolution/scene-z-order.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiObservation,
  AiZOrderObservation,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_SCENE_RESOLUTION_POLICY,
} from "./scene-resolution-policy";

export function buildSceneZOrderLookup(
  observations: AiObservation[]
): Map<string, number> {
  const global = observations.find(
    (obs): obs is AiZOrderObservation =>
      obs.kind === "z_order" &&
      obs.mode === "global_order" &&
      Array.isArray(obs.orderedObservationIds)
  );

  const map = new Map<string, number>();

  if (!global?.orderedObservationIds) {
    return map;
  }

  global.orderedObservationIds.forEach((observationId, index) => {
    map.set(
      observationId,
      MAGIC_LAYERS_SCENE_RESOLUTION_POLICY.zOrder.start +
        index * MAGIC_LAYERS_SCENE_RESOLUTION_POLICY.zOrder.step
    );
  });

  return map;
}

export function zIndexForObservation(input: {
  observationId: string;
  zOrderLookup: Map<string, number>;
  fallbackIndex: number;
}) {
  return (
    input.zOrderLookup.get(input.observationId) ??
    MAGIC_LAYERS_SCENE_RESOLUTION_POLICY.zOrder.start +
      input.fallbackIndex *
        MAGIC_LAYERS_SCENE_RESOLUTION_POLICY.zOrder.step
  );
}
```

Step 15 produced provisional order evidence. Step 17 now uses it only for kept layers.

```ts
import {
  AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,
  AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
} from "../schema/constants";

import type {
  AiBackgroundCandidateObservation,
  AiConfidence,
  AiEditableLevel,
  AiFallback,
  AiGeometry,
  AiLayerCapability,
  AiLayerType,
  AiReconstructedLayer,
  AiRasterCandidateObservation,
  AiTextCandidateObservation,
  AiVectorCandidateObservation,
  BBox,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  capabilitiesForEditableLevel,
} from "../schema/capabilities";

export function geometryFromBBox(bbox: BBox): AiGeometry {
  return {
    coordinateSpace: "canvas_px",

    bbox,

    transform: {
      left: bbox.x,
      top: bbox.y,
      width: bbox.width,
      height: bbox.height,
      scaleX: 1,
      scaleY: 1,
      angle: 0,
      opacity: 1,
      originX: "left",
      originY: "top",
    },
  };
}

export function makeFallback(input: {
  id: string;
  strategy:
    | "locked_reference"
    | "original_crop"
    | "raster_layer"
    | "rasterized_editable"
    | "previous_version"
    | "manual_user"
    | "none";
  assetId?: string;
  bbox?: BBox;
  reason: string;
  visibleByDefault?: boolean;
}): AiFallback {
  return {
    id: input.id,
    strategy: input.strategy,
    assetId: input.assetId,
    bbox: input.bbox,
    reason: input.reason,
    visibleByDefault: input.visibleByDefault ?? false,
    createdAt: Date.now(),
  };
}

export function createLockedReferenceLayer(input: {
  jobId: string;
  designId: string;
  workspaceId: string;
  editorReferenceAssetId: string;
  originalImageAssetId: string;
  canvas: {
    width: number;
    height: number;
  };
}): AiReconstructedLayer {
  const bbox = {
    x: 0,
    y: 0,
    width: input.canvas.width,
    height: input.canvas.height,
  };

  return {
    id: "layer_locked_reference",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,

    jobId: input.jobId,
    designId: input.designId,
    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,

    type: "locked_reference",
    editableLevel: "locked_reference",

    name: "Original reference",

    visible: false,
    locked: true,

    zIndex: -1000,

    geometry: geometryFromBBox(bbox),

    confidence: {
      overall: 1,
      visualFidelity: 1,
    },

    capabilities: capabilitiesForEditableLevel("locked_reference"),

    assetIds: [input.editorReferenceAssetId],

    fallbacks: [],

    provenance: {
      primarySource: "original_upload",
      contributingSources: ["original_upload", "normalizer"],
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,
    },

    decision: {
      strategy: "use_locked_reference",
      selectedObservationIds: [],
      reasonCodes: ["original_reference_preserved"],
      decidedBy: "system",
      decidedAt: Date.now(),
    },

    raster: {
      editorAssetId: input.editorReferenceAssetId,
      exportAssetId: input.originalImageAssetId,
      alphaMode: "binary_mask",
      edgeQuality: "high",
    },

    metadata: {
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      originalImageAssetId: input.originalImageAssetId,
      normalizedImageAssetId: input.editorReferenceAssetId,
    },
  };
}

export function createBackgroundLayer(input: {
  jobId: string;
  designId: string;
  workspaceId: string;
  observation: AiBackgroundCandidateObservation;
  zIndex: number;
}): AiReconstructedLayer {
  const editableLevel: AiEditableLevel = "raster_clean_background";

  const fallback = makeFallback({
    id: "fallback_background_original_reference",
    strategy: "locked_reference",
    assetId: input.observation.fallback.editorReferenceAssetId,
    bbox: input.observation.canvasBBox,
    reason: "Clean background may be imperfect",
  });

  return {
    id: "layer_clean_background",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,

    jobId: input.jobId,
    designId: input.designId,
    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,

    type: "clean_background",
    editableLevel,

    name: input.observation.validation.needsReview
      ? "Clean background · needs review"
      : "Clean background",

    visible: true,
    locked: false,

    zIndex: input.zIndex,

    geometry: geometryFromBBox(input.observation.canvasBBox),

    confidence: input.observation.confidence ?? {
      overall: 0.6,
      backgroundRepair: 0.6,
    },

    capabilities: capabilitiesForEditableLevel(editableLevel),

    assetIds: [input.observation.cleanBackgroundAssetId],

    fallbacks: [fallback],

    primaryFallbackId: fallback.id,

    provenance: {
      primarySource: "inpainting",
      contributingSources: ["inpainting", "system"],
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,
    },

    decision: {
      strategy: "use_clean_background",
      selectedObservationIds: [input.observation.id],
      reasonCodes: [
        "background_candidate_selected",
        ...(input.observation.validation.needsReview
          ? ["background_candidate_needs_review"]
          : []),
      ],
      decidedBy: "system",
      decidedAt: Date.now(),
    },

    raster: {
      editorAssetId: input.observation.cleanBackgroundAssetId,
      exportAssetId: input.observation.cleanBackgroundAssetId,
      alphaMode: "binary_mask",
      edgeQuality: input.observation.validation.needsReview
        ? "medium"
        : "high",
    },

    background: {
      assetId: input.observation.cleanBackgroundAssetId,
      sourceImageAssetId: input.observation.sourceImageAssetId,
      removedMaskAssetId: input.observation.removalMaskAssetId,
      repairAreaRatio: input.observation.repair.repairAreaRatio,
      hallucinationRisk: input.observation.repair.hallucinationRisk,
      conservativeRepair: input.observation.repair.conservativeRepair,
    },

    metadata: {
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      needsReview: input.observation.validation.needsReview,
      warnings: input.observation.validation.warnings,
    },
  };
}

export function createTextLayer(input: {
  jobId: string;
  designId: string;
  workspaceId: string;
  observation: AiTextCandidateObservation;

      overall: 0.8,
      ocr: 0.8,
      textSafety: 1,
    },

    capabilities: capabilitiesForEditableLevel("text_editable"),

    assetIds: [],

    fallbacks: [fallback],

    primaryFallbackId: fallback.id,

      reasonCodes: [
        "text_candidate_live_text",
        "text_safety_passed",
        "fallback_attached",
      ],
      decidedBy: "system",
      decidedAt: Date.now(),

      fontFallback: input.observation.style.fontFallback,

      fontSize: input.observation.style.fontSizePx ?? 16,
      fontWeight: input.observation.style.fontWeight,
      fontStyle: input.observation.style.fontStyle,

      letterSpacingPx: input.observation.style.letterSpacingPx,

      fill: input.observation.style.fill,
      stroke: input.observation.style.stroke,
      strokeWidth: input.observation.style.strokeWidth,

        semanticMutationDetected:
          input.observation.validation.semanticMutationDetected,
        roundTripOcrPassed:
          input.observation.validation.normalizedStringExact,

    },

export function createVectorLayer(input: {
  jobId: string;
  designId: string;
  workspaceId: string;
  observation: AiVectorCandidateObservation;

    id: `fallback_${input.observation.id}`,

    decision: {
      strategy: "use_vector",
      selectedObservationIds: [input.observation.id],
      reasonCodes: [
        "vector_candidate_passed",
        "vector_render_validation_passed",
        "fallback_attached",
      ],
      decidedBy: "system",
      decidedAt: Date.now(),
    },

export function createRasterLayer(input: {
  jobId: string;
  designId: string;
  workspaceId: string;
  observation: AiRasterCandidateObservation;
  zIndex: number;
}): AiReconstructedLayer {
  const editableLevel: AiEditableLevel =
    input.observation.editability.recommendedStrategy === "raster_masked"
      ? "raster_masked"
      : input.observation.editability.recommendedStrategy === "manual_review"
        ? "raster_fallback"
        : "raster_fallback";

  const fallback = makeFallback({
    id: `fallback_${input.observation.id}`,
    strategy: "original_crop",
    assetId: input.observation.assets.fallbackCropAssetId,
    bbox: input.observation.bbox,
    reason: "Raster layer fallback from original pixels",
  });

  return {
    id: `layer_raster_${safeId(input.observation.id)}`,

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,

    jobId: input.jobId,
    designId: input.designId,
    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,

    type: layerTypeForRaster(input.observation),
    editableLevel,

    name: nameForRasterLayer(input.observation),

    visible: true,
    locked: false,

    zIndex: input.zIndex,

    geometry: geometryFromBBox(input.observation.bbox),

    confidence: input.observation.confidence ?? {
      overall: 0.6,
      mask: 0.6,
    },

    capabilities: capabilitiesForEditableLevel(editableLevel),

    assetIds: [
      input.observation.assets.editorAssetId,
      ...(input.observation.assets.exportAssetId
        ? [input.observation.assets.exportAssetId]
        : []),
      ...(input.observation.assets.maskAssetId
        ? [input.observation.assets.maskAssetId]
        : []),
    ],

    fallbacks: [fallback],

    primaryFallbackId: fallback.id,

    provenance: {
      primarySource: "matting",
      contributingSources: ["matting", "connected_components", "system"],
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,
    },

    decision: {
      strategy:
        editableLevel === "raster_masked"
          ? "use_masked_raster"
          : "use_raster_fallback",
      selectedObservationIds: [input.observation.id],
      reasonCodes: [
        `raster_role_${input.observation.role}`,
        `strategy_${input.observation.editability.recommendedStrategy}`,
      ],
      decidedBy: "system",
      decidedAt: Date.now(),
    },

    raster: {
      editorAssetId: input.observation.assets.editorAssetId,
      exportAssetId: input.observation.assets.exportAssetId,
      maskAssetId: input.observation.assets.maskAssetId,
      originalCropAssetId:
        input.observation.assets.fallbackCropAssetId,
      crop: input.observation.bbox,
      alphaMode: input.observation.alpha.mode,
      edgeQuality: input.observation.alpha.edgeQuality,
      canReplace: input.observation.editability.canReplace,
      canCrop: input.observation.editability.canCrop,
      canEditMask: input.observation.editability.canEditMask,
    },

    metadata: {
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      needsReview: input.observation.editability.needsReview,
      warnings: [
        ...input.observation.validation.failureReasons,
        ...input.observation.validation.warnings,
      ],
    },
  };
}

function layerTypeForRaster(
  obs: AiRasterCandidateObservation
): AiLayerType {
  switch (obs.role) {
    case "person":
      return "person";
    case "product":
      return "product";
    case "photo_subject":
      return "photo_subject";
    case "image_block":
      return "image_block";
    case "logo_icon_raster":
      return "logo";
    case "text_raster_fallback":
      return "text";
    case "shape_raster_fallback":
      return "shape";
    case "decoration":
      return "decoration";
    case "shadow":
      return "shadow";
    case "overlay":
      return "overlay";
    default:
      return "unknown";
  }
}

function layerTypeForVector(
  obs: AiVectorCandidateObservation
): AiLayerType {
  if (
    ["rect", "rounded_rect", "circle", "ellipse", "line", "polygon"].includes(
      obs.primitive
    )
  ) {
    return "shape";
  }

  return "icon";
}

function nameForTextLayer(obs: AiTextCandidateObservation) {
  switch (obs.textRole) {
    case "headline":
      return "Headline";
    case "subtitle":
      return "Subtitle";
    case "price":
      return "Price text";
    case "button_label":
      return "Button text";
    case "menu_item":
      return "Menu text";
    default:
      return "Text";
  }
}

function nameForVectorLayer(obs: AiVectorCandidateObservation) {
  return `Vector ${obs.primitive}`;
}

function nameForRasterLayer(obs: AiRasterCandidateObservation) {
  switch (obs.role) {
    case "person":
      return "Person";
    case "product":
      return "Product";
    case "photo_subject":
      return "Photo subject";
    case "image_block":
      return "Image block";
    case "logo_icon_raster":
      return "Logo/icon";
    case "text_raster_fallback":
      return "Text fallback";
    case "shape_raster_fallback":
      return "Shape fallback";
    case "decoration":
      return "Decoration";
    case "shadow":
      return "Shadow";
    case "overlay":
      return "Overlay";
    default:
      return "Raster layer";
  }
}

function safeId(value: string) {
  return value.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "_").toLowerCase();
}
```

# 17.14 Layer selection logic


```ts
import type {
  AiBackgroundCandidateObservation,
  AiRasterCandidateObservation,
  AiTextCandidateObservation,
  AiVectorCandidateObservation,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  bboxIoU,
} from "../schema/geometry";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_SCENE_RESOLUTION_POLICY,
} from "./scene-resolution-policy";

import type {
  SceneCandidateDecision,
} from "./scene-resolution.types";

export type FinalLayerSelection = {
  background?: AiBackgroundCandidateObservation;

  textEditable: AiTextCandidateObservation[];

  vectorEditable: AiVectorCandidateObservation[];

  raster: AiRasterCandidateObservation[];

  decisions: SceneCandidateDecision[];

  warnings: string[];
};

export function selectFinalLayers(input: {
  backgroundCandidates: AiBackgroundCandidateObservation[];
  textCandidates: AiTextCandidateObservation[];
  vectorCandidates: AiVectorCandidateObservation[];
  rasterCandidates: AiRasterCandidateObservation[];
}): FinalLayerSelection {
  const decisions: SceneCandidateDecision[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];

  const background = selectBackgroundCandidate(input.backgroundCandidates);

  if (background) {
    decisions.push({
      candidateObservationId: background.id,
      candidateKind: "background",
      strategy: "use_clean_background",
      accepted: true,
      confidence: background.confidence?.overall ?? 0.6,
      needsReview: background.validation.needsReview,
      reasonCodes: ["selected_best_background_candidate"],
    });
  }

  const textEditable: AiTextCandidateObservation[] = [];

  const rejectedTextIds = new Set<string>();

  for (const text of input.textCandidates) {
    const decision = decideTextCandidate(text);

    decisions.push(decision);

    if (decision.accepted) {
      textEditable.push(text);
    } else {
      rejectedTextIds.add(text.id);
    }
  }

  const vectorEditable: AiVectorCandidateObservation[] = [];

  const rejectedVectorIds = new Set<string>();

  for (const vector of input.vectorCandidates) {
    const decision = decideVectorCandidate(vector);

    decisions.push(decision);

    if (decision.accepted) {
      vectorEditable.push(vector);
    } else {
      rejectedVectorIds.add(vector.id);
    }
  }

  const raster = selectRasterCandidates({
    rasterCandidates: input.rasterCandidates,
    acceptedTextIds: new Set(textEditable.map((text) => text.id)),
    rejectedTextIds,
    acceptedVectorIds: new Set(
      vectorEditable.map((vector) => vector.id)
    ),
    rejectedVectorIds,
  });

  for (const candidate of raster.accepted) {
    decisions.push({
      candidateObservationId: candidate.id,
      candidateKind: "raster",
      strategy:
        candidate.editability.recommendedStrategy === "raster_masked"
          ? "use_masked_raster"
          : "use_raster_fallback",
      accepted: true,
      confidence: candidate.confidence?.overall ?? 0.5,
      fallbackAssetId: candidate.assets.fallbackCropAssetId,
      needsReview: candidate.editability.needsReview,
      reasonCodes: [
        `selected_raster_role_${candidate.role}`,
      ],
    });
  }

  for (const rejected of raster.rejected) {
    decisions.push(rejected);
  }

  return {
    background,
    textEditable,
    vectorEditable,
    raster: raster.accepted,
    decisions,
    warnings,
  };
}

function selectBackgroundCandidate(
  candidates: AiBackgroundCandidateObservation[]
) {
  const p = MAGIC_LAYERS_SCENE_RESOLUTION_POLICY.background;

  return [...candidates]
    .filter(
      (candidate) =>
        (candidate.confidence?.overall ?? 0) >=
        p.minCleanBackgroundConfidence
    )
    .sort((a, b) => {
      const scoreA = scoreBackground(a);
      const scoreB = scoreBackground(b);
      return scoreB - scoreA;
    })[0];
}

function scoreBackground(candidate: AiBackgroundCandidateObservation) {
  return (
    (candidate.confidence?.overall ?? 0) * 0.45 +
    (candidate.validation.passed ? 0.25 : 0) +
    (candidate.validation.needsReview ? -0.08 : 0) +
    (1 - candidate.repair.hallucinationRisk) * 0.2 +
    (1 - candidate.repair.repairAreaRatio) * 0.1
  );
}

function decideTextCandidate(
  text: AiTextCandidateObservation
): SceneCandidateDecision {
  const p = MAGIC_LAYERS_SCENE_RESOLUTION_POLICY.text;

  const failures: string[] = [];

  if (text.editability !== "candidate_live_text") {
    failures.push("text_not_live_candidate");
  }

  if (
    (text.confidence?.overall ?? 0) <
    p.minLiveTextConfidence
  ) {
    failures.push("text_confidence_low");
  }

  if (
    p.requireNoSemanticMutation &&
    text.validation.semanticMutationDetected
  ) {
    failures.push("semantic_mutation_detected");
  }

  if (
    p.requireFallbackCrop &&
    !text.assets.fallbackCropAssetId
  ) {
    failures.push("missing_text_fallback_crop");
  }

  const accepted = failures.length === 0;

  return {
    candidateObservationId: text.id,
    candidateKind: "text",
    strategy: accepted
      ? "use_editable_text"
      : "use_raster_fallback",
    accepted,
    confidence: text.confidence?.overall ?? 0,
    fallbackAssetId: text.assets.fallbackCropAssetId,
    needsReview: !accepted,
    reasonCodes: accepted
      ? ["text_candidate_promoted_to_editable_text"]
      : failures,
  };
}

function decideVectorCandidate(
  vector: AiVectorCandidateObservation
): SceneCandidateDecision {
  const p = MAGIC_LAYERS_SCENE_RESOLUTION_POLICY.vector;

  const failures: string[] = [];

  if (!vector.editability.eligibleForVectorEditable) {
    failures.push("vector_not_eligible");
  }

  if (
    p.requireValidationPassed &&
    !vector.validation.passed
  ) {
    failures.push("vector_validation_failed");
  }

  if (
    (vector.confidence?.overall ?? 0) <
    p.minVectorEditableConfidence
  ) {
    failures.push("vector_confidence_low");
  }

  if (
    p.requireOptimizedSvgAsset &&
    !vector.optimizedSvgAssetId
  ) {
    failures.push("missing_optimized_svg_asset");
  }

  if (
    p.requireRasterFallback &&
    !vector.fallbackRasterAssetId
  ) {
    failures.push("missing_vector_raster_fallback");
  }

  const accepted = failures.length === 0;

  return {
    candidateObservationId: vector.id,
    candidateKind: "vector",
    strategy: accepted
      ? "use_vector"
      : "use_raster_fallback",
    accepted,
    confidence: vector.confidence?.overall ?? 0,
    fallbackAssetId: vector.fallbackRasterAssetId,
    needsReview: !accepted,
    reasonCodes: accepted
      ? ["vector_candidate_promoted_to_vector_layer"]
      : failures,
  };
}

function selectRasterCandidates(input: {
  rasterCandidates: AiRasterCandidateObservation[];
  acceptedTextIds: Set<string>;
  rejectedTextIds: Set<string>;
  acceptedVectorIds: Set<string>;
  rejectedVectorIds: Set<string>;
}) {
  const accepted: AiRasterCandidateObservation[] = [];
  const rejected: SceneCandidateDecision[] = [];

  const sorted = [...input.rasterCandidates].sort(
    (a, b) =>
      (b.confidence?.overall ?? 0) -
      (a.confidence?.overall ?? 0)
  );

  for (const raster of sorted) {
    const failures: string[] = [];

    if (!raster.assets.editorAssetId) {
      failures.push("missing_editor_asset");
    }

    const isTextFallback =
      raster.role === "text_raster_fallback";

    const sourceTextIds =
      raster.sourceTextCandidateObservationIds ?? [];

    const textAlreadyAccepted = sourceTextIds.some((id) =>
      input.acceptedTextIds.has(id)
    );

    if (
      isTextFallback &&
      textAlreadyAccepted &&
      MAGIC_LAYERS_SCENE_RESOLUTION_POLICY.dedupe
        .preferTextOverRasterTextFallback
    ) {
      failures.push("superseded_by_editable_text");
    }

    const isVectorFallback =
      raster.role === "shape_raster_fallback" ||
      raster.sourceVectorCandidateObservationIds.length > 0;

    const vectorAlreadyAccepted =
      raster.sourceVectorCandidateObservationIds.some((id) =>
        input.acceptedVectorIds.has(id)
      );

    if (
      isVectorFallback &&
      vectorAlreadyAccepted &&
      MAGIC_LAYERS_SCENE_RESOLUTION_POLICY.dedupe
        .preferVectorOverShapeRasterFallback
    ) {
      failures.push("superseded_by_vector");
    }

    if (
      raster.editability.recommendedStrategy === "raster_masked" &&
      (raster.confidence?.overall ?? 0) <
        MAGIC_LAYERS_SCENE_RESOLUTION_POLICY.raster
          .minRasterMaskedConfidence
    ) {
      failures.push("raster_masked_confidence_low");
    }

    if (
      raster.editability.recommendedStrategy !== "raster_masked" &&
      (raster.confidence?.overall ?? 0) <
        MAGIC_LAYERS_SCENE_RESOLUTION_POLICY.raster
          .minRasterFallbackConfidence
    ) {
      failures.push("raster_fallback_confidence_low");
    }

    const duplicate = accepted.find(
      (existing) =>
        bboxIoU(existing.bbox, raster.bbox) >=
        MAGIC_LAYERS_SCENE_RESOLUTION_POLICY.dedupe.bboxIoUThreshold
    );

    if (duplicate) {
      failures.push("duplicate_raster_candidate");
    }

    if (failures.length) {
      rejected.push({
        candidateObservationId: raster.id,
        candidateKind: "raster",
        strategy: failureStrategy(failures),
        accepted: false,
        confidence: raster.confidence?.overall ?? 0,
        fallbackAssetId: raster.assets.fallbackCropAssetId,
        needsReview: true,
        reasonCodes: failures,
      });

      continue;
    }

    accepted.push(raster);
  }

  return {
    accepted,
    rejected,
  };
}

function failureStrategy(
  failures: string[]
): SceneCandidateDecision["strategy"] {
  if (failures.includes("superseded_by_editable_text")) {
    return "reject_superseded_by_text";
  }

  if (failures.includes("superseded_by_vector")) {
    return "reject_superseded_by_vector";
  }

  if (failures.includes("duplicate_raster_candidate")) {
    return "reject_duplicate";
  }

  if (failures.includes("missing_editor_asset")) {
    return "reject_no_fallback";
  }

  return "reject_low_confidence";
}
```

# 17.15 Final group resolution

Step 16 generated group candidates. Step 17 turns accepted group candidates into final `AiResolvedGroup[]`.

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/scene-resolution/resolve-final-groups.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiGroupCandidateObservation,
  AiReconstructedLayer,
  AiResolvedGroup,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_SCENE_RESOLUTION_POLICY,
} from "./scene-resolution-policy";

export function resolveFinalGroups(input: {
  groupCandidates: AiGroupCandidateObservation[];
  layers: AiReconstructedLayer[];
}): AiResolvedGroup[] {
  const layerBySelectedObservationId = new Map<string, string>();

  for (const layer of input.layers) {
    for (const observationId of layer.decision.selectedObservationIds) {
      layerBySelectedObservationId.set(observationId, layer.id);
    }
  }

  const groups: AiResolvedGroup[] = [];

  const sorted = [...input.groupCandidates].sort(
    (a, b) =>
      (b.confidence?.overall ?? 0) -
      (a.confidence?.overall ?? 0)
  );

  for (const candidate of sorted) {
    if (
      (candidate.confidence?.overall ?? 0) <
      MAGIC_LAYERS_SCENE_RESOLUTION_POLICY.groups
        .minResolvedGroupConfidence
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    if (!candidate.validation.passed) continue;

    const childLayerIds = candidate.childObservationIds
      .map((observationId) =>
        layerBySelectedObservationId.get(observationId)
      )
      .filter((id): id is string => Boolean(id));

    if (childLayerIds.length < 2) continue;

    const childLayers = childLayerIds
      .map((id) => input.layers.find((layer) => layer.id === id))
      .filter((layer): layer is AiReconstructedLayer => Boolean(layer));

    if (childLayers.length < 2) continue;

    groups.push({
      id: `group_${safeId(candidate.id)}`,

      name: nameForGroup(candidate),

      role: candidate.role,

      childLayerIds,

      bbox: candidate.bbox,

      zIndexRange: {
        min: Math.min(...childLayers.map((layer) => layer.zIndex)),
        max: Math.max(...childLayers.map((layer) => layer.zIndex)),
      },

      confidence: candidate.confidence ?? {
        overall: 0.6,
        grouping: 0.6,
      },

      sourceObservationIds: [
        candidate.id,
        ...candidate.sourceObservationIds,
      ],

      lockedChildren: candidate.editability.lockedChildren,

      createdAt: Date.now(),
    });

    if (
      groups.length >=
      MAGIC_LAYERS_SCENE_RESOLUTION_POLICY.maxFinalGroups
    ) {
      break;
    }
  }

  return groups;
}

function nameForGroup(candidate: AiGroupCandidateObservation) {
  switch (candidate.role) {
    case "button":
      return "Button";
    case "badge":
      return "Badge";
    case "price_block":
      return "Price block";
    case "menu_item":
      return "Menu item";
    case "logo_lockup":
      return "Logo lockup";
    case "social_handle":
      return "Social handle";
    case "headline_block":
      return "Headline block";
    case "product_group":
      return "Product group";
    case "pattern":
      return "Pattern";
    default:
      return "Group";
  }
}

function safeId(value: string) {
  return value.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "_").toLowerCase();
}
```

Use final groups only as canonical metadata. Fabric grouping happens later only if the editor explicitly supports it. Figma’s plugin docs are a useful warning: groups fit their children and cannot be empty, so grouping is not just a label—it changes geometric semantics. citeturn646932search3turn646932search7

# 17.16 Final zIndex assignment

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/scene-resolution/assign-final-z-indexes.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiReconstructedLayer,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_SCENE_RESOLUTION_POLICY,
} from "./scene-resolution-policy";

export function assignFinalZIndexes(input: {
  layers: AiReconstructedLayer[];

  observationOrder: Map<string, number>;
}) {
  const sorted = [...input.layers].sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.type === "locked_reference") return -1;
    if (b.type === "locked_reference") return 1;

    const aObs = a.decision.selectedObservationIds[0];
    const bObs = b.decision.selectedObservationIds[0];

    const aOrder =
      input.observationOrder.get(aObs) ?? fallbackBandOrder(a);
    const bOrder =
      input.observationOrder.get(bObs) ?? fallbackBandOrder(b);

    if (aOrder !== bOrder) return aOrder - bOrder;

    return a.id.localeCompare(b.id);
  });

  return sorted.map((layer, index) => ({
    ...layer,
    zIndex:
      layer.type === "locked_reference"
        ? -1000
        : index *
          MAGIC_LAYERS_SCENE_RESOLUTION_POLICY.zOrder.step,
  }));
}

function fallbackBandOrder(layer: AiReconstructedLayer) {
  switch (layer.type) {
    case "locked_reference":
      return -1000;
    case "background":
    case "clean_background":
      return -900;
    case "shape":
      return 100;
    case "image_block":
      return 160;
    case "shadow":
      return 180;
    case "photo_subject":
      return 220;
    case "person":
    case "product":
      return 260;
    case "logo":
    case "icon":
      return 320;
    case "text":
      return 420;
    case "overlay":
      return 520;
    default:
      return 250;
  }
}
```

Final zIndex is assigned only after candidate rejection. This keeps the final stack compact and deterministic.

# 17.17 Reconstruction quality summary

