
```ts
import type {
  AiReconstructedLayer,
  AiResolvedGroup,
  AiReconstructionQuality,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

export function computeInitialReconstructionQuality(input: {
  layers: AiReconstructedLayer[];
  groups: AiResolvedGroup[];
  warnings: string[];
}): AiReconstructionQuality {
  const editableTextCount = input.layers.filter(
    (layer) => layer.editableLevel === "text_editable"
  ).length;

  const vectorEditableCount = input.layers.filter(
    (layer) => layer.editableLevel === "vector_editable"
  ).length;

  const rasterLayerCount = input.layers.filter((layer) =>
    [
      "raster_masked",
      "raster_clean_background",
      "raster_fallback",
    ].includes(layer.editableLevel)
  ).length;

  const fallbackLayerCount = input.layers.filter(
    (layer) => layer.fallbacks.length > 0
  ).length;

  const unknownLayerCount = input.layers.filter(
    (layer) => layer.type === "unknown"
  ).length;

  const needsReview =
    input.warnings.length > 0 ||
    input.layers.some((layer) => layer.metadata.needsReview) ||
    input.groups.some((group) => group.confidence.overall < 0.78);

  return {
    editableTextCount,
    vectorEditableCount,
    rasterLayerCount,
    fallbackLayerCount,
    unknownLayerCount,

    needsReview,

    warnings: input.warnings,
  };
}
```

Visual metrics such as SSIM, full-scene pixel diff, and final text exactness are not available yet. Step 19 and Step 20 will update them.

# 17.18 Scene resolution runner

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/scene-resolution/run-scene-resolution-pass.ts
```

```ts
import {
  AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,
  AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
} from "../schema/constants";

import type {
  AiAssetRef,
  AiBackgroundCandidateObservation,
  AiGroupCandidateObservation,
  AiObservation,
  AiRasterCandidateObservation,
  AiReconstructionDocument,
  AiTextCandidateObservation,
  AiVectorCandidateObservation,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  AiReconstructionDocumentSchema,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.zod";

import {
  assertReconstructionDocumentInvariants,
} from "../schema/invariants";

import type {
  AiObservationBundle,
} from "../observations/observation-bundle.types";

import {
  bucketForMagicStorageRole,
} from "../storage/storage-buckets";

import {
  reconstructionDocumentPath,
  sceneResolutionPassReportPath,
} from "../storage/storage-paths";

import {
  writeAiAsset,
} from "../storage/write-ai-asset";

import {
  selectFinalLayers,
} from "./select-final-layers";

import {
  createBackgroundLayer,
  createLockedReferenceLayer,
  createRasterLayer,
  createTextLayer,
  createVectorLayer,
} from "./layer-builders";

import {
  buildSceneZOrderLookup,
  zIndexForObservation,
} from "./scene-z-order";

import {
  assignFinalZIndexes,
} from "./assign-final-z-indexes";

import {
  resolveFinalGroups,
} from "./resolve-final-groups";

import {
  computeInitialReconstructionQuality,
} from "./compute-reconstruction-quality";

import type {
  SceneResolutionPass,
  SceneResolutionResult,
} from "./scene-resolution.types";

export async function runSceneResolutionPass(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  jobId: string;
  userId: string;

  sourceObservationBundleAssetId: string;

  observationBundle: AiObservationBundle;

  sourceImage: {
    originalAssetId: string;
    normalizedAssetId: string;
    editorReferenceAssetId: string;
    mimeType: "image/png" | "image/jpeg" | "image/webp";
    sha256?: string;
    perceptualHash?: string;
    originalWidth: number;
    originalHeight: number;
    normalizedWidth: number;
    normalizedHeight: number;
    uploadedAt: number;
  };
}): Promise<SceneResolutionResult> {
  const observations = Object.values(input.observationBundle.observations);

  const backgroundCandidates = observations.filter(
    (obs): obs is AiBackgroundCandidateObservation =>
      obs.kind === "background_candidate"
  );

  const textCandidates = observations.filter(
    (obs): obs is AiTextCandidateObservation =>
      obs.kind === "text_candidate"
  );

  const vectorCandidates = observations.filter(
    (obs): obs is AiVectorCandidateObservation =>
      obs.kind === "vector_candidate"
  );

  const rasterCandidates = observations.filter(
    (obs): obs is AiRasterCandidateObservation =>
      obs.kind === "raster_candidate"
  );

  const groupCandidates = observations.filter(
    (obs): obs is AiGroupCandidateObservation =>
      obs.kind === "group_candidate"
  );

  const selection = selectFinalLayers({
    backgroundCandidates,
    textCandidates,
    vectorCandidates,
    rasterCandidates,
  });

  const zLookup = buildSceneZOrderLookup(observations);

  const layers = [];

  layers.push(
    createLockedReferenceLayer({
      jobId: input.jobId,
      designId: input.designId,
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      editorReferenceAssetId:
        input.sourceImage.editorReferenceAssetId,
      originalImageAssetId: input.sourceImage.originalAssetId,
      canvas: input.observationBundle.canvas,
    })
  );

  if (selection.background) {
    layers.push(
      createBackgroundLayer({
        jobId: input.jobId,
        designId: input.designId,
        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        observation: selection.background,
        zIndex: zIndexForObservation({
          observationId: selection.background.id,
          zOrderLookup: zLookup,
          fallbackIndex: 1,
        }),
      })
    );
  } else {
    /**
     * If no clean background candidate exists, use editor reference as
     * a visible raster fallback background. Original reference remains hidden too.
     */
    layers.push(
      createFallbackBackgroundFromReference({
        jobId: input.jobId,
        designId: input.designId,
        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        editorReferenceAssetId:
          input.sourceImage.editorReferenceAssetId,
        canvas: input.observationBundle.canvas,
      })
    );
  }

  let fallbackIndex = 10;

  for (const text of selection.textEditable) {
    layers.push(
      createTextLayer({
        jobId: input.jobId,
        designId: input.designId,
        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        observation: text,
        zIndex: zIndexForObservation({
          observationId: text.id,
          zOrderLookup: zLookup,
          fallbackIndex: fallbackIndex++,
        }),
      })
    );
  }

  for (const vector of selection.vectorEditable) {
    layers.push(
      createVectorLayer({
        jobId: input.jobId,
        designId: input.designId,
        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        observation: vector,
        zIndex: zIndexForObservation({
          observationId: vector.id,
          zOrderLookup: zLookup,
          fallbackIndex: fallbackIndex++,
        }),
      })
    );
  }

  for (const raster of selection.raster) {
    layers.push(
      createRasterLayer({
        jobId: input.jobId,
        designId: input.designId,
        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        observation: raster,
        zIndex: zIndexForObservation({
          observationId: raster.id,
          zOrderLookup: zLookup,
          fallbackIndex: fallbackIndex++,
        }),
      })
    );
  }

  const finalLayers = assignFinalZIndexes({
    layers: layers.slice(
      0,
      Math.max(2, layers.length)
    ),
    observationOrder: zLookup,
  });

  const groups = resolveFinalGroups({
    groupCandidates,
    layers: finalLayers,
  });

  const warnings = [
    ...selection.warnings,
    ...finalLayers.flatMap((layer) => layer.metadata.warnings ?? []),
  ];

  const quality = computeInitialReconstructionQuality({
    layers: finalLayers,
    groups,
    warnings,
  });

  const reconstructionDocument: AiReconstructionDocument = {
    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,

    jobId: input.jobId,
    designId: input.designId,
    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    userId: input.userId,

    createdAt: Date.now(),
    updatedAt: Date.now(),

    sourceImage: {
      originalAssetId: input.sourceImage.originalAssetId,
      normalizedAssetId: input.sourceImage.normalizedAssetId,
      mimeType: input.sourceImage.mimeType,
      sha256: input.sourceImage.sha256,
      perceptualHash: input.sourceImage.perceptualHash,
      width: input.sourceImage.originalWidth,
      height: input.sourceImage.originalHeight,
      uploadedAt: input.sourceImage.uploadedAt,
    },

    canvas: {
      width: input.observationBundle.canvas.width,
      height: input.observationBundle.canvas.height,
      originalWidth: input.sourceImage.originalWidth,
      originalHeight: input.sourceImage.originalHeight,
      normalizedWidth: input.sourceImage.normalizedWidth,
      normalizedHeight: input.sourceImage.normalizedHeight,
      unit: "px",
    },

    routing: input.observationBundle.routing.diagnosis,

    assets: input.observationBundle.assets,

    observations: input.observationBundle.observations,

    layers: finalLayers,

    groups,

    quality,

    pipeline: {
      pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

      stepsCompleted: [
        "normalizing",
        "routing",
        "observations",
        "decomposition",
        "text_recovery",
        "elementization",
        "vector_recovery",
        "raster_generation",
        "background_reconstruction",
        "z_order_resolution",
        "group_resolution",
        "scene_resolution",
      ],

      modelsUsed: collectModelsUsed(observations),

      warnings,

      artifacts: {
        sourceObservationBundleAssetId:
          input.sourceObservationBundleAssetId,
      },
    },

    audit: {
      originalPreserved: true,

      lockedReferenceLayerId: "layer_locked_reference",

      firstRenderValidated: false,

      textSafetyValidated: false,

      schemaValidated: false,

      generatedAt: Date.now(),
    },
  };

  /**
   * Runtime validation before writing durable reconstruction document.
   * Zod is appropriate here because it validates unknown runtime data
   * against the TypeScript schema contract.
   */
  const parsed =
    AiReconstructionDocumentSchema.parse(reconstructionDocument);

  assertReconstructionDocumentInvariants(parsed);

  parsed.audit.schemaValidated = true;

  const reconstructionDocumentAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "reconstruction-document"
  );

  const reconstructionDocumentAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "assets",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("assets"),
    storagePath: reconstructionDocumentPath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: reconstructionDocumentAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 2), "utf8"),

    assetId: reconstructionDocumentAssetId,
    kind: "reconstruction_document",

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    source: "scene_resolver",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  const passAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "scene-resolution-pass"
  );

  const pass: SceneResolutionPass = {
    schemaVersion: "ai-scene-resolution-pass.v1",

    jobId: input.jobId,
    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    userId: input.userId,

    sourceObservationBundleAssetId:
      input.sourceObservationBundleAssetId,

    reconstructionDocumentAssetId:
      reconstructionDocumentAsset.id,

    status:
      quality.needsReview || warnings.length > 0
        ? "completed_with_warnings"
        : "completed",

    decisionCounts: {
      totalCandidates: selection.decisions.length,
      acceptedLayers: finalLayers.length,
      rejectedCandidates: selection.decisions.filter(
        (decision) => !decision.accepted
      ).length,
      acceptedTextEditable: finalLayers.filter(
        (layer) => layer.editableLevel === "text_editable"
      ).length,
      acceptedVectorEditable: finalLayers.filter(
        (layer) => layer.editableLevel === "vector_editable"
      ).length,
      acceptedRasterMasked: finalLayers.filter(
        (layer) => layer.editableLevel === "raster_masked"
      ).length,
      acceptedRasterFallback: finalLayers.filter(
        (layer) => layer.editableLevel === "raster_fallback"
      ).length,
      acceptedBackground: finalLayers.filter(
        (layer) => layer.type === "clean_background"
      ).length,
      acceptedGroups: groups.length,
      needsReviewLayers: finalLayers.filter(
        (layer) => layer.metadata.needsReview
      ).length,
    },

    decisions: selection.decisions,

    layerIds: finalLayers.map((layer) => layer.id),

    groupIds: groups.map((group) => group.id),

    quality: {
      needsReview: quality.needsReview,
      warnings: quality.warnings,
    },

    warnings,

    createdAt: Date.now(),
  };

  const sceneResolutionPassAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "source",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
    storagePath: sceneResolutionPassReportPath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: passAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(pass, null, 2), "utf8"),

    assetId: passAssetId,
    kind: "scene_resolution_pass_json",

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    source: "scene_resolver",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  parsed.pipeline.artifacts = {
    ...parsed.pipeline.artifacts,
    sceneResolutionPassAssetId: sceneResolutionPassAsset.id,
  };

  return {
    reconstructionDocument: parsed,
    reconstructionDocumentAsset,
    sceneResolutionPass: pass,
    sceneResolutionPassAsset,
    layers: finalLayers,
    groups,
  };
}
```

Zod is the right validation tool here because it validates runtime data, not just compile-time TypeScript assumptions. citeturn664515search1turn664515search3

# 17.19 Fallback background helper

Add this helper near `runSceneResolutionPass`.

```ts
import {
  AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,
  AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
} from "../schema/constants";

import type {
  AiReconstructedLayer,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  capabilitiesForEditableLevel,
} from "../schema/capabilities";

import {
  geometryFromBBox,
  makeFallback,
} from "./layer-builders";

function createFallbackBackgroundFromReference(input: {
  jobId: string;
  designId: string;
  workspaceId: string;
  editorReferenceAssetId: string;
  canvas: {
    width: number;
    height: number;
  };
}): AiReconstructedLayer {
  const bbox = {
    x: 0,
    y: 0,
    width: input.canvas.width,
    height: input.canvas.height,
  };

  const fallback = makeFallback({
    id: "fallback_background_locked_reference",
    strategy: "locked_reference",
    assetId: input.editorReferenceAssetId,
    bbox,
    reason: "No clean background candidate was accepted",
  });

  return {
    id: "layer_original_background_fallback",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,

    jobId: input.jobId,
    designId: input.designId,
    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,

    type: "background",
    editableLevel: "raster_fallback",

    name: "Original background fallback",

    visible: true,
    locked: false,

    zIndex: -900,

    geometry: geometryFromBBox(bbox),

    confidence: {
      overall: 1,
      visualFidelity: 1,
    },

    capabilities: capabilitiesForEditableLevel("raster_fallback"),

    assetIds: [input.editorReferenceAssetId],

    fallbacks: [fallback],

    primaryFallbackId: fallback.id,

    provenance: {
      primarySource: "normalizer",
      contributingSources: ["normalizer", "system"],
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,
    },

    decision: {
      strategy: "use_raster_fallback",
      selectedObservationIds: [],
      reasonCodes: ["clean_background_not_available"],
      decidedBy: "system",
      decidedAt: Date.now(),
    },

    raster: {
      editorAssetId: input.editorReferenceAssetId,
      exportAssetId: input.editorReferenceAssetId,
      alphaMode: "binary_mask",
      edgeQuality: "high",
    },

    metadata: {
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      needsReview: true,
      warnings: ["clean_background_not_available"],
    },
  };
}

function collectModelsUsed(observations: AiObservation[]) {
  const modelMap = new Map<string, any>();

  for (const observation of observations) {
    if (!observation.model) continue;

    const key = [
      observation.model.provider,
      observation.model.modelName,
      observation.model.modelVersion,
      observation.model.promptVersion,
    ].join(":");

    modelMap.set(key, observation.model);
  }

  return [...modelMap.values()];
}

function stableAssetId(jobId: string, label: string) {
  return `asset_${jobId}_${label}`
    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "_")
    .toLowerCase();
}
```

# 17.20 Firestore patch

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/scene-resolution/apply-scene-resolution-result.ts
```

```ts
import {
  FieldValue,
  getFirestore,
} from "firebase-admin/firestore";

import type {
  SceneResolutionResult,
} from "./scene-resolution.types";

export async function applySceneResolutionResult(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  jobId: string;
  result: SceneResolutionResult;
}) {
  const db = getFirestore();

  const designRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}`
  );

  const jobRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/aiLayerJobs/${input.jobId}`
  );

  const batch = db.batch();

  const assetsToIndex = [
    input.result.reconstructionDocumentAsset,
    input.result.sceneResolutionPassAsset,
  ];

  for (const asset of assetsToIndex) {
    batch.set(
      db.doc(
        `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/assets/${asset.id}`
      ),
      {
        id: asset.id,

        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        jobId: input.jobId,

        kind: asset.kind,
        storageRole: asset.storageRole,

        bucket: asset.bucket,
        storagePath: asset.storagePath,

        generation: asset.generation,
        metageneration: asset.metageneration,

        mimeType: asset.mimeType,

        width: asset.width,
        height: asset.height,
        sizeBytes: asset.sizeBytes,

        checksum: asset.checksum,

        source: asset.metadata?.source,

        retained: true,

        createdAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      },
      { merge: true }
    );
  }

  batch.update(jobRef, {
    "output.reconstructionAssetId":
      input.result.reconstructionDocumentAsset.id,

    sceneResolution: {
      sceneResolutionPassAssetId:
        input.result.sceneResolutionPassAsset.id,

      reconstructionDocumentAssetId:
        input.result.reconstructionDocumentAsset.id,

      decisionCounts:
        input.result.sceneResolutionPass.decisionCounts,

      layerIds:
        input.result.sceneResolutionPass.layerIds,

      groupIds:
        input.result.sceneResolutionPass.groupIds,

      quality:
        input.result.sceneResolutionPass.quality,

      warnings:
        input.result.sceneResolutionPass.warnings,

      createdAt:
        input.result.sceneResolutionPass.createdAt,
    },

    "progress.percent": 90,
    "progress.label": "Scene resolved",
    "progress.currentStep": "resolving_scene",

    updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
  });

  batch.update(designRef, {
    "source.currentReconstructionAssetId":
      input.result.reconstructionDocumentAsset.id,

    "quality.editableTextCount":
      input.result.reconstructionDocument.quality.editableTextCount,

    "quality.vectorEditableCount":
      input.result.reconstructionDocument.quality.vectorEditableCount,

    "quality.rasterLayerCount":
      input.result.reconstructionDocument.quality.rasterLayerCount,

    "quality.fallbackLayerCount":
      input.result.reconstructionDocument.quality.fallbackLayerCount,

    "quality.needsReview":
      input.result.reconstructionDocument.quality.needsReview,

    status:
      input.result.reconstructionDocument.quality.needsReview
        ? "needs_review"
        : "processing",

    updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
  });

  await batch.commit();
}
```

The design stays `processing` or `needs_review` until Step 18 generates Fabric and Step 19/20 validate. Do not mark it `ready` here.

# 17.22 Final layer acceptance rules

## Text layer

Create `text_editable` only when:

```txt
text_candidate.editability = candidate_live_text
semanticMutationDetected = false
confidence.overall >= threshold
fallback crop exists
text safety state exists
```

Otherwise:

```txt
use matching raster_candidate(role=text_raster_fallback)
```

Do not promote review text automatically.

---

## Vector layer

Create `vector_editable` only when:

```txt
vector_candidate.validation.passed = true
eligibleForVectorEditable = true
optimizedSvgAssetId exists
fallbackRasterAssetId exists
confidence.overall >= threshold
path complexity acceptable
render validation passed
```

Otherwise:

```txt
use matching raster_candidate(role=shape_raster_fallback)
```

Do not expose weak logo vectors as editable.

---

## Raster layer

Create `raster_masked` when:

```txt
raster_candidate.editability.recommendedStrategy = raster_masked
editorAssetId exists
mask/alpha quality acceptable
confidence above threshold
```

Create `raster_fallback` when:

```txt
candidate is useful but not semantically editable
candidate needs review
candidate is text/vector fallback
candidate is unknown but visually meaningful
```

Reject when:

```txt
duplicate
missing editor asset
too low confidence
superseded by accepted text/vector
```

---

## Background layer

Create `clean_background` when:

```txt
background_candidate exists
cleanBackgroundAssetId exists
validation passed or auto-accept needsReview allowed
fallback reference exists
```

Otherwise:

```txt
use original editor reference as background fallback
```

Always keep hidden locked reference layer.

---

## Group

Create final `AiResolvedGroup` only when:

```txt
group_candidate.validation.passed = true
at least 2 child observations map to accepted final layers
confidence >= threshold
conflicts resolved
nesting depth acceptable
```

Do not create `Fabric.Group` here.

---

# 17.23 Scene document invariants

The final `AiReconstructionDocument` is valid only if:

```txt
exactly one locked_reference layer exists

originalPreserved = true

all accepted layers have:
  id
  type
  editableLevel
  geometry
  confidence
  capabilities
  provenance
  decision
  fallback when uncertain

all text_editable layers have:
  text payload
  text safety state
  semanticMutationDetected = false
  fallback crop

all vector_editable layers have:
  vector payload
  fallback raster

all raster layers have:
  raster payload
  editor asset

all clean backgrounds have:
  background payload
  fallback original/reference

zIndex values are unique

groups reference existing layer IDs only

assets referenced by layers exist in document.assets

schema validates

invariants pass
```

Step 17 creates the canonical document, but it has not yet proven that the reconstruction visually matches the original.

So set:

```ts
quality.needsReview = true if any layer/group warning exists;
```

Step 19 will render and compare.

Step 20 will run the hard text safety validation pass.

Only after those should the job become:

```txt
completed
```

or:

```txt
needs_review
```

# 17.27 Non-negotiable invariants

Step 17 is valid only if:

```txt
No Fabric JSON is created.

No Fabric object is created.
```

## ChatGPT Response 028

<!-- assistant_message_ids: 1f548fc9-ef8e-4334-99b9-971149788520, 1a8ba897-a92d-461b-a9a8-5f49b1931f7f, 15d9e736-a2e0-4ecb-9d6f-6baff2a902ba, e869b6d1-48ed-4b2e-b190-91cdb953046b, 89b8e253-576f-4886-923f-e935f9889437 -->

Step 18 is where the AI pipeline finally reaches your existing Fabric editor; it must stay a deterministic projection layer, not another AI decision layer.

Step 18 is the conversion boundary: the reconstruction document becomes a Fabric-loadable package, while durable asset identity stays separate from runtime signed URLs.

The main new risks are preserving AI metadata through Fabric serialization and hydrating private asset URLs safely, without storing signed URLs as durable manifest state.

# Step 18 — Fabric generator

Step 18 converts the canonical reconstruction document into the **Fabric editor import package**.

The locked rule:

```txt
AiReconstructionDocument is the source of truth.
AiFabricManifest is the editor projection.
Fabric JSON is runtime/editor state only.
```

Step 18 is where the user’s existing Fabric editor finally receives something loadable:

```txt
AiReconstructionDocument
→ AiFabricManifest
→ hydrated manifest.fabricJson
→ canvas.loadFromJSON(...)
```

Fabric’s `loadFromJSON` expects JSON conforming to Fabric’s own `toJSON` shape, returns a `Promise<Canvas>`, and Fabric recommends aborting previous loading tasks before starting another load. Fabric also does not use `loadFromJSON` to resize the canvas, so dimensions must be set from the manifest wrapper first. citeturn157603view1

---

## 18.1 What Step 18 owns

Step 18 owns:

```txt
Fabric manifest generation
Fabric object JSON generation
layerIndex generation
logical group projection
asset URL placeholder insertion
runtime asset URL hydration
AI custom metadata attachment
Fabric manifest validation
Fabric manifest asset storage
Firestore fabricManifest pointer update
```

Step 18 does **not** own:

```txt
visual diff validation
text round-trip safety validation
server export
manual repair tools
autosave/versioning
final job completion
```

Those come later.

---

# 18.2 Important correction: durable manifest vs runtime manifest

Do **not** store signed URLs inside durable Fabric manifests.

Signed URLs expire. A saved design must not depend on them.

So Step 18 produces two forms:

```txt
Durable AiFabricManifest
  stored in GCS
  contains asset refs
  uses magic-asset://{assetId} placeholders in Fabric image src

Runtime hydrated AiFabricManifest
  returned to editor
  replaces magic-asset://{assetId} with signed HTTPS URLs
  can be passed into canvas.loadFromJSON(...)
```

Correct:

```txt
stored manifest:
  src: "magic-asset://asset_raster_001"

runtime manifest:
  src: "https://signed-gcs-url..."
```

Wrong:

```txt
stored manifest:
  src: "https://signed-gcs-url-that-expires"
```

Fabric images need browser-loadable URLs at runtime. Fabric’s image docs say an image can be initialized from a string URL, so the hydrated manifest must contain HTTPS URLs when it reaches the browser. citeturn157603view3

---

# 18.3 CORS constraint

Every runtime Fabric image must use:

```ts
crossOrigin: "anonymous"
```

And the asset response must return CORS headers.

If a cross-origin image is drawn into a canvas without CORS approval, the canvas becomes tainted, and browser APIs like `getImageData()`, `toBlob()`, and `toDataURL()` throw `SecurityError`. citeturn357901view0

Cloud Storage supports bucket-level CORS configuration and returns `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` when the request origin matches the bucket configuration. citeturn349610view2

---

# 18.4 Fabric metadata rule

Every Fabric object generated from AI must carry minimal AI metadata:

```txt
aiLayerId
aiLayerType
aiEditableLevel
aiConfidence
aiSource
aiFallbackAssetId
aiSchemaVersion
```

Do **not** embed the full `AiReconstructedLayer` into a Fabric object.

Fabric docs explicitly show that custom properties need TypeScript declaration and `FabricObject.customProperties` registration to survive serialization. They also warn that Fabric objects should not become your application data store. citeturn504993view0turn504993view1

---

# 18.5 Do not use Fabric `type` for product logic

Fabric’s `type` is for serialization/deserialization. Fabric docs warn not to build application logic around object `type`; use your own AI fields instead. citeturn157603view2

Correct:

```ts
object.aiEditableLevel === "text_editable"
```

Wrong:

```ts
object.type === "textbox"
```

Fabric `type` still exists in `fabricJson` because Fabric needs it to deserialize. Your app logic should use `aiLayerType` and `aiEditableLevel`.

```ts
// src/lib/magic-layers/fabric-generator/fabric-generation.types.ts

import type {
  AiAssetRef,
  AiReconstructionDocument,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import type {
  AiFabricManifest,
} from "../fabric-manifest/fabric-manifest.types";

export const AI_FABRIC_GENERATION_PASS_SCHEMA_VERSION =
  "ai-fabric-generation-pass.v1" as const;

export type FabricGenerationPassStatus =
  | "completed"
  | "completed_with_warnings"
  | "failed";

export type FabricGenerationPass = {
  schemaVersion: typeof AI_FABRIC_GENERATION_PASS_SCHEMA_VERSION;

  jobId: string;
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  userId: string;

  sourceReconstructionDocumentAssetId: string;

  fabricManifestAssetId: string;

  status: FabricGenerationPassStatus;

  objectCounts: {
    total: number;
    image: number;
    textbox: number;
    rect: number;
    circle: number;
    ellipse: number;
    line: number;
    polygon: number;
    path: number;
    skipped: number;
  };

  layerCounts: {
    sourceLayers: number;
    renderedLayers: number;
    logicalGroups: number;
  };

  warnings: string[];

  createdAt: number;
};

export type FabricGenerationResult = {
  reconstructionDocument: AiReconstructionDocument;

  fabricManifest: AiFabricManifest;

  fabricManifestAsset: AiAssetRef;

  fabricGenerationPass: FabricGenerationPass;

  fabricGenerationPassAsset: AiAssetRef;
};
```

# 18.10 Durable asset URI helper

```ts
// src/lib/magic-layers/fabric-generator/fabric-asset-uri.ts

export const MAGIC_FABRIC_ASSET_URI_PREFIX = "magic-asset://";

export function fabricAssetUri(assetId: string): string {
  return `${MAGIC_FABRIC_ASSET_URI_PREFIX}${assetId}`;
}

export function isFabricAssetUri(value: unknown): value is string {
  return (
    typeof value === "string" &&
    value.startsWith(MAGIC_FABRIC_ASSET_URI_PREFIX)
  );
}

export function assetIdFromFabricAssetUri(uri: string): string {
  if (!isFabricAssetUri(uri)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid Fabric asset URI: ${uri}`);
  }

  return uri.slice(MAGIC_FABRIC_ASSET_URI_PREFIX.length);
}
```

Durable manifest:

```json
{
  "src": "magic-asset://asset_layer_001_editor"
}
```

Runtime hydrated manifest:

```json
{
  "src": "https://signed-gcs-url..."
}
```

# 18.11 Patch Fabric custom properties

From Step 2, add one field:

```txt
aiGroupIds
```

This lets your layer panel and selection UI understand logical group membership without creating `fabric.Group`.

```ts
// src/lib/magic-layers/fabric-manifest/register-ai-fabric-properties.ts

import { FabricObject } from "fabric";
import type {
  AiConfidence,
  AiEditableLevel,
  AiLayerType,
  AiSource,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

export const AI_FABRIC_CUSTOM_PROPERTIES = [
  "id",
  "name",

  "aiLayerId",
  "aiLayerType",
  "aiEditableLevel",
  "aiConfidence",
  "aiSource",
  "aiFallbackAssetId",
  "aiSchemaVersion",

  "aiGroupIds",
] as const;

declare module "fabric" {
  interface FabricObject {
    id?: string;
    name?: string;

    aiLayerId?: string;
    aiLayerType?: AiLayerType;
    aiEditableLevel?: AiEditableLevel;
    aiConfidence?: AiConfidence;
    aiSource?: AiSource;
    aiFallbackAssetId?: string;
    aiSchemaVersion?: string;

    aiGroupIds?: string[];
  }

  interface SerializedObjectProps {
    id?: string;
    name?: string;

    aiLayerId?: string;
    aiLayerType?: AiLayerType;
    aiEditableLevel?: AiEditableLevel;
    aiConfidence?: AiConfidence;
    aiSource?: AiSource;
    aiFallbackAssetId?: string;
    aiSchemaVersion?: string;

    aiGroupIds?: string[];
  }
}

export function registerAiFabricCustomProperties() {
  const existing = FabricObject.customProperties ?? [];

  FabricObject.customProperties = Array.from(
    new Set([...existing, ...AI_FABRIC_CUSTOM_PROPERTIES])
  );
}
```

Do not overwrite existing editor custom properties. Always merge.

# 18.12 Fabric object builders

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/fabric-generator/fabric-object-builders.ts
```

```ts
import {
  Circle,
  Ellipse,
  FabricImage,
  Line,
  Path,
  Polygon,
  Rect,
  Textbox,
} from "fabric";

import type {
  AiAssetRef,
  AiReconstructedLayer,
  AiResolvedGroup,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import type {
  FabricObjectJson,
} from "../fabric-manifest/fabric-manifest.types";

import {
  fabricAssetUri,
} from "./fabric-asset-uri";

export type FabricObjectBuildResult = {
  objects: FabricObjectJson[];
  warnings: string[];
};

export function layerToFabricObjects(input: {
  layer: AiReconstructedLayer;
  assets: Record<string, AiAssetRef>;
  groups: AiResolvedGroup[];
}): FabricObjectBuildResult {
  const { layer } = input;

  switch (layer.editableLevel) {
    case "locked_reference":
    case "raster_masked":
    case "raster_clean_background":
    case "raster_fallback":
    case "unknown_confidence":
      return buildImageObject(input);

    case "text_editable":
      return buildTextboxObject(input);

    case "vector_editable":
      return buildVectorObject(input);

    case "group_editable":
      /**
       * Default: do not emit fabric.Group.
       * Groups stay logical until editor group behavior is explicitly supported.
       */
      return {
        objects: [],
        warnings: [`group_layer_skipped_${layer.id}`],
      };

    default:
      return {
        objects: [],
        warnings: [`unsupported_editable_level_${layer.editableLevel}`],
      };
  }
}

function buildBaseProps(input: {
  layer: AiReconstructedLayer;
  groups: AiResolvedGroup[];
}): Partial<FabricObjectJson> {
  const { layer } = input;
  const bbox = layer.geometry.bbox;
  const t = layer.geometry.transform;

  const locked = layer.locked || layer.editableLevel === "locked_reference";

  const canMove = layer.capabilities.includes("move");
  const canResize = layer.capabilities.includes("resize");
  const canRotate = layer.capabilities.includes("rotate");

  const aiGroupIds = input.groups
    .filter((group) => group.childLayerIds.includes(layer.id))
    .map((group) => group.id);

  return {
    id: layer.id,
    name: layer.name,

    left: round(t.left ?? bbox.x),
    top: round(t.top ?? bbox.y),

    width: round(t.width ?? bbox.width),
    height: round(t.height ?? bbox.height),

    scaleX: round(t.scaleX ?? 1),
    scaleY: round(t.scaleY ?? 1),

    angle: round(t.angle ?? 0),
    opacity: clamp01(t.opacity ?? 1),

    originX: t.originX ?? "left",
    originY: t.originY ?? "top",

    visible: layer.visible,

    selectable: !locked && layer.capabilities.includes("select"),
    evented: !locked,

    hasControls: !locked,
    hasBorders: !locked,

    lockMovementX: locked || !canMove,
    lockMovementY: locked || !canMove,
    lockScalingX: locked || !canResize,
    lockScalingY: locked || !canResize,
    lockRotation: locked || !canRotate,

    objectCaching: true,

    excludeFromExport: false,

    aiLayerId: layer.id,
    aiLayerType: layer.type,
    aiEditableLevel: layer.editableLevel,
    aiConfidence: layer.confidence,
    aiSource: layer.provenance.primarySource,
    aiFallbackAssetId: layer.primaryFallbackId,
    aiSchemaVersion: layer.schemaVersion,
    aiGroupIds,
  };
}

function buildImageObject(input: {
  layer: AiReconstructedLayer;
  assets: Record<string, AiAssetRef>;
  groups: AiResolvedGroup[];
}): FabricObjectBuildResult {
  const { layer, assets } = input;

  if (!layer.raster) {
    return {
      objects: [],
      warnings: [`missing_raster_payload_${layer.id}`],
    };
  }

  const editorAsset = assets[layer.raster.editorAssetId];

  if (!editorAsset) {
    return {
      objects: [],
      warnings: [`missing_editor_asset_${layer.raster.editorAssetId}`],
    };
  }

  const bbox = layer.geometry.bbox;

  const sourceWidth = editorAsset.width ?? bbox.width;
  const sourceHeight = editorAsset.height ?? bbox.height;

  const object: FabricObjectJson = {
    ...buildBaseProps(input),

    type: FabricImage.type,

    src: fabricAssetUri(editorAsset.id),

    /**
     * This remains in durable JSON.
     * Runtime hydration replaces src with HTTPS URL.
     */
    crossOrigin: "anonymous",

    left: round(bbox.x),
    top: round(bbox.y),

    width: round(sourceWidth),
    height: round(sourceHeight),

    scaleX: round(bbox.width / Math.max(1, sourceWidth)),
    scaleY: round(bbox.height / Math.max(1, sourceHeight)),

    perPixelTargetFind:
      layer.editableLevel === "raster_masked" ||
      layer.editableLevel === "raster_fallback",

    filters: [],
  };

  return {
    objects: [object],
    warnings: [],
  };
}

function buildTextboxObject(input: {
  layer: AiReconstructedLayer;
  assets: Record<string, AiAssetRef>;
  groups: AiResolvedGroup[];
}): FabricObjectBuildResult {
  const { layer } = input;

  if (!layer.text) {
    return {
      objects: [],
      warnings: [`missing_text_payload_${layer.id}`],
    };
  }

  const bbox = layer.geometry.bbox;
  const fontSize = layer.text.fontSize ?? Math.max(12, bbox.height * 0.72);

  const object: FabricObjectJson = {
    ...buildBaseProps(input),

    type: Textbox.type,

    text: layer.text.value,

    left: round(bbox.x),
    top: round(bbox.y),

    width: round(bbox.width),

    /**
     * Fabric Textbox height is auto-adjusted by text wrapping.
     * Keep height for diagnostics but do not rely on it for final render fit.
     */
    height: round(bbox.height),

    fontFamily:
      layer.text.fontFamily ??
      layer.text.fontFallback ??
      "Inter",

    fontSize,

    fontWeight: layer.text.fontWeight ?? "normal",
    fontStyle: layer.text.fontStyle ?? "normal",

    lineHeight: layer.text.lineHeight ?? 1.1,

    /**
     * Fabric charSpacing is thousandths of font-size.
     * Our schema stores letterSpacingPx.
     */
    charSpacing: pxLetterSpacingToFabricCharSpacing(
      layer.text.letterSpacingPx ?? 0,
      fontSize
    ),

    fill: layer.text.fill ?? "#000000",

    stroke: layer.text.stroke,
    strokeWidth: layer.text.strokeWidth ?? 0,

    textAlign: layer.text.textAlign ?? "left",

    editable: true,

    splitByGrapheme: false,

    perPixelTargetFind: false,
  };

  if (layer.text.shadow) {
    object.shadow = {
      color: layer.text.shadow.color ?? "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)",
      offsetX: layer.text.shadow.offsetX ?? 0,
      offsetY: layer.text.shadow.offsetY ?? 0,
      blur: layer.text.shadow.blur ?? 0,
    };
  }

  return {
    objects: [object],
    warnings: [],
  };
}

function buildVectorObject(input: {
  layer: AiReconstructedLayer;
  assets: Record<string, AiAssetRef>;
  groups: AiResolvedGroup[];
}): FabricObjectBuildResult {
  const { layer } = input;

  if (!layer.vector) {
    return {
      objects: [],
      warnings: [`missing_vector_payload_${layer.id}`],
    };
  }

  const bbox = layer.geometry.bbox;
  const vector = layer.vector;

  const base = buildBaseProps(input);

  const common = {
    ...base,
    fill: vector.fill ?? "transparent",
    stroke: vector.stroke,
    strokeWidth: vector.strokeWidth ?? 0,
  };

  switch (vector.primitive) {
    case "rect":
    case "rounded_rect":
      return {
        objects: [
          {
            ...common,
            type: Rect.type,
            left: round(bbox.x),
            top: round(bbox.y),
            width: round(bbox.width),
            height: round(bbox.height),
            scaleX: 1,
            scaleY: 1,
            rx: vector.radius ?? 0,
            ry: vector.radius ?? 0,
          },
        ],
        warnings: [],
      };

    case "circle": {
      const radius = Math.max(1, Math.min(bbox.width, bbox.height) / 2);

      return {
        objects: [
          {
            ...common,
            type: Circle.type,
            left: round(bbox.x),
            top: round(bbox.y),
            radius: round(radius),
            width: round(radius * 2),
            height: round(radius * 2),
            scaleX: round(bbox.width / (radius * 2)),
            scaleY: round(bbox.height / (radius * 2)),
          },
        ],
        warnings: [],
      };
    }

    case "ellipse":
      return {
        objects: [
          {
            ...common,
            type: Ellipse.type,
            left: round(bbox.x),
            top: round(bbox.y),
            rx: round(bbox.width / 2),
            ry: round(bbox.height / 2),
            scaleX: 1,
            scaleY: 1,
          },
        ],
        warnings: [],
      };

    case "line": {
      const p0 = vector.points?.[0] ?? {
        x: bbox.x,
        y: bbox.y + bbox.height / 2,
      };

      const p1 = vector.points?.[1] ?? {
        x: bbox.x + bbox.width,
        y: bbox.y + bbox.height / 2,
      };

      return {
        objects: [
          {
            ...common,
            type: Line.type,
            x1: round(p0.x),
            y1: round(p0.y),
            x2: round(p1.x),
            y2: round(p1.y),
            fill: undefined,
          },
        ],
        warnings: [],
      };
    }

    case "polygon":
      return {
        objects: [
          {
            ...common,
            type: Polygon.type,
            left: round(bbox.x),
            top: round(bbox.y),
            points:
              vector.points?.map((point) => ({
                x: round(point.x - bbox.x),
                y: round(point.y - bbox.y),
              })) ?? [],
          },
        ],
        warnings: [],
      };

    case "path":
    case "compound_path":
      if (!vector.pathData) {
        /**
         * This should have been rejected in Step 17.
         * Fabric generation must not fabricate an editable vector from SVG-only data.
         */
        return {
          objects: [],
          warnings: [`vector_not_fabric_mappable_${layer.id}`],
        };
      }

      return {
        objects: [
          {
            ...common,
            type: Path.type,
            left: round(bbox.x),
            top: round(bbox.y),
            path: vector.pathData,
          },
        ],
        warnings: [],
      };

    default:
      return {
        objects: [],
        warnings: [`unsupported_vector_primitive_${vector.primitive}`],
      };
  }
}

function pxLetterSpacingToFabricCharSpacing(
  letterSpacingPx: number,
  fontSizePx: number
) {
  if (!fontSizePx) return 0;

  return Math.round((letterSpacingPx / fontSizePx) * 1000);
}

function round(value: number, digits = 4): number {
  const factor = 10 ** digits;
  return Math.round(value * factor) / factor;
}

function clamp01(value: number): number {
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, value));
}
```

Fabric `Textbox` wraps text and auto-adjusts height, so text placement must be treated as approximate until Step 19/20 validation. citeturn157603view4

---

# 18.13 Hard vector invariant

Patch Step 17 policy:

```ts
vector: {
  // existing...
  requireFabricMappableVector: true,
}
```

A final `vector_editable` layer must be Fabric-mappable:

```txt
primitive rect/circle/ellipse/line/polygon
or
path/compound_path with pathData
```

Do **not** accept a vector layer whose only usable asset is SVG unless Step 18 parses that SVG into Fabric objects deterministically.

Day-one rule:

```txt
SVG-only vector candidate
→ use raster fallback
```

Later you can add a server-side SVG-to-Fabric parser path, but do not mix that into v1 without validation. Fabric v6 APIs are Promise-based for SVG loading, including `loadSVGFromString`, so parsing SVG is possible later but should stay behind a tested adapter. citeturn997423view0

# 18.14 Create layer index

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/fabric-generator/create-fabric-layer-index.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiReconstructedLayer,
  AiResolvedGroup,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import type {
  AiFabricLayerIndexEntry,
  FabricObjectJson,
} from "../fabric-manifest/fabric-manifest.types";

export function createFabricLayerIndex(input: {
  layers: AiReconstructedLayer[];
  groups: AiResolvedGroup[];
  objects: FabricObjectJson[];
}): Record<string, AiFabricLayerIndexEntry> {
  const index: Record<string, AiFabricLayerIndexEntry> = {};

  for (const layer of input.layers) {
    const objectIndex = input.objects.findIndex(
      (object) => object.aiLayerId === layer.id
    );

    if (objectIndex < 0) continue;

    const groupIds = input.groups
      .filter((group) => group.childLayerIds.includes(layer.id))
      .map((group) => group.id);

    index[layer.id] = {
      aiLayerId: layer.id,

      objectIndex,

      zIndex: layer.zIndex,

      name: layer.name,

      layerType: layer.type,

      editableLevel: layer.editableLevel,

      fabricObjectType: input.objects[objectIndex].type,

      assetIds: layer.assetIds,

      fallbackAssetIds: layer.fallbacks
        .map((fallback) => fallback.assetId)
        .filter((assetId): assetId is string => Boolean(assetId)),

      primaryFallbackAssetId: layer.primaryFallbackId
        ? layer.fallbacks.find(
            (fallback) => fallback.id === layer.primaryFallbackId
          )?.assetId
        : undefined,

      originalBBox: layer.geometry.originalBBox,

      canvasBBox: layer.geometry.bbox,

      visible: layer.visible,

      locked: layer.locked,

      warnings: layer.metadata.warnings,

      groupIds,
    } as AiFabricLayerIndexEntry & {
      groupIds: string[];
    };
  }

  return index;
}
```

If your Step 2 `AiFabricLayerIndexEntry` does not yet include `groupIds`, patch it:

```ts
groupIds?: string[];
```

# 18.16 Create Fabric manifest

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/fabric-generator/create-ai-fabric-manifest.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiReconstructionDocument,
  AiResolvedGroup,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import type {
  AiFabricManifest,
  AiFabricLogicalGroup,
  FabricObjectJson,
} from "../fabric-manifest/fabric-manifest.types";

import {
  AI_FABRIC_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION,
} from "../fabric-manifest/fabric-manifest.types";

import {
  layerToFabricObjects,
} from "./fabric-object-builders";

import {
  createFabricLayerIndex,
} from "./create-fabric-layer-index";

export function createAiFabricManifest(input: {
  reconstructionDocument: AiReconstructionDocument;

  fabricVersion: string;

  generatedBy: "server" | "client" | "worker";

  manifestGeneratorVersion: string;
}): {
  manifest: AiFabricManifest;
  warnings: string[];
} {
  const doc = input.reconstructionDocument;

  const warnings: string[] = [];

  const sortedLayers = [...doc.layers].sort(
    (a, b) => a.zIndex - b.zIndex
  );

  const objects: FabricObjectJson[] = [];

  for (const layer of sortedLayers) {
    const result = layerToFabricObjects({
      layer,
      assets: doc.assets,
      groups: doc.groups,
    });

    objects.push(...result.objects);
    warnings.push(...result.warnings);
  }

  const layerIndex = createFabricLayerIndex({
    layers: sortedLayers,
    groups: doc.groups,
    objects,
  });

  const logicalGroups = createLogicalGroups({
    groups: doc.groups,
    layerIndex,
  });

  const now = Date.now();

  const manifest: AiFabricManifest = {
    schemaVersion: AI_FABRIC_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION,

    jobId: doc.jobId,
    designId: doc.designId,
    workspaceId: doc.workspaceId,
    userId: doc.userId,

    createdAt: now,
    updatedAt: now,

    source: {
      reconstructionSchemaVersion: doc.schemaVersion,
      reconstructionDocumentAssetId:
        doc.pipeline.artifacts?.sourceObservationBundleAssetId,
      originalImageAssetId: doc.sourceImage.originalAssetId,
      normalizedImageAssetId: doc.sourceImage.normalizedAssetId,
    },

    canvas: {
      width: doc.canvas.width,
      height: doc.canvas.height,

      originalWidth: doc.canvas.originalWidth,
      originalHeight: doc.canvas.originalHeight,

      normalizedWidth: doc.canvas.normalizedWidth,
      normalizedHeight: doc.canvas.normalizedHeight,

      unit: "px",

      backgroundColor: doc.canvas.backgroundColor,
    },

    assets: doc.assets,

    layerIndex,

    logicalGroups,

    hydration: {
      assetSrcMode: "durable_asset_uri",
    },

    fabricJson: {
      version: input.fabricVersion,

      /**
       * Dimensions are for diagnostics.
       * The editor loader still sets canvas dimensions from manifest.canvas.
       */
      width: doc.canvas.width,
      height: doc.canvas.height,

      background: doc.canvas.backgroundColor ?? "transparent",

      objects,
    },

    reconstruction: {
      qualityScore: doc.quality.visualMatchScore,
      visualMatchScore: doc.quality.visualMatchScore,
      needsReview: doc.quality.needsReview || warnings.length > 0,
      warnings: [...doc.quality.warnings, ...warnings],
    },

    runtime: {
      fabricVersion: input.fabricVersion,
      generatedBy: input.generatedBy,
      pipelineVersion: doc.pipeline.pipelineVersion,
      manifestGeneratorVersion: input.manifestGeneratorVersion,
    },
  };

  return {
    manifest,
    warnings,
  };
}

function createLogicalGroups(input: {
  groups: AiResolvedGroup[];
  layerIndex: AiFabricManifest["layerIndex"];
}): AiFabricLogicalGroup[] {
  return input.groups.map((group) => ({
    id: group.id,
    name: group.name,
    role: group.role,

    childLayerIds: group.childLayerIds,

    childObjectIndices: group.childLayerIds
      .map((layerId) => input.layerIndex[layerId]?.objectIndex)
      .filter((index): index is number => typeof index === "number"),

    bbox: group.bbox,

    zIndexRange: group.zIndexRange,

    confidence: group.confidence,

    editorBehavior:
      group.confidence.overall >= 0.78
        ? "select_as_group"
        : "metadata_group_only",
  }));
}
```

Patch Step 2 validator so durable manifests allow `magic-asset://`.

Runtime hydrated manifests should require HTTPS.

```ts
import { z } from "zod";
import {
  MAGIC_FABRIC_ASSET_URI_PREFIX,
} from "./fabric-asset-uri";

export const DurableFabricImageSrcSchema = z.string().refine(
  (value) =>
    value.startsWith(MAGIC_FABRIC_ASSET_URI_PREFIX) ||
    value.startsWith("https://"),
  "Fabric image src must be magic-asset:// or https://"
);

export const RuntimeFabricImageSrcSchema = z.string().url().refine(
  (value) => value.startsWith("https://"),
  "Runtime Fabric image src must be HTTPS"
);
```

Manifest generation should validate durable mode.

Manifest hydration should validate runtime mode.

```ts
import structuredClone from "@ungap/structured-clone";

import type {
  AiAssetRef,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import type {
  AiFabricManifest,
  FabricObjectJson,
} from "../fabric-manifest/fabric-manifest.types";

import {
  assetIdFromFabricAssetUri,
  isFabricAssetUri,
} from "./fabric-asset-uri";

export type ResolveFabricRuntimeAssetUrl = (
  asset: AiAssetRef
) => Promise<{
  url: string;
  urlExpiresAt: number;
}>;

export async function hydrateAiFabricManifestForRuntime(input: {
  manifest: AiFabricManifest;

  resolveAssetUrl: ResolveFabricRuntimeAssetUrl;
}): Promise<AiFabricManifest> {
  const hydrated = structuredClone(input.manifest) as AiFabricManifest;

  let maxExpiry: number | undefined;

  for (const object of hydrated.fabricJson.objects) {
    await hydrateObjectSrc({
      object,
      assets: hydrated.assets,
      resolveAssetUrl: input.resolveAssetUrl,
      setMaxExpiry: (expiresAt) => {
        maxExpiry = Math.min(maxExpiry ?? expiresAt, expiresAt);
      },
    });
  }

  hydrated.hydration = {
    assetSrcMode: "runtime_signed_url",
    hydratedAt: Date.now(),
    urlExpiresAt: maxExpiry,
  };

  hydrated.updatedAt = Date.now();

  return hydrated;
}

async function hydrateObjectSrc(input: {
  object: FabricObjectJson;
  assets: AiFabricManifest["assets"];
  resolveAssetUrl: ResolveFabricRuntimeAssetUrl;
  setMaxExpiry: (expiresAt: number) => void;
}) {
  const src = input.object.src;

  if (!isFabricAssetUri(src)) return;

  const assetId = assetIdFromFabricAssetUri(src);

  const asset = input.assets[assetId];

  if (!asset) {
    throw new Error(`Missing asset for Fabric object src: ${assetId}`);
  }

  const resolved = await input.resolveAssetUrl(asset);

  input.object.src = resolved.url;
  input.object.crossOrigin = "anonymous";

  input.assets[assetId] = {
    ...asset,
    resolvedUrl: resolved.url,
    resolvedUrlExpiresAt: resolved.urlExpiresAt,
  };

  input.setMaxExpiry(resolved.urlExpiresAt);
}
```

This is the only manifest version that the editor may load.

---

# 18.19 Runtime manifest endpoint

Your editor should not read the stored manifest asset directly and try to load it.

Add an API endpoint:

```txt
GET /api/magic-layers/jobs/{jobId}/fabric-manifest
```

Behavior:

```txt
verify auth
verify workspace access
load durable fabricManifestAssetId from Firestore
load manifest JSON from GCS
hydrate signed URLs
return hydrated manifest
```

Example:

```ts
// src/app/api/magic-layers/jobs/[jobId]/fabric-manifest/route.ts

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getFirestore } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
import { getAuth } from "firebase-admin/auth";

import {
  loadAssetJson,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/storage/load-asset-json";

import {
  loadAssetRef,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/storage/load-asset-ref";

import {
  resolveAiAssetSignedUrl,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/storage/resolve-ai-asset-url";

import {
  hydrateAiFabricManifestForRuntime,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/fabric-generator/hydrate-ai-fabric-manifest";

import type {
  AiFabricManifest,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/fabric-manifest/fabric-manifest.types";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

export async function GET(
  req: NextRequest,
  context: {
    params: Promise<{
      jobId: string;
    }>;
  }
) {
  const { jobId } = await context.params;

  const authHeader = req.headers.get("authorization") ?? "";
  const idToken = authHeader.startsWith("Bearer ")
    ? authHeader.slice("Bearer ".length)
    : null;

  if (!idToken) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "missing_auth_token" },
      { status: 401 }
    );
  }

  const decoded = await getAuth().verifyIdToken(idToken);
  const userId = decoded.uid;

  const workspaceId = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("workspaceId");
  const designId = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("designId");

  if (!workspaceId || !designId) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "missing_workspace_or_design" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  const db = getFirestore();

  const workspaceSnap = await db.doc(`workspaces/${workspaceId}`).get();

  if (!workspaceSnap.exists) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "workspace_not_found" },
      { status: 404 }
    );
  }

  const workspace = workspaceSnap.data()!;

  if (
    workspace.ownerUserId !== userId &&
    !workspace.memberUserIds?.includes(userId)
  ) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "forbidden" },
      { status: 403 }
    );
  }

  const jobSnap = await db
    .doc(
      `workspaces/${workspaceId}/designs/${designId}/aiLayerJobs/${jobId}`
    )
    .get();

  if (!jobSnap.exists) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "job_not_found" },
      { status: 404 }
    );
  }

  const job = jobSnap.data()!;

  const manifestAssetId = job.output?.fabricManifestAssetId;

  if (!manifestAssetId) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "fabric_manifest_not_ready" },
      { status: 409 }
    );
  }

  const manifestAsset = await loadAssetRef({
    workspaceId,
    designId,
    assetId: manifestAssetId,
  });

  const durableManifest = await loadAssetJson<AiFabricManifest>(
    manifestAsset
  );

  const hydrated = await hydrateAiFabricManifestForRuntime({
    manifest: durableManifest,
    resolveAssetUrl: async (asset) =>
      resolveAiAssetSignedUrl({
        asset,
        expiresInMs: 6 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
      }),
  });

  return NextResponse.json(hydrated);
}
```

The client uses this endpoint, not the durable GCS JSON directly.

# 18.20 Fabric loader client contract

Your existing editor should load only hydrated manifests.

```ts
import type { Canvas, FabricObject } from "fabric";
import type { AiFabricManifest } from "@/lib/magic-layers/fabric-manifest/fabric-manifest.types";
import { registerAiFabricCustomProperties } from "@/lib/magic-layers/fabric-manifest/register-ai-fabric-properties";

let currentLoadAbortController: AbortController | null = null;

export async function loadHydratedMagicLayersManifest(input: {
  canvas: Canvas;
  manifest: AiFabricManifest;
}) {
  if (input.manifest.hydration.assetSrcMode !== "runtime_signed_url") {
    throw new Error("Cannot load durable manifest. Hydrate asset URLs first.");
  }

  currentLoadAbortController?.abort();

  const controller = new AbortController();
  currentLoadAbortController = controller;

  registerAiFabricCustomProperties();

  input.canvas.clear();

  input.canvas.setDimensions({
    width: input.manifest.canvas.width,
    height: input.manifest.canvas.height,
  });

  await input.canvas.loadFromJSON(
    input.manifest.fabricJson,
    (_serializedObject: unknown, fabricObject: FabricObject) => {
      fabricObject.set({
        dirty: true,
      });
    },
    {
      signal: controller.signal,
    }
  );

  for (const object of input.canvas.getObjects()) {
    object.setCoords();
  }

  input.canvas.requestRenderAll();

  return {
    objectCount: input.canvas.getObjects().length,
    layerIndex: input.manifest.layerIndex,
    logicalGroups: input.manifest.logicalGroups,
  };
}
```

Fabric’s `loadFromJSON` is Promise-based and supports abortable loading options. It is explicitly recommended to abort previous loading tasks before starting another load. citeturn157603view1

# 18.21 Run Fabric generation pass

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/fabric-generator/run-fabric-generation-pass.ts
```

```ts
import {
  version as fabricVersion,
} from "fabric";

import {
  AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,
  AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
} from "../schema/constants";

import type {
  AiReconstructionDocument,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  bucketForMagicStorageRole,
} from "../storage/storage-buckets";

import {
  fabricGenerationPassReportPath,
  fabricManifestPath,
} from "../storage/storage-paths";

import {
  writeAiAsset,
} from "../storage/write-ai-asset";

import {
  createAiFabricManifest,
} from "./create-ai-fabric-manifest";

import type {
  FabricGenerationPass,
  FabricGenerationResult,
} from "./fabric-generation.types";

export async function runFabricGenerationPass(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  jobId: string;
  userId: string;

  sourceReconstructionDocumentAssetId: string;

  reconstructionDocument: AiReconstructionDocument;
}): Promise<FabricGenerationResult> {
  const generated = createAiFabricManifest({
    reconstructionDocument: input.reconstructionDocument,
    fabricVersion,
    generatedBy: "worker",
    manifestGeneratorVersion: "fabric-manifest-generator.v1",
  });

  const fabricManifestAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "fabric-manifest"
  );

  const fabricManifestAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "assets",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("assets"),
    storagePath: fabricManifestPath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: fabricManifestAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(
      JSON.stringify(generated.manifest, null, 2),
      "utf8"
    ),

    assetId: fabricManifestAssetId,
    kind: "fabric_manifest",

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    source: "scene_resolver",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    sourceAssetId: input.sourceReconstructionDocumentAssetId,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  const objectCounts = countFabricObjects(
    generated.manifest.fabricJson.objects
  );

  const passAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "fabric-generation-pass"
  );

  const pass: FabricGenerationPass = {
    schemaVersion: "ai-fabric-generation-pass.v1",

    jobId: input.jobId,
    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    userId: input.userId,

    sourceReconstructionDocumentAssetId:
      input.sourceReconstructionDocumentAssetId,

    fabricManifestAssetId: fabricManifestAsset.id,

    status:
      generated.warnings.length > 0
        ? "completed_with_warnings"
        : "completed",

    objectCounts,

    layerCounts: {
      sourceLayers: input.reconstructionDocument.layers.length,
      renderedLayers: Object.keys(generated.manifest.layerIndex).length,
      logicalGroups: generated.manifest.logicalGroups.length,
    },

    warnings: generated.warnings,

    createdAt: Date.now(),
  };

  const passAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "source",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
    storagePath: fabricGenerationPassReportPath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: passAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(pass, null, 2), "utf8"),

    assetId: passAssetId,
    kind: "fabric_generation_pass_json",

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    source: "system",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    sourceAssetId: fabricManifestAsset.id,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  return {
    reconstructionDocument: input.reconstructionDocument,
    fabricManifest: generated.manifest,
    fabricManifestAsset,
    fabricGenerationPass: pass,
    fabricGenerationPassAsset: passAsset,
  };
}

function countFabricObjects(objects: { type: string }[]) {
  const lowerTypes = objects.map((object) => object.type.toLowerCase());

  return {
    total: objects.length,

    image: lowerTypes.filter((type) => type.includes("image")).length,

    textbox: lowerTypes.filter((type) => type.includes("textbox")).length,

    rect: lowerTypes.filter((type) => type.includes("rect")).length,

    circle: lowerTypes.filter((type) => type.includes("circle")).length,

    ellipse: lowerTypes.filter((type) => type.includes("ellipse")).length,

    line: lowerTypes.filter((type) => type.includes("line")).length,

    polygon: lowerTypes.filter((type) => type.includes("polygon")).length,

    path: lowerTypes.filter((type) => type.includes("path")).length,

    skipped: 0,
  };
}

function stableAssetId(jobId: string, label: string) {
  return `asset_${jobId}_${label}`
    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "_")
    .toLowerCase();
}
```

Fabric v6 moved to named imports like `Canvas` and `Rect`, and its APIs moved toward Promise-based patterns; using direct named imports aligns with Fabric’s current TypeScript-first model. citeturn997423view0

---

# 18.22 Firestore patch

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/fabric-generator/apply-fabric-generation-result.ts
```

```ts
import {
  FieldValue,
  getFirestore,
} from "firebase-admin/firestore";

import type {
  FabricGenerationResult,
} from "./fabric-generation.types";

export async function applyFabricGenerationResult(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  jobId: string;
  result: FabricGenerationResult;
}) {
  const db = getFirestore();

  const designRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}`
  );

  const jobRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/aiLayerJobs/${input.jobId}`
  );

  const batch = db.batch();

  const assetsToIndex = [
    input.result.fabricManifestAsset,
    input.result.fabricGenerationPassAsset,
  ];

  for (const asset of assetsToIndex) {
    batch.set(
      db.doc(
        `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/assets/${asset.id}`
      ),
      {
        id: asset.id,

        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        jobId: input.jobId,

        kind: asset.kind,
        storageRole: asset.storageRole,

        bucket: asset.bucket,
        storagePath: asset.storagePath,

        generation: asset.generation,
        metageneration: asset.metageneration,

        mimeType: asset.mimeType,

        width: asset.width,
        height: asset.height,
        sizeBytes: asset.sizeBytes,

        checksum: asset.checksum,

        source: asset.metadata?.source,

        retained: true,

        createdAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      },
      { merge: true }
    );
  }

  batch.update(jobRef, {
    "output.fabricManifestAssetId":
      input.result.fabricManifestAsset.id,

    fabricGeneration: {
      fabricGenerationPassAssetId:
        input.result.fabricGenerationPassAsset.id,

      fabricManifestAssetId:
        input.result.fabricManifestAsset.id,

      objectCounts:
        input.result.fabricGenerationPass.objectCounts,

      layerCounts:
        input.result.fabricGenerationPass.layerCounts,

      warnings:
        input.result.fabricGenerationPass.warnings,

      createdAt:
        input.result.fabricGenerationPass.createdAt,
    },

    "progress.percent": 94,
    "progress.label": "Editor document prepared",
    "progress.currentStep": "generating_fabric",

    updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
  });

  batch.update(designRef, {
    "source.currentFabricManifestAssetId":
      input.result.fabricManifestAsset.id,

    "source.currentReconstructionAssetId":
      input.result.fabricGenerationPass
        .sourceReconstructionDocumentAssetId,

    status:
      input.result.fabricManifest.reconstruction.needsReview
        ? "needs_review"
        : "processing",

    updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
  });

  await batch.commit();
}
```

Do not mark the job completed here. Step 19 and Step 20 still need to validate visual match and text safety.

# 18.23 Worker integration

Patch the worker `generating_fabric` step.

```ts
await runStep(context, "generating_fabric", async () => {
  const job = await loadMagicLayersJob(context);

  const reconstructionAssetId =
    job.output.reconstructionAssetId;

  if (!reconstructionAssetId) {
    throw new Error("missing_reconstruction_asset_id");
  }

  const reconstructionDocument =
    await loadReconstructionDocumentFromAsset({
      workspaceId: context.workspaceId,
      designId: context.designId,
      assetId: reconstructionAssetId,
    });

  const result = await runFabricGenerationPass({
    workspaceId: context.workspaceId,
    designId: context.designId,
    jobId: context.jobId,
    userId: job.userId,

    sourceReconstructionDocumentAssetId:
      reconstructionAssetId,

    reconstructionDocument,
  });

  await applyFabricGenerationResult({
    workspaceId: context.workspaceId,
    designId: context.designId,
    jobId: context.jobId,
    result,
  });
});
```

```txt
GET /api/magic-layers/jobs/{jobId}/fabric-manifest
```

That returns the hydrated runtime manifest.

# 18.24 Object mapping rules

## `locked_reference`

Maps to:

```txt
fabric.Image
visible=false
selectable=false
evented=false
```

Used for:

```txt
compare mode
restore
debugging
manual repair
```

## `clean_background`

Maps to:

```txt
fabric.Image
visible=true
selectable=true or optionally locked by default
```

User can:

```txt
replace
regenerate
restore original
```

## `raster_masked`

Maps to:

```txt
fabric.Image
src = editorAssetId
perPixelTargetFind = true
```

User can:

```txt
move
resize
rotate
crop
edit mask
replace asset
```

## `raster_fallback`

Maps to:

```txt
fabric.Image
```

User can:

```txt
move
hide
delete
restore original
```

No semantic editing claim.

## `text_editable`

Maps to:

```txt
fabric.Textbox
```

User can:

```txt
edit text
font
size
line height
color
alignment
```

But the object keeps fallback metadata.

## `vector_editable`

Maps to:

```txt
fabric.Rect
fabric.Circle
fabric.Ellipse
fabric.Line
fabric.Polygon
fabric.Path
```

Only if Fabric-mappable. Otherwise Step 17 should have selected raster fallback.

## `group_editable`

Default maps to:

```txt
no Fabric.Group
logicalGroups metadata only
```

# 18.25 Manifest invariants

A durable Fabric manifest is valid only if:

```txt
manifest.schemaVersion is correct

manifest.fabricJson.objects is non-empty

fabricJson.objects are sorted by final layer zIndex

every AI object has aiLayerId

every aiLayerId exists in layerIndex

every image object src is magic-asset://assetId

every magic-asset assetId exists in manifest.assets

every image object has crossOrigin = "anonymous"

locked_reference object exists

logicalGroups reference valid layer IDs

full AiReconstructionDocument is not embedded in Fabric objects

custom AI metadata is attached minimally

stored manifest contains no signed URLs
```

A runtime hydrated manifest is valid only if:

```txt
hydration.assetSrcMode = runtime_signed_url

every image object src is HTTPS

every image object has crossOrigin = "anonymous"

all signed URLs have urlExpiresAt

canvas dimensions are set from manifest.canvas before loadFromJSON
```

---

# 18.26 What Step 18 must not do

Do not add:

```txt
visual diff score
full-scene render validation
text round-trip OCR
server export
autosave versions
manual repair tools
PSD export
SVG export
PDF export
```

Do not:

```txt
store signed URLs permanently
embed base64 images
embed full reconstruction layers in Fabric objects
create Fabric.Group by default
accept SVG-only vectors as editable Fabric objects
load durable manifest directly into canvas
mark job completed
```

---

# 18.27 Non-negotiable invariants

Step 18 is valid only if:

```txt
AiReconstructionDocument remains source of truth.

AiFabricManifest is generated from AiReconstructionDocument.

Stored manifest uses magic-asset:// placeholders.

Runtime hydrated manifest uses signed HTTPS URLs.

Fabric image objects use crossOrigin="anonymous".

Every Fabric object has AI metadata.

Every Fabric object maps back to a layerIndex entry.

Groups remain logical metadata by default.

Fabric object order follows final layer zIndex.

No signed URL is durable state.

No full AI layer data is embedded in Fabric objects.

No Fabric JSON is generated before schema-valid reconstruction exists.

No job is marked completed before validation.
```

---

# 18.28 Definition of done

Step 18 is complete when:

```txt
Fabric object builders exist.

Raster layers map to Fabric Image JSON.

Text layers map to Fabric Textbox JSON.

Vector layers map to Fabric primitive/path JSON.

Unsupported vector mappings are rejected or downgraded before this step.

Logical groups are projected into manifest metadata.

Layer index is generated.

Durable AiFabricManifest is stored in GCS.

Runtime hydration replaces magic-asset:// with signed HTTPS URLs.

Editor loader refuses non-hydrated manifests.

Firestore points to fabricManifestAssetId.

No visual validation has run yet.

No export has run yet.

Job is not marked completed yet.
```

Locked Step 18 architecture:

```txt
AiReconstructionDocument
→ Fabric object projection
→ durable AiFabricManifest with magic-asset:// src
→ fabric generation pass report
→ Firestore fabricManifestAssetId
→ runtime hydration endpoint
→ canvas.loadFromJSON(hydratedManifest.fabricJson)
```

Next is Step 19: **Visual recomposition validator**.

# Step 18 — Fabric generator

Step 18 converts the canonical reconstruction document into an **editor-loadable Fabric projection**.

The locked rule:

```txt
AiReconstructionDocument is the truth.
Fabric manifest is the editor projection.
Fabric JSON is runtime state.
```

This step creates Fabric-compatible JSON, but it still does **not** validate the visual match. Visual recomposition validation is Step 19. Text safety hard validation is Step 20.

Fabric’s `loadFromJSON` expects Fabric-compatible JSON, returns a `Promise<Canvas>`, and Fabric explicitly recommends aborting previous loading tasks before calling it again. So the output of this step must be clean Fabric JSON inside a wrapper manifest, not an arbitrary app document passed directly into Fabric. citeturn633494view2

---

## 18.1 Critical correction: durable manifest vs runtime manifest

Do **not** persist signed URLs inside the durable Fabric manifest.

Signed URLs expire. If you store them inside Fabric JSON, the saved design becomes stale.

So Step 18 must produce two forms:

```txt
1. Durable Fabric manifest template
   Stored in GCS.
   Contains asset IDs and placeholder URLs.
   Does not contain signed URLs.

2. Runtime hydrated Fabric manifest
   Returned by API/editor loader.
   Contains temporary HTTPS URLs.
   Passed into canvas.loadFromJSON(manifest.fabricJson).
```

Correct:

```txt
AiReconstructionDocument
→ AiFabricManifestTemplate stored in GCS
→ runtime hydration resolves asset URLs
→ AiFabricRuntimeManifest returned to editor
→ canvas.loadFromJSON(runtimeManifest.fabricJson)
```

Wrong:

```txt
AiReconstructionDocument
→ Fabric JSON with signed URLs
→ store forever
```

This is the key long-term asset-durability rule.

---

# 18.2 What Step 18 owns

Step 18 owns:

```txt
Fabric manifest template generation
Fabric object JSON generation
AI metadata projection onto Fabric objects
asset placeholder mapping
runtime URL hydration
Fabric custom property registration contract
Fabric layer index generation
Fabric generation pass report
Firestore Fabric manifest pointer update
```

Step 18 does **not** own:

```txt
visual diff validation
text round-trip safety validation
server export
autosave/versioning
manual repair tools
collaboration
PSD/SVG/PDF export
```

---

# 18.3 Fabric-specific facts that matter

Fabric custom properties must be explicitly declared and included in serialization; Fabric’s docs show `FabricObject.customProperties = ['name', 'id']` as the mechanism. The same docs warn that Fabric objects should not become your application data store, which is why only lightweight AI identity metadata goes into Fabric objects. citeturn633494view0turn633494view1

Fabric image objects can be initialized from a URL string, so hydrated runtime manifests must put browser-loadable HTTPS URLs in image object `src`. citeturn633494view3

Fabric can parse SVG strings into Fabric objects through `loadSVGFromString`, but this should be used conservatively. For simple primitives, generate `Rect`, `Circle`, `Line`, `Polygon`, or `Path` directly instead of importing arbitrary SVG trees. citeturn633494view4

Browser export depends on CORS. MDN states that drawing cross-origin image data without CORS approval taints the canvas, blocking `getImageData`, `toBlob`, `toDataURL`, and `captureStream`. So every runtime image URL must be CORS-safe and every Fabric image object should use `crossOrigin: "anonymous"`. citeturn411771search0

Fabric text `charSpacing` is expressed in thousandths of an em, so your schema’s `letterSpacingPx` must be converted before writing Fabric JSON. citeturn720325view0

```txt
job.output.reconstructionAssetId
AiReconstructionDocument
asset refs from reconstruction.assets
```

# 18.6 Patch asset kinds

```ts
import { FabricObject } from "fabric";

import type {
  AiConfidence,
  AiEditableLevel,
  AiLayerSource,
  AiLayerType,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

export const AI_FABRIC_CUSTOM_PROPERTIES = [
  "id",
  "name",

  "aiLayerId",
  "aiLayerType",
  "aiEditableLevel",
  "aiConfidence",
  "aiSource",
  "aiFallbackAssetId",
  "aiSourceAssetId",
  "aiSchemaVersion",
] as const;

declare module "fabric" {
  interface FabricObject {
    id?: string;
    name?: string;

    aiLayerId?: string;
    aiLayerType?: AiLayerType;
    aiEditableLevel?: AiEditableLevel;
    aiConfidence?: AiConfidence;
    aiSource?: AiLayerSource;
    aiFallbackAssetId?: string;
    aiSourceAssetId?: string;
    aiSchemaVersion?: string;
  }

  interface SerializedObjectProps {
    id?: string;
    name?: string;

    aiLayerId?: string;
    aiLayerType?: AiLayerType;
    aiEditableLevel?: AiEditableLevel;
    aiConfidence?: AiConfidence;
    aiSource?: AiLayerSource;
    aiFallbackAssetId?: string;
    aiSourceAssetId?: string;
    aiSchemaVersion?: string;
  }
}

export function registerAiFabricCustomProperties() {
  const existing = FabricObject.customProperties ?? [];

  FabricObject.customProperties = Array.from(
    new Set([...existing, ...AI_FABRIC_CUSTOM_PROPERTIES])
  );
}
```


```ts
export function fabricAssetUri(assetId: string) {
  return `magic-asset://${assetId}`;
}

export function isFabricAssetUri(value: unknown): value is string {
  return (
    typeof value === "string" &&
    value.startsWith("magic-asset://")
  );
}

export function assetIdFromFabricAssetUri(value: string) {
  return value.replace("magic-asset://", "");
}
```

Durable template JSON uses:

```txt
src: magic-asset://assetId
```

Runtime hydrated JSON uses:

```txt
src: https://signed-url...
```

Never call `canvas.loadFromJSON()` on a template containing `magic-asset://`.

# 18.13 Base Fabric props

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/fabric-generator/to-fabric-object-base.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiReconstructedLayer,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import type {
  FabricObjectJson,
} from "./fabric-generator.types";

function round(value: number, digits = 4) {
  const factor = 10 ** digits;
  return Math.round(value * factor) / factor;
}

function clamp01(value: number) {
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, value));
}

export function baseFabricObjectProps(
  layer: AiReconstructedLayer
): FabricObjectJson {
  const bbox = layer.geometry.bbox;
  const t = layer.geometry.transform;

  const locked =
    layer.locked ||
    layer.editableLevel === "locked_reference";

  const canMove = layer.capabilities.includes("move");
  const canResize = layer.capabilities.includes("resize");
  const canRotate = layer.capabilities.includes("rotate");

  return {
    id: layer.id,
    name: layer.name,

    left: round(t.left ?? bbox.x),
    top: round(t.top ?? bbox.y),

    width: round(t.width ?? bbox.width),
    height: round(t.height ?? bbox.height),

    scaleX: round(t.scaleX ?? 1),
    scaleY: round(t.scaleY ?? 1),

    angle: round(t.angle ?? 0),
    opacity: clamp01(t.opacity ?? 1),

    originX: t.originX ?? "left",
    originY: t.originY ?? "top",

    visible: layer.visible,

    selectable:
      !locked &&
      layer.capabilities.includes("select"),

    evented: !locked,

    hasControls: !locked,
    hasBorders: !locked,

    lockMovementX: locked || !canMove,
    lockMovementY: locked || !canMove,

    lockScalingX: locked || !canResize,
    lockScalingY: locked || !canResize,

    lockRotation: locked || !canRotate,

    objectCaching: true,

    excludeFromExport: false,

    aiLayerId: layer.id,
    aiLayerType: layer.type,
    aiEditableLevel: layer.editableLevel,
    aiConfidence: layer.confidence,
    aiSource: layer.provenance.primarySource,
    aiFallbackAssetId: layer.primaryFallbackId,
    aiSchemaVersion: layer.schemaVersion,
  };
}
```
