# 18.14 Raster/image layer conversion

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/fabric-generator/raster-layer-to-fabric.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiAssetRef,
  AiReconstructedLayer,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  fabricAssetUri,
} from "./fabric-asset-uri";

import {
  FABRIC_JSON_TYPES,
} from "./fabric-json-types";

import {
  baseFabricObjectProps,
} from "./to-fabric-object-base";

import type {
  FabricObjectJson,
} from "./fabric-generator.types";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_FABRIC_GENERATOR_POLICY,
} from "./fabric-generator-policy";

export function rasterLayerToFabricObject(input: {
  layer: AiReconstructedLayer;
  assets: Record<string, AiAssetRef>;
}): FabricObjectJson {
  const { layer, assets } = input;

  if (!layer.raster) {
    throw new Error(`Layer ${layer.id} is missing raster payload`);
  }

  const assetId = layer.raster.editorAssetId;
  const asset = assets[assetId];

  if (!asset) {
    throw new Error(`Layer ${layer.id} references missing raster asset ${assetId}`);
  }

  const bbox = layer.geometry.bbox;

  const sourceWidth = asset.width ?? bbox.width;
  const sourceHeight = asset.height ?? bbox.height;

  const base = baseFabricObjectProps(layer);

  return {
    ...base,

    type: FABRIC_JSON_TYPES.image,

    src: fabricAssetUri(assetId),

    aiSourceAssetId: assetId,

    crossOrigin:
      MAGIC_LAYERS_FABRIC_GENERATOR_POLICY.image.crossOrigin,

    left: bbox.x,
    top: bbox.y,

    width: sourceWidth,
    height: sourceHeight,

    scaleX: bbox.width / Math.max(1, sourceWidth),
    scaleY: bbox.height / Math.max(1, sourceHeight),

    objectCaching:
      MAGIC_LAYERS_FABRIC_GENERATOR_POLICY.image.objectCaching,

    perPixelTargetFind:
      layer.editableLevel === "raster_masked"
        ? MAGIC_LAYERS_FABRIC_GENERATOR_POLICY.image
            .perPixelTargetFindForRasterMasked
        : false,

    filters: [],
  };
}
```

This is the core asset sizing rule:

```txt
Fabric width/height = source asset natural size.
Fabric scaleX/scaleY = canvas bbox size / source asset size.
```

That preserves performance flexibility between editor-resolution and export-resolution assets.

# 18.15 Text layer conversion

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/fabric-generator/text-layer-to-fabric.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiReconstructedLayer,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  FABRIC_JSON_TYPES,
} from "./fabric-json-types";

import {
  baseFabricObjectProps,
} from "./to-fabric-object-base";

import type {
  FabricObjectJson,
} from "./fabric-generator.types";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_FABRIC_GENERATOR_POLICY,
} from "./fabric-generator-policy";

export function textLayerToFabricObject(
  layer: AiReconstructedLayer
): FabricObjectJson {
  if (!layer.text) {
    throw new Error(`Layer ${layer.id} is missing text payload`);
  }

  const bbox = layer.geometry.bbox;
  const text = layer.text;

  const fontSize = clamp(
    text.fontSize,
    MAGIC_LAYERS_FABRIC_GENERATOR_POLICY.text.minFontSize,
    MAGIC_LAYERS_FABRIC_GENERATOR_POLICY.text.maxFontSize
  );

  return {
    ...baseFabricObjectProps(layer),

    type: FABRIC_JSON_TYPES.textbox,

    text: text.value,

    left: bbox.x,
    top: bbox.y,

    width: bbox.width,

    /**
     * Let Fabric compute text height.
     * Keep bbox height in metadata via ai fields, not as hard Fabric height.
     */
    height: undefined,

    fontFamily:
      text.fontFamily ??
      text.fontFallback ??
      MAGIC_LAYERS_FABRIC_GENERATOR_POLICY.text.defaultFontFamily,

    fontSize,

    fontWeight: text.fontWeight ?? "normal",

    fontStyle: text.fontStyle ?? "normal",

    lineHeight: text.lineHeight ?? 1.1,

    charSpacing: letterSpacingPxToFabricCharSpacing({
      letterSpacingPx: text.letterSpacingPx ?? 0,
      fontSize,
    }),

    fill: text.fill ?? "#000000",

    stroke: text.stroke,

    strokeWidth: text.strokeWidth ?? 0,

    textAlign: text.textAlign ?? "left",

    editable: true,

    splitByGrapheme: false,

    objectCaching: true,
  };
}

function letterSpacingPxToFabricCharSpacing(input: {
  letterSpacingPx: number;
  fontSize: number;
}) {
  if (!MAGIC_LAYERS_FABRIC_GENERATOR_POLICY.text.convertLetterSpacingPxToCharSpacing) {
    return input.letterSpacingPx;
  }

  return Math.round((input.letterSpacingPx / Math.max(1, input.fontSize)) * 1000);
}

function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number) {
  return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
}
```

Do not force Fabric Textbox height. Fabric Textbox wraps and adjusts height automatically, so the first visual validation in Step 19 must check whether this text projection still matches.

# 18.16 Vector layer conversion

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/fabric-generator/vector-layer-to-fabric.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiReconstructedLayer,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  FABRIC_JSON_TYPES,
} from "./fabric-json-types";

import {
  baseFabricObjectProps,
} from "./to-fabric-object-base";

import type {
  FabricObjectJson,
} from "./fabric-generator.types";

export function vectorLayerToFabricObject(
  layer: AiReconstructedLayer
): FabricObjectJson {
  if (!layer.vector) {
    throw new Error(`Layer ${layer.id} is missing vector payload`);
  }

  const bbox = layer.geometry.bbox;
  const vector = layer.vector;
  const base = baseFabricObjectProps(layer);

  const common = {
    fill: vector.fill ?? "transparent",
    stroke: vector.stroke,
    strokeWidth: vector.strokeWidth ?? 0,
    opacity: vector.opacity ?? base.opacity ?? 1,
  };

  switch (vector.primitive) {
    case "rect":
    case "rounded_rect":
      return {
        ...base,
        ...common,
        type: FABRIC_JSON_TYPES.rect,
        left: bbox.x,
        top: bbox.y,
        width: bbox.width,
        height: bbox.height,
        scaleX: 1,
        scaleY: 1,
        rx: vector.radius ?? 0,
        ry: vector.radius ?? 0,
      };

    case "circle": {
      const radius = Math.max(1, Math.min(bbox.width, bbox.height) / 2);

      return {
        ...base,
        ...common,
        type: FABRIC_JSON_TYPES.circle,
        left: bbox.x,
        top: bbox.y,
        radius,
        width: radius * 2,
        height: radius * 2,
        scaleX: bbox.width / Math.max(1, radius * 2),
        scaleY: bbox.height / Math.max(1, radius * 2),
      };
    }

    case "ellipse":
      return {
        ...base,
        ...common,
        type: FABRIC_JSON_TYPES.ellipse,
        left: bbox.x,
        top: bbox.y,
        rx: bbox.width / 2,
        ry: bbox.height / 2,
        width: bbox.width,
        height: bbox.height,
        scaleX: 1,
        scaleY: 1,
      };

    case "line": {
      const p0 = vector.points?.[0] ?? { x: bbox.x, y: bbox.y + bbox.height / 2 };
      const p1 = vector.points?.[1] ?? { x: bbox.x + bbox.width, y: bbox.y + bbox.height / 2 };

      return {
        ...base,
        ...common,
        type: FABRIC_JSON_TYPES.line,
        x1: p0.x,
        y1: p0.y,
        x2: p1.x,
        y2: p1.y,
        fill: undefined,
      };
    }

    case "polygon":
      return {
        ...base,
        ...common,
        type: FABRIC_JSON_TYPES.polygon,
        left: bbox.x,
        top: bbox.y,
        points:
          vector.points?.map((point) => ({
            x: point.x - bbox.x,
            y: point.y - bbox.y,
          })) ?? [],
      };

    case "path":
    case "compound_path":
      if (!vector.pathData) {
        /**
         * If pathData is missing but sourceVectorAssetId exists,
         * Step 18 should still avoid importing arbitrary SVG here.
         * Scene resolver should have kept raster fallback instead.
         */
        throw new Error(`Vector layer ${layer.id} is missing pathData`);
      }

      return {
        ...base,
        ...common,
        type: FABRIC_JSON_TYPES.path,
        left: bbox.x,
        top: bbox.y,
        path: vector.pathData,
      };

    default:
      throw new Error(`Unsupported vector primitive: ${vector.primitive}`);
  }
}
```

For day one, do not auto-import compound SVG into a group of Fabric objects. Keep weak compound SVG as raster fallback unless the vector candidate already has safe path data.

# 18.17 Layer-to-Fabric dispatcher

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/fabric-generator/layer-to-fabric-object.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiAssetRef,
  AiReconstructedLayer,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import type {
  FabricObjectJson,
} from "./fabric-generator.types";

import {
  rasterLayerToFabricObject,
} from "./raster-layer-to-fabric";

import {
  textLayerToFabricObject,
} from "./text-layer-to-fabric";

import {
  vectorLayerToFabricObject,
} from "./vector-layer-to-fabric";

export function layerToFabricObject(input: {
  layer: AiReconstructedLayer;
  assets: Record<string, AiAssetRef>;
}): FabricObjectJson | null {
  const { layer } = input;

  switch (layer.editableLevel) {
    case "locked_reference":
    case "raster_masked":
    case "raster_clean_background":
    case "raster_fallback":
    case "unknown_confidence":
      return rasterLayerToFabricObject(input);

    case "text_editable":
      return textLayerToFabricObject(layer);

    case "vector_editable":
      return vectorLayerToFabricObject(layer);

    case "group_editable":
      /**
       * Groups remain metadata-first.
       * Do not create Fabric.Group by default.
       */
      return null;

    default:
      throw new Error(`Unsupported editableLevel: ${layer.editableLevel}`);
  }
}
```

# 18.18 Generate Fabric manifest template

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/fabric-generator/create-fabric-manifest-template.ts
```

```ts
import { version as fabricVersion } from "fabric";

import type {
  AiReconstructionDocument,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  AI_FABRIC_GENERATOR_VERSION,
  AI_FABRIC_MANIFEST_TEMPLATE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  type AiFabricLayerIndexEntry,
  type AiFabricManifestTemplate,
  type FabricObjectJson,
} from "./fabric-generator.types";

import {
  layerToFabricObject,
} from "./layer-to-fabric-object";

export function createFabricManifestTemplate(input: {
  reconstructionDocument: AiReconstructionDocument;
  reconstructionDocumentAssetId: string;
}): AiFabricManifestTemplate {
  const doc = input.reconstructionDocument;

  const sortedLayers = [...doc.layers].sort(
    (a, b) => a.zIndex - b.zIndex
  );

  const objects: FabricObjectJson[] = [];
  const layerIndex: Record<string, AiFabricLayerIndexEntry> = {};

  const groupsByLayerId = buildGroupIdsByLayerId(doc);

  for (const layer of sortedLayers) {
    const object = layerToFabricObject({
      layer,
      assets: doc.assets,
    });

    if (!object) continue;

    const objectIndex = objects.length;

    objects.push(object);

    layerIndex[layer.id] = {
      aiLayerId: layer.id,

      objectIndex,

      zIndex: layer.zIndex,

      name: layer.name,

      layerType: layer.type,
      editableLevel: layer.editableLevel,

      fabricObjectType: object.type,

      assetIds: layer.assetIds,

      fallbackAssetIds: layer.fallbacks
        .map((fallback) => fallback.assetId)
        .filter((id): id is string => Boolean(id)),

      primaryFallbackAssetId: layer.primaryFallbackId
        ? layer.fallbacks.find((fallback) => fallback.id === layer.primaryFallbackId)?.assetId
        : undefined,

      canvasBBox: layer.geometry.bbox,

      visible: layer.visible,
      locked: layer.locked,

      groupIds: groupsByLayerId.get(layer.id) ?? [],

      warnings: layer.metadata.warnings,
    };
  }

  return {
    schemaVersion: AI_FABRIC_MANIFEST_TEMPLATE_SCHEMA_VERSION,

    mode: "durable_template",

    jobId: doc.jobId,
    workspaceId: doc.workspaceId,
    designId: doc.designId,
    userId: doc.userId,

    createdAt: Date.now(),
    updatedAt: Date.now(),

    source: {
      reconstructionSchemaVersion: doc.schemaVersion,
      reconstructionDocumentAssetId: input.reconstructionDocumentAssetId,
      originalImageAssetId: doc.sourceImage.originalAssetId,
      normalizedImageAssetId: doc.sourceImage.normalizedAssetId,
    },

    canvas: {
      width: doc.canvas.width,
      height: doc.canvas.height,

      originalWidth: doc.canvas.originalWidth,
      originalHeight: doc.canvas.originalHeight,

      normalizedWidth: doc.canvas.normalizedWidth,
      normalizedHeight: doc.canvas.normalizedHeight,

      unit: "px",

      backgroundColor: doc.canvas.backgroundColor,
    },

    assets: doc.assets,

    layerIndex,

    fabricJsonTemplate: {
      version: fabricVersion,

      width: doc.canvas.width,
      height: doc.canvas.height,

      background: doc.canvas.backgroundColor ?? "transparent",

      objects,
    },

    reconstruction: {
      qualityScore: doc.quality.visualMatchScore,
      visualMatchScore: doc.quality.visualMatchScore,
      needsReview: doc.quality.needsReview,
      warnings: doc.quality.warnings,
    },

    runtime: {
      fabricVersion,
      generatedBy: "worker",
      pipelineVersion: doc.pipeline.pipelineVersion,
      manifestGeneratorVersion: AI_FABRIC_GENERATOR_VERSION,
    },
  };
}

function buildGroupIdsByLayerId(doc: AiReconstructionDocument) {
  const map = new Map<string, string[]>();

  for (const group of doc.groups) {
    for (const layerId of group.childLayerIds) {
      const current = map.get(layerId) ?? [];
      current.push(group.id);
      map.set(layerId, current);
    }
  }

  return map;
}
```

# 18.19 Hydrate runtime Fabric manifest

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/fabric-generator/hydrate-fabric-runtime-manifest.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiAssetRef,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  assetIdFromFabricAssetUri,
  isFabricAssetUri,
} from "./fabric-asset-uri";

import {
  AI_FABRIC_RUNTIME_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  type AiFabricManifestTemplate,
  type AiFabricRuntimeManifest,
  type FabricObjectJson,
} from "./fabric-generator.types";

export type ResolveFabricAssetUrl = (
  asset: AiAssetRef
) => Promise<{
  url: string;
  urlExpiresAt: number;
}>;

export async function hydrateFabricRuntimeManifest(input: {
  template: AiFabricManifestTemplate;
  resolveAssetUrl: ResolveFabricAssetUrl;
}): Promise<AiFabricRuntimeManifest> {
  const assets = { ...input.template.assets };

  const fabricJson = structuredClone(
    input.template.fabricJsonTemplate
  );

  const imageObjects = fabricJson.objects.filter(
    (object) => typeof object.src === "string"
  );

  for (const object of imageObjects) {
    await hydrateObjectSrc({
      object,
      assets,
      resolveAssetUrl: input.resolveAssetUrl,
    });
  }

  return {
    ...input.template,

    schemaVersion: AI_FABRIC_RUNTIME_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION,

    mode: "runtime_hydrated",

    assets,

    fabricJson,
  };
}

async function hydrateObjectSrc(input: {
  object: FabricObjectJson;
  assets: AiFabricRuntimeManifest["assets"];
  resolveAssetUrl: ResolveFabricAssetUrl;
}) {
  if (!isFabricAssetUri(input.object.src)) {
    return;
  }

  const assetId = assetIdFromFabricAssetUri(input.object.src);

  const asset = input.assets[assetId];

  if (!asset) {
    throw new Error(`Fabric object references missing asset ${assetId}`);
  }

  const resolved = await input.resolveAssetUrl(asset);

  input.assets[assetId] = {
    ...asset,
    resolvedUrl: resolved.url,
    resolvedUrlExpiresAt: resolved.urlExpiresAt,
  };

  input.object.src = resolved.url;
  input.object.crossOrigin = "anonymous";
  input.object.aiSourceAssetId = assetId;
}
```

Runtime hydration should happen in a backend API before the editor imports the manifest.

# 18.20 Runtime loader in the editor

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/fabric-generator/load-fabric-runtime-manifest.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  Canvas,
  FabricObject,
} from "fabric";

import type {
  AiFabricRuntimeManifest,
} from "./fabric-generator.types";

import {
  registerAiFabricCustomProperties,
} from "./register-ai-fabric-properties";

export async function loadFabricRuntimeManifest(input: {
  canvas: Canvas;
  manifest: AiFabricRuntimeManifest;
  abortSignal?: AbortSignal;
}) {
  registerAiFabricCustomProperties();

  const { canvas, manifest } = input;

  canvas.clear();

  /**
   * Fabric loadFromJSON does not own editor canvas dimensions.
   * Set them from the manifest wrapper first.
   */
  canvas.setDimensions({
    width: manifest.canvas.width,
    height: manifest.canvas.height,
  });

  await canvas.loadFromJSON(
    manifest.fabricJson,
    (_serialized: unknown, object: FabricObject) => {
      object.set({
        dirty: true,
      });
    },
    input.abortSignal ? { signal: input.abortSignal } : undefined
  );

  for (const object of canvas.getObjects()) {
    object.setCoords();
  }

  canvas.requestRenderAll();

  return {
    objectCount: canvas.getObjects().length,
    layerIndex: manifest.layerIndex,
  };
}
```

The editor must never call this with a durable template. It must call it only with a runtime hydrated manifest.

# 18.22 Validation

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/fabric-generator/fabric-manifest-template.zod.ts
```

```ts
import { z } from "zod";

import {
  AI_FABRIC_MANIFEST_TEMPLATE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  AI_FABRIC_RUNTIME_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION,
} from "./fabric-generator.types";

const FabricObjectJsonSchema = z
  .object({
    type: z.string().min(1),

    id: z.string().optional(),
    name: z.string().optional(),

    left: z.number().optional(),
    top: z.number().optional(),

    width: z.number().nonnegative().optional(),
    height: z.number().nonnegative().optional(),

    scaleX: z.number().optional(),
    scaleY: z.number().optional(),

    src: z.string().optional(),

    crossOrigin: z
      .enum(["anonymous", "use-credentials"])
      .nullable()
      .optional(),

    aiLayerId: z.string().optional(),
    aiLayerType: z.string().optional(),
    aiEditableLevel: z.string().optional(),
    aiSourceAssetId: z.string().optional(),
  })
  .passthrough();

const FabricJsonSchema = z
  .object({
    version: z.string().min(1),
    width: z.number().positive().optional(),
    height: z.number().positive().optional(),
    objects: z.array(FabricObjectJsonSchema),
  })
  .passthrough();

const LayerIndexEntrySchema = z.object({
  aiLayerId: z.string(),
  objectIndex: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  zIndex: z.number().int(),
  name: z.string(),
  layerType: z.string(),
  editableLevel: z.string(),
  fabricObjectType: z.string(),
  assetIds: z.array(z.string()),
  fallbackAssetIds: z.array(z.string()),
  canvasBBox: z.object({
    x: z.number(),
    y: z.number(),
    width: z.number().nonnegative(),
    height: z.number().nonnegative(),
  }),
  visible: z.boolean(),
  locked: z.boolean(),
  groupIds: z.array(z.string()),
});

const AssetSchema = z
  .object({
    id: z.string(),
    kind: z.string(),
    bucket: z.string(),
    storagePath: z.string(),
    mimeType: z.string().optional(),
  })
  .passthrough();

export const AiFabricManifestTemplateSchema = z
  .object({
    schemaVersion: z.literal(
      AI_FABRIC_MANIFEST_TEMPLATE_SCHEMA_VERSION
    ),

    mode: z.literal("durable_template"),

    jobId: z.string(),
    workspaceId: z.string(),
    designId: z.string(),
    userId: z.string(),

    source: z.object({
      reconstructionSchemaVersion: z.string(),
      reconstructionDocumentAssetId: z.string(),
      originalImageAssetId: z.string(),
      normalizedImageAssetId: z.string().optional(),
    }),

    canvas: z.object({
      width: z.number().positive(),
      height: z.number().positive(),
      originalWidth: z.number().positive(),
      originalHeight: z.number().positive(),
      normalizedWidth: z.number().positive(),
      normalizedHeight: z.number().positive(),
      unit: z.literal("px"),
      backgroundColor: z.string().optional(),
    }),

    assets: z.record(z.string(), AssetSchema),

    layerIndex: z.record(z.string(), LayerIndexEntrySchema),

    fabricJsonTemplate: FabricJsonSchema,

    reconstruction: z.object({
      qualityScore: z.number().min(0).max(1).optional(),
      visualMatchScore: z.number().min(0).max(1).optional(),
      needsReview: z.boolean(),
      warnings: z.array(z.string()),
    }),

    runtime: z.object({
      fabricVersion: z.string(),
      generatedBy: z.literal("worker"),
      pipelineVersion: z.string(),
      manifestGeneratorVersion: z.string(),
    }),
  })
  .superRefine((manifest, ctx) => {
    if (manifest.fabricJsonTemplate.objects.length === 0) {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
        path: ["fabricJsonTemplate", "objects"],
        message: "Fabric manifest template must contain objects",
      });
    }

    for (const [layerId, entry] of Object.entries(manifest.layerIndex)) {
      const object = manifest.fabricJsonTemplate.objects[entry.objectIndex];

      if (!object) {
        ctx.addIssue({
          code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
          path: ["layerIndex", layerId],
          message: "Layer index points to missing Fabric object",
        });

        continue;
      }

      if (object.aiLayerId !== layerId) {
        ctx.addIssue({
          code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
          path: ["layerIndex", layerId],
          message: "Layer index aiLayerId does not match Fabric object",
        });
      }
    }

    for (const object of manifest.fabricJsonTemplate.objects) {
      if (!object.aiLayerId) {
        ctx.addIssue({
          code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
          path: ["fabricJsonTemplate", "objects"],
          message: "Every generated Fabric object must have aiLayerId",
        });
      }

      if (object.src && !object.src.startsWith("magic-asset://")) {
        ctx.addIssue({
          code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
          path: ["fabricJsonTemplate", "objects"],
          message: "Durable template image src must use magic-asset://",
        });
      }
    }
  });

export const AiFabricRuntimeManifestSchema = z
  .object({
    schemaVersion: z.literal(
      AI_FABRIC_RUNTIME_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION
    ),

    mode: z.literal("runtime_hydrated"),

    fabricJson: FabricJsonSchema,
  })
  .passthrough()
  .superRefine((manifest, ctx) => {
    for (const [index, object] of manifest.fabricJson.objects.entries()) {
      if (object.src) {
        if (!/^https:\/\//.test(object.src)) {
          ctx.addIssue({
            code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
            path: ["fabricJson", "objects", index, "src"],
            message: "Runtime Fabric image src must be HTTPS",
          });
        }

        if (object.crossOrigin !== "anonymous") {
          ctx.addIssue({
            code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
            path: ["fabricJson", "objects", index, "crossOrigin"],
            message: "Runtime Fabric image must use crossOrigin anonymous",
          });
        }
      }
    }
  });
```

# 18.23 Fabric generation pass runner

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/fabric-generator/run-fabric-generation-pass.ts
```

```ts
import {
  AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,
  AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
} from "../schema/constants";

import type {
  AiReconstructionDocument,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  bucketForMagicStorageRole,
} from "../storage/storage-buckets";

import {
  fabricGenerationPassReportPath,
  fabricManifestTemplatePath,
} from "../storage/storage-paths";

import {
  writeAiAsset,
} from "../storage/write-ai-asset";

import {
  createFabricManifestTemplate,
} from "./create-fabric-manifest-template";

import {
  AiFabricManifestTemplateSchema,
} from "./fabric-manifest-template.zod";

import type {
  FabricGenerationPass,
} from "./fabric-generator.types";

export type FabricGenerationResult = {
  fabricManifestTemplate: ReturnType<typeof createFabricManifestTemplate>;

  fabricManifestTemplateAsset: any;

  fabricGenerationPass: FabricGenerationPass;

  fabricGenerationPassAsset: any;
};

export async function runFabricGenerationPass(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  jobId: string;
  userId: string;

  reconstructionDocument: AiReconstructionDocument;

  reconstructionDocumentAssetId: string;
}): Promise<FabricGenerationResult> {
  const template = createFabricManifestTemplate({
    reconstructionDocument: input.reconstructionDocument,
    reconstructionDocumentAssetId: input.reconstructionDocumentAssetId,
  });

  const parsed = AiFabricManifestTemplateSchema.parse(template);

  const manifestAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "fabric-manifest-template"
  );

  const manifestAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "assets",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("assets"),
    storagePath: fabricManifestTemplatePath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: manifestAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(
      JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 2),
      "utf8"
    ),

    assetId: manifestAssetId,
    kind: "fabric_manifest_template_json" as any,

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    source: "system",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    sourceAssetId: input.reconstructionDocumentAssetId,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  const objectCounts = countFabricObjects(
    parsed.fabricJsonTemplate.objects
  );

  const layerCounts = countLayers(
    input.reconstructionDocument
  );

  const passAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "fabric-generation-pass"
  );

  const pass: FabricGenerationPass = {
    schemaVersion: "ai-fabric-generation-pass.v1",

    jobId: input.jobId,
    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    userId: input.userId,

    reconstructionDocumentAssetId:
      input.reconstructionDocumentAssetId,

    fabricManifestTemplateAssetId:
      manifestAsset.id,

    objectCounts,

    layerCounts,

    warnings: [
      ...input.reconstructionDocument.quality.warnings,
      ...template.reconstruction.warnings,
    ],

    createdAt: Date.now(),
  };

  const passAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "source",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
    storagePath: fabricGenerationPassReportPath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: passAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(pass, null, 2), "utf8"),

    assetId: passAssetId,
    kind: "fabric_generation_pass_json" as any,

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    source: "system",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    sourceAssetId: manifestAsset.id,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  return {
    fabricManifestTemplate: parsed,
    fabricManifestTemplateAsset: manifestAsset,
    fabricGenerationPass: pass,
    fabricGenerationPassAsset: passAsset,
  };
}

function countFabricObjects(objects: { type: string }[]) {
  return {
    total: objects.length,
    images: objects.filter((object) =>
      object.type.toLowerCase().includes("image")
    ).length,
    textboxes: objects.filter((object) =>
      object.type.toLowerCase().includes("textbox")
    ).length,
    vectors: objects.filter((object) =>
      ["rect", "circle", "ellipse", "line", "polygon", "path"].some(
        (type) => object.type.toLowerCase().includes(type)
      )
    ).length,
    groupsProjected: 0,
  };
}

function countLayers(doc: AiReconstructionDocument) {
  return {
    total: doc.layers.length,
    lockedReference: doc.layers.filter(
      (layer) => layer.type === "locked_reference"
    ).length,
    background: doc.layers.filter(
      (layer) =>
        layer.type === "background" ||
        layer.type === "clean_background"
    ).length,
    textEditable: doc.layers.filter(
      (layer) => layer.editableLevel === "text_editable"
    ).length,
    vectorEditable: doc.layers.filter(
      (layer) => layer.editableLevel === "vector_editable"
    ).length,
    raster: doc.layers.filter((layer) =>
      [
        "raster_masked",
        "raster_clean_background",
        "raster_fallback",
      ].includes(layer.editableLevel)
    ).length,
  };
}

function stableAssetId(jobId: string, label: string) {
  return `asset_${jobId}_${label}`
    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "_")
    .toLowerCase();
}
```

```ts
import {
  FieldValue,
  getFirestore,
} from "firebase-admin/firestore";

import type {
  FabricGenerationResult,
} from "./run-fabric-generation-pass";

export async function applyFabricGenerationResult(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  jobId: string;
  result: FabricGenerationResult;
}) {
  const db = getFirestore();

  const designRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}`
  );

  const jobRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/aiLayerJobs/${input.jobId}`
  );

  const batch = db.batch();

  const assetsToIndex = [
    input.result.fabricManifestTemplateAsset,
    input.result.fabricGenerationPassAsset,
  ];

  for (const asset of assetsToIndex) {
    batch.set(
      db.doc(
        `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/assets/${asset.id}`
      ),
      {
        id: asset.id,

        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        jobId: input.jobId,

        kind: asset.kind,
        storageRole: asset.storageRole,

        bucket: asset.bucket,
        storagePath: asset.storagePath,

        generation: asset.generation,
        metageneration: asset.metageneration,

        mimeType: asset.mimeType,

        width: asset.width,
        height: asset.height,
        sizeBytes: asset.sizeBytes,

        checksum: asset.checksum,

        source: asset.metadata?.source,

        retained: true,

        createdAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      },
      { merge: true }
    );
  }

  batch.update(jobRef, {
    "output.fabricManifestAssetId":
      input.result.fabricManifestTemplateAsset.id,

    fabricGeneration: {
      fabricManifestTemplateAssetId:
        input.result.fabricManifestTemplateAsset.id,

      fabricGenerationPassAssetId:
        input.result.fabricGenerationPassAsset.id,

      objectCounts:
        input.result.fabricGenerationPass.objectCounts,

      layerCounts:
        input.result.fabricGenerationPass.layerCounts,

      warnings:
        input.result.fabricGenerationPass.warnings,

      createdAt:
        input.result.fabricGenerationPass.createdAt,
    },

    "progress.percent": 94,
    "progress.label": "Editor manifest generated",
    "progress.currentStep": "generating_fabric",

    updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
  });

  batch.update(designRef, {
    "source.currentFabricManifestAssetId":
      input.result.fabricManifestTemplateAsset.id,

    status: "processing",

    updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
  });

  await batch.commit();
}
```

# 18.25 Runtime manifest API

The editor should request a hydrated manifest from your backend.

Endpoint:

```txt
GET /api/magic-layers/jobs/{jobId}/fabric-runtime-manifest
```

Behavior:

```txt
load job
verify user/workspace access
load fabric manifest template asset
resolve every image asset URL
return runtime hydrated manifest
do not store hydrated manifest
```

Example:

```ts
// src/app/api/magic-layers/jobs/[jobId]/fabric-runtime-manifest/route.ts

import {
  NextRequest,
  NextResponse,
} from "next/server";

import {
  getFirestore,
} from "firebase-admin/firestore";

import {
  loadAssetRef,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/storage/load-asset-ref";

import {
  downloadJsonAsset,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/storage/download-json-asset";

import {
  resolveAiAssetSignedUrl,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/storage/resolve-ai-asset-url";

import {
  hydrateFabricRuntimeManifest,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/fabric-generator/hydrate-fabric-runtime-manifest";

import {
  AiFabricRuntimeManifestSchema,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/fabric-generator/fabric-manifest-template.zod";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

export async function GET(
  req: NextRequest,
  context: {
    params: Promise<{ jobId: string }>;
  }
) {
  const { jobId } = await context.params;

  const user = await verifyFirebaseUserAndAppCheck(req);

  const {
    workspaceId,
    designId,
  } = getWorkspaceDesignFromQuery(req);

  await assertWorkspaceAccess({
    userId: user.uid,
    workspaceId,
  });

  const db = getFirestore();

  const jobSnap = await db
    .doc(
      `workspaces/${workspaceId}/designs/${designId}/aiLayerJobs/${jobId}`
    )
    .get();

  if (!jobSnap.exists) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "job_not_found" },
      { status: 404 }
    );
  }

  const job = jobSnap.data()!;

  const manifestAssetId = job.output?.fabricManifestAssetId;

  if (!manifestAssetId) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "fabric_manifest_not_ready" },
      { status: 409 }
    );
  }

  const manifestAsset = await loadAssetRef({
    workspaceId,
    designId,
    assetId: manifestAssetId,
  });

  const template = await downloadJsonAsset(manifestAsset);

  const runtimeManifest = await hydrateFabricRuntimeManifest({
    template,
    resolveAssetUrl: async (asset) => {
      const resolved = await resolveAiAssetSignedUrl({
        asset,
        expiresInMs: 6 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
      });

      return {
        url: resolved.url,
        urlExpiresAt: resolved.urlExpiresAt,
      };
    },
  });

  const parsed =
    AiFabricRuntimeManifestSchema.parse(runtimeManifest);

  return NextResponse.json(parsed);
}
```

The helper functions here are your existing auth/access/storage helpers. The important part is the boundary:

```txt
template persisted
runtime hydrated response not persisted
```

```ts
await runStep(context, "generating_fabric", async () => {
  const job = await loadMagicLayersJob(context);

  const reconstructionAssetId =
    job.output.reconstructionAssetId;

  const reconstructionDocument =
    await loadReconstructionDocumentFromAsset({
      workspaceId: context.workspaceId,
      designId: context.designId,
      assetId: reconstructionAssetId,
    });

  const result = await runFabricGenerationPass({
    workspaceId: context.workspaceId,
    designId: context.designId,
    jobId: context.jobId,
    userId: job.userId,

    reconstructionDocument,

    reconstructionDocumentAssetId:
      reconstructionAssetId,
  });

  await applyFabricGenerationResult({
    workspaceId: context.workspaceId,
    designId: context.designId,
    jobId: context.jobId,
    result,
  });
});
```

After Step 18, the editor can request:

```txt
fabric-runtime-manifest
```

and load:

```ts
canvas.loadFromJSON(runtimeManifest.fabricJson)
```

---

# 18.27 Layer panel data source

The layer panel should use:

```txt
runtimeManifest.layerIndex
+
runtimeManifest.fabricJson.objects
+
AiReconstructionDocument groups later if needed
```

Not just Fabric object array.

Each row should show:

```txt
name
layerType
editableLevel
confidence
fallback indicator
visibility
lock
groupIds
warnings
```

Do not infer AI state from Fabric `type`.

---

# 18.28 Fabric object ordering

The Fabric object array must be bottom-to-top.

This is already handled by:

```ts
const sortedLayers = [...doc.layers].sort((a, b) => a.zIndex - b.zIndex);
```

Later user edits can reorder Fabric objects. That edited order belongs to editor state/versioning, not the original reconstruction truth.

---

# 18.29 Group projection

Default Step 18 behavior:

```txt
Do not generate Fabric.Group.
Put groupIds in layerIndex.
Let the layer panel display logical nesting.
```

This protects editability.

Only generate `fabric.Group` later when the editor supports:

```txt
child editing
ungroup
undo/redo
selection handles
serialization
z-order inside group
```

---

# 18.30 Fabric generator acceptance gates

A Fabric manifest template is valid only if:

```txt
every rendered layer becomes a Fabric object or is intentionally metadata-only

every Fabric object has aiLayerId

every aiLayerId exists in layerIndex

every layerIndex.objectIndex points to correct Fabric object

every image object has aiSourceAssetId

durable template image src uses magic-asset://assetId

runtime manifest image src uses HTTPS URL

runtime image objects use crossOrigin anonymous

locked_reference object exists

object order follows zIndex ascending

no signed URL is persisted

no base64 asset is embedded

custom properties are registered in editor

schema validation passes
```

---

# 18.31 What Step 18 must not do

Do not:

```txt
validate visual match
run OCR
run text safety
render preview
export PNG/PDF/SVG/PSD
autosave current editor state
modify AiReconstructionDocument
store signed URLs durably
create Fabric.Group by default
```

Do not pass the durable template into Fabric:

```ts
canvas.loadFromJSON(template.fabricJsonTemplate) // wrong
```

Only pass the hydrated runtime manifest:

```ts
canvas.loadFromJSON(runtimeManifest.fabricJson) // correct
```

# 18.33 Non-negotiable invariants

Step 18 is valid only if:

```txt
AiReconstructionDocument remains canonical truth.

Fabric manifest is projection only.

Durable Fabric manifest template contains no signed URLs.

Runtime hydrated manifest contains signed HTTPS URLs.

Runtime hydrated manifest is not persisted.

Every Fabric object has AI identity metadata.

Every custom Fabric property is registered before load/save.

Every image object has aiSourceAssetId.

Every runtime image object has crossOrigin anonymous.

Every runtime image src is HTTPS.

Every durable image src is magic-asset://assetId.

Layer index maps AI layer IDs to Fabric object indices.

Groups are metadata-only by default.

Object order follows final zIndex.

No base64 is embedded.

No Fabric JSON is passed to validation steps as truth.

Design is not marked ready yet.
```

# 18.34 Definition of done

Step 18 is complete when:

```txt
AiReconstructionDocument is converted into AiFabricManifestTemplate.

AiFabricManifestTemplate is stored in GCS.

Fabric generation pass report is stored in GCS.

Firestore points to fabricManifestAssetId.

Runtime hydration API resolves image URLs.

Runtime hydrated manifest validates.

Editor can call canvas.loadFromJSON(runtimeManifest.fabricJson).

AI custom properties survive Fabric serialization.

No signed URLs are stored durably.

No visual validation has been claimed yet.
```

Locked Step 18 architecture:

```txt
AiReconstructionDocument
→ Fabric manifest template with magic-asset:// placeholders
→ stored durable manifest asset
→ runtime hydration resolves signed URLs
→ runtimeManifest.fabricJson
→ canvas.loadFromJSON(...)
```

## ChatGPT Response 029

<!-- assistant_message_ids: 2f5f1d1f-b446-440f-bba4-37ea118d1068, 90b6b784-489d-42bb-a4e5-894c3d3fd350, 7c2f5063-3374-401b-bca7-7441b33f934a -->

Step 19 is where the pipeline stops trusting the generated scene and measures the actual Fabric projection against the original pixels, not an intermediate reconstruction render.

Validation can update quality and audit metadata, but it must not rewrite layers or generate new Fabric objects.

# Step 19 — Visual recomposition validator

Step 19 is the **first hard trust gate**.

The locked rule:

```txt
The generated Fabric scene must be rendered and compared against the normalized original image before the job can be considered successful.
```

This step does **not** create new layers.  
It does **not** change Fabric JSON.  
It does **not** repair the scene.  
It measures whether the reconstruction actually matches the source image.

Fabric rendering is now the thing being tested. Fabric’s `loadFromJSON` is async, expects Fabric-compatible JSON, and does not own canvas sizing, so the validator must load the hydrated runtime manifest exactly like the editor does: set dimensions first, then `loadFromJSON`. citeturn812328search1

---

# 19.1 What Step 19 owns

Step 19 owns:

```txt
runtime Fabric manifest hydration
headless Fabric render
normalized-original vs reconstructed-render comparison
RGB L1 score
pixel diff ratio
SSIM score
edge difference score
visual match score
diff heatmap generation
render preview asset generation
visual validation pass report
reconstruction quality update
Firestore visual validation summary
hard pass / needs_review / fail decision
```

Step 19 does **not** own:

```txt
text semantic safety
OCR round-trip validation
scene repair
candidate reselection
Fabric autosave
export rendering
manual repair tools
```

Text-specific safety remains Step 20.

---

# 19.2 Renderer decision

Use **headless browser rendering**, not Node-canvas, as the primary visual validator.

Reason:

```txt
Your editor is browser Fabric.
User-visible output is browser Fabric.
Text layout, font fallback, image loading, and anti-aliasing must be tested in the same class of environment.
```

Node/Fabric rendering can work, and Fabric has server-side Node guidance, but for first-render validation the more reliable test is: load the same hydrated Fabric manifest into a headless browser and screenshot the canvas. Playwright’s official screenshot API supports capturing screenshots from a page or element, which fits this validator. citeturn891172search0

Use this model:

```txt
worker
→ load durable Fabric manifest template
→ hydrate image URLs
→ render in headless Chromium
→ screenshot canvas
→ compare screenshot to normalized source
```

Do **not** use:

```txt
canvas.toDataURL() inside browser
```

as the validator output. If any image CORS breaks, `toDataURL()` can fail due to canvas tainting. Use Playwright element screenshot for the validator, while still keeping `crossOrigin="anonymous"` for normal editor/export safety. citeturn891172search0turn812328search9

---

# 19.3 Comparison target

Compare against:

```txt
normalized_image
```

not the original raw upload.

Reason:

```txt
Step 6 defines normalized_px === canvas_px.
All reconstructed geometry is based on normalized canvas dimensions.
Fabric renders against normalized canvas size.
```

So the validator compares:

```txt
normalized original PNG
vs
headless Fabric render PNG
```

Both must be:

```txt
same width
same height
same color space
same alpha/background handling
```

Sharp supports output to raw pixel buffers, which is what we need for deterministic pixel comparison. citeturn891172search6

---

# 19.4 Metrics

Use four metrics.

```txt
rgbL1
  average absolute RGB error

pixelDiffRatio
  perceptual pixel mismatch ratio using pixelmatch

ssim
  structural similarity

edgeDiffRatio
  shape/edge mismatch
```

Pixelmatch is useful because it was built for screenshot comparison and includes anti-aliasing-aware perceptual color difference logic. citeturn891172search1

SSIM is useful because it is a full-reference image similarity metric designed to compare a processed image against a reference image using structural similarity, not only absolute pixel error. citeturn812328search14

Final score:

```txt
visualMatchScore =
  0.40 * ssim
+ 0.25 * (1 - rgbL1)
+ 0.25 * (1 - pixelDiffRatio)
+ 0.10 * (1 - edgeDiffRatio)
```

---

# 19.5 Validation levels

Use three levels.

```txt
pass
  First render visually matches original well enough.
  Continue to Step 20.

needs_review
  Render is usable but visually imperfect.
  Continue to Step 20, but design cannot auto-ready.

fail
  Render does not approximate original.
  Stop automatic success path.
```

Policy:

```ts
export const MAGIC_LAYERS_VISUAL_VALIDATION_POLICY = {
  render: {
    deviceScaleFactor: 1,
    timeoutMs: 60_000,
    waitForFonts: true,
    waitForNetworkIdle: true,
  },

  diff: {
    pixelmatchThreshold: 0.12,
    includeAntiAliasedPixels: false,
  },

  thresholds: {
    pass: {
      minVisualMatchScore: 0.92,
      minSsim: 0.94,
      maxRgbL1: 0.055,
      maxPixelDiffRatio: 0.08,
      maxEdgeDiffRatio: 0.12,
    },

    needsReview: {
      minVisualMatchScore: 0.80,
      minSsim: 0.86,
      maxRgbL1: 0.12,
      maxPixelDiffRatio: 0.18,
      maxEdgeDiffRatio: 0.25,
    },
  },

  failReasons: {
    catastrophicVisualMismatchScoreBelow: 0.8,
  },
} as const;
```

The thresholds should be measured and tuned on your own poster dataset, but start conservative.

# 19.12 Headless browser renderer

```txt

```

```ts
import {
  chromium,
} from "playwright";

import type {
  AiFabricRuntimeManifest,
} from "../fabric-generator/fabric-generator.types";

import type {
  FabricRenderer,
  FabricRenderResult,
} from "./fabric-renderer.types";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_VISUAL_VALIDATION_POLICY,
} from "./visual-validation-policy";

export const playwrightFabricRenderer: FabricRenderer = {
  name: "playwright_chromium_fabric_renderer",

  async render(
    manifest: AiFabricRuntimeManifest
  ): Promise<FabricRenderResult> {
    const rendererUrl = process.env.MAGIC_LAYERS_RENDERER_URL;

    if (!rendererUrl) {
      throw new Error("Missing MAGIC_LAYERS_RENDERER_URL");
    }

    const browser = await chromium.launch({
      args: ["--no-sandbox"],
    });

    try {
      const page = await browser.newPage({
        viewport: {
          width: manifest.canvas.width,
          height: manifest.canvas.height,
        },
        deviceScaleFactor:
          MAGIC_LAYERS_VISUAL_VALIDATION_POLICY.render.deviceScaleFactor,
      });

      await page.goto(rendererUrl, {
        waitUntil: MAGIC_LAYERS_VISUAL_VALIDATION_POLICY.render.waitForNetworkIdle
          ? "networkidle"
          : "domcontentloaded",
        timeout:
          MAGIC_LAYERS_VISUAL_VALIDATION_POLICY.render.timeoutMs,
      });

      await page.evaluate(async (runtimeManifest) => {
        const win = window as any;

        if (!win.renderMagicLayersRuntimeManifest) {
          throw new Error(
            "Renderer page missing renderMagicLayersRuntimeManifest"
          );
        }

        await win.renderMagicLayersRuntimeManifest(runtimeManifest);
      }, manifest);

      if (MAGIC_LAYERS_VISUAL_VALIDATION_POLICY.render.waitForFonts) {
        await page.evaluate(async () => {
          if ("fonts" in document) {
            await (document as any).fonts.ready;
          }
        });
      }

      const canvas = page.locator(
        "[data-magic-layers-render-canvas='true']"
      );

      const pngBuffer = await canvas.screenshot({
        type: "png",
        timeout:
          MAGIC_LAYERS_VISUAL_VALIDATION_POLICY.render.timeoutMs,
      });

      return {
        pngBuffer,
        width: manifest.canvas.width,
        height: manifest.canvas.height,
        rendererName: this.name,
      };
    } finally {
      await browser.close();
    }
  },
};
```

`MAGIC_LAYERS_RENDERER_URL` should point to an internal render shell that loads Fabric in the browser.

# 19.13 Browser render shell

Create a protected internal page:

```txt
src/app/internal/magic-layers/render-shell/page.tsx
```

```tsx
"use client";

import {
  useEffect,
  useRef,
} from "react";

import {
  Canvas,
  FabricObject,
} from "fabric";

import {
  registerAiFabricCustomProperties,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/fabric-generator/register-ai-fabric-properties";

import type {
  AiFabricRuntimeManifest,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/fabric-generator/fabric-generator.types";

declare global {
  interface Window {
    renderMagicLayersRuntimeManifest?: (
      manifest: AiFabricRuntimeManifest
    ) => Promise<void>;
  }
}

export default function MagicLayersRenderShell() {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);
  const fabricCanvasRef = useRef<Canvas | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    registerAiFabricCustomProperties();

    window.renderMagicLayersRuntimeManifest = async (
      manifest: AiFabricRuntimeManifest
    ) => {
      if (!canvasRef.current) {
        throw new Error("Render canvas missing");
      }

      fabricCanvasRef.current?.dispose();

      const canvas = new Canvas(canvasRef.current, {
        preserveObjectStacking: true,
        renderOnAddRemove: false,
        selection: false,
      });

      fabricCanvasRef.current = canvas;

      canvas.setDimensions({
        width: manifest.canvas.width,
        height: manifest.canvas.height,
      });

      await canvas.loadFromJSON(
        manifest.fabricJson,
        (_serialized: unknown, object: FabricObject) => {
          object.set({
            selectable: false,
            evented: false,
            dirty: true,
          });
        }
      );

      canvas.requestRenderAll();

      await waitForNextAnimationFrame();
      await waitForNextAnimationFrame();
    };

    return () => {
      fabricCanvasRef.current?.dispose();
      delete window.renderMagicLayersRuntimeManifest;
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <main
      style={{
        margin: 0,
        padding: 0,
        overflow: "hidden",
      }}
    >
      <canvas
        ref={canvasRef}
        data-magic-layers-render-canvas="true"
      />
    </main>
  );
}

function waitForNextAnimationFrame() {
  return new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => resolve());
  });
}
```

Protect this route with middleware or service-only access. The renderer should not be public.

# 19.14 Diff metrics

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/visual-validation/compute-visual-diff-metrics.ts
```

```ts
import sharp from "sharp";
import pixelmatch from "pixelmatch";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_VISUAL_VALIDATION_POLICY,
} from "./visual-validation-policy";

import type {
  VisualValidationMetrics,
} from "./visual-validation.types";

export async function computeVisualDiffMetrics(input: {
  referencePng: Buffer;
  renderPng: Buffer;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}): Promise<{
  metrics: VisualValidationMetrics;
  diffPng: Buffer;
}> {
  const reference = await toRgbaRaw({
    buffer: input.referencePng,
    width: input.width,
    height: input.height,
  });

  const render = await toRgbaRaw({
    buffer: input.renderPng,
    width: input.width,
    height: input.height,
  });

  const diff = Buffer.alloc(input.width * input.height * 4);

  const diffPixels = pixelmatch(
    reference.data,
    render.data,
    diff,
    input.width,
    input.height,
    {
      threshold:
        MAGIC_LAYERS_VISUAL_VALIDATION_POLICY.diff.pixelmatchThreshold,
      includeAA:
        MAGIC_LAYERS_VISUAL_VALIDATION_POLICY.diff.includeAntiAliasedPixels,
    }
  );

  const pixelDiffRatio =
    diffPixels / Math.max(1, input.width * input.height);

  const rgbL1 = computeRgbL1(reference.data, render.data);

  const ssim = computeGlobalSsim(reference.data, render.data);

  const edgeDiffRatio = computeEdgeDiffRatio({
    reference: reference.data,
    render: render.data,
    width: input.width,
    height: input.height,
  });

  const visualMatchScore =
    ssim * 0.4 +
    (1 - rgbL1) * 0.25 +
    (1 - pixelDiffRatio) * 0.25 +
    (1 - edgeDiffRatio) * 0.1;

  const diffPng = await sharp(diff, {
    raw: {
      width: input.width,
      height: input.height,
      channels: 4,
    },
  })
    .png({
      compressionLevel: 9,
      adaptiveFiltering: true,
    })
    .toBuffer();

  return {
    metrics: {
      rgbL1,
      pixelDiffRatio,
      ssim,
      edgeDiffRatio,
      visualMatchScore,
    },
    diffPng,
  };
}

async function toRgbaRaw(input: {
  buffer: Buffer;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}) {
  const {
    data,
    info,
  } = await sharp(input.buffer, {
    failOn: "warning",
  })
    .resize(input.width, input.height, {
      fit: "fill",
    })
    .ensureAlpha()
    .raw()
    .toBuffer({
      resolveWithObject: true,
    });

  return {
    data,
    width: info.width,
    height: info.height,
  };
}

function computeRgbL1(a: Buffer, b: Buffer) {
  let sum = 0;
  let count = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i += 4) {
    sum += Math.abs(a[i] - b[i]) / 255;
    sum += Math.abs(a[i + 1] - b[i + 1]) / 255;
    sum += Math.abs(a[i + 2] - b[i + 2]) / 255;
    count += 3;
  }

  return sum / Math.max(1, count);
}

/**
 * First-pass global SSIM on luminance.
 * Later replace with windowed SSIM for closer perceptual behavior.
 */
function computeGlobalSsim(a: Buffer, b: Buffer) {
  const lumaA: number[] = [];
  const lumaB: number[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i += 4) {
    lumaA.push(0.2126 * a[i] + 0.7152 * a[i + 1] + 0.0722 * a[i + 2]);
    lumaB.push(0.2126 * b[i] + 0.7152 * b[i + 1] + 0.0722 * b[i + 2]);
  }

  const meanA = mean(lumaA);
  const meanB = mean(lumaB);

  const varianceA = variance(lumaA, meanA);
  const varianceB = variance(lumaB, meanB);
  const covarianceAB = covariance(lumaA, lumaB, meanA, meanB);

  const c1 = (0.01 * 255) ** 2;
  const c2 = (0.03 * 255) ** 2;

  return (
    ((2 * meanA * meanB + c1) * (2 * covarianceAB + c2)) /
    ((meanA ** 2 + meanB ** 2 + c1) * (varianceA + varianceB + c2))
  );
}

function computeEdgeDiffRatio(input: {
  reference: Buffer;
  render: Buffer;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}) {
  const refEdges = sobelEdges(input.reference, input.width, input.height);
  const renderEdges = sobelEdges(input.render, input.width, input.height);

  let diff = 0;
  let count = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < refEdges.length; i++) {
    if (refEdges[i] !== renderEdges[i]) diff++;
    count++;
  }

  return diff / Math.max(1, count);
}

function sobelEdges(buffer: Buffer, width: number, height: number) {
  const gray = new Float32Array(width * height);

  for (let i = 0, p = 0; i < buffer.length; i += 4, p++) {
    gray[p] =
      0.2126 * buffer[i] +
      0.7152 * buffer[i + 1] +
      0.0722 * buffer[i + 2];
  }

  const edges = new Uint8Array(width * height);

  for (let y = 1; y < height - 1; y++) {
    for (let x = 1; x < width - 1; x++) {
      const idx = y * width + x;

      const gx =
        -gray[idx - width - 1] -
        2 * gray[idx - 1] -
        gray[idx + width - 1] +
        gray[idx - width + 1] +
        2 * gray[idx + 1] +
        gray[idx + width + 1];

      const gy =
        -gray[idx - width - 1] -
        2 * gray[idx - width] -
        gray[idx - width + 1] +
        gray[idx + width - 1] +
        2 * gray[idx + width] +
        gray[idx + width + 1];

      const magnitude = Math.sqrt(gx * gx + gy * gy);

      edges[idx] = magnitude > 80 ? 1 : 0;
    }
  }

  return edges;
}

function mean(values: number[]) {
  return values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / Math.max(1, values.length);
}

function variance(values: number[], meanValue: number) {
  return (
    values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + (value - meanValue) ** 2, 0) /
    Math.max(1, values.length - 1)
  );
}

function covariance(
  a: number[],
  b: number[],
  meanA: number,
  meanB: number
) {
  let sum = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
    sum += (a[i] - meanA) * (b[i] - meanB);
  }

  return sum / Math.max(1, a.length - 1);
}
```

Later, replace the global SSIM with sliding-window SSIM. For day one, global SSIM plus pixelmatch plus edge diff is sufficient as a gate.

# 19.15 Validation decision

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/visual-validation/evaluate-visual-validation.ts
```

```ts
import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_VISUAL_VALIDATION_POLICY,
} from "./visual-validation-policy";

import type {
  VisualValidationLevel,
  VisualValidationMetrics,
} from "./visual-validation.types";

export function evaluateVisualValidation(
  metrics: VisualValidationMetrics
): {
  level: VisualValidationLevel;
  passed: boolean;
  failureReasons: string[];
  warnings: string[];
} {
  const p = MAGIC_LAYERS_VISUAL_VALIDATION_POLICY.thresholds.pass;
  const r = MAGIC_LAYERS_VISUAL_VALIDATION_POLICY.thresholds.needsReview;

  const passFailures = thresholdFailures(metrics, p);

  if (passFailures.length === 0) {
    return {
      level: "pass",
      passed: true,
      failureReasons: [],
      warnings: [],
    };
  }

  const reviewFailures = thresholdFailures(metrics, r);

  if (reviewFailures.length === 0) {
    return {
      level: "needs_review",
      passed: false,
      failureReasons: [],
      warnings: passFailures.map((reason) => `review_${reason}`),
    };
  }

  return {
    level: "fail",
    passed: false,
    failureReasons: reviewFailures,
    warnings: passFailures.map((reason) => `failed_${reason}`),
  };
}

function thresholdFailures(
  metrics: VisualValidationMetrics,
  threshold: {
    minVisualMatchScore: number;
    minSsim: number;
    maxRgbL1: number;
    maxPixelDiffRatio: number;
    maxEdgeDiffRatio: number;
  }
) {
  const failures: string[] = [];

  if (metrics.visualMatchScore < threshold.minVisualMatchScore) {
    failures.push("visual_match_score_low");
  }

  if (metrics.ssim < threshold.minSsim) {
    failures.push("ssim_low");
  }

  if (metrics.rgbL1 > threshold.maxRgbL1) {
    failures.push("rgb_l1_high");
  }

  if (metrics.pixelDiffRatio > threshold.maxPixelDiffRatio) {
    failures.push("pixel_diff_ratio_high");
  }

  if (metrics.edgeDiffRatio > threshold.maxEdgeDiffRatio) {
    failures.push("edge_diff_ratio_high");
  }

  return failures;
}
```

```ts
import {
  AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,
  AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
} from "../schema/constants";

import type {
  AiReconstructionDocument,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  AiReconstructionDocumentSchema,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.zod";

import {
  assertReconstructionDocumentInvariants,
} from "../schema/invariants";

import {
  bucketForMagicStorageRole,
} from "../storage/storage-buckets";

import {
  reconstructionDocumentPath,
  visualValidationDiffPngPath,
  visualValidationPassReportPath,
  visualValidationRenderPngPath,
} from "../storage/storage-paths";

import {
  writeAiAsset,
} from "../storage/write-ai-asset";

import {
  downloadAssetBuffer,
} from "../storage/download-ai-asset";

import type {
  AiFabricManifestTemplate,
} from "../fabric-generator/fabric-generator.types";

import {
  hydrateFabricRuntimeManifest,
} from "../fabric-generator/hydrate-fabric-runtime-manifest";

import {
  resolveAiAssetSignedUrl,
} from "../storage/resolve-ai-asset-url";

import {
  playwrightFabricRenderer,
} from "./playwright-fabric-renderer";

import {
  computeVisualDiffMetrics,
} from "./compute-visual-diff-metrics";

import {
  evaluateVisualValidation,
} from "./evaluate-visual-validation";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_VISUAL_VALIDATION_POLICY,
} from "./visual-validation-policy";

import type {
  VisualValidationPass,
  VisualValidationResult,
} from "./visual-validation.types";

export async function runVisualValidationPass(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  jobId: string;
  userId: string;

  reconstructionDocument: AiReconstructionDocument;

  reconstructionDocumentAssetId: string;

  fabricManifestTemplate: AiFabricManifestTemplate;

  fabricManifestTemplateAssetId: string;
}): Promise<VisualValidationResult> {
  const normalizedAssetId =
    input.reconstructionDocument.sourceImage.normalizedAssetId;

  if (!normalizedAssetId) {
    throw new Error("missing_normalized_asset_id_for_visual_validation");
  }

  const normalizedAsset =
    input.reconstructionDocument.assets[normalizedAssetId];

  if (!normalizedAsset) {
    throw new Error(`missing_normalized_asset_${normalizedAssetId}`);
  }

  const referenceBuffer = await downloadAssetBuffer(normalizedAsset);

  const runtimeManifest = await hydrateFabricRuntimeManifest({
    template: input.fabricManifestTemplate,
    resolveAssetUrl: async (asset) => {
      const resolved = await resolveAiAssetSignedUrl({
        asset,
        expiresInMs: 60 * 60 * 1000,
      });

      return {
        url: resolved.url,
        urlExpiresAt: resolved.urlExpiresAt,
      };
    },
  });

  const rendered = await playwrightFabricRenderer.render(runtimeManifest);

  const {
    metrics,
    diffPng,
  } = await computeVisualDiffMetrics({
    referencePng: referenceBuffer,
    renderPng: rendered.pngBuffer,
    width: input.reconstructionDocument.canvas.width,
    height: input.reconstructionDocument.canvas.height,
  });

  const evaluation = evaluateVisualValidation(metrics);

  const renderAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "visual-validation-render"
  );

  const renderAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "assets",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("assets"),
    storagePath: visualValidationRenderPngPath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: renderAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: rendered.pngBuffer,

    assetId: renderAssetId,
    kind: "visual_validation_render_png" as any,

    contentType: "image/png",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    width: input.reconstructionDocument.canvas.width,
    height: input.reconstructionDocument.canvas.height,

    source: "visual_validator",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    sourceAssetId: input.fabricManifestTemplateAssetId,

    cacheControl: "private, max-age=86400",
  });

  const diffAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "visual-validation-diff"
  );

  const diffAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "assets",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("assets"),
    storagePath: visualValidationDiffPngPath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: diffAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: diffPng,

    assetId: diffAssetId,
    kind: "visual_validation_diff_png" as any,

    contentType: "image/png",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    width: input.reconstructionDocument.canvas.width,
    height: input.reconstructionDocument.canvas.height,

    source: "visual_validator",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    sourceAssetId: renderAsset.id,

    cacheControl: "private, max-age=86400",
  });

  const updatedReconstructionDocument =
    updateReconstructionDocumentWithVisualValidation({
      doc: input.reconstructionDocument,
      metrics,
      evaluation,
      renderAssetId: renderAsset.id,
      diffAssetId: diffAsset.id,
    });

  const parsed =
    AiReconstructionDocumentSchema.parse(updatedReconstructionDocument);

  assertReconstructionDocumentInvariants(parsed);

  const updatedReconstructionDocumentAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "reconstruction-document-after-visual-validation"
  );

  const updatedReconstructionDocumentAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "assets",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("assets"),
    storagePath: reconstructionDocumentPath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: updatedReconstructionDocumentAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(
      JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 2),
      "utf8"
    ),

    assetId: updatedReconstructionDocumentAssetId,
    kind: "reconstruction_document",

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    source: "visual_validator",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    sourceAssetId: input.reconstructionDocumentAssetId,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  const passAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "visual-validation-pass"
  );

  const pass: VisualValidationPass = {
    schemaVersion: "ai-visual-validation-pass.v1",

    jobId: input.jobId,
    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    userId: input.userId,

    sourceReconstructionDocumentAssetId:
      input.reconstructionDocumentAssetId,

    updatedReconstructionDocumentAssetId:
      updatedReconstructionDocumentAsset.id,

    fabricManifestTemplateAssetId:
      input.fabricManifestTemplateAssetId,

    renderAssetId: renderAsset.id,

    diffAssetId: diffAsset.id,

    level: evaluation.level,

    passed: evaluation.passed,

    metrics,

    thresholds: {
      pass: MAGIC_LAYERS_VISUAL_VALIDATION_POLICY.thresholds.pass,
      needsReview:
        MAGIC_LAYERS_VISUAL_VALIDATION_POLICY.thresholds.needsReview,
    },

    renderer: {
      name: rendered.rendererName,
      viewportWidth: input.reconstructionDocument.canvas.width,
      viewportHeight: input.reconstructionDocument.canvas.height,
      deviceScaleFactor:
        MAGIC_LAYERS_VISUAL_VALIDATION_POLICY.render.deviceScaleFactor,
    },

    failureReasons: evaluation.failureReasons,

    warnings: evaluation.warnings,

    createdAt: Date.now(),
  };

  const passAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "source",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
    storagePath: visualValidationPassReportPath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: passAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(pass, null, 2), "utf8"),

    assetId: passAssetId,
    kind: "visual_validation_pass_json" as any,

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    source: "visual_validator",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    sourceAssetId: updatedReconstructionDocumentAsset.id,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  return {
    updatedReconstructionDocument: parsed,
    updatedReconstructionDocumentAsset,
    visualValidationPass: pass,
    visualValidationPassAsset: passAsset,
    renderAsset,
    diffAsset,
  };
}

function updateReconstructionDocumentWithVisualValidation(input: {
  doc: AiReconstructionDocument;
  metrics: {
    rgbL1: number;
    pixelDiffRatio: number;
    ssim: number;
    edgeDiffRatio: number;
    visualMatchScore: number;
  };
  evaluation: {
    level: "pass" | "needs_review" | "fail";
    passed: boolean;
    warnings: string[];
    failureReasons: string[];
  };
  renderAssetId: string;
  diffAssetId: string;
}): AiReconstructionDocument {
  const warnings = [
    ...input.doc.quality.warnings,
    ...input.evaluation.warnings,
    ...input.evaluation.failureReasons,
  ];

  return {
    ...input.doc,

    updatedAt: Date.now(),

    quality: {
      ...input.doc.quality,

      visualMatchScore: input.metrics.visualMatchScore,
      ssim: input.metrics.ssim,
      rgbL1: input.metrics.rgbL1,
      pixelDiffRatio: input.metrics.pixelDiffRatio,
      edgeDiffRatio: input.metrics.edgeDiffRatio,

      needsReview:
        input.doc.quality.needsReview ||
        input.evaluation.level !== "pass",

      warnings: [...new Set(warnings)],

      artifacts: {
        ...input.doc.quality.artifacts,
        visualRenderAssetId: input.renderAssetId,
        visualDiffAssetId: input.diffAssetId,
      },
    },

    pipeline: {
      ...input.doc.pipeline,
      artifacts: {
        ...input.doc.pipeline.artifacts,
        visualRenderAssetId: input.renderAssetId,
        visualDiffAssetId: input.diffAssetId,
      },
    },

    audit: {
      ...input.doc.audit,
      firstRenderValidated: input.evaluation.passed,
    },
  };
}

function stableAssetId(jobId: string, label: string) {
  return `asset_${jobId}_${label}`
    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "_")
    .toLowerCase();
}
```

# 19.17 Firestore patch

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/visual-validation/apply-visual-validation-result.ts
```

```ts
import {
  FieldValue,
  getFirestore,
} from "firebase-admin/firestore";

import type {
  VisualValidationResult,
} from "./visual-validation.types";

export async function applyVisualValidationResult(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  jobId: string;
  result: VisualValidationResult;
}) {
  const db = getFirestore();

  const designRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}`
  );

  const jobRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/aiLayerJobs/${input.jobId}`
  );

  const batch = db.batch();

  const assetsToIndex = [
    input.result.updatedReconstructionDocumentAsset,
    input.result.visualValidationPassAsset,
    input.result.renderAsset,
    input.result.diffAsset,
  ];

  for (const asset of assetsToIndex) {
    batch.set(
      db.doc(
        `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/assets/${asset.id}`
      ),
      {
        id: asset.id,

        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        jobId: input.jobId,

        kind: asset.kind,
        storageRole: asset.storageRole,

        bucket: asset.bucket,
        storagePath: asset.storagePath,

        generation: asset.generation,
        metageneration: asset.metageneration,

        mimeType: asset.mimeType,

        width: asset.width,
        height: asset.height,
        sizeBytes: asset.sizeBytes,

        checksum: asset.checksum,

        source: asset.metadata?.source,

        retained: true,

        createdAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      },
      { merge: true }
    );
  }

  const level = input.result.visualValidationPass.level;

  batch.update(jobRef, {
    "output.reconstructionAssetId":
      input.result.updatedReconstructionDocumentAsset.id,

    visualValidation: {
      visualValidationPassAssetId:
        input.result.visualValidationPassAsset.id,

      updatedReconstructionDocumentAssetId:
        input.result.updatedReconstructionDocumentAsset.id,

      renderAssetId:
        input.result.renderAsset.id,

      diffAssetId:
        input.result.diffAsset.id,

      level,

      passed:
        input.result.visualValidationPass.passed,

      metrics:
        input.result.visualValidationPass.metrics,

      failureReasons:
        input.result.visualValidationPass.failureReasons,

      warnings:
        input.result.visualValidationPass.warnings,

      createdAt:
        input.result.visualValidationPass.createdAt,
    },

    "quality.visualMatchScore":
      input.result.visualValidationPass.metrics.visualMatchScore,

    "quality.ssim":
      input.result.visualValidationPass.metrics.ssim,

    "quality.rgbL1":
      input.result.visualValidationPass.metrics.rgbL1,

    "quality.pixelDiffRatio":
      input.result.visualValidationPass.metrics.pixelDiffRatio,

    "quality.needsReview":
      level !== "pass",

    "progress.percent": 97,
    "progress.label":
      level === "pass"
        ? "Visual validation passed"
        : level === "needs_review"
          ? "Visual validation needs review"
          : "Visual validation failed",

    "progress.currentStep": "validating",

    updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
  });

  batch.update(designRef, {
    "source.currentReconstructionAssetId":
      input.result.updatedReconstructionDocumentAsset.id,

    "current.thumbnailAssetId":
      input.result.renderAsset.id,

    "quality.visualMatchScore":
      input.result.visualValidationPass.metrics.visualMatchScore,

    "quality.ssim":
      input.result.visualValidationPass.metrics.ssim,

    "quality.rgbL1":
      input.result.visualValidationPass.metrics.rgbL1,

    "quality.needsReview":
      level !== "pass",

    status:
      level === "fail"
        ? "failed"
        : level === "needs_review"
          ? "needs_review"
          : "processing",

    updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
  });

  if (level === "fail") {
    batch.update(jobRef, {
      status: "failed",
      error: {
        code: "visual_reconstruction_failed",
        message:
          "The reconstructed Fabric render did not sufficiently match the normalized original image.",
        retryable: false,
        failedStep: "visual_validation",
      },
      updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });
  }

  await batch.commit();
}
```

```ts
await runStep(context, "validating", async () => {
  const job = await loadMagicLayersJob(context);

  const reconstructionAssetId =
    job.output.reconstructionAssetId;

  const fabricManifestTemplateAssetId =
    job.output.fabricManifestAssetId;

  if (!reconstructionAssetId) {
    throw new Error("missing_reconstruction_asset_id");
  }

  if (!fabricManifestTemplateAssetId) {
    throw new Error("missing_fabric_manifest_template_asset_id");
  }

  const reconstructionDocument =
    await loadReconstructionDocumentFromAsset({
      workspaceId: context.workspaceId,
      designId: context.designId,
      assetId: reconstructionAssetId,
    });

  const fabricManifestTemplate =
    await loadFabricManifestTemplateFromAsset({
      workspaceId: context.workspaceId,
      designId: context.designId,
      assetId: fabricManifestTemplateAssetId,
    });

  const visualResult = await runVisualValidationPass({
    workspaceId: context.workspaceId,
    designId: context.designId,
    jobId: context.jobId,
    userId: job.userId,

    reconstructionDocument,
    reconstructionDocumentAssetId: reconstructionAssetId,

    fabricManifestTemplate,
    fabricManifestTemplateAssetId,
  });

  await applyVisualValidationResult({
    workspaceId: context.workspaceId,
    designId: context.designId,
    jobId: context.jobId,
    result: visualResult,
  });

  if (visualResult.visualValidationPass.level === "fail") {
    throw new Error("visual_reconstruction_failed");
  }

  /**
   * Step 20 text safety validation runs after this.
   */
});
```

---

# 19.19 Critical failure this catches

Step 19 catches errors such as:

```txt
foreground duplicated over original background
clean background visibly wrong
text rendered with wrong font/line wrapping
missing image asset
wrong image scale
wrong z-order
wrong opacity
wrong vector geometry
wrong crop placement
tainted/broken image load
SVG/path rendering mismatch
unexpected Fabric serialization issue
```

The important one:

```txt
original full image used as background
+ extracted foreground visible
= duplicated objects
```

That must fail visual validation unless the scene resolver suppressed foreground layers.

---

# 19.20 Validation pass interpretation

## `pass`

```txt
audit.firstRenderValidated = true
design remains processing until Step 20
can proceed to text safety validation
```

## `needs_review`

```txt
audit.firstRenderValidated = false
design.status = needs_review
continue to Step 20
user can open editor with warning
```

## `fail`

```txt
job.status = failed
design.status = failed
do not claim Magic Layers succeeded
repair loop or fallback-only generation is required later
```

This matches the product contract:

```txt
successful only when first render visually matches original
needs review when useful but imperfect
failed when reconstruction is not a plausible approximation
```

---

# 19.21 Why Step 19 updates the reconstruction document

Step 17 created the document with:

```ts
audit.firstRenderValidated = false
quality.visualMatchScore = undefined
```

Step 19 writes a new immutable reconstruction document asset with:

```ts
audit.firstRenderValidated = true | false

quality.visualMatchScore
quality.ssim
quality.rgbL1
quality.pixelDiffRatio
quality.edgeDiffRatio
quality.artifacts.visualRenderAssetId
quality.artifacts.visualDiffAssetId
```

This does not change renderable content, so the Fabric manifest template does not need to be regenerated.

If a later repair changes layers, then Step 17/18 must run again for that repaired scene.

---

# 19.22 What Step 19 must not do

Do not:

```txt
change layers
change zIndex
change text
downgrade text to raster
regenerate background
regenerate masks
create Fabric objects
export final PNG/PDF
mark completed
```

Do not hide visual failure.

A failed visual match is not a warning-level issue if the score is below the hard threshold.

---

# 19.23 Non-negotiable invariants

Step 19 is valid only if:

```txt
It renders the hydrated runtime Fabric manifest.

It does not render the durable template directly.

It compares against normalized image.

It uses exact canvas dimensions.

It uses deviceScaleFactor = 1 unless explicitly testing high-DPI output.

It stores render preview PNG.

It stores diff PNG.
```

## ChatGPT Response 030

<!-- assistant_message_ids: b913432a-2497-4b7f-a38d-4c0527540415, c9313565-5f18-4f9f-9cd1-80aac9be38af, 5ff67839-c7a0-484a-b4ea-2b18111b44a4 -->

Step 20 is the second validation gate, focused specifically on preventing visible text from changing after conversion.

A full-scene render can pass while an editable text string is still wrong, so this step must validate preserved wording independently.

# Step 20 — Text safety validator

Step 20 is the **hard semantic-content gate** for text.

The locked rule:

```txt
No reconstructed editable text may silently change visible text content.
```

Step 20 does **not** create new layers.  
Step 20 does **not** repair text.  
Step 20 does **not** regenerate Fabric JSON.  
Step 20 validates whether the final editable-text layers are safe.

If text is unsafe, the job must not become “ready.” The repair loop later can downgrade unsafe editable text to raster fallback.

Cloud Vision gives us the right primitive for this pass because `TEXT_DETECTION` extracts text from images and returns the full string plus individual words/bounding boxes, while `DOCUMENT_TEXT_DETECTION` is optimized for dense document-like text and returns page/block/paragraph/word structure. citeturn310276view0 The `fullTextAnnotation` hierarchy is useful because it exposes pages, blocks, paragraphs, words, and symbols; words and symbols carry bounding boxes and confidence scores. citeturn310276view1turn194773view0 Unicode normalization must be deterministic here, so use Unicode Normalization Forms, especially NFKC/NFC, for comparison. citeturn310276view2

---

## 20.1 What Step 20 owns

Step 20 owns:

```txt
final editable-text validation
source text vs layer text comparison
original crop OCR
rendered crop OCR
protected token comparison
Unicode normalization
text edit-distance scoring
text safety pass report
text safety diagnostic crop assets
updated reconstruction document
Firestore text safety summary
final pass / needs_review / fail decision
```

Step 20 does **not** own:

```txt
text repair
text-to-raster downgrade
Fabric manifest regeneration
visual full-scene diff
manual editing tools
export
autosave/versioning
```

---

# 20.2 Why Step 20 exists separately from Step 10

Step 10 created **text candidates**.

Step 17 decided which candidates became `text_editable`.

Step 18 projected those layers into Fabric.

Step 19 validated the full visual render.

Step 20 validates **semantic text preservation**.

A scene can visually pass while still having a dangerous text error:

```txt
"PALMESTINE" visually close to "PALESTINE"
"50%" changed to "80%"
"₹99" changed to "₹999"
"@brand" changed to "@brano"
"Mon" changed to "Sun"
```

Step 20 exists because visual similarity is not enough for text.

---

# 20.3 Inputs

Step 20 consumes:


```txt
job.visualValidation.renderAssetId
```

It validates only:

```txt
visible text_editable layers
```

Raster text fallbacks are not semantic-editable text. They may still be visually checked by Step 19, but they do not create the “AI silently rewrote my text” risk.

---

# 20.5 Final decision levels

Use three levels:

```ts
type TextSafetyLevel =
  | "pass"
  | "needs_review"
  | "fail";
```

Meaning:

```txt
pass
  All editable text layers preserve source text content.

needs_review
  No proven semantic mutation, but OCR/crop confidence is weak.

fail
  At least one editable text layer changed semantic content or protected tokens.
```

Hard rule:

```txt
fail blocks automatic completion.
needs_review allows editor opening, but design cannot be auto-ready.
```
