```ts
export const MAGIC_LAYERS_TEXT_SAFETY_POLICY = {
  validateOnlyVisibleEditableText: true,

  crop: {
    paddingRatio: 0.18,
    minPaddingPx: 8,
    maxPaddingPx: 48,

    usePrimaryFallbackBBoxWhenAvailable: true,
  },

  ocr: {
    enabled: true,

    engine: "google_cloud_vision_text_detection" as const,

    minHighConfidence: 0.82,

    minUsableConfidence: 0.55,

    maxCropLongEdge: 1536,
  },

  comparison: {
    /**
     * Stored layer text must be essentially identical to expected source text.
     */
    maxStoredTextEditDistanceRatioForPass: 0.0,

    /**
     * OCR can be noisy, so rendered OCR gets a small tolerance.
     */
    maxRenderOcrEditDistanceRatioForPass: 0.04,

    maxRenderOcrEditDistanceRatioForReview: 0.14,

    maxOriginalOcrDisagreementForPass: 0.08,

    maxOriginalOcrDisagreementForReview: 0.18,

    failOnProtectedTokenMismatch: true,

    caseSensitiveStoredText: true,

    normalizeUnicode: true,
  },

  protectedTokens: {
    numbers: true,
    currency: true,
    percentages: true,
    dates: true,
    emails: true,
    urls: true,
    handles: true,
    hashtags: true,
    phoneNumbers: true,
  },
} as const;
```

Default stance:

```txt
Stored layer text must match expected source text exactly after normalization.
OCR has tolerance.
Protected tokens have zero tolerance.
```

# 20.11 Text normalization

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/text-safety/normalize-text-for-safety.ts
```

```ts
export function normalizeTextForSafety(input: string): string {
  return input
    .normalize("NFKC")
    .replace(/[“”]/g, '"')
    .replace(/[‘’]/g, "'")
    .replace(/[‐‑‒–—―]/g, "-")
    .replace(/\u00A0/g, " ")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();
}

export function normalizeTextLoose(input: string): string {
  return normalizeTextForSafety(input)
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}@#%₹$€£.+:/-]+/gu, "");
}

export function levenshteinDistance(a: string, b: string): number {
  const dp = Array.from({ length: a.length + 1 }, () =>
    Array<number>(b.length + 1).fill(0)
  );

  for (let i = 0; i <= a.length; i++) dp[i][0] = i;
  for (let j = 0; j <= b.length; j++) dp[0][j] = j;

  for (let i = 1; i <= a.length; i++) {
    for (let j = 1; j <= b.length; j++) {
      const cost = a[i - 1] === b[j - 1] ? 0 : 1;

      dp[i][j] = Math.min(
        dp[i - 1][j] + 1,
        dp[i][j - 1] + 1,
        dp[i - 1][j - 1] + cost
      );
    }
  }

  return dp[a.length][b.length];
}

export function editDistanceRatio(input: {
  a: string;
  b: string;
}) {
  const a = normalizeTextForSafety(input.a);
  const b = normalizeTextForSafety(input.b);

  const distance = levenshteinDistance(a, b);

  return distance / Math.max(1, Math.max(a.length, b.length));
}
```

Use `NFKC` because it collapses compatibility variants that can be visually equivalent, such as full-width forms and certain composed/decomposed sequences.

# 20.12 Protected token extraction

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/text-safety/protected-tokens.ts
```

```ts
import {
  normalizeTextForSafety,
} from "./normalize-text-for-safety";

export type ProtectedTokenSet = {
  numbers: string[];

  currency: string[];

  percentages: string[];

  dates: string[];

  emails: string[];

  urls: string[];

  handles: string[];

  hashtags: string[];

  phoneNumbers: string[];
};

export function extractProtectedTokens(value: string): ProtectedTokenSet {
  const text = normalizeTextForSafety(value);

  return {
    numbers: matchAll(text, /\b\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?\b/g),

    currency: matchAll(
      text,
      /(?:₹|\$|€|£)\s?\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?|\b\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?\s?(?:INR|USD|EUR|GBP)\b/gi
    ),

    percentages: matchAll(text, /\b\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?\s?%/g),

    dates: matchAll(
      text,
      /\b(?:\d{1,2}[/-]\d{1,2}(?:[/-]\d{2,4})?|\d{1,2}\s?(?:Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Sept|Oct|Nov|Dec)[a-z]*|\b(?:Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri|Sat|Sun)\b)/gi
    ),

    emails: matchAll(
      text,
      /\b[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}\b/gi
    ),

    urls: matchAll(
      text,
      /\b(?:https?:\/\/)?(?:www\.)?[a-z0-9-]+(?:\.[a-z0-9-]+)+(?:\/[^\s]*)?/gi
    ),

    handles: matchAll(text, /@[a-z0-9_.-]+/gi),

    hashtags: matchAll(text, /#[\p{L}\p{N}_-]+/gu),

    phoneNumbers: matchAll(
      text,
      /(?:\+?\d{1,3}[-.\s]?)?(?:\(?\d{3,5}\)?[-.\s]?)?\d{3,5}[-.\s]?\d{3,5}/g
    ),
  };
}

export function compareProtectedTokens(input: {
  expected: string;
  actual: string;
}) {
  const expected = extractProtectedTokens(input.expected);
  const actual = extractProtectedTokens(input.actual);

  const mismatches: string[] = [];

  for (const key of Object.keys(expected) as (keyof ProtectedTokenSet)[]) {
    const expectedTokens = normalizeTokenList(expected[key]);
    const actualTokens = normalizeTokenList(actual[key]);

    if (!sameMultiset(expectedTokens, actualTokens)) {
      mismatches.push(key);
    }
  }

  return {
    mismatchCount: mismatches.length,
    mismatchTypes: mismatches,
  };
}

function matchAll(text: string, regex: RegExp): string[] {
  return [...text.matchAll(regex)].map((match) => match[0]);
}

function normalizeTokenList(tokens: string[]) {
  return tokens.map((token) =>
    normalizeTextForSafety(token).toLowerCase()
  ).sort();
}

function sameMultiset(a: string[], b: string[]) {
  if (a.length !== b.length) return false;

  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
    if (a[i] !== b[i]) return false;
  }

  return true;
}
```

Protected token mismatch is a hard fail because numbers, prices, dates, phone numbers, handles, URLs, and currency are usually business-critical.

# 20.13 Crop extraction

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/text-safety/extract-text-safety-crops.ts
```

```ts
import sharp from "sharp";

import type {
  AiReconstructedLayer,
  BBox,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_TEXT_SAFETY_POLICY,
} from "./text-safety-policy";

export function textSafetyCropBBox(input: {
  layer: AiReconstructedLayer;
  canvasWidth: number;
  canvasHeight: number;
}): BBox {
  const primaryFallback = input.layer.primaryFallbackId
    ? input.layer.fallbacks.find(
        (fallback) => fallback.id === input.layer.primaryFallbackId
      )
    : undefined;

  const baseBBox =
    MAGIC_LAYERS_TEXT_SAFETY_POLICY.crop.usePrimaryFallbackBBoxWhenAvailable &&
    primaryFallback?.bbox
      ? primaryFallback.bbox
      : input.layer.geometry.bbox;

  const padding = Math.max(
    MAGIC_LAYERS_TEXT_SAFETY_POLICY.crop.minPaddingPx,
    Math.min(
      MAGIC_LAYERS_TEXT_SAFETY_POLICY.crop.maxPaddingPx,
      Math.round(
        Math.max(baseBBox.width, baseBBox.height) *
          MAGIC_LAYERS_TEXT_SAFETY_POLICY.crop.paddingRatio
      )
    )
  );

  const x = Math.max(0, Math.floor(baseBBox.x - padding));
  const y = Math.max(0, Math.floor(baseBBox.y - padding));

  const right = Math.min(
    input.canvasWidth,
    Math.ceil(baseBBox.x + baseBBox.width + padding)
  );

  const bottom = Math.min(
    input.canvasHeight,
    Math.ceil(baseBBox.y + baseBBox.height + padding)
  );

  return {
    x,
    y,
    width: Math.max(1, right - x),
    height: Math.max(1, bottom - y),
  };
}

export async function extractTextSafetyCrop(input: {
  imageBuffer: Buffer;
  bbox: BBox;
}) {
  const {
    data,
    info,
  } = await sharp(input.imageBuffer, {
    failOn: "warning",
  })
    .extract({
      left: input.bbox.x,
      top: input.bbox.y,
      width: input.bbox.width,
      height: input.bbox.height,
    })
    .resize({
      width: MAGIC_LAYERS_TEXT_SAFETY_POLICY.ocr.maxCropLongEdge,
      height: MAGIC_LAYERS_TEXT_SAFETY_POLICY.ocr.maxCropLongEdge,
      fit: "inside",
      withoutEnlargement: true,
    })
    .png({
      compressionLevel: 9,
      adaptiveFiltering: true,
    })
    .toBuffer({
      resolveWithObject: true,
    });

  return {
    buffer: data,
    width: info.width,
    height: info.height,
  };
}
```

Use the same bbox for the original normalized crop and the rendered crop. This keeps OCR comparison aligned.

# 20.14 OCR wrapper

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/text-safety/run-text-safety-ocr.ts
```

```ts
import {
  ImageAnnotatorClient,
} from "@google-cloud/vision";

import type vision from "@google-cloud/vision";

import {
  normalizeTextForSafety,
} from "./normalize-text-for-safety";

import type {
  TextSafetyOcrResult,
} from "./text-safety.types";

const client = new ImageAnnotatorClient();

export async function runTextSafetyOcr(input: {
  imageBuffer: Buffer;

  languageHints?: string[];
}): Promise<{
  result: TextSafetyOcrResult;
  rawResponse: vision.protos.google.cloud.vision.v1.IAnnotateImageResponse;
}> {
  const [response] = await client.textDetection({
    image: {
      content: input.imageBuffer,
    },
    imageContext: input.languageHints?.length
      ? {
          languageHints: input.languageHints,
        }
      : undefined,
  });

  const text =
    response.textAnnotations?.[0]?.description ??
    response.fullTextAnnotation?.text ??
    "";

  const confidence = confidenceFromResponse(response);

  return {
    result: {
      text,
      normalizedText: normalizeTextForSafety(text),
      confidence,
      wordCount: countWords(text),
    },
    rawResponse: response,
  };
}

function confidenceFromResponse(
  response: vision.protos.google.cloud.vision.v1.IAnnotateImageResponse
): number {
  const confidences: number[] = [];

  for (const page of response.fullTextAnnotation?.pages ?? []) {
    for (const block of page.blocks ?? []) {
      if (typeof block.confidence === "number") {
        confidences.push(block.confidence);
      }

      for (const paragraph of block.paragraphs ?? []) {
        if (typeof paragraph.confidence === "number") {
          confidences.push(paragraph.confidence);
        }

        for (const word of paragraph.words ?? []) {
          if (typeof word.confidence === "number") {
            confidences.push(word.confidence);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  if (!confidences.length) {
    return response.textAnnotations?.length ? 0.65 : 0;
  }

  return (
    confidences.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) /
    confidences.length
  );
}

function countWords(value: string) {
  return value.trim()
    ? value.trim().split(/\s+/).length
    : 0;
}
```

Use `TEXT_DETECTION` for these small crops. `DOCUMENT_TEXT_DETECTION` is better for dense document-like layouts, but a final editable text layer crop should usually be short text.

```ts
import type {
  AiReconstructedLayer,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  compareProtectedTokens,

import {
  editDistanceRatio,
  normalizeTextForSafety,

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_TEXT_SAFETY_POLICY,
} from "./text-safety-policy";

import type {
  TextSafetyLayerResult,
  TextSafetyOcrResult,
} from "./text-safety.types";

export function evaluateTextLayerSafety(input: {
  layer: AiReconstructedLayer;

  expectedText: string;

  originalCropOcr?: TextSafetyOcrResult;

  renderCropOcr?: TextSafetyOcrResult;

  originalCropAssetId?: string;

  renderCropAssetId?: string;
}): TextSafetyLayerResult {
  const layerText = input.layer.text?.value ?? "";

  const normalizedExpectedText =
    normalizeTextForSafety(input.expectedText);

  const normalizedLayerText =
    normalizeTextForSafety(layerText);

  const storedTextEditDistanceRatio = editDistanceRatio({
    a: normalizedExpectedText,
    b: normalizedLayerText,
  });

  const protectedStored = compareProtectedTokens({
    expected: normalizedExpectedText,
    actual: normalizedLayerText,
  });

  const originalOcrToExpectedRatio = input.originalCropOcr
    ? editDistanceRatio({
        a: input.originalCropOcr.normalizedText,
        b: normalizedExpectedText,
      })
    : undefined;

  const renderOcrToLayerTextRatio = input.renderCropOcr
    ? editDistanceRatio({
        a: input.renderCropOcr.normalizedText,
        b: normalizedLayerText,
      })
    : undefined;

  const renderOcrToExpectedRatio = input.renderCropOcr
    ? editDistanceRatio({
        a: input.renderCropOcr.normalizedText,
        b: normalizedExpectedText,
      })
    : undefined;

  const failureReasons: string[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];

  if (!input.layer.text) {
    failureReasons.push("missing_text_payload");
  }

  if (input.layer.text?.safety?.semanticMutationDetected) {
    failureReasons.push("existing_semantic_mutation_flag");
  }

  if (
    storedTextEditDistanceRatio >
    MAGIC_LAYERS_TEXT_SAFETY_POLICY.comparison
      .maxStoredTextEditDistanceRatioForPass
  ) {
    failureReasons.push("stored_layer_text_differs_from_expected_text");
  }

  if (
    MAGIC_LAYERS_TEXT_SAFETY_POLICY.comparison.failOnProtectedTokenMismatch &&
    protectedStored.mismatchCount > 0
  ) {
    failureReasons.push(
      `protected_token_mismatch:${protectedStored.mismatchTypes.join(",")}`
    );
  }

  if (input.originalCropOcr) {
    const originalOcrHighConfidence =
      input.originalCropOcr.confidence >=
      MAGIC_LAYERS_TEXT_SAFETY_POLICY.ocr.minHighConfidence;

    const originalOcrUsable =
      input.originalCropOcr.confidence >=
      MAGIC_LAYERS_TEXT_SAFETY_POLICY.ocr.minUsableConfidence;

    const protectedOriginalOcr = compareProtectedTokens({
      expected: normalizedExpectedText,
      actual: input.originalCropOcr.normalizedText,
    });

    if (
      originalOcrHighConfidence &&
      originalOcrToExpectedRatio !== undefined &&
      originalOcrToExpectedRatio >
        MAGIC_LAYERS_TEXT_SAFETY_POLICY.comparison
          .maxOriginalOcrDisagreementForReview
    ) {
      failureReasons.push("high_confidence_original_ocr_disagrees_with_expected_text");
    } else if (
      originalOcrUsable &&
      originalOcrToExpectedRatio !== undefined &&
      originalOcrToExpectedRatio >
        MAGIC_LAYERS_TEXT_SAFETY_POLICY.comparison
          .maxOriginalOcrDisagreementForPass
    ) {
      warnings.push("original_ocr_disagrees_with_expected_text");
    }

    if (
      originalOcrHighConfidence &&
      protectedOriginalOcr.mismatchCount > 0
    ) {
      failureReasons.push(
        `original_ocr_protected_token_mismatch:${protectedOriginalOcr.mismatchTypes.join(",")}`
      );
    }
  } else {
    warnings.push("original_crop_ocr_missing");
  }

  if (input.renderCropOcr) {
    const renderOcrHighConfidence =
      input.renderCropOcr.confidence >=
      MAGIC_LAYERS_TEXT_SAFETY_POLICY.ocr.minHighConfidence;

    const renderOcrUsable =
      input.renderCropOcr.confidence >=
      MAGIC_LAYERS_TEXT_SAFETY_POLICY.ocr.minUsableConfidence;

    const protectedRenderOcr = compareProtectedTokens({
      expected: normalizedExpectedText,
      actual: input.renderCropOcr.normalizedText,
    });

    if (
      renderOcrHighConfidence &&
      renderOcrToExpectedRatio !== undefined &&
      renderOcrToExpectedRatio >
        MAGIC_LAYERS_TEXT_SAFETY_POLICY.comparison
          .maxRenderOcrEditDistanceRatioForReview
    ) {
      failureReasons.push("high_confidence_render_ocr_disagrees_with_expected_text");
    } else if (
      renderOcrUsable &&
      renderOcrToExpectedRatio !== undefined &&
      renderOcrToExpectedRatio >
        MAGIC_LAYERS_TEXT_SAFETY_POLICY.comparison
          .maxRenderOcrEditDistanceRatioForPass
    ) {
      warnings.push("render_ocr_disagrees_with_expected_text");
    }

    if (
      renderOcrHighConfidence &&
      protectedRenderOcr.mismatchCount > 0
    ) {
      failureReasons.push(
        `render_ocr_protected_token_mismatch:${protectedRenderOcr.mismatchTypes.join(",")}`
      );
    }
  } else {
    warnings.push("render_crop_ocr_missing");
  }

  const semanticMutationDetected = failureReasons.some((reason) =>
    [
      "existing_semantic_mutation_flag",
      "stored_layer_text_differs_from_expected_text",
      "high_confidence_original_ocr_disagrees_with_expected_text",
      "high_confidence_render_ocr_disagrees_with_expected_text",
    ].some((prefix) => reason.startsWith(prefix))
  );

  const level =
    failureReasons.length > 0
      ? "fail"
      : warnings.length > 0
        ? "needs_review"
        : "pass";

  return {
    layerId: input.layer.id,
    layerName: input.layer.name,

    expectedText: input.expectedText,
    layerText,

    normalizedExpectedText,
    normalizedLayerText,

    originalCropOcr: input.originalCropOcr,
    renderCropOcr: input.renderCropOcr,

    originalCropAssetId: input.originalCropAssetId,
    renderCropAssetId: input.renderCropAssetId,

    metrics: {
      storedTextEditDistanceRatio,
      originalOcrToExpectedRatio,
      renderOcrToLayerTextRatio,
      renderOcrToExpectedRatio,
      protectedTokenMismatchCount:
        protectedStored.mismatchCount,
    },

    level,

    passed: level === "pass",

    semanticMutationDetected,

    failureReasons,

    warnings,

    recommendedRepair:
      level === "fail"
        ? "downgrade_to_raster_fallback"
        : level === "needs_review"
          ? "manual_review"
          : "none",
  };
}
```

The safest deterministic gate is:

```txt
layer.text.value must match the expected source text exactly after normalization.
```

OCR is secondary evidence because OCR can fail on stylized text.

# 20.16 Expected text resolver

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/text-safety/expected-text-for-layer.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiReconstructedLayer,
  AiReconstructionDocument,
  AiTextCandidateObservation,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

export function expectedTextForLayer(input: {
  doc: AiReconstructionDocument;
  layer: AiReconstructedLayer;
}): {
  expectedText: string;
  sourceTextCandidate?: AiTextCandidateObservation;
} {
  const selectedObservationIds =
    input.layer.decision.selectedObservationIds;

  for (const observationId of selectedObservationIds) {
    const observation = input.doc.observations[observationId];

    if (observation?.kind === "text_candidate") {
      return {
        expectedText:
          observation.originalOcrText ??
          observation.text ??
          input.layer.text?.originalValue ??
          input.layer.text?.value ??
          "",
        sourceTextCandidate: observation,
      };
    }
  }

  return {
    expectedText:
      input.layer.text?.originalValue ??
      input.layer.text?.safety?.originalOcrText ??
      input.layer.text?.value ??
      "",
  };
}
```

The expected source text should come from the accepted `text_candidate` whenever possible.

# 20.17 Run text safety validation pass

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/text-safety/run-text-safety-validation-pass.ts
```

```ts
import {
  AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,
  AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
} from "../schema/constants";

import type {
  AiReconstructedLayer,
  AiReconstructionDocument,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import {
  AiReconstructionDocumentSchema,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.zod";

import {
  assertReconstructionDocumentInvariants,
} from "../schema/invariants";

import {
  bucketForMagicStorageRole,
} from "../storage/storage-buckets";

import {
  reconstructionDocumentPath,
  textSafetyOriginalCropPath,
  textSafetyPassReportPath,
  textSafetyRawOcrPath,
  textSafetyRenderCropPath,
} from "../storage/storage-paths";

import {
  writeAiAsset,
} from "../storage/write-ai-asset";

import {
  downloadAssetBuffer,
} from "../storage/download-ai-asset";

import {
  expectedTextForLayer,
} from "./expected-text-for-layer";

import {
  extractTextSafetyCrop,
  textSafetyCropBBox,
} from "./extract-text-safety-crops";

import {
  runTextSafetyOcr,
} from "./run-text-safety-ocr";

import {
  evaluateTextLayerSafety,
} from "./evaluate-text-layer-safety";

import type {
  TextSafetyLayerResult,
  TextSafetyPass,
  TextSafetyValidationResult,
} from "./text-safety.types";

export async function runTextSafetyValidationPass(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  jobId: string;
  userId: string;

  reconstructionDocument: AiReconstructionDocument;

  reconstructionDocumentAssetId: string;

  visualRenderAssetId: string;
}): Promise<TextSafetyValidationResult> {
  const doc = input.reconstructionDocument;

  const normalizedAssetId = doc.sourceImage.normalizedAssetId;

  if (!normalizedAssetId) {
    throw new Error("missing_normalized_asset_id_for_text_safety");
  }

  const normalizedAsset = doc.assets[normalizedAssetId];
  const visualRenderAsset = doc.assets[input.visualRenderAssetId];

  if (!normalizedAsset) {
    throw new Error(`missing_normalized_asset_${normalizedAssetId}`);
  }

  if (!visualRenderAsset) {
    throw new Error(`missing_visual_render_asset_${input.visualRenderAssetId}`);
  }

  const normalizedBuffer = await downloadAssetBuffer(normalizedAsset);
  const renderBuffer = await downloadAssetBuffer(visualRenderAsset);

  const textLayers = doc.layers.filter(
    (layer) =>
      layer.visible &&
      layer.editableLevel === "text_editable"
  );

  const diagnosticAssets = [];
  const layerResults: TextSafetyLayerResult[] = [];

  for (const layer of textLayers) {
    const cropBBox = textSafetyCropBBox({
      layer,
      canvasWidth: doc.canvas.width,
      canvasHeight: doc.canvas.height,
    });

    const originalCrop = await extractTextSafetyCrop({
      imageBuffer: normalizedBuffer,
      bbox: cropBBox,
    });

    const renderCrop = await extractTextSafetyCrop({
      imageBuffer: renderBuffer,
      bbox: cropBBox,
    });

    const originalCropAssetId = stableAssetId(
      input.jobId,
      `${layer.id}-text-safety-original-crop`
    );

    const originalCropAsset = await writeAiAsset({
      storageRole: "source",
      bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
      storagePath: textSafetyOriginalCropPath({
        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        jobId: input.jobId,
        layerId: layer.id,
        assetId: originalCropAssetId,
      }),

      bytes: originalCrop.buffer,

      assetId: originalCropAssetId,
      kind: "text_safety_original_crop_png" as any,

      contentType: "image/png",

      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      layerId: layer.id,

      width: originalCrop.width,
      height: originalCrop.height,

      source: "text_safety_validator",

      schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

      sourceAssetId: normalizedAsset.id,

      cacheControl: "private, max-age=86400",
    });

    diagnosticAssets.push(originalCropAsset);

    const renderCropAssetId = stableAssetId(
      input.jobId,
      `${layer.id}-text-safety-render-crop`
    );

    const renderCropAsset = await writeAiAsset({
      storageRole: "source",
      bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
      storagePath: textSafetyRenderCropPath({
        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        jobId: input.jobId,
        layerId: layer.id,
        assetId: renderCropAssetId,
      }),

      bytes: renderCrop.buffer,

      assetId: renderCropAssetId,
      kind: "text_safety_render_crop_png" as any,

      contentType: "image/png",

      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      layerId: layer.id,

      width: renderCrop.width,
      height: renderCrop.height,

      source: "text_safety_validator",

      schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

      sourceAssetId: visualRenderAsset.id,

      cacheControl: "private, max-age=86400",
    });

    diagnosticAssets.push(renderCropAsset);

    const expected = expectedTextForLayer({
      doc,
      layer,
    });

    const languageHints =
      expected.sourceTextCandidate?.language
        ? [expected.sourceTextCandidate.language]
        : undefined;

    const originalOcr = await runTextSafetyOcr({
      imageBuffer: originalCrop.buffer,
      languageHints,
    });

    const renderOcr = await runTextSafetyOcr({
      imageBuffer: renderCrop.buffer,
      languageHints,
    });

    const rawOcrAssetId = stableAssetId(
      input.jobId,
      `${layer.id}-text-safety-ocr`
    );

    const rawOcrAsset = await writeAiAsset({
      storageRole: "source",
      bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
      storagePath: textSafetyRawOcrPath({
        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        jobId: input.jobId,
        layerId: layer.id,
        assetId: rawOcrAssetId,
      }),

      bytes: Buffer.from(
        JSON.stringify(
          {
            originalCropOcr: originalOcr.rawResponse,
            renderCropOcr: renderOcr.rawResponse,
          },
          null,
          2
        ),
        "utf8"
      ),

      assetId: rawOcrAssetId,
      kind: "text_safety_raw_ocr_json" as any,

      contentType: "application/json",

      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      layerId: layer.id,

      source: "text_safety_validator",

      schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

      sourceAssetId: originalCropAsset.id,

      cacheControl: "private, no-store",
    });

    diagnosticAssets.push(rawOcrAsset);

    originalOcr.result.rawOutputAssetId = rawOcrAsset.id;
    renderOcr.result.rawOutputAssetId = rawOcrAsset.id;

    const layerResult = evaluateTextLayerSafety({
      layer,
      expectedText: expected.expectedText,
      originalCropOcr: originalOcr.result,
      renderCropOcr: renderOcr.result,
      originalCropAssetId: originalCropAsset.id,
      renderCropAssetId: renderCropAsset.id,
    });

    layerResults.push(layerResult);
  }

  const level = aggregateTextSafetyLevel(layerResults);
  const passed = level === "pass";

  const textExactRate =
    textLayers.length === 0
      ? 1
      : layerResults.filter((result) => result.level === "pass").length /
        textLayers.length;

  const updatedDoc = updateDocumentWithTextSafety({
    doc,
    level,
    passed,
    layerResults,
    textExactRate,
  });

  const parsed = AiReconstructionDocumentSchema.parse(updatedDoc);

  assertReconstructionDocumentInvariants(parsed);

  const updatedDocAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "reconstruction-document-after-text-safety"
  );

  const updatedDocAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "assets",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("assets"),
    storagePath: reconstructionDocumentPath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: updatedDocAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 2), "utf8"),

    assetId: updatedDocAssetId,
    kind: "reconstruction_document",

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    source: "text_safety_validator",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    sourceAssetId: input.reconstructionDocumentAssetId,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  const passAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.jobId,
    "text-safety-pass"
  );

  const pass: TextSafetyPass = {
    schemaVersion: "ai-text-safety-pass.v1",

    jobId: input.jobId,
    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    userId: input.userId,

    sourceReconstructionDocumentAssetId:
      input.reconstructionDocumentAssetId,

    updatedReconstructionDocumentAssetId:
      updatedDocAsset.id,

    visualRenderAssetId:
      input.visualRenderAssetId,

    level,

    passed,

    textExactRate,

    layerCounts: {
      editableTextLayers: textLayers.length,
      passed: layerResults.filter((result) => result.level === "pass").length,
      needsReview: layerResults.filter((result) => result.level === "needs_review").length,
      failed: layerResults.filter((result) => result.level === "fail").length,
    },

    layerResults,

    failureReasons: [
      ...new Set(layerResults.flatMap((result) => result.failureReasons)),
    ],

    warnings: [
      ...new Set(layerResults.flatMap((result) => result.warnings)),
    ],

    createdAt: Date.now(),
  };

  const passAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "source",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
    storagePath: textSafetyPassReportPath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      jobId: input.jobId,
      assetId: passAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(pass, null, 2), "utf8"),

    assetId: passAssetId,
    kind: "text_safety_pass_json" as any,

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    jobId: input.jobId,

    source: "text_safety_validator",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    sourceAssetId: updatedDocAsset.id,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  return {
    updatedReconstructionDocument: parsed,
    updatedReconstructionDocumentAsset: updatedDocAsset,
    textSafetyPass: pass,
    textSafetyPassAsset: passAsset,
    diagnosticAssets,
  };
}

function aggregateTextSafetyLevel(
  layerResults: TextSafetyLayerResult[]
) {
  if (layerResults.some((result) => result.level === "fail")) {
    return "fail";
  }

  if (layerResults.some((result) => result.level === "needs_review")) {
    return "needs_review";
  }

  return "pass";
}

function updateDocumentWithTextSafety(input: {
  doc: AiReconstructionDocument;
  level: "pass" | "needs_review" | "fail";
  passed: boolean;
  layerResults: TextSafetyLayerResult[];
  textExactRate: number;
}): AiReconstructionDocument {
  const unsafeLayerIds = new Set(
    input.layerResults
      .filter((result) => result.level === "fail")
      .map((result) => result.layerId)
  );

  const reviewLayerIds = new Set(
    input.layerResults
      .filter((result) => result.level === "needs_review")
      .map((result) => result.layerId)
  );

  const layers = input.doc.layers.map((layer) => {
    const result = input.layerResults.find(
      (item) => item.layerId === layer.id
    );

    if (!result) return layer;

    return {
      ...layer,

      confidence: {
        ...layer.confidence,
        textSafety:
          result.level === "pass"
            ? 1
            : result.level === "needs_review"
              ? 0.55
              : 0,
      },

      metadata: {
        ...layer.metadata,
        needsReview:
          layer.metadata.needsReview ||
          reviewLayerIds.has(layer.id) ||
          unsafeLayerIds.has(layer.id),

        warnings: [
          ...(layer.metadata.warnings ?? []),
          ...result.warnings,
          ...result.failureReasons,
        ],
      },
    };
  });

  const warnings = [
    ...input.doc.quality.warnings,
    ...input.layerResults.flatMap((result) => result.warnings),
    ...input.layerResults.flatMap((result) => result.failureReasons),
  ];

  return {
    ...input.doc,

    updatedAt: Date.now(),

    layers,

    quality: {
      ...input.doc.quality,

      textExactRate: input.textExactRate,

      textSafetyLevel: input.level,

      textUnsafeLayerCount: unsafeLayerIds.size,

      textNeedsReviewLayerCount: reviewLayerIds.size,

      needsReview:
        input.doc.quality.needsReview ||
        input.level !== "pass",

      warnings: [...new Set(warnings)],

      artifacts: {
        ...input.doc.quality.artifacts,
      },
    },

    pipeline: {
      ...input.doc.pipeline,
      artifacts: {
        ...input.doc.pipeline.artifacts,
      },
    },

    audit: {
      ...input.doc.audit,
      textSafetyValidated: input.passed,
    },
  };
}

function stableAssetId(jobId: string, label: string) {
  return `asset_${jobId}_${label}`
    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "_")
    .toLowerCase();
}
```

Remove `as any` after patching your asset enum.

# 20.18 Firestore patch

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/text-safety/apply-text-safety-validation-result.ts
```

```ts
import {
  FieldValue,
  getFirestore,
} from "firebase-admin/firestore";

import type {
  TextSafetyValidationResult,
} from "./text-safety.types";

export async function applyTextSafetyValidationResult(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  jobId: string;
  result: TextSafetyValidationResult;
}) {
  const db = getFirestore();

  const designRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}`
  );

  const jobRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/aiLayerJobs/${input.jobId}`
  );

  const batch = db.batch();

  const assetsToIndex = [
    input.result.updatedReconstructionDocumentAsset,
    input.result.textSafetyPassAsset,
    ...input.result.diagnosticAssets,
  ];

  for (const asset of assetsToIndex) {
    batch.set(
      db.doc(
        `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/assets/${asset.id}`
      ),
      {
        id: asset.id,

        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        jobId: input.jobId,
        layerId: asset.metadata?.layerId,

        kind: asset.kind,
        storageRole: asset.storageRole,

        bucket: asset.bucket,
        storagePath: asset.storagePath,

        generation: asset.generation,
        metageneration: asset.metageneration,

        mimeType: asset.mimeType,

        width: asset.width,
        height: asset.height,
        sizeBytes: asset.sizeBytes,

        checksum: asset.checksum,

        source: asset.metadata?.source,

        retained: true,

        createdAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      },
      { merge: true }
    );
  }

  const level = input.result.textSafetyPass.level;

  batch.update(jobRef, {
    "output.reconstructionAssetId":
      input.result.updatedReconstructionDocumentAsset.id,

    textSafety: {
      textSafetyPassAssetId:
        input.result.textSafetyPassAsset.id,

      updatedReconstructionDocumentAssetId:
        input.result.updatedReconstructionDocumentAsset.id,

      level,

      passed:
        input.result.textSafetyPass.passed,

      textExactRate:
        input.result.textSafetyPass.textExactRate,

      layerCounts:
        input.result.textSafetyPass.layerCounts,

      failureReasons:
        input.result.textSafetyPass.failureReasons,

      warnings:
        input.result.textSafetyPass.warnings,

      createdAt:
        input.result.textSafetyPass.createdAt,
    },

    "quality.textExactRate":
      input.result.textSafetyPass.textExactRate,

    "quality.textSafetyLevel":
      level,

    "quality.needsReview":
      level !== "pass",

    "progress.percent": 99,

    "progress.label":
      level === "pass"
        ? "Text safety passed"
        : level === "needs_review"
          ? "Text safety needs review"
          : "Text safety failed",

    "progress.currentStep": "validating",

    updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
  });

  batch.update(designRef, {
    "source.currentReconstructionAssetId":
      input.result.updatedReconstructionDocumentAsset.id,

    "quality.textExactRate":
      input.result.textSafetyPass.textExactRate,

    "quality.textSafetyLevel":
      level,

    "quality.needsReview":
      level !== "pass",

    status:
      level === "fail"
        ? "failed"
        : level === "needs_review"
          ? "needs_review"
          : "ready",

    updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
  });

  if (level === "fail") {
    batch.update(jobRef, {
      status: "failed",

      error: {
        code: "text_safety_failed",
        message:
          "One or more editable text layers failed semantic preservation validation.",
        retryable: false,
        failedStep: "text_safety_validation",
      },

      updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });
  }

  await batch.commit();
}
```

If Step 19 had already set `needs_review`, preserve that state by reading job/design before final status if needed. The safest production implementation should compute:

```txt
ready only if visualValidation.level = pass and textSafety.level = pass and reconstruction.quality.needsReview = false
```

# 20.19 Worker integration

Patch the `validating` step after Step 19.

```ts
await runStep(context, "validating", async () => {
  const job = await loadMagicLayersJob(context);

  /**
   * Step 19 should already have updated this pointer.
   */
  const reconstructionAssetId =
    job.output.reconstructionAssetId;

  const visualRenderAssetId =
    job.visualValidation?.renderAssetId;

  if (!reconstructionAssetId) {
    throw new Error("missing_reconstruction_asset_id");
  }

  if (!visualRenderAssetId) {
    throw new Error("missing_visual_render_asset_id");
  }

  const reconstructionDocument =
    await loadReconstructionDocumentFromAsset({
      workspaceId: context.workspaceId,
      designId: context.designId,
      assetId: reconstructionAssetId,
    });

  const result = await runTextSafetyValidationPass({
    workspaceId: context.workspaceId,
    designId: context.designId,
    jobId: context.jobId,
    userId: job.userId,

    reconstructionDocument,

    reconstructionDocumentAssetId:
      reconstructionAssetId,

    visualRenderAssetId,
  });

  await applyTextSafetyValidationResult({
    workspaceId: context.workspaceId,
    designId: context.designId,
    jobId: context.jobId,
    result,
  });

  if (result.textSafetyPass.level === "fail") {
    throw new Error("text_safety_failed");
  }
});
```

After this, the worker may mark the job completed only if:

```txt
visual validation did not fail
text safety did not fail
```

---

# 20.20 Final completion rule

Patch `markCompleted(...)` from Step 5 so it does not blindly mark every surviving job as ready.

```ts
async function markCompleted(context: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  jobId: string;
}) {
  const db = getFirestore();

  const jobRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${context.workspaceId}/designs/${context.designId}/aiLayerJobs/${context.jobId}`
  );

  const designRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${context.workspaceId}/designs/${context.designId}`
  );

  await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
    const jobSnap = await tx.get(jobRef);

    if (!jobSnap.exists) {
      throw new Error("job_not_found");
    }

    const job = jobSnap.data()!;

    if (job.status === "failed" || job.status === "cancelled") {
      return;
    }

    const visualLevel = job.visualValidation?.level;
    const textLevel = job.textSafety?.level;

    const needsReview =
      visualLevel !== "pass" ||
      textLevel !== "pass" ||
      job.quality?.needsReview === true;

    tx.update(jobRef, {
      status: "completed",

      "progress.percent": 100,
      "progress.label": needsReview ? "Needs review" : "Ready",

      completedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      "orchestration.execution.executionCompletedAt":
        FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),

      updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });

    tx.update(designRef, {
      status: needsReview ? "needs_review" : "ready",
      updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });
  });
}
```

This is important:

```txt
completed job does not always mean ready design.
completed + needs_review is valid.
failed means unsafe/unusable automatic reconstruction.
```

---

# 20.21 Safety decision matrix

| Condition | Step 20 result | Job behavior |
|---|---:|---|
| No editable text layers | `pass` | Continue |
| Layer text equals expected, OCR readable and matching | `pass` | Continue |
| Layer text equals expected, OCR weak/unreadable | `needs_review` | Complete as needs_review |
| Stored layer text differs from expected | `fail` | Stop |
| Protected token mismatch | `fail` | Stop |
| High-confidence original OCR disagrees with expected | `fail` | Stop |
| High-confidence rendered OCR disagrees with expected | `fail` | Stop |
| Medium-confidence OCR disagreement | `needs_review` | Complete as needs_review |
| Existing `semanticMutationDetected=true` | `fail` | Stop |

---

# 20.22 Why this does not auto-repair

The tempting move is:

```txt
unsafe text → automatically downgrade to raster fallback → regenerate Fabric
```

Do not do that inside Step 20.

Reason:

```txt
validator must be deterministic and side-effect-minimal
repair creates a new scene
new scene requires Step 17/18/19/20 again
repair belongs to Step 25
```

Step 20 should output:

```txt
recommendedRepair = downgrade_to_raster_fallback
```

but not perform it.

---

# 20.23 What Step 20 must not do

Do not:

```txt
rewrite text
correct spelling
translate text
choose alternative OCR text
call Gemini to interpret meaning
downgrade layers automatically
regenerate Fabric manifest
regenerate preview
mark unsafe text as warning-only
```

No LLM should be allowed to decide that different visible text is “semantically close enough.” Use deterministic comparison and protected-token checks.

---

# 20.24 Non-negotiable invariants

Step 20 is valid only if:

```txt
Only visible text_editable layers are validated.

Expected text is taken from accepted text_candidate / original OCR state.

Stored layer text must match expected text after normalization.

Original crop OCR is run or explicitly marked missing.

Rendered crop OCR is run or explicitly marked missing.

Protected tokens are compared exactly.

Semantic mutation causes fail.

OCR uncertainty causes needs_review, not pass.

A text safety pass report is stored.

Updated reconstruction document is stored.

audit.textSafetyValidated is true only when all text passes.

Firestore stores summary and pointers only.

No text is modified.

No Fabric JSON is regenerated.

No job is marked ready unless visual and text safety both pass.
```

# 20.26 Definition of done

Step 20 is complete when:

```txt
Every visible editable text layer is checked.

Expected source text is resolved.

Original crop is extracted.

Rendered crop is extracted.

OCR is run on both crops.

Stored text is compared to expected text.

Rendered OCR is compared to expected text.

Protected tokens are compared exactly.

Each text layer gets pass / needs_review / fail.

Global text safety gets pass / needs_review / fail.

Updated reconstruction document is stored.

Text safety pass report is stored.

Firestore points to updated reconstruction document.

Unsafe semantic mutation fails the job.

Uncertain text marks needs_review.

No repair happens inside the validator.
```

Locked Step 20 architecture:

```txt
Updated reconstruction document
+ visual render PNG
+ normalized original PNG
→ crop each editable text layer
→ OCR original crop
→ OCR rendered crop
→ deterministic text comparison
→ protected token comparison
→ text safety pass report
→ updated reconstruction audit/quality
→ Firestore final validation state
```

Next is Step 21: **User-facing layer panel**.

## ChatGPT Response 031

<!-- assistant_message_ids: 3cdebcbf-7256-4073-bdd8-230280adeceb, 6ffa3019-b851-4858-b12a-864d3d386504, b4737e97-9fae-4615-82d2-8bd34f72cc56 -->

Step 21 shifts from backend reconstruction into editor UX. The layer panel must manipulate Fabric runtime state while preserving the reconstruction document as immutable provenance.

It should surface confidence, warnings, fallbacks, and editable status, while all user actions operate on Fabric objects and saved editor state—not reconstruction truth.

# Step 21 — User-facing layer panel

Step 21 turns the generated Fabric runtime manifest into a usable **AI-aware layer panel**.

The locked rule:

```txt
The layer panel controls Fabric runtime objects.
It does not mutate AiReconstructionDocument.
It does not run AI repair.
It does not regenerate Fabric JSON.
```

This step is editor UX, not reconstruction. The panel’s job is to expose the AI layer system safely:

```txt
show layers
show confidence
show fallback state
show warnings
select objects
toggle visibility
lock/unlock
reorder
rename
duplicate/delete locally
display logical groups
```

Fabric already has stack manipulation APIs such as `bringObjectForward`, `bringObjectToFront`, `sendObjectBackwards`, and `sendObjectToBack`, so the panel should use Fabric’s public object stack APIs, not mutate internal object arrays. citeturn341640view0

---

# 21.1 What Step 21 owns

Step 21 owns:

```txt
layer panel data model
Fabric object ↔ AI layer mapping
selection sync
visibility sync
lock sync
reorder commands
rename commands
group display metadata
confidence/warning UI
fallback indicators
review indicators
keyboard-accessible tree/list behavior
local dirty-state tracking
```

Step 21 does **not** own:

```txt
autosave
Firestore version writes
repair loops
fallback restoration execution
AI regeneration
export
visual validation
text safety validation
Fabric manifest generation
canonical reconstruction mutation
```

Autosave/versioning is Step 23. Repair is Step 25. Export is later. This step is strictly the editor control surface.

---

# 21.2 Data sources

The layer panel should derive its state from three things:

```txt
1. AiFabricRuntimeManifest
   layerIndex
   logicalGroups
   fabricJson object metadata
   assets/fallback pointers

2. Fabric canvas runtime
   object order
   selected objects
   visible/locked/object state
   deleted/duplicated/reordered objects

3. AiReconstructionDocument summary
   optional deeper provenance
   warnings
   confidence
   fallback metadata
```

Do not build the panel only from Firestore.

Do not build it only from Fabric objects.

Correct:

```txt
Fabric canvas = current editable runtime state
Manifest layerIndex = AI identity map
Reconstruction document = immutable provenance
```

Firestore can listen for job/design state updates with `onSnapshot`, but that listener should update processing/validation status, not drive per-drag layer mutations. Firebase’s docs describe `onSnapshot()` as producing an initial document snapshot and then updates when the document changes. citeturn341640view3

---

# 21.3 Display order

Fabric object order is bottom-to-top draw order.

The layer panel should display top-to-bottom:

```txt
frontmost layer at top
backmost layer at bottom
```

So:

```ts
panelRows = canvas.getObjects().reverse()
```

But for actual Fabric stack operations:

```txt
bottom-to-top index = canvas.getObjects() index
```

Do not confuse:

```txt
panel row index
```

with:

```txt
Fabric object stack index
```

This is one of the most common layer panel bugs.

---

# 21.4 Group rule

Groups remain logical metadata.

Do **not** create `fabric.Group` in Step 21.

Default behavior:

```txt
show group rows
allow expand/collapse
allow select children
allow select group as multi-selection
do not reparent Fabric objects
do not wrap children in Fabric.Group
```

Reason:

```txt
Fabric grouping changes object interaction, hit testing, transforms, and serialization behavior.
```

The WAI tree view pattern is the right accessibility model for a hierarchical layer panel because it defines expandable/collapsible parent nodes and selectable child nodes. citeturn341640view2

---

# 21.5 Layer panel UI contract

Each row should show:

```txt
thumbnail/icon
layer name
layer type
editable level
confidence badge
warning badge
fallback badge
visibility toggle
lock toggle
group membership
```

Example labels:

```txt
Headline
text · editable · 94%

Logo
logo · raster fallback · 61%

Product
product · masked raster · 88%

Clean background
generated background · needs review · 72%

Original reference
locked reference · 100%
```

Do not show:

```txt
Layer 1
Layer 2
Object 3
```

The panel must make AI uncertainty visible.

# 21.7 Build the panel model

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/layer-panel/build-layer-panel-model.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  Canvas,
  FabricObject,
} from "fabric";

import type {
  AiFabricRuntimeManifest,
} from "../fabric-generator/fabric-generator.types";

import type {
  LayerPanelGroupNode,
  LayerPanelLayerNode,
  LayerPanelModel,
  LayerPanelNode,
} from "./layer-panel.types";

export function buildLayerPanelModel(input: {
  canvas: Canvas;
  manifest: AiFabricRuntimeManifest;

  expandedGroupIds: Set<string>;

  dirty: boolean;
}): LayerPanelModel {
  const objects = input.canvas.getObjects();

  const activeObjects = new Set(
    input.canvas
      .getActiveObjects()
      .map((object) => object.aiLayerId)
      .filter((id): id is string => Boolean(id))
  );

  const activeLayerId =
    input.canvas.getActiveObject()?.aiLayerId;

  const layerNodes = objects
    .map((object, objectIndex) => {
      const layerId = object.aiLayerId;

      if (!layerId) return null;

      const entry = input.manifest.layerIndex[layerId];

      if (!entry) return null;

      return fabricObjectToLayerNode({
        object,
        objectIndex,
        displayIndex: objects.length - 1 - objectIndex,
        entry,
        selected: activeObjects.has(layerId),
        active: activeLayerId === layerId,
      });
    })
    .filter((node): node is LayerPanelLayerNode => Boolean(node));

  const groupNodes = input.manifest.logicalGroups.map(
    (group): LayerPanelGroupNode => {
      const confidenceLabel = confidenceLabelFor(
        group.confidence?.overall
      );

      const needsReview =
        confidenceLabel === "low" ||
        confidenceLabel === "unknown" ||
        group.editorBehavior === "manual_review";

      return {
        kind: "group",

        id: `group-node-${group.id}`,

        groupId: group.id,

        name: group.name,

        role: group.role,

        expanded: input.expandedGroupIds.has(group.id),

        selected: group.childLayerIds.some((layerId) =>
          activeObjects.has(layerId)
        ),

        active: false,

        childLayerIds: group.childLayerIds,

        childObjectIndices: group.childObjectIndices,

        zIndexRange: group.zIndexRange,

        confidence: group.confidence,

        confidenceLabel,

        needsReview,

        warningLevel: needsReview ? "warning" : "none",

        warnings: needsReview
          ? ["group_needs_review"]
          : [],

        canSelect: true,

        canRename: true,

        canUngroup: true,
      };
    }
  );

  const nodes = composePanelNodes({
    layerNodes,
    groupNodes,
  });

  return {
    nodes,

    layerNodes,

    groupNodes,

    selectedLayerIds: [...activeObjects],

    activeLayerId,

    objectCount: objects.length,

    needsReviewCount: nodes.filter((node) => node.needsReview).length,

    warningCount: nodes.filter(
      (node) => node.warningLevel !== "none"
    ).length,

    dirty: input.dirty,
  };
}

function fabricObjectToLayerNode(input: {
  object: FabricObject;
  objectIndex: number;
  displayIndex: number;
  entry: AiFabricRuntimeManifest["layerIndex"][string];
  selected: boolean;
  active: boolean;
}): LayerPanelLayerNode {
  const {
    object,
    objectIndex,
    displayIndex,
    entry,
  } = input;

  const confidence =
    object.aiConfidence ??
    ({
      overall: 0,
    } as any);

  const confidenceLabel = confidenceLabelFor(confidence.overall);

  const warnings = [
    ...(entry.warnings ?? []),
    ...(confidenceLabel === "low"
      ? ["low_confidence_layer"]
      : []),
  ];

  const locked =
    object.lockMovementX === true &&
    object.lockMovementY === true &&
    object.lockScalingX === true &&
    object.lockScalingY === true;

  return {
    kind: "layer",

    id: `layer-node-${entry.aiLayerId}`,

    layerId: entry.aiLayerId,

    objectIndex,

    displayIndex,

    zIndex: entry.zIndex,

    name: object.name ?? entry.name,

    layerType: entry.layerType,

    editableLevel: entry.editableLevel,

    visible: object.visible !== false,

    locked,

    selected: input.selected,

    active: input.active,

    confidence,

    confidenceLabel,

    needsReview:
      warnings.length > 0 ||
      confidenceLabel === "low" ||
      confidenceLabel === "unknown",

    warningLevel:
      warnings.length > 0
        ? confidenceLabel === "low"
          ? "critical"
          : "warning"
        : "none",

    warnings,

    hasFallback: entry.fallbackAssetIds.length > 0,

    primaryFallbackAssetId: entry.primaryFallbackAssetId,

    assetIds: entry.assetIds,

    fallbackAssetIds: entry.fallbackAssetIds,

    groupIds: entry.groupIds ?? [],

    bbox: entry.canvasBBox,

    canSelect: object.selectable !== false,
    canMove: !object.lockMovementX && !object.lockMovementY,
    canResize: !object.lockScalingX && !object.lockScalingY,
    canRotate: !object.lockRotation,
    canRename: true,
    canDelete: entry.editableLevel !== "locked_reference",
    canDuplicate: entry.editableLevel !== "locked_reference",
    canReorder: entry.editableLevel !== "locked_reference",
    canEditText: entry.editableLevel === "text_editable",
    canEditVector: entry.editableLevel === "vector_editable",
    canReplaceAsset:
      entry.editableLevel === "raster_masked" ||
      entry.editableLevel === "raster_fallback",
    canRestoreFallback: entry.fallbackAssetIds.length > 0,
  };
}

function composePanelNodes(input: {
  layerNodes: LayerPanelLayerNode[];
  groupNodes: LayerPanelGroupNode[];
}): LayerPanelNode[] {
  /**
   * Day-one behavior:
   * - show groups as metadata sections
   * - show all layers in actual front-to-back order
   * - do not remove child layers from main list
   *
   * Later, you can enable nested display with a primary-group assignment.
   */
  const frontToBackLayers = [...input.layerNodes].sort(
    (a, b) => b.objectIndex - a.objectIndex
  );

  const usefulGroups = input.groupNodes.filter(
    (group) => group.childLayerIds.length >= 2
  );

  return [
    ...usefulGroups.sort(
      (a, b) => b.zIndexRange.max - a.zIndexRange.max
    ),
    ...frontToBackLayers,
  ];
}

function confidenceLabelFor(
  value: number | undefined
): "high" | "medium" | "low" | "unknown" {
  if (typeof value !== "number") return "unknown";

  if (value >= 0.82) return "high";

  if (value >= 0.62) return "medium";

  return "low";
}
```

Important: this model is derived from Fabric runtime state. Do not persist it directly.

# 21.8 Resolve Fabric objects by AI layer ID

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/layer-panel/fabric-layer-lookup.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  Canvas,
  FabricObject,
} from "fabric";

export function getFabricObjectByLayerId(input: {
  canvas: Canvas;
  layerId: string;
}): FabricObject | undefined {
  return input.canvas
    .getObjects()
    .find((object) => object.aiLayerId === input.layerId);
}

export function getFabricObjectsByLayerIds(input: {
  canvas: Canvas;
  layerIds: string[];
}): FabricObject[] {
  const ids = new Set(input.layerIds);

  return input.canvas
    .getObjects()
    .filter((object) => object.aiLayerId && ids.has(object.aiLayerId));
}

export function getLayerIdForFabricObject(
  object: FabricObject
): string | undefined {
  return object.aiLayerId;
}
```

Do not search by Fabric `type`. Use `aiLayerId`.

```ts
import {

import {

} from "./fabric-layer-lookup";

export function applyLayerPanelCommand(input: {
  canvas: Canvas;
  manifest: AiFabricRuntimeManifest;
  command: LayerPanelCommand;
  markDirty: () => void;
}) {
  const {
    canvas,
    manifest,
    command,
  } = input;

  switch (command.type) {
    case "select_layer":
      selectLayer({
        canvas,
        layerId: command.layerId,
        additive: command.additive,
      });
      break;

    case "select_group":
      selectGroup({
        canvas,
        manifest,
        groupId: command.groupId,
        additive: command.additive,
      });
      break;

    case "toggle_visibility":
      toggleVisibility({
        canvas,
        layerId: command.layerId,
      });
      input.markDirty();
      break;

    case "set_visibility":
      setVisibility({
        canvas,
        layerId: command.layerId,
        visible: command.visible,
      });
      input.markDirty();
      break;

    case "toggle_lock":
      toggleLock({
        canvas,
        layerId: command.layerId,
      });
      input.markDirty();
      break;

    case "set_locked":
      setLocked({
        canvas,
        layerId: command.layerId,
        locked: command.locked,
      });
      input.markDirty();
      break;

    case "rename_layer":
      renameLayer({
        canvas,
        layerId: command.layerId,
        name: command.name,
      });
      input.markDirty();
      break;

    case "delete_layer":
      deleteLayer({
        canvas,
        layerId: command.layerId,
      });
      input.markDirty();
      break;

    case "duplicate_layer":
      duplicateLayer({
        canvas,
        layerId: command.layerId,
      });
      input.markDirty();
      break;

    case "bring_to_front":
      bringToFront({
        canvas,
        layerId: command.layerId,
      });
      input.markDirty();
      break;

    case "send_to_back":
      sendToBack({
        canvas,
        layerId: command.layerId,
      });
      input.markDirty();
      break;

    case "move_layer":
      moveLayerToDisplayIndex({
        canvas,
        layerId: command.layerId,
        toDisplayIndex: command.toDisplayIndex,
      });
      input.markDirty();
      break;

    case "restore_fallback":
      /**
       * Step 25 owns fallback restoration.
       * Step 21 only emits this command.
       */
      throw new Error("restore_fallback_is_step_25");

    case "rename_group":
      /**
       * Rename logical group in editor-local UI state.
       * Do not mutate reconstruction document here.
       */
      input.markDirty();
      break;

    default:
      assertNever(command);
  }

  canvas.requestRenderAll();
}

function selectLayer(input: {
  canvas: Canvas;
  layerId: string;
  additive?: boolean;
}) {
  const object = getFabricObjectByLayerId(input);

  if (!object) return;

  if (!input.additive) {
    input.canvas.discardActiveObject();
    input.canvas.setActiveObject(object);
    input.canvas.requestRenderAll();
    return;
  }

  const existing = input.canvas.getActiveObjects();

  const objects = uniqueObjects([...existing, object]);

  if (objects.length === 1) {
    input.canvas.setActiveObject(objects[0]);
  } else {
    const selection = new ActiveSelection(objects, {
      canvas: input.canvas,
    });

    input.canvas.setActiveObject(selection);
  }

  input.canvas.requestRenderAll();
}

function selectGroup(input: {
  canvas: Canvas;
  manifest: AiFabricRuntimeManifest;
  groupId: string;
  additive?: boolean;
}) {
  const group = input.manifest.logicalGroups.find(
    (item) => item.id === input.groupId
  );

  if (!group) return;

  const objects = getFabricObjectsByLayerIds({
    canvas: input.canvas,
    layerIds: group.childLayerIds,
  });

  if (!objects.length) return;

  if (!input.additive) {
    input.canvas.discardActiveObject();
  }

  const selectionObjects = uniqueObjects([
    ...input.canvas.getActiveObjects(),
    ...objects,
  ]);

  const selection =
    selectionObjects.length === 1
      ? selectionObjects[0]
      : new ActiveSelection(selectionObjects, {
          canvas: input.canvas,
        });

  input.canvas.setActiveObject(selection);
  input.canvas.requestRenderAll();
}

function toggleVisibility(input: {
  canvas: Canvas;
  layerId: string;
}) {
  const object = getFabricObjectByLayerId(input);

  if (!object) return;

  object.set({
    visible: object.visible === false,
  });

  object.setCoords();
}

function setVisibility(input: {
  canvas: Canvas;
  layerId: string;
  visible: boolean;
}) {
  const object = getFabricObjectByLayerId(input);

  if (!object) return;

  object.set({
    visible: input.visible,
  });

  object.setCoords();
}

function toggleLock(input: {
  canvas: Canvas;
  layerId: string;
}) {
  const object = getFabricObjectByLayerId(input);

  if (!object) return;

  const locked =
    object.lockMovementX &&
    object.lockMovementY &&
    object.lockScalingX &&
    object.lockScalingY &&
    object.lockRotation;

  setObjectLocked(object, !locked);
}

function setLocked(input: {
  canvas: Canvas;
  layerId: string;
  locked: boolean;
}) {
  const object = getFabricObjectByLayerId(input);

  if (!object) return;

  setObjectLocked(object, input.locked);
}

function setObjectLocked(
  object: FabricObject,
  locked: boolean
) {
  object.set({
    selectable: !locked,
    evented: !locked,

    hasControls: !locked,
    hasBorders: !locked,

    lockMovementX: locked,
    lockMovementY: locked,

    lockScalingX: locked,
    lockScalingY: locked,

    lockRotation: locked,
  });

  object.setCoords();
}

function renameLayer(input: {
  canvas: Canvas;
  layerId: string;
  name: string;
}) {
  const object = getFabricObjectByLayerId(input);

  if (!object) return;

  object.set({
    name: input.name.trim() || object.name,
  });
}

function deleteLayer(input: {
  canvas: Canvas;
  layerId: string;
}) {
  const object = getFabricObjectByLayerId(input);

  if (!object) return;

  if (object.aiEditableLevel === "locked_reference") return;

  input.canvas.remove(object);
  input.canvas.discardActiveObject();
}

async function duplicateLayer(input: {
  canvas: Canvas;
  layerId: string;
}) {
  const object = getFabricObjectByLayerId(input);

  if (!object) return;

  if (object.aiEditableLevel === "locked_reference") return;

  const cloned = await object.clone([
    "id",
    "name",
    "aiLayerId",
    "aiLayerType",
    "aiEditableLevel",
    "aiConfidence",
    "aiSource",
    "aiFallbackAssetId",
    "aiSourceAssetId",
    "aiSchemaVersion",
  ]);

  const duplicateId = `${object.aiLayerId}_duplicate_${Date.now()}`;

  cloned.set({
    id: duplicateId,
    name: `${object.name ?? "Layer"} copy`,

    aiLayerId: duplicateId,

    left: (object.left ?? 0) + 16,
    top: (object.top ?? 0) + 16,
  });

  input.canvas.add(cloned);
  input.canvas.setActiveObject(cloned);
}

function bringToFront(input: {
  canvas: Canvas;
  layerId: string;
}) {
  const object = getFabricObjectByLayerId(input);

  if (!object) return;

  if (object.aiEditableLevel === "locked_reference") return;

  input.canvas.bringObjectToFront(object);
}

function sendToBack(input: {
  canvas: Canvas;
  layerId: string;
}) {
  const object = getFabricObjectByLayerId(input);

  if (!object) return;

  if (object.aiEditableLevel === "locked_reference") return;

  input.canvas.sendObjectToBack(object);

  /**
   * Keep locked reference below everything.
   */
  const reference = input.canvas
    .getObjects()
    .find((item) => item.aiEditableLevel === "locked_reference");

  if (reference) {
    input.canvas.sendObjectToBack(reference);
  }
}

function moveLayerToDisplayIndex(input: {
  canvas: Canvas;
  layerId: string;
  toDisplayIndex: number;
}) {
  const objects = input.canvas.getObjects();

  const object = getFabricObjectByLayerId(input);

  if (!object) return;

  if (object.aiEditableLevel === "locked_reference") return;

  /**
   * display index is top-to-bottom.
   * Fabric index is bottom-to-top.
   */
  const toFabricIndex =
    objects.length - 1 - input.toDisplayIndex;

  moveObjectToIndex({
    canvas: input.canvas,
    object,
    index: clamp(toFabricIndex, 0, objects.length - 1),
  });

  keepLockedReferenceAtBack(input.canvas);
}

function moveObjectToIndex(input: {
  canvas: Canvas;
  object: FabricObject;
  index: number;
}) {
  /**
   * Fabric has public stack APIs for common movement.
   * For exact arbitrary index, use remove/insert rather than mutating _objects.
   */
  const objects = input.canvas.getObjects();
  const currentIndex = objects.indexOf(input.object);

  if (currentIndex < 0 || currentIndex === input.index) return;

  input.canvas.remove(input.object);

  input.canvas.insertAt(input.index, input.object);

  input.object.setCoords();
}

function keepLockedReferenceAtBack(canvas: Canvas) {
  const reference = canvas
    .getObjects()
    .find((object) => object.aiEditableLevel === "locked_reference");

  if (reference) {
    canvas.sendObjectToBack(reference);
  }
}

function uniqueObjects(objects: FabricObject[]) {
  return [...new Set(objects)];
}

function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number) {
  return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
}

function assertNever(value: never): never {
  throw new Error(`Unhandled layer panel command: ${JSON.stringify(value)}`);
}
```

Notes:

```txt
bring/send uses Fabric public stack APIs.
arbitrary exact move uses remove + insertAt.
never mutate canvas._objects directly.
```

Fabric docs also state that after changing position or dimension-related properties, `setCoords()` is needed to update borders/controls, which is why commands call it after object mutations. citeturn341640view0

# 21.10 Hook for layer panel state

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/layer-panel/use-layer-panel-model.ts
```

```ts
import {
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from "react";

import type {
  Canvas,
} from "fabric";

import type {
  AiFabricRuntimeManifest,
} from "../fabric-generator/fabric-generator.types";

import {
  buildLayerPanelModel,
} from "./build-layer-panel-model";

export function useLayerPanelModel(input: {
  canvas: Canvas | null;
  manifest: AiFabricRuntimeManifest | null;
  dirty: boolean;
}) {
  const [revision, setRevision] = useState(0);

  const [expandedGroupIds, setExpandedGroupIds] = useState<Set<string>>(
    () => new Set()
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = input.canvas;

    if (!canvas) return;

    const bump = () => setRevision((value) => value + 1);

    canvas.on("selection:created", bump);
    canvas.on("selection:updated", bump);
    canvas.on("selection:cleared", bump);
    canvas.on("object:modified", bump);
    canvas.on("object:added", bump);
    canvas.on("object:removed", bump);

    return () => {
      canvas.off("selection:created", bump);
      canvas.off("selection:updated", bump);
      canvas.off("selection:cleared", bump);
      canvas.off("object:modified", bump);
      canvas.off("object:added", bump);
      canvas.off("object:removed", bump);
    };
  }, [input.canvas]);

  const model = useMemo(() => {
    if (!input.canvas || !input.manifest) return null;

    return buildLayerPanelModel({
      canvas: input.canvas,
      manifest: input.manifest,
      expandedGroupIds,
      dirty: input.dirty,
    });
  }, [
    input.canvas,
    input.manifest,
    input.dirty,
    expandedGroupIds,
    revision,
  ]);

  return {
    model,

    expandedGroupIds,

    toggleGroupExpanded(groupId: string) {
      setExpandedGroupIds((prev) => {
        const next = new Set(prev);

        if (next.has(groupId)) {
          next.delete(groupId);
        } else {
          next.add(groupId);
        }

        return next;
      });
    },
  };
}
```

This hook listens to Fabric runtime state. It does not write Firestore.

# 21.11 React panel shell

Create:

```txt
src/components/magic-layers/LayerPanel.tsx
```

```tsx
"use client";

import type {
  Canvas,
} from "fabric";

import type {
  AiFabricRuntimeManifest,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/fabric-generator/fabric-generator.types";

import {
  applyLayerPanelCommand,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/layer-panel/apply-layer-panel-command";

import {
  useLayerPanelModel,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/layer-panel/use-layer-panel-model";

import type {
  LayerPanelNode,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/layer-panel/layer-panel.types";

export function LayerPanel(props: {
  canvas: Canvas | null;

  manifest: AiFabricRuntimeManifest | null;

  dirty: boolean;

  markDirty: () => void;
}) {
  const {
    model,
    toggleGroupExpanded,
  } = useLayerPanelModel({
    canvas: props.canvas,
    manifest: props.manifest,
    dirty: props.dirty,
  });

  if (!model || !props.canvas || !props.manifest) {
    return (
      <aside className="layer-panel">
        <div className="layer-panel__empty">
          No layers loaded
        </div>
      </aside>
    );
  }

  return (
    <aside
      className="layer-panel"
      aria-label="Layers"
    >
      <header className="layer-panel__header">
        <div>
          <strong>Layers</strong>
          {model.dirty ? (
            <span className="layer-panel__dirty">Unsaved</span>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        {model.needsReviewCount > 0 ? (
          <span className="layer-panel__review">
            {model.needsReviewCount} needs review
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </header>

      <div
        role="tree"
        aria-label="Magic Layers"
        className="layer-panel__tree"
      >
        {model.nodes.map((node) => (
          <LayerPanelRow
            key={node.id}
            node={node}
            onToggleGroupExpanded={toggleGroupExpanded}
            onCommand={(command) =>
              applyLayerPanelCommand({
                canvas: props.canvas!,
                manifest: props.manifest!,
                command,
                markDirty: props.markDirty,
              })
            }
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
}

function LayerPanelRow(props: {
  node: LayerPanelNode;

  onToggleGroupExpanded: (groupId: string) => void;

  onCommand: Parameters<typeof applyLayerPanelCommand>[0]["command"] extends infer Command
    ? (command: Command) => void
    : never;
}) {
  const { node } = props;

  if (node.kind === "group") {
    return (
      <div
        role="treeitem"
        aria-expanded={node.expanded}
        aria-selected={node.selected}
        className={rowClassName(node)}
      >
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => props.onToggleGroupExpanded(node.groupId)}
          aria-label={node.expanded ? "Collapse group" : "Expand group"}
        >
          {node.expanded ? "▾" : "▸"}
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          className="layer-panel__name"
          onClick={() =>
            props.onCommand({
              type: "select_group",
              groupId: node.groupId,
            } as any)
          }
        >
          {node.name}
        </button>

        <span className="layer-panel__meta">
          {node.role} · {node.confidenceLabel}
        </span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      role="treeitem"
      aria-selected={node.selected}
      className={rowClassName(node)}
    >
      <button
        type="button"
        aria-label={node.visible ? "Hide layer" : "Show layer"}
        onClick={() =>
          props.onCommand({
            type: "toggle_visibility",
            layerId: node.layerId,
          } as any)
        }
      >
        {node.visible ? "👁" : "○"}
      </button>

      <button
        type="button"
        aria-label={node.locked ? "Unlock layer" : "Lock layer"}
        onClick={() =>
          props.onCommand({
            type: "toggle_lock",
            layerId: node.layerId,
          } as any)
        }
      >
        {node.locked ? "🔒" : "🔓"}
      </button>

      <button
        type="button"
        className="layer-panel__name"
        onClick={() =>
          props.onCommand({
            type: "select_layer",
            layerId: node.layerId,
          } as any)
        }
      >
        {node.name}
      </button>

      <span className="layer-panel__meta">
        {node.layerType} · {labelEditableLevel(node.editableLevel)} ·{" "}
        {node.confidenceLabel}
      </span>

      {node.hasFallback ? (
        <span className="layer-panel__badge">
          fallback
        </span>
      ) : null}

      {node.needsReview ? (
        <span className="layer-panel__badge layer-panel__badge--warning">
          review
        </span>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

function rowClassName(node: LayerPanelNode) {
  return [
    "layer-panel__row",
    node.selected ? "layer-panel__row--selected" : "",
    node.active ? "layer-panel__row--active" : "",
    node.needsReview ? "layer-panel__row--review" : "",
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(" ");
}

function labelEditableLevel(level: string) {
  switch (level) {
    case "text_editable":
      return "editable text";

    case "vector_editable":
      return "editable vector";

    case "raster_masked":
      return "masked raster";

    case "raster_clean_background":
      return "clean background";

    case "raster_fallback":
      return "raster fallback";

    case "locked_reference":
      return "reference";

    default:
      return level;
  }
}
```

The `as any` casts in the row callbacks should be removed once the command prop type is simplified in your component system. The model and command types are already explicit.

# 21.12 Keyboard behavior

The layer panel should behave like a tree/list:

```txt
Arrow Up / Down
  move focus between rows

Enter / Space
  select row

Shift + Arrow
  extend selection

Left / Right
  collapse / expand group rows

Delete
  delete selected layer if allowed

Cmd/Ctrl + D
  duplicate selected layer

Cmd/Ctrl + ]
  bring forward

Cmd/Ctrl + [
  send backward
```

This should follow the WAI tree view semantics where rows are tree items, parent items can be expanded/collapsed, and selection is separate from keyboard focus. citeturn341640view2

Do not implement drag-only reordering. Keyboard reorder is required for accessibility and power users.

---

# 21.13 Drag reorder contract

Drag reorder should only reorder Fabric objects.

It should not update:

```txt
AiReconstructionDocument.layers
AiReconstructionDocument.groups
Firestore design doc
```

Step 23 autosave stores the edited Fabric runtime JSON.

Reorder rules:

```txt
locked_reference cannot be moved above other objects
clean_background cannot be moved above foreground by default unless user explicitly unlocks advanced mode
group rows are not reordered as Fabric.Group
dragging a group selects/reorders child objects together only if select-as-group mode is active
```

Day-one simpler rule:

```txt
allow drag reorder only for individual layer rows
group rows are display-only
```

This avoids breaking z-order semantics.

---

# 21.14 Review indicators

Use these badges:

```txt
High confidence
  no badge or subtle confidence

Medium confidence
  “review” badge

Low confidence
  “low confidence” badge

Fallback attached
  “fallback” badge

Generated background
  “generated” badge

Unsafe text
  should not appear in ready jobs
  if present, show critical warning

Visual validation failed
  editor should open in review/diagnostic mode only
```

Layer row warnings should come from:

```txt
layer.metadata.warnings
layer.metadata.needsReview
layer.confidence
manifest.reconstruction.warnings
```

Do not invent warnings in the panel that are not backed by metadata. UI can summarize, but not fabricate.

# 21.15 Layer actions matrix

| Editable level | Select | Move | Resize | Text edit | Vector edit | Replace | Mask edit | Restore fallback |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `locked_reference` | limited | no | no | no | no | no | no | yes |
| `text_editable` | yes | yes | yes | yes | no | no | no | yes |
| `vector_editable` | yes | yes | yes | no | yes | no | no | yes |
| `raster_masked` | yes | yes | yes | no | no | yes | yes | yes |
| `raster_clean_background` | yes | limited | no | no | no | yes | no | yes |
| `raster_fallback` | yes | yes | yes | no | no | limited | no | yes |
| `unknown_confidence` | yes | yes | yes | no | no | no | no | yes |

The panel should hide disabled controls instead of letting users click actions that fail silently.

# 21.16 Dirty state

Step 21 should only set local dirty state:

```ts
markDirty()
```

It should not save.

Dirty events:

```txt
visibility changed
lock changed
selection not dirty
rename changed
object moved
object resized
object rotated
object deleted
object duplicated
object reordered
```

Not dirty:

```txt
select layer
expand group
collapse group
hover row
focus row
open context menu
```

Autosave comes in Step 23.

---

# 21.17 Firestore listener scope

Use Firestore listeners only for job/design status:

```txt
processing
ready
needs_review
failed
currentFabricManifestAssetId
currentReconstructionAssetId
quality summary
```

Do not write per-layer panel state into Firestore on every click.

Correct:

```ts
onSnapshot(designDoc, updateStatusAndPointers)
```

Wrong:

```ts
onSnapshot(layerPanelDoc, live sync every object selection)
```

Firestore realtime listeners are appropriate for low-frequency document state changes; Firebase documents that `onSnapshot()` emits immediately and then again when the document changes. citeturn341640view3

# 21.18 Context menu

Layer row context menu should include:

```txt
Rename
Duplicate
Delete
Bring to front
Send to back
Show / Hide
Lock / Unlock
Select group
Restore fallback
Open diagnostics
```

But actions must be capability-gated.

Example:

```txt
locked_reference
  Restore original
  Hide / Show
  Open diagnostics

text_editable
  Edit text
  Change font
  Restore raster fallback
  Open text safety report

clean_background
  Regenerate background
  Restore original background
  Open diff heatmap
```

Execution of restore/regenerate is not Step 21. The menu can expose the command, but the repair flow belongs to Step 25.

Layer panel should link each row to diagnostics:

```txt
confidence breakdown
source observations
fallback asset
warnings
validation metrics
text safety result
visual diff contribution later
```

Do not show all this by default. Use a row details drawer:

```txt
Layer details
  source
  confidence
  fallback
  validation
  warnings
  provenance
```

This is where AI trust becomes inspectable without bloating the primary UI.

# 21.20 Layer panel invariants

The panel is valid only if:

```txt
every visible row maps to either a Fabric object or logical group

every layer row has aiLayerId

every layer row has editableLevel

every layer row has confidenceLabel

every layer row has visibility state

every layer row has lock state

layer panel display order is front-to-back

Fabric object stack order remains bottom-to-top

locked_reference remains bottom-most

group rows do not create Fabric.Group

selection sync works both ways:
  canvas selection → panel highlight
  panel click → canvas selection

visibility sync works both ways:
  panel toggle → Fabric object visible
  Fabric object state → panel row

lock sync works both ways:
  panel toggle → Fabric object lock flags
  Fabric object lock flags → panel row

commands use Fabric public APIs or safe canvas methods

no canonical reconstruction mutation occurs

no Firestore autosave occurs in this step
```

---

# 21.21 Failure modes

## Panel shows duplicate layer rows

Cause:

```txt
same aiLayerId appears on multiple Fabric objects
```

Mitigation:

```txt
detect duplicate aiLayerId
show critical diagnostics
do not allow reorder until resolved
```

## Layer row exists but Fabric object is missing

Cause:

```txt
object skipped during Fabric generation
object deleted by user
manifest/layerIndex stale
```

Mitigation:

```txt
mark as missing object
hide unavailable actions
autosave later persists deletion
```

## Fabric object exists but no layerIndex entry

Cause:

```txt
manual user-created object
duplicate layer
third-party editor tool added object
```

Mitigation:

```txt
show as “Manual layer”
assign editor-local aiLayerId
do not attach reconstruction provenance
```

## Group row selection breaks child editing

Cause:

```txt
Fabric.Group created too early
```

Mitigation:

```txt
metadata-only groups
select-as-group uses ActiveSelection
```

## Reorder breaks locked reference

Cause:

```txt
reference layer moved above scene
```

Mitigation:

```txt
after every reorder call keepLockedReferenceAtBack()
```
