# 23.12 Serialize autosave payload

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/autosave/create-editor-autosave-payload.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  Canvas,
} from "fabric";

import {
  serializeEditorRuntime,
} from "../editor-behavior/serialize-editor-runtime";

import type {
  MagicEditorEditEvent,
} from "../editor-behavior/editor-behavior.types";

import {
  computeEditorRuntimeStats,
} from "./compute-editor-runtime-stats";

import type {
  EditorAutosavePayload,
} from "./autosave.types";

export function createEditorAutosavePayload(input: {
  canvas: Canvas;

  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  userId: string;

  sessionId: string;

  baseRevision: number;

  editEvents: MagicEditorEditEvent[];
}): EditorAutosavePayload {
  const autosaveId = createAutosaveId();

  return {
    schemaVersion: "ai-editor-autosave.v1",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    userId: input.userId,

    sessionId: input.sessionId,

    autosaveId,

    baseRevision: input.baseRevision,

    idempotencyKey: `${input.sessionId}:${autosaveId}`,

    fabricRuntimeJson: serializeEditorRuntime(input.canvas),

    editEvents: input.editEvents,

    stats: computeEditorRuntimeStats(input.canvas),

    createdAt: Date.now(),
  };
}

function createAutosaveId() {
  return `autosave_${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
}
```

This serializes full runtime snapshot, not a patch.

# 23.13 Autosave API route

Create:

```txt
src/app/api/workspaces/[workspaceId]/designs/[designId]/autosave/route.ts
```

```ts
import {
  NextRequest,
  NextResponse,
} from "next/server";

import {
  FieldValue,
  getFirestore,
} from "firebase-admin/firestore";

import {
  getAuth,
} from "firebase-admin/auth";

import {
  bucketForMagicStorageRole,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/storage/storage-buckets";

import {
  editorAutosaveEventsJsonPath,
  editorAutosaveRuntimeJsonPath,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/storage/storage-paths";

import {
  writeAiAsset,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/storage/write-ai-asset";

import {
  AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,
  AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/schema/constants";

import type {
  EditorAutosavePayload,
  EditorAutosaveResponse,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/autosave/autosave.types";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

export async function POST(
  req: NextRequest,
  context: {
    params: Promise<{
      workspaceId: string;
      designId: string;
    }>;
  }
) {
  const {
    workspaceId,
    designId,
  } = await context.params;

  const userId = await verifyUserId(req);

  await assertWorkspaceAccess({
    workspaceId,
    userId,
  });

  const payload =
    (await req.json()) as EditorAutosavePayload;

  validateAutosavePayload({
    payload,
    workspaceId,
    designId,
    userId,
  });

  const runtimeBytes = Buffer.from(
    JSON.stringify(payload.fabricRuntimeJson),
    "utf8"
  );

  if (runtimeBytes.byteLength > 8 * 1024 * 1024) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        status: "rejected",
        reason: "fabric_runtime_json_too_large",
      } satisfies EditorAutosaveResponse,
      { status: 413 }
    );
  }

  const assetsBucket = bucketForMagicStorageRole("assets");

  const runtimeAssetId = `asset_${payload.autosaveId}_fabric_runtime`;

  const runtimeAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "assets",
    bucket: assetsBucket,
    storagePath: editorAutosaveRuntimeJsonPath({
      workspaceId,
      designId,
      autosaveId: payload.autosaveId,
    }),

    bytes: runtimeBytes,

    assetId: runtimeAssetId,
    kind: "editor_autosave_runtime_json" as any,

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId,
    designId,

    source: "manual_user",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  let editEventsAssetId: string | undefined;

  if (payload.editEvents.length > 0) {
    const eventsAssetId = `asset_${payload.autosaveId}_edit_events`;

    const eventsAsset = await writeAiAsset({
      storageRole: "assets",
      bucket: assetsBucket,
      storagePath: editorAutosaveEventsJsonPath({
        workspaceId,
        designId,
        autosaveId: payload.autosaveId,
      }),

      bytes: Buffer.from(
        JSON.stringify(payload.editEvents, null, 2),
        "utf8"
      ),

      assetId: eventsAssetId,
      kind: "editor_autosave_events_json" as any,

      contentType: "application/json",

      workspaceId,
      designId,

      source: "manual_user",

      schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

      sourceAssetId: runtimeAsset.id,

      cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
    });

    editEventsAssetId = eventsAsset.id;
  }

  const db = getFirestore();

  const designRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${workspaceId}/designs/${designId}`
  );

  const autosaveRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${workspaceId}/designs/${designId}/autosaves/${payload.autosaveId}`
  );

  const assetRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${workspaceId}/designs/${designId}/assets/${runtimeAsset.id}`
  );

  const result = await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
    const designSnap = await tx.get(designRef);

    if (!designSnap.exists) {
      throw new Error("design_not_found");
    }

    const design = designSnap.data()!;

    const currentRevision = design.current?.revision ?? 0;

    if (payload.baseRevision !== currentRevision) {
      tx.set(autosaveRef, {
        id: payload.autosaveId,

        workspaceId,
        designId,

        userId,
        sessionId: payload.sessionId,

        baseRevision: payload.baseRevision,

        revision: currentRevision,

        fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId: runtimeAsset.id,

        editEventsAssetId: editEventsAssetId ?? null,

        objectCount: payload.stats.objectCount,
        dirtyObjectCount: payload.stats.dirtyObjectCount,

        status: "conflict",

        conflict: {
          currentRevision,
          currentAutosaveId: design.current?.autosaveId ?? null,
          reason: "base_revision_mismatch",
        },

        createdAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });

      return {
        status: "conflict" as const,
        currentRevision,
      };
    }

    const nextRevision = currentRevision + 1;

    tx.set(
      assetRef,
      {
        id: runtimeAsset.id,

        workspaceId,
        designId,

        kind: runtimeAsset.kind,
        storageRole: runtimeAsset.storageRole,

        bucket: runtimeAsset.bucket,
        storagePath: runtimeAsset.storagePath,

        generation: runtimeAsset.generation,
        metageneration: runtimeAsset.metageneration,

        mimeType: runtimeAsset.mimeType,

        sizeBytes: runtimeAsset.sizeBytes,

        checksum: runtimeAsset.checksum,

        source: runtimeAsset.metadata.source,

        retained: true,

        createdAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      },
      { merge: true }
    );

    tx.set(autosaveRef, {
      id: payload.autosaveId,

      workspaceId,
      designId,

      userId,
      sessionId: payload.sessionId,

      baseRevision: payload.baseRevision,

      revision: nextRevision,

      fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId: runtimeAsset.id,

      editEventsAssetId: editEventsAssetId ?? null,

      objectCount: payload.stats.objectCount,
      dirtyObjectCount: payload.stats.dirtyObjectCount,

      status: "accepted",

      createdAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });

    tx.update(designRef, {
      "current.fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId": runtimeAsset.id,
      "current.autosaveId": payload.autosaveId,
      "current.revision": nextRevision,
      "current.updatedByUserId": userId,
      "current.updatedAt": FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),

      status: "draft",

      updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });

    return {
      status: "accepted" as const,
      revision: nextRevision,
    };
  });

  if (result.status === "conflict") {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        status: "conflict",
        autosaveId: payload.autosaveId,
        currentRevision: result.currentRevision,
        conflictAutosaveAssetId: runtimeAsset.id,
        message: "Autosave conflict. Reload or merge before continuing.",
      } satisfies EditorAutosaveResponse,
      { status: 409 }
    );
  }

  return NextResponse.json(
    {
      status: "accepted",
      autosaveId: payload.autosaveId,
      revision: result.revision,
      fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId: runtimeAsset.id,
      editEventsAssetId,
    } satisfies EditorAutosaveResponse,
    { status: 200 }
  );
}

async function verifyUserId(req: NextRequest) {
  const authHeader = req.headers.get("authorization") ?? "";

  const idToken = authHeader.startsWith("Bearer ")
    ? authHeader.slice("Bearer ".length)
    : undefined;

  if (!idToken) {
    throw new Error("missing_auth_token");
  }

  const decoded = await getAuth().verifyIdToken(idToken);

  return decoded.uid;
}

async function assertWorkspaceAccess(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  userId: string;
}) {
  const db = getFirestore();

  const workspaceSnap = await db.doc(`workspaces/${input.workspaceId}`).get();

  if (!workspaceSnap.exists) {
    throw new Error("workspace_not_found");
  }

  const workspace = workspaceSnap.data()!;

  if (
    workspace.ownerUserId !== input.userId &&
    !workspace.memberUserIds?.includes(input.userId)
  ) {
    throw new Error("workspace_forbidden");
  }
}

function validateAutosavePayload(input: {
  payload: EditorAutosavePayload;
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  userId: string;
}) {
  if (input.payload.workspaceId !== input.workspaceId) {
    throw new Error("workspace_mismatch");
  }

  if (input.payload.designId !== input.designId) {
    throw new Error("design_mismatch");
  }

  if (input.payload.userId !== input.userId) {
    throw new Error("user_mismatch");
  }

  if (!input.payload.sessionId) {
    throw new Error("missing_session_id");
  }

  if (!input.payload.autosaveId) {
    throw new Error("missing_autosave_id");
  }

  if (!input.payload.fabricRuntimeJson?.objects) {
    throw new Error("invalid_fabric_runtime_json");
  }
}
```

Remove `as any` after patching your asset enum.

# 23.14 Client autosave manager

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/autosave/create-autosave-manager.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  Canvas,
} from "fabric";

import type {
  MagicEditorBehaviorBindings,
} from "../editor-behavior/editor-behavior.types";

import {
  createEditorAutosavePayload,
} from "./create-editor-autosave-payload";

import {
  saveLocalEditorDraft,
  localDraftKey,
} from "./local-draft-store";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_AUTOSAVE_POLICY,
} from "./autosave-policy";

import type {
  EditorAutosaveResponse,
} from "./autosave.types";

export type AutosaveManager = {
  markDirty: () => void;

  flush: () => Promise<void>;

  dispose: () => void;

  getRevision: () => number;

  getState: () => {
    saving: boolean;
    dirty: boolean;
    lastSavedAt?: number;
    lastError?: string;
  };
};

export function createAutosaveManager(input: {
  canvas: Canvas;

  bindings: MagicEditorBehaviorBindings;

  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  userId: string;

  sessionId: string;

  initialRevision: number;

  getIdToken: () => Promise<string>;

  onAccepted?: (response: Extract<EditorAutosaveResponse, { status: "accepted" }>) => void;

  onConflict?: (response: Extract<EditorAutosaveResponse, { status: "conflict" }>) => void;

  onRejected?: (response: Extract<EditorAutosaveResponse, { status: "rejected" }>) => void;
}): AutosaveManager {
  let revision = input.initialRevision;

  let dirty = false;
  let saving = false;
  let disposed = false;
  let lastSavedAt: number | undefined;
  let lastError: string | undefined;

  let debounceTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  let maxWaitTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;

  async function persistLocalDraft() {
    const state = input.bindings.getState();

    const payload = createEditorAutosavePayload({
      canvas: input.canvas,

      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      userId: input.userId,

      sessionId: input.sessionId,

      baseRevision: revision,

      editEvents: state.editEvents,
    });

    await saveLocalEditorDraft({
      key: localDraftKey({
        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        userId: input.userId,
      }),

      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      userId: input.userId,

      sessionId: input.sessionId,

      baseRevision: revision,

      fabricRuntimeJson: payload.fabricRuntimeJson,

      editEvents: payload.editEvents,

      savedAt: Date.now(),
    });
  }

  async function flush() {
    if (disposed) return;
    if (!dirty && input.bindings.getState().editEvents.length === 0) return;
    if (saving) return;

    saving = true;

    clearTimers();

    try {
      await persistLocalDraft();

      const state = input.bindings.getState();

      const payload = createEditorAutosavePayload({
        canvas: input.canvas,

        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        userId: input.userId,

        sessionId: input.sessionId,

        baseRevision: revision,

        editEvents: state.editEvents.slice(
          -MAGIC_LAYERS_AUTOSAVE_POLICY.maxEditEventsPerAutosave
        ),
      });

      const token = await input.getIdToken();

      const response = await fetch(
        `/api/workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/autosave`,
        {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
          },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload),
        }
      );

      const body = (await response.json()) as EditorAutosaveResponse;

      if (body.status === "accepted") {
        revision = body.revision;
        dirty = false;
        lastSavedAt = Date.now();
        lastError = undefined;
        input.bindings.clearEvents();
        input.onAccepted?.(body);
      } else if (body.status === "conflict") {
        lastError = "autosave_conflict";
        input.onConflict?.(body);
      } else {
        lastError = body.reason;
        input.onRejected?.(body);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      lastError =
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : "autosave_failed";
    } finally {
      saving = false;
    }
  }

  function markDirty() {
    dirty = true;

    void persistLocalDraft();

    if (debounceTimer) {
      clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
    }

    debounceTimer = setTimeout(
      () => void flush(),
      MAGIC_LAYERS_AUTOSAVE_POLICY.debounceMs
    );

    if (!maxWaitTimer) {
      maxWaitTimer = setTimeout(
        () => void flush(),
        MAGIC_LAYERS_AUTOSAVE_POLICY.maxWaitMs
      );
    }
  }

  function clearTimers() {
    if (debounceTimer) clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
    if (maxWaitTimer) clearTimeout(maxWaitTimer);

    debounceTimer = undefined;
    maxWaitTimer = undefined;
  }

  const handleVisibilityChange = () => {
    if (document.visibilityState === "hidden") {
      void flush();
    }
  };

  const handleBeforeUnload = () => {
    /**
     * async fetch cannot be guaranteed here.
     * local draft was already written on markDirty.
     */
    void persistLocalDraft();
  };

  if (MAGIC_LAYERS_AUTOSAVE_POLICY.saveOnVisibilityHidden) {
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", handleVisibilityChange);
  }

  if (MAGIC_LAYERS_AUTOSAVE_POLICY.saveOnBeforeUnload) {
    window.addEventListener("beforeunload", handleBeforeUnload);
  }

  return {
    markDirty,

    flush,

    dispose() {
      disposed = true;
      clearTimers();
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", handleVisibilityChange);
      window.removeEventListener("beforeunload", handleBeforeUnload);
    },

    getRevision() {
      return revision;
    },

    getState() {
      return {
        saving,
        dirty,
        lastSavedAt,
        lastError,
      };
    },
  };
}
```

This manager writes local drafts aggressively and server autosaves conservatively.

Create:

```txt
src/app/api/workspaces/[workspaceId]/designs/[designId]/versions/route.ts
```

```ts
import {
  NextRequest,
  NextResponse,
} from "next/server";

import {
  FieldValue,
  getFirestore,
} from "firebase-admin/firestore";

import {
  getAuth,
} from "firebase-admin/auth";

import {
  bucketForMagicStorageRole,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/storage/storage-buckets";

import {
  designVersionRuntimeJsonPath,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/storage/storage-paths";

import {
  writeAiAsset,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/storage/write-ai-asset";

import {
  AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,
  AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/schema/constants";

import type {
  FabricRuntimeJson,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/fabric-generator/fabric-generator.types";

import type {
  EditorRuntimeStats,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/autosave/autosave.types";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

type CreateDesignVersionRequest = {
  versionId: string;

  baseRevision: number;

  source:
    | "manual_save"
    | "user_autosave_checkpoint"
    | "export_checkpoint";

  fabricRuntimeJson: FabricRuntimeJson;

  stats: EditorRuntimeStats;
};

export async function POST(
  req: NextRequest,
  context: {
    params: Promise<{
      workspaceId: string;
      designId: string;
    }>;
  }
) {
  const {
    workspaceId,
    designId,
  } = await context.params;

  const userId = await verifyUserId(req);

  await assertWorkspaceAccess({
    workspaceId,
    userId,
  });

  const body =
    (await req.json()) as CreateDesignVersionRequest;

  if (!body.versionId) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "missing_version_id" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  const assetId = `asset_${body.versionId}_fabric_runtime`;

  const asset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "assets",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("assets"),

    storagePath: designVersionRuntimeJsonPath({
      workspaceId,
      designId,
      versionId: body.versionId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(
      JSON.stringify(body.fabricRuntimeJson, null, 2),
      "utf8"
    ),

    assetId,
    kind: "design_version_runtime_json" as any,

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId,
    designId,

    source: "manual_user",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  const db = getFirestore();

  const designRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${workspaceId}/designs/${designId}`
  );

  const versionRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${workspaceId}/designs/${designId}/versions/${body.versionId}`
  );

  await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
    const designSnap = await tx.get(designRef);

    if (!designSnap.exists) {
      throw new Error("design_not_found");
    }

    const design = designSnap.data()!;

    const currentRevision = design.current?.revision ?? 0;
    const nextRevision = Math.max(currentRevision, body.baseRevision) + 1;

    tx.set(versionRef, {
      id: body.versionId,

      workspaceId,
      designId,

      source: body.source,

      fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId: asset.id,

      reconstructionAssetId:
        design.source?.currentReconstructionAssetId ?? null,

      fabricManifestAssetId:
        design.source?.currentFabricManifestAssetId ?? null,

      parentVersionId:
        design.current?.versionId ?? null,

      baseRevision: body.baseRevision,

      revision: nextRevision,

      stats: body.stats,

      createdByUserId: userId,

      createdAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });

    tx.update(designRef, {
      "current.versionId": body.versionId,
      "current.fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId": asset.id,
      "current.revision": nextRevision,
      "current.updatedByUserId": userId,
      "current.updatedAt": FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),

      status: "draft",

      updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });
  });

  return NextResponse.json({
    versionId: body.versionId,
    fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId: asset.id,
  });
}

async function verifyUserId(req: NextRequest) {
  const authHeader = req.headers.get("authorization") ?? "";

  const idToken = authHeader.startsWith("Bearer ")
    ? authHeader.slice("Bearer ".length)
    : undefined;

  if (!idToken) {
    throw new Error("missing_auth_token");
  }

  const decoded = await getAuth().verifyIdToken(idToken);

  return decoded.uid;
}

async function assertWorkspaceAccess(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  userId: string;
}) {
  const db = getFirestore();

  const workspaceSnap = await db.doc(`workspaces/${input.workspaceId}`).get();

  if (!workspaceSnap.exists) {
    throw new Error("workspace_not_found");
  }

  const workspace = workspaceSnap.data()!;

  if (
    workspace.ownerUserId !== input.userId &&
    !workspace.memberUserIds?.includes(input.userId)
  ) {
    throw new Error("workspace_forbidden");
  }
}
```

Remove `as any` after patching your asset enum.

# 23.16 Restore latest state on editor load

Loading priority:

```txt
1. Local IndexedDB draft newer than server pointer
2. Server current.fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId
3. Step 18 runtime hydrated Fabric manifest
```

Meaning:

```txt
if local draft exists and local baseRevision >= server current.revision
  ask user to restore local draft

else if server runtime JSON exists
  load runtime JSON

else
  load generated Fabric runtime manifest
```

Do not silently replace server state with local draft. Show:

This avoids restoring stale offline edits over a newer server save.

# 23.20 Cost discipline

Firestore writes per active editor session should be bounded:

```txt
autosave accepted:
  1 asset index write
  1 autosave doc write
  1 design pointer update

manual version:
  1 asset index write
  1 version doc write
  1 design pointer update
```

Do not write:

```txt
one Firestore document per object movement
one Firestore document per layer change
full Fabric JSON into design doc
full edit events into design doc
selection changes into Firestore
group expansion state into Firestore
```

Firestore pricing is operation-based and the free tier includes a daily write quota, so unnecessary per-event writes become cost and scale risk. citeturn653424search14

---

# 23.21 Server-side current pointer invariant

The design doc must always satisfy:

```txt
current.revision is monotonic

current.fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId points to latest accepted runtime state

current.autosaveId points to latest accepted autosave

current.versionId points to latest manual/checkpoint version

source.currentReconstructionAssetId remains separate

source.currentFabricManifestAssetId remains generated manifest template

current.fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId is optional until first user edit
```

This allows this load logic:

```txt
if current.fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId exists
  load current user state

else
  hydrate generated manifest template
```

---

# 23.22 Autosave does not regenerate Fabric manifest

After user edits, do not update:

```txt
source.currentFabricManifestAssetId
```

Why:

```txt
Fabric manifest template is the generated AI import package.
FabricRuntimeJson is the user-edited state.
```

If user edits are saved into the manifest template, you lose the distinction between:

```txt
AI-generated starting point
user-edited current design
```

---

# 23.23 User-created objects

Autosave must preserve manual objects:

```txt
aiRuntimeKind = manual_object
aiCreatedByEditor = true
aiLayerId = manual_layer_...
```

Manual objects are valid inside `FabricRuntimeJson`.

They do not need matching `AiReconstructedLayer`.

Layer panel can display them as:

```txt
Manual layer
```

Step 24 or later can define how manual objects appear in export and versions.

---

# 23.24 Autosave validation before upload

Before upload, run:

```txt
assertAllFabricObjectsHaveAiIdentity(canvas)
assert locked_reference remains bottom-most
assert runtime JSON size below limit
assert no image src is expired signed URL without aiSourceAssetId
```

Important point:

```txt
Runtime Fabric JSON may contain HTTPS signed URLs.
But every image object must also preserve aiSourceAssetId.
```

When loading saved runtime JSON later, server/client must rehydrate image `src` from `aiSourceAssetId` if the URL is expired.

So saved runtime JSON is allowed to contain stale URLs only if:

```txt
aiSourceAssetId exists
```

Safer option:

```txt
before saving, replace image src with magic-asset://aiSourceAssetId
```

That is the better long-term rule.

# 23.25 Strip runtime URLs before saving

Create:


```ts
import type {
  FabricRuntimeJson,
} from "../fabric-generator/fabric-generator.types";

import {
  fabricAssetUri,
} from "../fabric-generator/fabric-asset-uri";

export function stripRuntimeUrlsFromFabricJson(
  json: FabricRuntimeJson
): FabricRuntimeJson {
  return {
    ...json,
    objects: json.objects.map((object) => {
      if (!object.src) return object;

      if (!object.aiSourceAssetId) {
        return object;
      }

      return {
        ...object,
        src: fabricAssetUri(object.aiSourceAssetId),
      };
    }),
  };
}
```

```ts
  serializeEditorRuntime(input.canvas)
);
```

This makes autosaved runtime JSON durable.

# 23.26 Runtime JSON hydration

Saved runtime JSON also needs hydration.

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/autosave/hydrate-saved-fabric-runtime-json.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiAssetRef,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import type {
  FabricRuntimeJson,
} from "../fabric-generator/fabric-generator.types";

import {
  assetIdFromFabricAssetUri,
  isFabricAssetUri,
} from "../fabric-generator/fabric-asset-uri";

export async function hydrateSavedFabricRuntimeJson(input: {
  fabricRuntimeJson: FabricRuntimeJson;

  assets: Record<string, AiAssetRef>;

  resolveAssetUrl: (asset: AiAssetRef) => Promise<{
    url: string;
    urlExpiresAt: number;
  }>;
}): Promise<FabricRuntimeJson> {
  const json = structuredClone(input.fabricRuntimeJson);

  for (const object of json.objects) {
    if (!isFabricAssetUri(object.src)) continue;

    const assetId = assetIdFromFabricAssetUri(object.src);

    const asset = input.assets[assetId];

    if (!asset) {
      throw new Error(`Missing asset ${assetId} for saved Fabric runtime JSON`);
    }

    const resolved = await input.resolveAssetUrl(asset);

    object.src = resolved.url;
    object.crossOrigin = "anonymous";
    object.aiSourceAssetId = assetId;
  }

  return json;
}
```

Autosaved Fabric runtime JSON should be durable like the generated template.

Autosaves should not live forever.

```txt
accepted autosaves:

conflict autosaves:

edit event assets:
```

# Step 24 — Runtime loading, recovery, and editor boot sequence

Step 24 defines how the editor opens an existing Magic Layers design safely.

The locked rule:

```txt
Editor boot must load the latest user runtime state when it exists.
If no user runtime state exists, load the generated Fabric runtime manifest.
If a newer local draft exists, recover it explicitly.
```

This step is not reconstruction. It is runtime loading and recovery.

Fabric `loadFromJSON` is async, and Fabric docs note that loading JSON does not resize the canvas, so the boot sequence must set canvas dimensions from the manifest/runtime wrapper before loading objects. citeturn286326search2

---

# 24.1 What Step 24 owns

Step 24 owns:

```txt
editor boot source selection
server current-runtime loading
generated manifest hydration fallback
local draft recovery
signed URL hydration
runtime JSON hydration
canvas loading
session creation
Firestore status listener
base revision initialization
autosave manager initialization
layer panel initialization
editor behavior binding
boot failure handling
```

Step 24 does **not** own:

```txt
autosave writes
manual versions
AI repair
fallback restoration
export
visual validation
text safety validation
canonical reconstruction mutation
```

Step 23 persists changes. Step 25 repairs layers. Step 26 exports.

---

# 24.2 Boot priority

The editor must load in this order:

```txt
1. Local IndexedDB draft
   only if user explicitly chooses recovery

2. Server current runtime
   design.current.fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId

3. Generated Fabric manifest template
   design.source.currentFabricManifestAssetId

4. Failure screen
   if no runtime or generated manifest exists
```

Do not open the generated manifest if a newer saved runtime exists.

Do not silently open a local draft over newer server state.

IndexedDB is appropriate for local recovery because it supports significant structured browser storage, including blobs and richer data than Web Storage. citeturn414326search7

---

# 24.3 Durable runtime rule

Both generated manifests and saved runtime JSON must be durable.

Stored JSON may contain:

```txt
magic-asset://assetId
```

Stored JSON must not contain durable signed URLs.

Runtime-loaded JSON must contain:

```txt
https://signed-url...
crossOrigin: "anonymous"
```

Cloud Storage signed URLs are time-limited access tokens, so they are correct for runtime loading but wrong for durable saved state. citeturn699971search2

---

# 24.4 CORS rule

Every runtime image URL loaded into Fabric must be CORS-safe.

Required object state:

```ts
{
  src: "https://signed-url",
  crossOrigin: "anonymous"
}
```

Firebase Storage docs state that browser downloads from Cloud Storage require bucket CORS configuration. citeturn699971search3

---

# 24.5 Auth and App Check rule

All boot APIs must verify:

```txt
Firebase Auth ID token
Firebase App Check token
workspace access
design access
```

Firebase Admin SDK supports verifying ID tokens on the backend, and App Check custom backend docs require checking and verifying App Check tokens for protected backend resources. citeturn699971search1turn699971search0

---

# 24.6 Firestore listener scope

Use Firestore realtime listeners for:

```txt
design status
current revision
current autosave pointer
current runtime pointer
repair request status
job progress
```

Do not use Firestore listeners for:

```txt
selection state
drag movement
every layer change
every text character edit
```

Firestore `onSnapshot()` gives an initial document snapshot and then updates on document changes, which is useful for design/job state but too expensive/noisy for per-object editor mutations. citeturn609426search0

# 24.9 Server boot endpoint

Create one endpoint that gives the editor its server-side boot state.

```txt
GET /api/workspaces/{workspaceId}/designs/{designId}/editor-boot
```

Behavior:

```txt
verify auth
verify App Check
verify workspace/design access
load design doc
load current runtime JSON if available
else load generated Fabric manifest template
return current revision + assets + source JSON
```

Create:

```txt
src/app/api/workspaces/[workspaceId]/designs/[designId]/editor-boot/route.ts
```

```ts
import {
  NextRequest,
  NextResponse,
} from "next/server";

import {
  getFirestore,
} from "firebase-admin/firestore";

import {
  getAuth,
} from "firebase-admin/auth";

import {
  getAppCheck,
} from "firebase-admin/app-check";

import {
  downloadJsonAsset,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/storage/download-json-asset";

import {
  loadAssetRef,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/storage/load-asset-ref";

import type {
  EditorBootServerState,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/editor-boot/editor-boot.types";

import type {
  FabricRuntimeJson,
  AiFabricManifestTemplate,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/fabric-generator/fabric-generator.types";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

export async function GET(
  req: NextRequest,
  context: {
    params: Promise<{
      workspaceId: string;
      designId: string;
    }>;
  }
) {
  const {
    workspaceId,
    designId,
  } = await context.params;

  const userId = await verifyAuthAndAppCheck(req);

  await assertWorkspaceAccess({
    workspaceId,
    userId,
  });

  const db = getFirestore();

  const designRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${workspaceId}/designs/${designId}`
  );

  const designSnap = await designRef.get();

  if (!designSnap.exists) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "design_not_found" },
      { status: 404 }
    );
  }

  const design = designSnap.data()!;

  const revision = design.current?.revision ?? 0;

  const currentRuntimeAssetId =
    design.current?.fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId;

  const fabricManifestTemplateAssetId =
    design.source?.currentFabricManifestAssetId;

  const reconstructionAssetId =
    design.source?.currentReconstructionAssetId;

  const assets: EditorBootServerState["assets"] = {};

  if (currentRuntimeAssetId) {
    const runtimeAsset = await loadAssetRef({
      workspaceId,
      designId,
      assetId: currentRuntimeAssetId,
    });

    const runtimeJson =
      await downloadJsonAsset<FabricRuntimeJson>(runtimeAsset);

    assets[runtimeAsset.id] = runtimeAsset;

    const response: EditorBootServerState = {
      workspaceId,
      designId,

      status: "runtime_available",

      designStatus: design.status,

      revision,

      currentRuntimeAssetId,

      fabricManifestTemplateAssetId,
      reconstructionAssetId,

      assets,

      currentRuntimeJson: runtimeJson,

      quality: design.quality,
    };

    return NextResponse.json(response);
  }

  if (fabricManifestTemplateAssetId) {
    const manifestAsset = await loadAssetRef({
      workspaceId,
      designId,
      assetId: fabricManifestTemplateAssetId,
    });

    const manifest =
      await downloadJsonAsset<AiFabricManifestTemplate>(
        manifestAsset
      );

    /**
     * Manifest already contains the assets map generated by Step 18.
     */
    const response: EditorBootServerState = {
      workspaceId,
      designId,

      status: "generated_manifest_available",

      designStatus: design.status,

      revision,

      fabricManifestTemplateAssetId,
      reconstructionAssetId,

      assets: manifest.assets,

      fabricManifestTemplate: manifest,

      quality: design.quality,
    };

    return NextResponse.json(response);
  }

  return NextResponse.json({
    workspaceId,
    designId,

    status: design.status === "failed" ? "failed" : "not_ready",

    designStatus: design.status,

    revision,

    reconstructionAssetId,

    assets: {},

    quality: design.quality,
  } satisfies EditorBootServerState);
}

async function verifyAuthAndAppCheck(req: NextRequest) {
  const authHeader = req.headers.get("authorization") ?? "";

  const idToken = authHeader.startsWith("Bearer ")
    ? authHeader.slice("Bearer ".length)
    : undefined;

  if (!idToken) {
    throw new Error("missing_auth_token");
  }

  const decoded = await getAuth().verifyIdToken(idToken);

  const appCheckToken = req.headers.get("x-firebase-appcheck");

  if (!appCheckToken) {
    throw new Error("missing_app_check_token");
  }

  await getAppCheck().verifyToken(appCheckToken);

  return decoded.uid;
}

async function assertWorkspaceAccess(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  userId: string;
}) {
  const db = getFirestore();

  const snap = await db.doc(`workspaces/${input.workspaceId}`).get();

  if (!snap.exists) {
    throw new Error("workspace_not_found");
  }

  const workspace = snap.data()!;

  if (
    workspace.ownerUserId !== input.userId &&
    !workspace.memberUserIds?.includes(input.userId)
  ) {
    throw new Error("workspace_forbidden");
  }
}
```

# 24.10 Runtime asset URL endpoint

Step 24 needs a reusable runtime asset URL endpoint.

```txt
POST /api/workspaces/{workspaceId}/designs/{designId}/asset-runtime-url
```

Create:

```txt
src/app/api/workspaces/[workspaceId]/designs/[designId]/asset-runtime-url/route.ts
```

```ts
import {
  NextRequest,
  NextResponse,
} from "next/server";

import {
  getAuth,
} from "firebase-admin/auth";

import {
  getAppCheck,
} from "firebase-admin/app-check";

import {
  loadAssetRef,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/storage/load-asset-ref";

import {
  resolveAiAssetSignedUrl,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/storage/resolve-ai-asset-url";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

export async function POST(
  req: NextRequest,
  context: {
    params: Promise<{
      workspaceId: string;
      designId: string;
    }>;
  }
) {
  const {
    workspaceId,
    designId,
  } = await context.params;

  const userId = await verifyAuthAndAppCheck(req);

  await assertWorkspaceAccess({
    workspaceId,
    userId,
  });

  const body = await req.json();

  const assetId = body.assetId;

  if (!assetId) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "missing_asset_id" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  const asset = await loadAssetRef({
    workspaceId,
    designId,
    assetId,
  });

  const resolved = await resolveAiAssetSignedUrl({
    asset,
    expiresInMs: 6 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  return NextResponse.json({
    assetId,
    url: resolved.url,
    urlExpiresAt: resolved.urlExpiresAt,
  });
}

async function verifyAuthAndAppCheck(req: NextRequest) {
  const authHeader = req.headers.get("authorization") ?? "";

  const idToken = authHeader.startsWith("Bearer ")
    ? authHeader.slice("Bearer ".length)
    : undefined;

  if (!idToken) {
    throw new Error("missing_auth_token");
  }

  const decoded = await getAuth().verifyIdToken(idToken);

  const appCheckToken = req.headers.get("x-firebase-appcheck");

  if (!appCheckToken) {
    throw new Error("missing_app_check_token");
  }

  await getAppCheck().verifyToken(appCheckToken);

  return decoded.uid;
}
```

This endpoint prevents the client from needing direct GCS signing privileges.

# 24.11 Hydrate runtime JSON from server state

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/editor-boot/hydrate-editor-runtime-source.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiFabricRuntimeManifest,
  FabricRuntimeJson,
} from "../fabric-generator/fabric-generator.types";

import {
  AI_FABRIC_RUNTIME_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION,
} from "../fabric-generator/fabric-generator.types";

import {
  hydrateFabricRuntimeManifest,
} from "../fabric-generator/hydrate-fabric-runtime-manifest";

import {
  hydrateSavedFabricRuntimeJson,
} from "../autosave/hydrate-saved-fabric-runtime-json";

import type {
  EditorBootServerState,
} from "./editor-boot.types";

export async function hydrateEditorRuntimeSource(input: {
  serverState: EditorBootServerState;

  resolveAssetUrl: (assetId: string) => Promise<{
    url: string;
    urlExpiresAt: number;
  }>;
}): Promise<AiFabricRuntimeManifest> {
  const state = input.serverState;

  if (
    state.status === "runtime_available" &&
    state.currentRuntimeJson
  ) {
    const hydratedRuntimeJson =
      await hydrateSavedFabricRuntimeJson({
        fabricRuntimeJson: state.currentRuntimeJson,
        assets: state.assets,
        resolveAssetUrl: async (asset) => {
          return input.resolveAssetUrl(asset.id);
        },
      });

    return runtimeManifestFromSavedRuntimeJson({
      serverState: state,
      fabricRuntimeJson: hydratedRuntimeJson,
    });
  }

  if (
    state.status === "generated_manifest_available" &&
    state.fabricManifestTemplate
  ) {
    return hydrateFabricRuntimeManifest({
      template: state.fabricManifestTemplate,
      resolveAssetUrl: async (asset) => {
        return input.resolveAssetUrl(asset.id);
      },
    });
  }

  throw new Error(`editor_runtime_not_available:${state.status}`);
}

function runtimeManifestFromSavedRuntimeJson(input: {
  serverState: EditorBootServerState;
  fabricRuntimeJson: FabricRuntimeJson;
}): AiFabricRuntimeManifest {
  const manifestTemplate = input.serverState.fabricManifestTemplate;

  if (manifestTemplate) {
    return {
      ...manifestTemplate,

      schemaVersion: AI_FABRIC_RUNTIME_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION,

      mode: "runtime_hydrated",

      assets: input.serverState.assets,

      fabricJson: input.fabricRuntimeJson,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Minimal runtime wrapper when only saved runtime JSON is available.
   * This should be rare; normally Step 18 manifest template exists.
   */
  const width = input.fabricRuntimeJson.width ?? 1;
  const height = input.fabricRuntimeJson.height ?? 1;

  return {
    schemaVersion: AI_FABRIC_RUNTIME_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION,

    mode: "runtime_hydrated",

    jobId: "",
    workspaceId: input.serverState.workspaceId,
    designId: input.serverState.designId,
    userId: "",

    createdAt: Date.now(),
    updatedAt: Date.now(),

    source: {
      reconstructionSchemaVersion: "unknown",
      reconstructionDocumentAssetId:
        input.serverState.reconstructionAssetId ?? "",
      originalImageAssetId: "",
      normalizedImageAssetId: undefined,
    },

    canvas: {
      width,
      height,
      originalWidth: width,
      originalHeight: height,
      normalizedWidth: width,
      normalizedHeight: height,
      unit: "px",
    },

    assets: input.serverState.assets,

    layerIndex: {},

    fabricJson: input.fabricRuntimeJson,

    reconstruction: {
      needsReview: true,
      warnings: ["runtime_loaded_without_manifest_template"],
    },

    runtime: {
      fabricVersion: input.fabricRuntimeJson.version,
      generatedBy: "worker",
      pipelineVersion: "unknown",
      manifestGeneratorVersion: "ai-fabric-generator.v1",
    },
  };
}
```

The fallback wrapper should almost never be used. It exists to prevent total editor failure.

# 24.12 Local draft decision

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/editor-boot/resolve-local-draft-decision.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  LocalEditorDraft,
} from "../autosave/local-draft-store";

import type {
  EditorBootLocalDraftDecision,
  EditorBootServerState,
} from "./editor-boot.types";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_EDITOR_BOOT_POLICY,
} from "./editor-boot-policy";

export async function resolveLocalDraftDecision(input: {
  draft?: LocalEditorDraft;

  serverState: EditorBootServerState;

  askUser?: (input: {
    draft: LocalEditorDraft;
    serverState: EditorBootServerState;
  }) => Promise<EditorBootLocalDraftDecision>;
}): Promise<EditorBootLocalDraftDecision> {
  if (!MAGIC_LAYERS_EDITOR_BOOT_POLICY.localDraft.enabled) {
    return "discard_local_draft";
  }

  if (!input.draft) {
    return "discard_local_draft";
  }

  const age = Date.now() - input.draft.savedAt;

  if (age > MAGIC_LAYERS_EDITOR_BOOT_POLICY.localDraft.maxAgeMs) {
    return "discard_local_draft";
  }

  if (
    MAGIC_LAYERS_EDITOR_BOOT_POLICY.localDraft
      .useLocalDraftOnlyWhenRevisionMatchesOrNewer &&
    input.draft.baseRevision < input.serverState.revision
  ) {
    return "defer";
  }

  if (
    MAGIC_LAYERS_EDITOR_BOOT_POLICY.localDraft.requireUserConfirmation &&
    input.askUser
  ) {
    return input.askUser({
      draft: input.draft,
      serverState: input.serverState,
    });
  }

  return "use_local_draft";
}
```

Do not auto-load local drafts over newer server state.

# 24.13 Runtime manifest from local draft

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/editor-boot/runtime-manifest-from-local-draft.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiFabricRuntimeManifest,
} from "../fabric-generator/fabric-generator.types";

import {
  AI_FABRIC_RUNTIME_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION,
} from "../fabric-generator/fabric-generator.types";

import {
  hydrateSavedFabricRuntimeJson,
} from "../autosave/hydrate-saved-fabric-runtime-json";

import type {
  LocalEditorDraft,
} from "../autosave/local-draft-store";

import type {
  EditorBootServerState,
} from "./editor-boot.types";

export async function runtimeManifestFromLocalDraft(input: {
  draft: LocalEditorDraft;

  serverState: EditorBootServerState;

  resolveAssetUrl: (assetId: string) => Promise<{
    url: string;
    urlExpiresAt: number;
  }>;
}): Promise<AiFabricRuntimeManifest> {
  const hydratedJson = await hydrateSavedFabricRuntimeJson({
    fabricRuntimeJson: input.draft.fabricRuntimeJson,
    assets: input.serverState.assets,
    resolveAssetUrl: async (asset) => {
      return input.resolveAssetUrl(asset.id);
    },
  });

  if (input.serverState.fabricManifestTemplate) {
    return {
      ...input.serverState.fabricManifestTemplate,

      schemaVersion: AI_FABRIC_RUNTIME_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION,

      mode: "runtime_hydrated",

      assets: input.serverState.assets,

      fabricJson: hydratedJson,

      reconstruction: {
        ...input.serverState.fabricManifestTemplate.reconstruction,
        needsReview: true,
        warnings: [
          ...input.serverState.fabricManifestTemplate.reconstruction.warnings,
          "local_draft_recovered",
        ],
      },
    };
  }

  const width = hydratedJson.width ?? 1;
  const height = hydratedJson.height ?? 1;

  return {
    schemaVersion: AI_FABRIC_RUNTIME_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION,

    mode: "runtime_hydrated",

    jobId: "",
    workspaceId: input.draft.workspaceId,
    designId: input.draft.designId,
    userId: input.draft.userId,

    createdAt: Date.now(),
    updatedAt: Date.now(),

    source: {
      reconstructionSchemaVersion: "unknown",
      reconstructionDocumentAssetId:
        input.serverState.reconstructionAssetId ?? "",
      originalImageAssetId: "",
      normalizedImageAssetId: undefined,
    },

    canvas: {
      width,
      height,
      originalWidth: width,
      originalHeight: height,
      normalizedWidth: width,
      normalizedHeight: height,
      unit: "px",
    },

    assets: input.serverState.assets,

    layerIndex: {},

    fabricJson: hydratedJson,

    reconstruction: {
      needsReview: true,
      warnings: ["local_draft_recovered_without_manifest_template"],
    },

    runtime: {
      fabricVersion: hydratedJson.version,
      generatedBy: "worker",
      pipelineVersion: "unknown",
      manifestGeneratorVersion: "ai-fabric-generator.v1",
    },
  };
}
```

# 24.14 Client boot orchestrator

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/editor-boot/load-magic-layers-editor.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  Canvas,
} from "fabric";

import {
  loadLocalEditorDraft,
} from "../autosave/local-draft-store";

import {
  loadFabricRuntimeManifest,
} from "../fabric-generator/load-fabric-runtime-manifest";

import {
  bindMagicLayerEditorBehavior,
} from "../editor-behavior/bind-magic-layer-editor-behavior";

import {
  createAutosaveManager,
} from "../autosave/create-autosave-manager";

import {
  createEditorSessionId,
} from "../autosave/editor-session";

import {
  hydrateEditorRuntimeSource,
} from "./hydrate-editor-runtime-source";

import {
  resolveLocalDraftDecision,
} from "./resolve-local-draft-decision";

import {
  runtimeManifestFromLocalDraft,
} from "./runtime-manifest-from-local-draft";

import type {
  EditorBootInput,
  EditorBootResult,
  EditorBootServerState,
} from "./editor-boot.types";

export async function loadMagicLayersEditor(input: EditorBootInput & {
  canvas: Canvas;

  markDirty: () => void;

  onAutosaveAccepted?: (revision: number) => void;

  onAutosaveConflict?: () => void;
}): Promise<{
  bootResult: EditorBootResult;

  bindings: ReturnType<typeof bindMagicLayerEditorBehavior>;

  autosaveManager: ReturnType<typeof createAutosaveManager>;

  sessionId: string;
}> {
  input.onStatus?.("checking");

  const serverState = await fetchEditorBootState(input);

  if (
    serverState.status === "not_ready" ||
    serverState.status === "failed"
  ) {
    throw new Error(`editor_not_ready:${serverState.status}`);
  }

  const resolveAssetUrl = async (assetId: string) => {
    const idToken = await input.getIdToken();
    const appCheckToken = await input.getAppCheckToken();

    const response = await fetch(
      `/api/workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/asset-runtime-url`,
      {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${idToken}`,
          "x-firebase-appcheck": appCheckToken,
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          assetId,
        }),
      }
    );

    const body = await response.json();

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(body.error ?? "asset_url_failed");
    }

    return {
      url: body.url,
      urlExpiresAt: body.urlExpiresAt,
    };
  };

  const localDraft = await loadLocalEditorDraft({
    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    userId: input.userId,
  });

  const localDecision = await resolveLocalDraftDecision({
    draft: localDraft,
    serverState,
    askUser: input.onLocalDraftFound,
  });

  let source: EditorBootResult["source"];
  let runtimeManifest;

  if (localDraft && localDecision === "use_local_draft") {
    input.onStatus?.("loading");

    runtimeManifest = await runtimeManifestFromLocalDraft({
      draft: localDraft,
      serverState,
      resolveAssetUrl,
    });

    source = "local_draft";
  } else {
    input.onStatus?.("loading");

    runtimeManifest = await hydrateEditorRuntimeSource({
      serverState,
      resolveAssetUrl,
    });

    source =
      serverState.status === "runtime_available"
        ? "server_runtime"
        : "generated_manifest";
  }

  await loadFabricRuntimeManifest({
    canvas: input.canvas,
    manifest: runtimeManifest,
  });

  const bindings = bindMagicLayerEditorBehavior({
    canvas: input.canvas,
    manifest: runtimeManifest,
    onDirty: input.markDirty,
    onRuntimeInvariantError: input.onError,
  });

  const sessionId = createEditorSessionId();

  const autosaveManager = createAutosaveManager({
    canvas: input.canvas,
    bindings,

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    userId: input.userId,

    sessionId,

    initialRevision: serverState.revision,

    getIdToken: input.getIdToken,

    onAccepted: (response) => {
      input.onAutosaveAccepted?.(response.revision);
    },

    onConflict: () => {
      input.onAutosaveConflict?.();
    },
  });

  input.onStatus?.("loaded");

  return {
    bootResult: {
      source,
      revision: serverState.revision,
      runtimeManifest,
      serverState,
      localDraftUsed: source === "local_draft",
      warnings:
        source === "local_draft"
          ? ["local_draft_recovered"]
          : [],
    },

    bindings,

    autosaveManager,

    sessionId,
  };
}

async function fetchEditorBootState(
  input: EditorBootInput
): Promise<EditorBootServerState> {
  const idToken = await input.getIdToken();
  const appCheckToken = await input.getAppCheckToken();

  const response = await fetch(
    `/api/workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/editor-boot`,
    {
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${idToken}`,
        "x-firebase-appcheck": appCheckToken,
      },
    }
  );

  const body = await response.json();

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(body.error ?? "editor_boot_failed");
  }

  return body as EditorBootServerState;
}
```

This is the main boot path.

# 24.15 React hook for editor boot

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/editor-boot/use-magic-layers-editor-boot.ts
```

```ts
"use client";

import {
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useRef,
  useState,
} from "react";

import type {
  Canvas,
} from "fabric";

import {
  loadMagicLayersEditor,
} from "./load-magic-layers-editor";

import type {
  EditorBootResult,
  EditorBootStatus,
} from "./editor-boot.types";

export function useMagicLayersEditorBoot(input: {
  canvas: Canvas | null;

  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  userId: string;

  getIdToken: () => Promise<string>;
  getAppCheckToken: () => Promise<string>;

  onDirty: () => void;
}) {
  const [status, setStatus] =
    useState<EditorBootStatus>("idle");

  const [bootResult, setBootResult] =
    useState<EditorBootResult | null>(null);

  const [error, setError] =
    useState<Error | null>(null);

  const cleanupRef = useRef<null | (() => void)>(null);

  const boot = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!input.canvas) return;

    cleanupRef.current?.();
    cleanupRef.current = null;

    setStatus("checking");
    setError(null);

    try {
      const result = await loadMagicLayersEditor({
        canvas: input.canvas,

        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        userId: input.userId,

        getIdToken: input.getIdToken,
        getAppCheckToken: input.getAppCheckToken,

        markDirty: input.onDirty,

        onStatus: setStatus,

        onLocalDraftFound: async () => {
          /**
           * Replace with your modal UI.
           * Default safe behavior: do not auto-restore.
           */
          return "defer";
        },

        onError: setError,
      });

      cleanupRef.current = () => {
        result.bindings.dispose();
        result.autosaveManager.dispose();
      };

      setBootResult(result.bootResult);
      setStatus("loaded");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err as Error);
      setStatus("failed");
    }
  }, [
    input.canvas,
    input.workspaceId,
    input.designId,
    input.userId,
    input.getIdToken,
    input.getAppCheckToken,
    input.onDirty,
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void boot();

    return () => {
      cleanupRef.current?.();
      cleanupRef.current = null;
    };
  }, [boot]);

  return {
    status,
    bootResult,
    error,
    reload: boot,
  };
}
```

# 24.16 Design status listener

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/editor-boot/listen-to-design-runtime-state.ts
```

```ts
import {
  doc,
  onSnapshot,
  type Firestore,
} from "firebase/firestore";

export type DesignRuntimeState = {
  status:
    | "processing"
    | "ready"
    | "needs_review"
    | "draft"
    | "failed";

  revision: number;

  fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId?: string;

  fabricManifestAssetId?: string;

  reconstructionAssetId?: string;

  autosaveId?: string;

  quality?: {
    needsReview?: boolean;
    visualMatchScore?: number;
    textSafetyLevel?: "pass" | "needs_review" | "fail";
  };
};

export function listenToDesignRuntimeState(input: {
  db: Firestore;

  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;

  onState: (state: DesignRuntimeState) => void;

  onError?: (error: Error) => void;
}) {
  const ref = doc(
    input.db,
    "workspaces",
    input.workspaceId,
    "designs",
    input.designId
  );

  return onSnapshot(
    ref,
    (snapshot) => {
      const data = snapshot.data();

      if (!data) return;

      input.onState({
        status: data.status,
        revision: data.current?.revision ?? 0,
        fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId:
          data.current?.fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId,
        fabricManifestAssetId:
          data.source?.currentFabricManifestAssetId,
        reconstructionAssetId:
          data.source?.currentReconstructionAssetId,
        autosaveId:
          data.current?.autosaveId,
        quality: data.quality,
      });
    },
    (error) => input.onError?.(error)
  );
}
```

Use this to update:

```txt
ready/needs_review/failed badge
remote revision conflict warnings
repair completion banner
```

Do not reload the canvas automatically while the user is dirty.

---

# 24.17 Boot source behavior

## `generated_manifest`

Used when:

```txt
current.fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId is missing
source.currentFabricManifestAssetId exists
```

Meaning:

```txt
first editor open after AI generation
```

After first edit/autosave, future opens should use `server_runtime`.

## `server_runtime`

Used when:

```txt
current.fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId exists
```

Meaning:

```txt
user has edited or autosaved at least once
```

## `local_draft`

Used only when:

```txt
IndexedDB draft exists
user explicitly chooses recovery
draft is not older than server revision
```

Local draft recovery should mark editor dirty immediately.

---

# 24.18 Boot failure states

Handle these explicitly.

```txt
not_ready
  AI job still processing.
  Show progress and listen to job/design docs.

failed
  AI job failed.
  Show failure reason and original upload/reference if available.

missing_manifest
  Reconstruction exists but Fabric manifest missing.
  Allow retry Step 18 generation.

missing_runtime_asset
  design.current points to missing GCS asset.
  Fall back to generated manifest if available.
  Mark needs review.

asset_hydration_failed
  signed URL generation or asset lookup failed.
  Do not load partial canvas silently.

fabric_load_failed
  runtime JSON invalid or object load failure.
  Offer load generated manifest or latest version.

local_draft_conflict
  local draft baseRevision < server revision.
  Offer “save local copy as version” or discard.
```

Do not open a half-loaded canvas as if it is valid.

---

# 24.19 Current runtime endpoint alternative

The Step 23 `current-runtime` endpoint can remain, but Step 24’s `editor-boot` endpoint is cleaner because it returns:

```txt
status
revision
runtime or generated manifest
assets map
quality
```

Use `current-runtime` only if you want smaller APIs.

Recommended day-one:

```txt
single editor-boot endpoint
```

It reduces client branching and race conditions.

# 24.20 Session document

Create session on boot:

```txt
workspaces/{workspaceId}/designs/{designId}/editSessions/{sessionId}
```

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/editor-boot/create-edit-session.ts
```

```ts
import {
  addDoc,
  collection,
  serverTimestamp,
  type Firestore,
} from "firebase/firestore";

export async function createEditSession(input: {
  db: Firestore;

  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  userId: string;

  sessionId: string;
}) {
  await addDoc(
    collection(
      input.db,
      "workspaces",
      input.workspaceId,
      "designs",
      input.designId,
      "editSessions"
    ),
    {
      id: input.sessionId,

      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      userId: input.userId,

      status: "active",

      createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
      lastSeenAt: serverTimestamp(),
    }
  );
}
```

In production, prefer `doc(..., sessionId).set(...)` instead of `addDoc` so the document ID equals `sessionId`.

Session docs are not collaboration. They are conflict/safety signals.

# 24.21 Rehydrating signed URLs after expiry

Runtime manifests contain signed URLs that expire.

When the editor is open for a long time:

```txt
image src may expire
export may fail
new image reload may fail
```

So before:

```txt
server export
client preview export
manual save hydration
fallback restoration
repair patch application
```

refresh asset URLs where:

```txt
resolvedUrlExpiresAt - now < refreshUrlIfExpiresWithinMs
```

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/editor-boot/refresh-runtime-asset-urls.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  Canvas,
} from "fabric";

import type {
  AiFabricRuntimeManifest,
} from "../fabric-generator/fabric-generator.types";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_EDITOR_BOOT_POLICY,
} from "./editor-boot-policy";

export async function refreshRuntimeAssetUrls(input: {
  canvas: Canvas;

  manifest: AiFabricRuntimeManifest;

  resolveAssetUrl: (assetId: string) => Promise<{
    url: string;
    urlExpiresAt: number;
  }>;
}) {
  const now = Date.now();

  for (const object of input.canvas.getObjects()) {
    const assetId = object.aiSourceAssetId;

    if (!assetId) continue;

    const asset = input.manifest.assets[assetId];

    const expiresAt = asset?.resolvedUrlExpiresAt;

    if (
      expiresAt &&
      expiresAt - now >
        MAGIC_LAYERS_EDITOR_BOOT_POLICY.hydration
          .refreshUrlIfExpiresWithinMs
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    const resolved = await input.resolveAssetUrl(assetId);

    input.manifest.assets[assetId] = {
      ...input.manifest.assets[assetId],
      resolvedUrl: resolved.url,
      resolvedUrlExpiresAt: resolved.urlExpiresAt,
    };

    if ("setSrc" in object) {
      await (object as any).setSrc(resolved.url, {
        crossOrigin: "anonymous",
      });

      object.set({
        aiSourceAssetId: assetId,
      });

      object.setCoords();
    }
  }

  input.canvas.requestRenderAll();
}
```

Do not save refreshed signed URLs as durable state. Step 23 strips them back to `magic-asset://`.

# Step 25 — Fallback restoration, repair loops, and targeted regeneration

Step 25 defines how weak AI output is repaired **without corrupting the original reconstruction truth**.

Locked rule:

```txt
Repair creates explicit patches and/or new assets.
Repair does not silently mutate AiReconstructionDocument.
Repair does not overwrite the generated Fabric manifest template.
Repair does not apply unvalidated AI output to the editor.
```

This step exists because a Magic Layers system will never be perfect on first pass. The defensible product is not “AI is always right.” The defensible product is:

```txt
AI reconstructs.
Validators detect risk.
User/system repairs are explicit.
Every repair is reversible and auditable.
```

Fabric supports image source replacement through `FabricImage.setSrc()`, and its docs recommend aborting previous loading tasks before setting a new source to avoid races. That makes runtime fallback restoration and asset replacement viable, but only as editor runtime operations. citeturn865483search0 Firebase Storage supports browser uploads from `Blob` / `File`, so user replacement assets can be uploaded, verified, normalized, and then patched into the canvas. citeturn865483search1 Google Cloud Storage signed URLs are time-limited access URLs, so repair patches must store asset IDs, not signed URLs. citeturn823131search0 Gemini image models can edit images, but generative repair must remain guarded because it can alter meaning or invent pixels. citeturn865483search2

Step 25 owns:

```txt
fallback restoration

repair request Firestore docs

repair patch generation
```

---

# 25.2 Repair categories

Use four classes.

```txt
local_runtime_repair
  no AI
  no server worker
  applies an existing fallback asset to the Fabric canvas

asset_replacement
  user uploads a new image
  server verifies/normalizes it
  runtime object source is replaced

targeted_ai_repair
  server regenerates one target asset/candidate
  returns a repair patch

full_reconstruction_retry
  creates a new AI job when local repair is insufficient
```

Day-one supported repair actions:

```txt
restore_fallback
downgrade_text_to_raster_fallback
replace_raster_asset
regenerate_clean_background
remask_raster_layer
revectorize_shape
convert_raster_text_to_editable
full_reconstruction_retry
```

Hard rule:

```txt
If text safety failed, first repair is raster fallback.
Do not “fix” unsafe text by asking a model to rewrite it.
```

---

# 25.3 Repair decision matrix

| Problem | Default repair |
|---|---|
| Unsafe editable text | `downgrade_text_to_raster_fallback` |
| Weak text font/style | `restore_fallback` or manual text edit |
| Bad vector shape | `restore_fallback` or `revectorize_shape` |
| Bad product/person mask | `remask_raster_layer` |
| Bad clean background | `regenerate_clean_background` |
| User wants new product/photo | `replace_raster_asset` |
| Many objects wrong | `full_reconstruction_retry` |
| Visual validation failed catastrophically | fallback-only or full retry |

```ts
  "ai-repair-patch.v1" as const;

      height?: number;

      preserveTransform: true;

      reason: string;

  | {
```

# 25.9 Runtime fallback restoration

Fastest repair path:

```txt
existing fallback asset
→ hydrate runtime URL
→ apply to Fabric object
→ mark object dirty
→ Step 23 autosaves
```

For image-like Fabric objects, use:

```txt
FabricImage.setSrc(...)
```

For text/vector objects, replace the object with a `FabricImage` using the fallback crop.

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/repair/apply-fallback-restoration.ts
```

```ts
import {
  FabricImage,
  type Canvas,
  type FabricObject,
} from "fabric";

import type {
  AiFabricRuntimeManifest,
} from "../fabric-generator/fabric-generator.types";

import {
  getFabricObjectByLayerId,
} from "../layer-panel/fabric-layer-lookup";

import {
  normalizeFabricObjectAfterEdit,
} from "../editor-behavior/normalize-object-after-edit";

export async function applyFallbackRestoration(input: {
  canvas: Canvas;

  manifest: AiFabricRuntimeManifest;

  layerId: string;

  fallbackAssetId?: string;

  resolveAssetUrl: (assetId: string) => Promise<{
    url: string;
    urlExpiresAt: number;
  }>;

  repairMode:
    | "restore_fallback"
    | "downgrade_text_to_raster_fallback";
}) {
  const object = getFabricObjectByLayerId({
    canvas: input.canvas,
    layerId: input.layerId,
  });

  if (!object) {
    throw new Error(`missing_fabric_object_${input.layerId}`);
  }

  const layerIndex = input.manifest.layerIndex[input.layerId];

  if (!layerIndex) {
    throw new Error(`missing_layer_index_${input.layerId}`);
  }

  const fallbackAssetId =
    input.fallbackAssetId ??
    layerIndex.primaryFallbackAssetId ??
    layerIndex.fallbackAssetIds[0];

  if (!fallbackAssetId) {
    throw new Error(`missing_fallback_asset_${input.layerId}`);
  }

  const resolved = await input.resolveAssetUrl(fallbackAssetId);

  const isImageObject =
    String(object.type).toLowerCase().includes("image");

  if (isImageObject && "setSrc" in object) {
    await (object as any).setSrc(resolved.url, {
      crossOrigin: "anonymous",
    });

    object.set({
      aiSourceAssetId: fallbackAssetId,
      aiFallbackAssetId: fallbackAssetId,
      aiDirty: true,
    });

    normalizeFabricObjectAfterEdit(object);
    input.canvas.requestRenderAll();

    return {
      layerId: input.layerId,
      fallbackAssetId,
      replacedObject: false,
    };
  }

  const replacement = await FabricImage.fromURL(
    resolved.url,
    {
      crossOrigin: "anonymous",
    }
  );

  copyPlacementAndAiIdentity({
    source: object,
    target: replacement,
    fallbackAssetId,
  });

  const index = input.canvas.getObjects().indexOf(object);

  input.canvas.remove(object);
  input.canvas.insertAt(index, replacement);
  input.canvas.setActiveObject(replacement);

  replacement.setCoords();

  input.canvas.requestRenderAll();

  return {
    layerId: input.layerId,
    fallbackAssetId,
    replacedObject: true,
  };
}

function copyPlacementAndAiIdentity(input: {
  source: FabricObject;
  target: FabricImage;
  fallbackAssetId: string;
}) {
  const source = input.source;

  input.target.set({
    id: source.id,
    name: source.name,

    left: source.left,
    top: source.top,

    width: source.width,
    height: source.height,

    scaleX: source.scaleX,
    scaleY: source.scaleY,

    angle: source.angle,
    opacity: source.opacity,

    originX: source.originX,
    originY: source.originY,

    visible: source.visible,

    selectable: source.selectable,
    evented: source.evented,

    aiLayerId: source.aiLayerId,
    aiParentLayerId: source.aiParentLayerId,

    aiLayerType: source.aiLayerType,

    aiEditableLevel: "raster_fallback",

    aiConfidence: {
      ...(source.aiConfidence ?? {}),
      overall: Math.max(0.7, source.aiConfidence?.overall ?? 0),
    },

    aiSource: "manual_user",

    aiFallbackAssetId: input.fallbackAssetId,
    aiSourceAssetId: input.fallbackAssetId,

    aiSchemaVersion: source.aiSchemaVersion,

    aiRuntimeKind: source.aiRuntimeKind ?? "reconstruction_layer",

    aiCreatedByEditor: false,
    aiDirty: true,

    crossOrigin: "anonymous",
  });
}
```

This is local runtime repair. It does not need an AI worker.

# 25.10 Repair patch application

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/repair/apply-repair-patch-to-canvas.ts
```

```ts
import {
  FabricImage,
  type Canvas,
} from "fabric";

import type {
  MagicRepairPatch,
} from "./repair.types";

import {
  getFabricObjectByLayerId,
} from "../layer-panel/fabric-layer-lookup";

import {
  normalizeFabricObjectAfterEdit,
} from "../editor-behavior/normalize-object-after-edit";

export async function applyRepairPatchToCanvas(input: {
  canvas: Canvas;

  currentRevision: number;

  patch: MagicRepairPatch;

  resolveAssetUrl: (assetId: string) => Promise<{
    url: string;
    urlExpiresAt: number;
  }>;
}) {
  if (input.patch.baseRevision !== input.currentRevision) {
    throw new Error("repair_patch_base_revision_mismatch");
  }

  for (const op of input.patch.ops) {
    switch (op.op) {
      case "replace_image_src": {
        const object = getFabricObjectByLayerId({
          canvas: input.canvas,
          layerId: op.layerId,
        });

        if (!object) {
          throw new Error(`patch_missing_object_${op.layerId}`);
        }

        const resolved = await input.resolveAssetUrl(op.assetId);

        if ("setSrc" in object) {
          await (object as any).setSrc(resolved.url, {
            crossOrigin: "anonymous",
          });

          object.set({
            aiSourceAssetId: op.assetId,
            aiDirty: true,
          });

          normalizeFabricObjectAfterEdit(object);
        } else {
          const replacement = await FabricImage.fromURL(
            resolved.url,
            {
              crossOrigin: "anonymous",
            }
          );

          replacement.set({
            ...object.toObject(),
            src: resolved.url,
            crossOrigin: "anonymous",
            aiSourceAssetId: op.assetId,
            aiDirty: true,
          });

          const index = input.canvas.getObjects().indexOf(object);

          input.canvas.remove(object);
          input.canvas.insertAt(index, replacement);

          replacement.setCoords();
        }

        break;
      }

      case "set_object_props": {
        const object = getFabricObjectByLayerId({
          canvas: input.canvas,
          layerId: op.layerId,
        });

        if (!object) {
          throw new Error(`patch_missing_object_${op.layerId}`);
        }

        object.set({
          ...op.props,
          aiDirty: true,
        } as any);

        normalizeFabricObjectAfterEdit(object);
        break;
      }

      case "remove_object": {
        const object = getFabricObjectByLayerId({
          canvas: input.canvas,
          layerId: op.layerId,
        });

        if (object) {
          input.canvas.remove(object);
        }

        break;
      }

      case "replace_object":
        throw new Error("replace_object_patch_not_enabled_day_one");

      case "add_object":
        throw new Error("add_object_patch_not_enabled_day_one");

      case "mark_review_resolved": {
        const object = getFabricObjectByLayerId({
          canvas: input.canvas,
          layerId: op.layerId,
        });

        if (object) {
          object.set({
            aiDirty: true,
          });
        }

        break;
      }
    }
  }

  input.canvas.requestRenderAll();
}
```

Day-one patch ops should be limited to:

```txt
replace_image_src
set_object_props
remove_object
```

Enable `replace_object` only after you have tested Fabric object replacement across text, vector, image, selection state, autosave, and undo.

```ts
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        Authorization: `Bearer ${input.idToken}`,
        "x-firebase-appcheck": input.appCheckToken,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        assetId: input.assetId,
      }),
    }
  );

  const body = await response.json();

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(body.error ?? "asset_url_failed");
  }

  return body as {
    assetId: string;
    url: string;
    urlExpiresAt: number;
  };
}
```

Backend repair APIs should verify Firebase Auth and App Check. Firebase App Check docs state that custom backends should check that requests include an App Check token and verify it with the Admin SDK. citeturn823131search2

```ts
import {
  FieldValue,
  getFirestore,
} from "firebase-admin/firestore";

import type {
  MagicRepairType,
} from "./repair.types";

export async function createRepairRequest(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  userId: string;

  jobId?: string;

  repairType: MagicRepairType;

  target: {
    layerId?: string;
    objectId?: string;
    groupId?: string;
    bbox?: {
      x: number;
      y: number;
      width: number;
      height: number;
    };
  };

  input: {
    baseRevision: number;
    runtimeSnapshotAssetId?: string;
    reconstructionAssetId?: string;
    fabricManifestTemplateAssetId?: string;
    uploadedAssetId?: string;
    fallbackAssetId?: string;
    prompt?: string;
    constraints?: Record<string, unknown>;
  };
}) {
  const db = getFirestore();

  const ref = db
    .collection(
      `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/repairRequests`
    )
    .doc();

  await ref.set({
    id: ref.id,

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    userId: input.userId,

    jobId: input.jobId ?? null,

    status: "queued",

    repairType: input.repairType,

    target: input.target,

    input: input.input,

    progress: {
      percent: 0,
      label: "Repair queued",
    },

    createdAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
  });

  return {
    repairRequestId: ref.id,

}
```

# 25.13 Repair request API

Create:

```txt
src/app/api/workspaces/[workspaceId]/designs/[designId]/repair-requests/route.ts
```

```ts
import {
  NextRequest,
  NextResponse,
} from "next/server";

import {
  getAuth,
} from "firebase-admin/auth";

import {
  getAppCheck,
} from "firebase-admin/app-check";

import {
  createRepairRequest,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/repair/create-repair-request";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

export async function POST(
  req: NextRequest,
  context: {
    params: Promise<{
      workspaceId: string;
      designId: string;
    }>;
  }
) {
  const {
    workspaceId,
    designId,
  } = await context.params;

  const userId = await verifyAuthAndAppCheck(req);

  await assertWorkspaceAccess({
    workspaceId,
    userId,
  });

  const body = await req.json();

  const result = await createRepairRequest({
    workspaceId,
    designId,
    userId,

    jobId: body.jobId,

    repairType: body.repairType,

    target: body.target,

    input: body.input,
  });

  await enqueueRepairWorker({
    workspaceId,
    designId,
    repairRequestId: result.repairRequestId,
  });

  return NextResponse.json(result);
}

async function verifyAuthAndAppCheck(req: NextRequest) {
  const authHeader = req.headers.get("authorization") ?? "";

  const idToken = authHeader.startsWith("Bearer ")
    ? authHeader.slice("Bearer ".length)
    : undefined;

  if (!idToken) {
    throw new Error("missing_auth_token");
  }

  const decoded = await getAuth().verifyIdToken(idToken);

  const appCheckToken = req.headers.get("x-firebase-appcheck");

  if (!appCheckToken) {
    throw new Error("missing_app_check_token");
  }

  await getAppCheck().verifyToken(appCheckToken);

  return decoded.uid;
}
```

# 25.14 Repair worker dispatcher

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/repair/run-repair-request.ts
```

```ts
import {
  FieldValue,
  getFirestore,
} from "firebase-admin/firestore";

import type {
  MagicRepairPatch,
} from "./repair.types";

import {
  persistRepairPatch,
} from "./persist-repair-patch";

import {
  repairExistingFallback,
} from "./repair-existing-fallback";

import {
  repairReplaceRasterAsset,
} from "./repair-replace-raster-asset";

import {
  repairCleanBackground,
} from "./repair-clean-background";

import {
  repairRasterMask,
} from "./repair-raster-mask";

import {
  repairVectorShape,
} from "./repair-vector-shape";

import {
  repairTextConversion,
} from "./repair-text-conversion";

export async function runRepairRequest(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  repairRequestId: string;
}) {
  const db = getFirestore();

  const ref = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/repairRequests/${input.repairRequestId}`
  );

  const snap = await ref.get();

  if (!snap.exists) {
    throw new Error("repair_request_not_found");
  }

  const request = snap.data()!;

  await ref.update({
    status: "running",
    "progress.percent": 10,
    "progress.label": "Repair running",
    updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
  });

  try {
    let patch: MagicRepairPatch;

    switch (request.repairType) {
      case "restore_fallback":
      case "downgrade_text_to_raster_fallback":
        patch = await repairExistingFallback(request);
        break;

      case "replace_raster_asset":
        patch = await repairReplaceRasterAsset(request);
        break;

      case "regenerate_clean_background":
        patch = await repairCleanBackground(request);
        break;

      case "remask_raster_layer":
        patch = await repairRasterMask(request);
        break;

      case "revectorize_shape":
        patch = await repairVectorShape(request);
        break;

      case "convert_raster_text_to_editable":
        patch = await repairTextConversion(request);
        break;

      case "full_reconstruction_retry":
        throw new Error("full_reconstruction_retry_is_new_job_flow");

      default:
        throw new Error(`unsupported_repair_type:${request.repairType}`);
    }

    const output = await persistRepairPatch({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      repairRequestId: input.repairRequestId,
      patch,
    });

    await ref.update({
      status: "completed",

      output: {
        repairPatchAssetId: output.patchAsset.id,
        repairedAssetIds: patch.repairedAssetIds,
      },

      "progress.percent": 100,
      "progress.label": "Repair completed",

      completedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });

    return output;
  } catch (error) {
    await ref.update({
      status: "failed",

      error: {
        code: "repair_failed",
        message:
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown repair error",
        retryable: true,
      },

      updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });

    throw error;
  }
}
```
