# 25.15 Persist repair patch

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/repair/persist-repair-patch.ts
```

```ts
import {
  AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,
  AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
} from "../schema/constants";

import {
  bucketForMagicStorageRole,
} from "../storage/storage-buckets";

import {
  repairPatchPath,
  repairRequestReportPath,
} from "../storage/storage-paths";

import {
  writeAiAsset,
} from "../storage/write-ai-asset";

import type {
  MagicRepairPatch,
} from "./repair.types";

export async function persistRepairPatch(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  repairRequestId: string;
  patch: MagicRepairPatch;
}) {
  validateRepairPatch(input.patch);

  const patchAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.repairRequestId,
    "repair-patch"
  );

  const patchAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "assets",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("assets"),
    storagePath: repairPatchPath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      repairRequestId: input.repairRequestId,
      assetId: patchAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(
      JSON.stringify(input.patch, null, 2),
      "utf8"
    ),

    assetId: patchAssetId,
    kind: "repair_patch_json" as any,

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,

    source: "system",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  const reportAssetId = stableAssetId(
    input.repairRequestId,
    "repair-report"
  );

  const reportAsset = await writeAiAsset({
    storageRole: "source",
    bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
    storagePath: repairRequestReportPath({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      repairRequestId: input.repairRequestId,
      assetId: reportAssetId,
    }),

    bytes: Buffer.from(
      JSON.stringify(
        {
          repairRequestId: input.repairRequestId,
          patchAssetId: patchAsset.id,
          repairedAssetIds: input.patch.repairedAssetIds,
          warnings: input.patch.warnings,
          createdAt: Date.now(),
        },
        null,
        2
      ),
      "utf8"
    ),

    assetId: reportAssetId,
    kind: "repair_request_report_json" as any,

    contentType: "application/json",

    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,

    source: "system",

    schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

    sourceAssetId: patchAsset.id,

    cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
  });

  return {
    patchAsset,
    reportAsset,
  };
}

function validateRepairPatch(patch: MagicRepairPatch) {
  for (const op of patch.ops) {
    if ("assetId" in op) {
      if (/^https?:\/\//.test(op.assetId)) {
        throw new Error("repair_patch_contains_signed_url");
      }

      if (/^data:/i.test(op.assetId)) {
        throw new Error("repair_patch_contains_base64_asset");
      }
    }
  }
}

function stableAssetId(repairRequestId: string, label: string) {
  return `asset_${repairRequestId}_${label}_${crypto.randomUUID()}`
    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "_")
    .toLowerCase();
}
```

Remove `as any` after patching asset kind enum.

# 25.16 Repair: existing fallback

```ts
import type {
  MagicRepairPatch,
} from "./repair.types";

export async function repairExistingFallback(
  request: any
): Promise<MagicRepairPatch> {
  const layerId = request.target?.layerId;
  const fallbackAssetId =
    request.input?.fallbackAssetId ??
    request.input?.constraints?.fallbackAssetId;

  if (!layerId) {
    throw new Error("missing_layer_id");
  }

  if (!fallbackAssetId) {
    throw new Error("missing_fallback_asset_id");
  }

  return {
    schemaVersion: "ai-repair-patch.v1",

    workspaceId: request.workspaceId,
    designId: request.designId,
    repairRequestId: request.id,

    baseRevision: request.input.baseRevision,

    repairType: request.repairType,

    targetLayerId: layerId,

    ops: [
      {
        op: "replace_image_src",
        layerId,
        assetId: fallbackAssetId,
        preserveTransform: true,
        reason:
          request.repairType === "downgrade_text_to_raster_fallback"
            ? "Unsafe or weak editable text downgraded to raster fallback"
            : "Layer restored from fallback asset",
      },
      {
        op: "set_object_props",
        layerId,
        props: {
          aiEditableLevel: "raster_fallback",
          aiSourceAssetId: fallbackAssetId,
          aiFallbackAssetId: fallbackAssetId,
          aiDirty: true,
        },
        reason: "Runtime layer now uses fallback representation",
      },
    ],

    repairedAssetIds: [fallbackAssetId],

    warnings: [],

    createdAt: Date.now(),
  };
}
```

This is also the correct repair when Step 20 text safety fails.

```ts
import type {

export async function repairReplaceRasterAsset(
  request: any
): Promise<MagicRepairPatch> {
  const layerId = request.target?.layerId;
  const uploadedAssetId = request.input?.uploadedAssetId;

  if (!layerId) {
    throw new Error("missing_layer_id");
  }

  if (!uploadedAssetId) {
    throw new Error("missing_uploaded_asset_id");
  }

  /**
   * Production implementation:
   * - verify uploaded asset belongs to this workspace/design
   * - decode image
   * - normalize to editor asset
   * - create user_replacement_asset
   *
   * Day-one can use uploadedAssetId after verification.
   */
  const replacementAssetId = uploadedAssetId;

  return {
    schemaVersion: "ai-repair-patch.v1",

    workspaceId: request.workspaceId,
    designId: request.designId,
    repairRequestId: request.id,

    baseRevision: request.input.baseRevision,

    repairType: "replace_raster_asset",

    targetLayerId: layerId,

    ops: [
      {
        op: "replace_image_src",
        layerId,
        assetId: replacementAssetId,
        preserveTransform: true,
        reason: "User replaced raster asset",
      },
      {
        op: "set_object_props",
        layerId,
        props: {
          aiSource: "manual_user",
          aiRuntimeKind: "manual_object",
          aiSourceAssetId: replacementAssetId,
          aiDirty: true,
        },
        reason: "Layer now uses user-provided replacement asset",
      },
    ],

    repairedAssetIds: [replacementAssetId],

    warnings: [],

    createdAt: Date.now(),
  };
}
```

```ts
      },

        op: "set_object_props",
        layerId: backgroundLayerId,
        props: {
          aiSourceAssetId: repairedBackgroundAssetId,
          aiDirty: true,
        },
        reason: "Background layer repaired",
      },
    ],

    repairedAssetIds: [repairedBackgroundAssetId],

    warnings: [],

    createdAt: Date.now(),
  };
}

async function runTargetedBackgroundRepairAndReturnAssetId(
  request: any
): Promise<string> {
  /**
   * Reuse Step 14 in target mode:
   * - build removal mask from selected target layer(s)
   * - run conservative repair engine
   * - force outside-mask preservation
   * - write repaired_background_png
   * - return asset id
   */
  throw new Error("targeted_background_repair_not_implemented");
}
```

Background repair must repeat Step 14’s safety rule:

```txt
outside mask = original/current background pixels
inside mask = repaired pixels
```

Generative image editing can be useful later, but it must be review-first and mask-composited. Gemini image docs describe image editing capabilities, but this system should never allow a generative model to rewrite unmasked areas. citeturn865483search2

```ts
    warnings: [],

  request: any
): Promise<{
  passed: boolean;
  fabricObject: any;
```

```ts
import {
  NextRequest,
  NextResponse,
} from "next/server";

import {
  getFirestore,
} from "firebase-admin/firestore";

import {
  downloadJsonAsset,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/storage/download-json-asset";

import {
  loadAssetRef,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/storage/load-asset-ref";

import type {
  MagicRepairPatch,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/repair/repair.types";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

export async function GET(
  req: NextRequest,
  context: {
    params: Promise<{
      workspaceId: string;
      designId: string;
      repairRequestId: string;
    }>;
  }
) {
  const {
    workspaceId,
    designId,
    repairRequestId,
  } = await context.params;

  const userId = await verifyAuthAndAppCheck(req);

  await assertWorkspaceAccess({
    workspaceId,
    userId,
  });

  const db = getFirestore();

  const repairSnap = await db
    .doc(
      `workspaces/${workspaceId}/designs/${designId}/repairRequests/${repairRequestId}`
    )
    .get();

  if (!repairSnap.exists) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "repair_request_not_found" },
      { status: 404 }
    );
  }

  const repair = repairSnap.data()!;

  if (repair.status !== "completed") {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "repair_not_completed" },
      { status: 409 }
    );
  }

  const patchAssetId = repair.output?.repairPatchAssetId;

  if (!patchAssetId) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "repair_patch_missing" },
      { status: 404 }
    );
  }

  const patchAsset = await loadAssetRef({
    workspaceId,
    designId,
    assetId: patchAssetId,
  });

  const patch = await downloadJsonAsset<MagicRepairPatch>(
    patchAsset
  );

  return NextResponse.json(patch);
}
```

---

# 25.23 Client repair flow

The client flow is deterministic:

```txt
1. User clicks repair action.
2. Client creates repair request.
3. Client listens to repairRequests/{repairRequestId}.
4. When completed, client fetches repair patch.
5. Client hydrates patch asset URLs.
6. Client applies patch to Fabric canvas.
7. Client marks dirty.
8. Step 23 autosaves repaired runtime state.
9. Optional: create repair_result version.
```

Patch application must verify:

```txt
patch.baseRevision === current autosave revision
```

If not:

```txt
show conflict
do not apply automatically
```

---

# 25.24 User replacement upload

For `replace_raster_asset`:

```txt
browser file
→ upload to staging path
→ server verifies and normalizes
→ creates user_replacement_asset
→ repair request uses uploadedAssetId
→ patch replaces layer image source
```

Do not save browser blob URLs.

Do not save signed URLs.

Do not trust MIME type only. Decode and inspect the image server-side.

Firebase Storage supports `uploadBytes()` from `Blob` / `File`, and metadata can specify fields such as `contentType`. citeturn865483search1turn865483search9

---

# 25.25 Repair UI actions

Layer panel should expose these actions based on layer type.

| Layer state | Repair actions |
|---|---|
| `text_editable` + safety fail | Restore raster fallback |
| `text_raster_fallback` | Try convert to editable text |
| `vector_editable` + warning | Restore raster fallback, revectorize |
| `raster_masked` | Remask object, replace image, restore fallback |
| `clean_background` | Regenerate background, restore original |
| `unknown_confidence` | Restore fallback, manual review |
| `locked_reference` | Show/hide, restore original view only |

Every repair action should display:

```txt
what changes
whether new assets will be created
whether it can be undone
whether AI will be used
whether validation is required
```

---

# 25.26 Repair validation requirements

Every targeted AI repair must validate before returning a patch.

```txt
background repair
  outside-mask preservation
  seam risk
  hallucination risk

mask repair
  mask area sanity
  alpha coverage
  bbox bounds
  edge quality

vector repair
  render validation
  path complexity
  fallback attached

text conversion
  OCR/string safety
  protected token safety
  render validation

replacement upload
  MIME validation
  decode validation
  dimensions
  storage ownership
```

No unvalidated AI result reaches the canvas.

---

# 25.27 Repair result persistence

Repair patch is not the final saved state.

After applying patch:

```txt
Fabric runtime canvas changes
→ mark dirty
→ Step 23 autosave persists runtime JSON
→ optional design version source = repair_result
```

Recommended post-repair save:

```txt
create autosave checkpoint immediately
create version if repair was user-confirmed
```

Undo rule:

```txt
Before applying repair patch:
  create checkpoint if dirty

After applying repair patch:
  autosave repaired runtime
```

---

# 25.28 Full reconstruction retry

Use only when targeted repair is insufficient.

Trigger criteria:

```txt
visual validation failed catastrophically
many layers low confidence
background/foreground relationship broken
text recovery failed across many regions
z-order widely wrong
```

Full retry creates:

```txt
new aiLayerJobs/{jobId}
new reconstruction document
new Fabric manifest template
new editor runtime source
```

It does not overwrite the user’s current edited runtime unless the user explicitly chooses to replace it.

---

# 25.29 Security requirements

Repair APIs must verify:

```txt
Firebase Auth
Firebase App Check
workspace access
design access
repair target belongs to design
base revision is valid
uploaded asset belongs to design
fallback asset belongs to design
repair patch assets belong to design
runtime snapshot belongs to design
```

Reject:

```txt
foreign asset IDs
signed URLs in patch
base64 data in patch
repairing locked_reference
unbounded prompts
cross-design asset references
```

App Check should be enforced on custom backend endpoints to ensure requests originate from your app, not only from an authenticated user. citeturn823131search2turn823131search6

---

# 25.30 What Step 25 must not do

Do not:

```txt
silently repair without request
overwrite AiReconstructionDocument
overwrite AiFabricManifestTemplate
apply AI output without validation
auto-convert unsafe text to editable
store signed URLs
store blob URLs
store base64 assets
apply patch to stale runtime without conflict handling
run full reconstruction for a single local defect
```

# 25.32 Non-negotiable invariants

Step 25 is valid only if:

```txt
Every repair is explicit.

Fallback restoration can happen without AI.

Unsafe editable text repairs to raster fallback first.

AI repair results are validated before patch creation.

Repair output is a patch asset.

Patch contains no signed URLs.

Patch contains no base64 images.

Patch references only design-owned assets.

Patch is applied only to matching runtime revision.

Applying repair marks runtime dirty.

Step 23 persists repaired runtime state.

Repair result can create a version.

AiReconstructionDocument remains original AI snapshot.

Fabric manifest template remains original AI projection.

Full reconstruction retry creates a new job, not an overwrite.
```

---

# 25.33 Definition of done

Step 25 is complete when:

```txt
Layer panel can trigger fallback restoration.

Unsafe text can be downgraded to raster fallback.

Raster assets can be replaced by user upload.

Repair request docs exist.

Repair worker dispatch exists.

Repair patch assets are generated.

Client can load and apply repair patches.

Repair patch application marks canvas dirty.

Step 23 autosaves repaired runtime state.

Repair result versions can be created.

No repair mutates the original reconstruction document.

No repair stores signed URLs.

No unvalidated AI repair reaches the canvas.
```

Locked Step 25 architecture:

```txt
User/system repair request
→ explicit repair request doc
→ local fallback OR targeted repair worker
→ validated repair assets
→ repair patch JSON
→ client applies patch to Fabric runtime
→ Step 23 persists repaired runtime snapshot
→ optional repair_result version
```

Next is Step 26: **Exports, server rendering, and production output pipeline**.

## ChatGPT Response 036

Step 26 is the production export boundary: official downloads must render server-side from the saved Fabric runtime state, not client canvas output or the original reconstruction.

# Step 26 — Exports, server rendering, and production output pipeline

Step 26 turns the saved editor state into production outputs:

```txt
PNG
JPEG
WebP
flattened PDF
best-effort SVG
runtime JSON package
```

The locked rule:

```txt
Exports are generated from the current Fabric runtime state.
Exports do not mutate AiReconstructionDocument.
Exports do not mutate AiFabricManifestTemplate.
Exports do not run repair.
Exports do not trust unsaved browser state.
```

The important product boundary:

```txt
AiReconstructionDocument = AI provenance truth
AiFabricManifestTemplate = generated import package
FabricRuntimeJson = current user-edited design
ExportOutput = disposable production artifact
```

Fabric supports raster export APIs such as `toCanvasElement`, `toBlob`, and `toDataURL`, plus SVG export through `toSVG`; however Fabric’s own docs state that SVG and Canvas are not identical and SVG import/export is not one-to-one, so SVG export must be treated as best-effort, not canonical truth. citeturn113684search0turn570662view2

---

## 26.1 What Step 26 owns

Step 26 owns:

```txt
export request API
export request Firestore docs
export queue/worker dispatch
runtime state resolution
asset URL hydration
server-side Fabric rendering
PNG/JPEG/WebP/PDF/SVG output generation
export artifact storage
export validation
export status updates
download URL generation
export version checkpoint
```

Step 26 does **not** own:

```txt
editing
autosave logic
repair logic
AI layer regeneration
text safety validation
visual reconstruction validation
canonical reconstruction mutation
```

Step 23 must save current runtime state first. Step 26 exports that saved state.

---

# 26.2 Core export principle

Final exports must be server-rendered.

Client export is allowed only for:

```txt
quick preview
temporary download
debugging
```

Server export is required for:

```txt
final output
paid/downloadable output
PDF
high-resolution raster
consistent fonts
auditability
reproducibility
```

Reason:

```txt
browser export depends on current tab state
browser export may miss unsaved changes
browser export can fail due to CORS/canvas tainting
browser export is not reproducible
browser export cannot be audited reliably
```

So the final flow is:

```txt
client flushes autosave
→ server reads design.current.fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId
→ server hydrates asset URLs
→ server renders in controlled headless Chromium
→ server stores output assets
→ client downloads signed URL
```

---

# 26.3 Export source rule

Export input priority:

```txt
1. design.current.fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId
2. generated Fabric manifest template only if no user runtime exists
```

Do not export from:

```txt
AiReconstructionDocument directly
local unsaved canvas
stale generated manifest when user runtime exists
client-submitted arbitrary Fabric JSON
```

Required client sequence before export:

```ts
await autosaveManager.flush();

await createExportRequest({
  workspaceId,
  designId,
  baseRevision: autosaveManager.getRevision(),
  format: "png",
  scale: 2,
});
```

If `baseRevision` does not match `design.current.revision`, the export request must be rejected with conflict.

---

# 26.4 Supported export formats

Use these format names:

```ts
export type MagicExportFormat =
  | "png"
  | "jpeg"
  | "webp"
  | "pdf_flattened"
  | "svg_best_effort"
  | "fabric_runtime_json";
```

## `png`

Primary production raster output.

Use for:

```txt
social images
posters
transparent exports
high-fidelity preview
```

## `jpeg`

Flattened RGB export.

Use for:

```txt
small file sharing
non-transparent final images
```

## `webp`

Optimized web delivery export.

Use for:

```txt
web previews
downloadable web assets
smaller final files
```

WebP supports lossy/lossless compression and transparency, so it is useful for web delivery when the user does not require PNG. citeturn531538search3

## `pdf_flattened`

Raster PDF output.

Use for:

```txt
downloadable proof
print-ish output
simple sharing
```

Do not claim:

```txt
editable PDF
CMYK PDF
press-ready PDF/X
vector PDF
```

Playwright `page.pdf()` generates PDF using print CSS by default; for screen-like output, call `page.emulateMedia({ media: "screen" })`, and exact colors need print color adjustment. citeturn570662view0turn414157search3

## `svg_best_effort`

Fabric SVG export.

Use for:

```txt
simple vector-heavy designs
debugging
interchange when acceptable
```

Do not claim:

```txt
pixel-perfect SVG
canonical SVG
round-trip-safe SVG
```

Fabric docs explicitly warn SVG import/export is not one-to-one. citeturn570662view2

## `fabric_runtime_json`

Durable editor state export.

Use for:

```txt
backup
developer/debug package
migration
support
```

Must strip signed URLs and use:

```txt
magic-asset://assetId
```

# 26.7 Storage path patch

Patch Step 3 paths:

```ts
export function exportRequestRootPath(
  input: WorkspaceDesignPathInput & {
    exportRequestId: string;
  }
) {
  return joinPath([
    "workspaces",
    input.workspaceId,
    "designs",
    input.designId,
    "exports",
    input.exportRequestId,
  ]);
}

export function exportOutputAssetPath(
  input: WorkspaceDesignPathInput & {
    exportRequestId: string;
    assetId: string;
    extension:
      | "png"
      | "jpg"
      | "webp"
      | "pdf"
      | "svg"
      | "json"
      | "zip";
  }
) {
  return joinPath([
    exportRequestRootPath(input),
    `${input.assetId}.${input.extension}`,
  ]);
}

export function exportRequestReportPath(
  input: WorkspaceDesignPathInput & {
    exportRequestId: string;
    assetId: string;
  }
) {
  return joinPath([
    exportRequestRootPath(input),
    `${input.assetId}.export-report.json`,
  ]);
}
```

Export output assets should usually use immutable cache headers because the asset ID is content/version-specific. Cloud Storage `Cache-Control` metadata controls whether and how long objects are cached. citeturn570662view5

# 26.10 Export request API

Create:

```txt
src/app/api/workspaces/[workspaceId]/designs/[designId]/exports/route.ts
```

```ts
import {
  NextRequest,
  NextResponse,
} from "next/server";

import {
  FieldValue,
  getFirestore,
} from "firebase-admin/firestore";

import {
  getAuth,
} from "firebase-admin/auth";

import {
  getAppCheck,
} from "firebase-admin/app-check";

import type {
  MagicExportFormat,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/export/export.types";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_EXPORT_POLICY,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/export/export-policy";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

export async function POST(
  req: NextRequest,
  context: {
    params: Promise<{
      workspaceId: string;
      designId: string;
    }>;
  }
) {
  const {
    workspaceId,
    designId,
  } = await context.params;

  const userId = await verifyAuthAndAppCheck(req);

  await assertWorkspaceAccess({
    workspaceId,
    userId,
  });

  const body = await req.json();

  const format = body.format as MagicExportFormat;

  validateExportRequestBody(body);

  const db = getFirestore();

  const designRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${workspaceId}/designs/${designId}`
  );

  const exportRef = db
    .collection(
      `workspaces/${workspaceId}/designs/${designId}/exportRequests`
    )
    .doc();

  await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
    const designSnap = await tx.get(designRef);

    if (!designSnap.exists) {
      throw new Error("design_not_found");
    }

    const design = designSnap.data()!;

    const currentRevision = design.current?.revision ?? 0;

    if (body.baseRevision !== currentRevision) {
      throw new Error("export_base_revision_mismatch");
    }

    tx.set(exportRef, {
      id: exportRef.id,

      workspaceId,
      designId,
      userId,

      status: "queued",

      format,

      input: {
        baseRevision: body.baseRevision,

        fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId:
          design.current?.fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId ?? null,

        fabricManifestTemplateAssetId:
          design.source?.currentFabricManifestAssetId ?? null,

        reconstructionAssetId:
          design.source?.currentReconstructionAssetId ?? null,

        versionId:
          design.current?.versionId ?? null,

        scale:
          body.scale ??
          MAGIC_LAYERS_EXPORT_POLICY.render.defaultScale,

        transparentBackground:
          body.transparentBackground ?? false,

        includeLockedReference:
          body.includeLockedReference ??
          MAGIC_LAYERS_EXPORT_POLICY.render
            .includeLockedReferenceByDefault,

        includeHiddenLayers:
          body.includeHiddenLayers ??
          MAGIC_LAYERS_EXPORT_POLICY.render
            .includeHiddenLayersByDefault,

        quality: body.quality ?? null,
      },

      progress: {
        percent: 0,
        label: "Export queued",
      },

      createdAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });
  });

  await enqueueExportWorker({
    workspaceId,
    designId,
    exportRequestId: exportRef.id,
  });

  return NextResponse.json({
    exportRequestId: exportRef.id,
  });
}

function validateExportRequestBody(body: any) {
  const allowedFormats = Object.keys(
    MAGIC_LAYERS_EXPORT_POLICY.formats
  );

  if (!allowedFormats.includes(body.format)) {
    throw new Error("unsupported_export_format");
  }

  const scale =
    body.scale ??
    MAGIC_LAYERS_EXPORT_POLICY.render.defaultScale;

  if (
    scale <= 0 ||
    scale > MAGIC_LAYERS_EXPORT_POLICY.render.maxScale
  ) {
    throw new Error("invalid_export_scale");
  }

  if (typeof body.baseRevision !== "number") {
    throw new Error("missing_base_revision");
  }
}

async function verifyAuthAndAppCheck(req: NextRequest) {
  const authHeader = req.headers.get("authorization") ?? "";

  const idToken = authHeader.startsWith("Bearer ")
    ? authHeader.slice("Bearer ".length)
    : undefined;

  if (!idToken) {
    throw new Error("missing_auth_token");
  }

  const decoded = await getAuth().verifyIdToken(idToken);

  const appCheckToken = req.headers.get("x-firebase-appcheck");

  if (!appCheckToken) {
    throw new Error("missing_app_check_token");
  }

  await getAppCheck().verifyToken(appCheckToken);

  return decoded.uid;
}
```

App Check verification belongs on custom backend endpoints; Firebase docs say custom backends should require and verify App Check tokens. citeturn570662view6

# 26.11 Resolve export source

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/export/resolve-export-source.ts
```

```ts
import {
  getFirestore,
} from "firebase-admin/firestore";

import {
  downloadJsonAsset,
} from "../storage/download-json-asset";

import {
  loadAssetRef,
} from "../storage/load-asset-ref";

import type {
  AiFabricManifestTemplate,
  FabricRuntimeJson,
} from "../fabric-generator/fabric-generator.types";

import {
  hydrateFabricRuntimeManifest,
} from "../fabric-generator/hydrate-fabric-runtime-manifest";

import {
  hydrateSavedFabricRuntimeJson,
} from "../autosave/hydrate-saved-fabric-runtime-json";

import {
  resolveAiAssetSignedUrl,
} from "../storage/resolve-ai-asset-url";

import type {
  ResolvedExportSource,
} from "./export.types";

export async function resolveExportSource(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  exportRequestId: string;
}): Promise<ResolvedExportSource> {
  const db = getFirestore();

  const designSnap = await db
    .doc(`workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}`)
    .get();

  if (!designSnap.exists) {
    throw new Error("design_not_found");
  }

  const design = designSnap.data()!;

  const currentRuntimeAssetId =
    design.current?.fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId;

  const manifestTemplateAssetId =
    design.source?.currentFabricManifestAssetId;

  const revision = design.current?.revision ?? 0;

  if (currentRuntimeAssetId) {
    const runtimeAsset = await loadAssetRef({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      assetId: currentRuntimeAssetId,
    });

    const runtimeJson =
      await downloadJsonAsset<FabricRuntimeJson>(runtimeAsset);

    const template = manifestTemplateAssetId
      ? await loadManifestTemplate({
          workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
          designId: input.designId,
          assetId: manifestTemplateAssetId,
        })
      : undefined;

    const assets = template?.assets ?? {};

    const hydratedRuntimeJson =
      await hydrateSavedFabricRuntimeJson({
        fabricRuntimeJson: runtimeJson,
        assets,
        resolveAssetUrl: async (asset) => {
          const resolved = await resolveAiAssetSignedUrl({
            asset,
            expiresInMs: 60 * 60 * 1000,
          });

          return {
            url: resolved.url,
            urlExpiresAt: resolved.urlExpiresAt,
          };
        },
      });

    if (!template) {
      throw new Error("missing_manifest_template_for_runtime_export");
    }

    return {
      revision,
      fabricRuntimeJson: runtimeJson,
      fabricManifestTemplate: template,
      runtimeManifest: {
        ...template,
        schemaVersion: "ai-fabric-runtime-manifest.v1",
        mode: "runtime_hydrated",
        fabricJson: hydratedRuntimeJson,
      },
      assets,
      sourceRuntimeAssetId: currentRuntimeAssetId,
      sourceManifestTemplateAssetId: manifestTemplateAssetId,
      reconstructionAssetId:
        design.source?.currentReconstructionAssetId,
    };
  }

  if (!manifestTemplateAssetId) {
    throw new Error("no_export_source_available");
  }

  const template = await loadManifestTemplate({
    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    assetId: manifestTemplateAssetId,
  });

  const runtimeManifest = await hydrateFabricRuntimeManifest({
    template,
    resolveAssetUrl: async (asset) => {
      const resolved = await resolveAiAssetSignedUrl({
        asset,
        expiresInMs: 60 * 60 * 1000,
      });

      return {
        url: resolved.url,
        urlExpiresAt: resolved.urlExpiresAt,
      };
    },
  });

  return {
    revision,
    fabricManifestTemplate: template,
    runtimeManifest,
    assets: template.assets,
    sourceManifestTemplateAssetId: manifestTemplateAssetId,
    reconstructionAssetId:
      design.source?.currentReconstructionAssetId,
  };
}

async function loadManifestTemplate(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  assetId: string;
}) {
  const asset = await loadAssetRef({
    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    assetId: input.assetId,
  });

  return downloadJsonAsset<AiFabricManifestTemplate>(asset);
}
```

Signed URLs are for temporary runtime access only; Cloud Storage signed URLs provide limited-time access to a resource. citeturn570662view3

# 26.12 Export render shell

Reuse the Step 19 render shell, but expose export methods.

Patch:

```txt
src/app/internal/magic-layers/render-shell/page.tsx
```

Add:

```tsx
declare global {
  interface Window {
    renderMagicLayersRuntimeManifest?: (
      manifest: AiFabricRuntimeManifest
    ) => Promise<void>;

    exportMagicLayersCanvasPng?: (
      multiplier: number
    ) => Promise<number[]>;

    exportMagicLayersCanvasSvg?: () => Promise<string>;

    magicLayersFabricCanvas?: Canvas;
  }
}
```

Inside the existing `useEffect`:

```tsx
window.magicLayersFabricCanvas = canvas;
```

Add export functions:

```tsx
window.exportMagicLayersCanvasPng = async (
  multiplier: number
) => {
  const canvas = window.magicLayersFabricCanvas;

  if (!canvas) {
    throw new Error("Fabric canvas missing");
  }

  const exportCanvas = canvas.toCanvasElement(multiplier);

  const blob = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
    exportCanvas.toBlob((value) => {
      if (!value) {
        reject(new Error("canvas_to_blob_failed"));
        return;
      }

      resolve(value);
    }, "image/png");
  });

  const buffer = await blob.arrayBuffer();

  return [...new Uint8Array(buffer)];
};

window.exportMagicLayersCanvasSvg = async () => {
  const canvas = window.magicLayersFabricCanvas;

  if (!canvas) {
    throw new Error("Fabric canvas missing");
  }

  return canvas.toSVG();
};
```

Fabric `toCanvasElement` supports a multiplier, and `toBlob` returns a Blob promise on `StaticCanvas`; those are the right primitives for high-resolution raster export. citeturn113684search0

# 26.13 Headless export renderer

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/export/playwright-export-renderer.ts
```

```ts
import {
  chromium,
} from "playwright";

import type {
  AiFabricRuntimeManifest,
} from "../fabric-generator/fabric-generator.types";

import type {
  ExportRenderResult,
} from "./export.types";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_EXPORT_POLICY,
} from "./export-policy";

export async function renderFabricRuntimeToPng(input: {
  runtimeManifest: AiFabricRuntimeManifest;

  scale: number;

  includeLockedReference: boolean;

  includeHiddenLayers: boolean;
}): Promise<ExportRenderResult> {
  const startedAt = Date.now();

  const rendererUrl = process.env.MAGIC_LAYERS_RENDERER_URL;

  if (!rendererUrl) {
    throw new Error("missing_MAGIC_LAYERS_RENDERER_URL");
  }

  const browser = await chromium.launch({
    args: ["--no-sandbox"],
  });

  try {
    const page = await browser.newPage({
      viewport: {
        width: input.runtimeManifest.canvas.width,
        height: input.runtimeManifest.canvas.height,
      },
      deviceScaleFactor: 1,
    });

    await page.goto(rendererUrl, {
      waitUntil: "networkidle",
      timeout: MAGIC_LAYERS_EXPORT_POLICY.render.timeoutMs,
    });

    const runtimeManifest = filterRuntimeManifestForExport({
      runtimeManifest: input.runtimeManifest,
      includeLockedReference: input.includeLockedReference,
      includeHiddenLayers: input.includeHiddenLayers,
    });

    await page.evaluate(async (manifest) => {
      const win = window as any;

      if (!win.renderMagicLayersRuntimeManifest) {
        throw new Error("renderMagicLayersRuntimeManifest missing");
      }

      await win.renderMagicLayersRuntimeManifest(manifest);
    }, runtimeManifest);

    await page.evaluate(async () => {
      if ("fonts" in document) {
        await (document as any).fonts.ready;
      }
    });

    const bytes = await page.evaluate(async (scale) => {
      const win = window as any;

      if (!win.exportMagicLayersCanvasPng) {
        throw new Error("exportMagicLayersCanvasPng missing");
      }

      return win.exportMagicLayersCanvasPng(scale);
    }, input.scale);

    const pngBuffer = Buffer.from(bytes);

    return {
      pngBuffer,
      width: Math.round(input.runtimeManifest.canvas.width * input.scale),
      height: Math.round(input.runtimeManifest.canvas.height * input.scale),
      rendererName: "playwright_chromium_fabric_export_renderer",
      renderMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
    };
  } finally {
    await browser.close();
  }
}

export async function renderFabricRuntimeToSvg(input: {
  runtimeManifest: AiFabricRuntimeManifest;

  includeLockedReference: boolean;

  includeHiddenLayers: boolean;
}): Promise<string> {
  const rendererUrl = process.env.MAGIC_LAYERS_RENDERER_URL;

  if (!rendererUrl) {
    throw new Error("missing_MAGIC_LAYERS_RENDERER_URL");
  }

  const browser = await chromium.launch({
    args: ["--no-sandbox"],
  });

  try {
    const page = await browser.newPage({
      viewport: {
        width: input.runtimeManifest.canvas.width,
        height: input.runtimeManifest.canvas.height,
      },
      deviceScaleFactor: 1,
    });

    await page.goto(rendererUrl, {
      waitUntil: "networkidle",
      timeout: MAGIC_LAYERS_EXPORT_POLICY.render.timeoutMs,
    });

    const runtimeManifest = filterRuntimeManifestForExport({
      runtimeManifest: input.runtimeManifest,
      includeLockedReference: input.includeLockedReference,
      includeHiddenLayers: input.includeHiddenLayers,
    });

    await page.evaluate(async (manifest) => {
      const win = window as any;
      await win.renderMagicLayersRuntimeManifest(manifest);
    }, runtimeManifest);

    return page.evaluate(async () => {
      const win = window as any;
      return win.exportMagicLayersCanvasSvg();
    });
  } finally {
    await browser.close();
  }
}

function filterRuntimeManifestForExport(input: {
  runtimeManifest: AiFabricRuntimeManifest;
  includeLockedReference: boolean;
  includeHiddenLayers: boolean;
}): AiFabricRuntimeManifest {
  const manifest = structuredClone(input.runtimeManifest);

  manifest.fabricJson.objects = manifest.fabricJson.objects.filter((object) => {
    if (!input.includeHiddenLayers && object.visible === false) {
      return false;
    }

    if (
      !input.includeLockedReference &&
      object.aiEditableLevel === "locked_reference"
    ) {
      return false;
    }

    return true;
  });

  return manifest;
}
```

Playwright supports screenshot/PDF rendering in a controlled browser context; for export we use the same controlled browser approach rather than relying on arbitrary client tabs. citeturn570662view1

# 26.14 Postprocess export output

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/export/postprocess-export-output.ts
```

```ts
import sharp from "sharp";

import type {
  ExportOutputResult,
  MagicExportFormat,
} from "./export.types";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_EXPORT_POLICY,
} from "./export-policy";

export async function postprocessExportOutput(input: {
  format: MagicExportFormat;

  sourcePng: Buffer;

  width: number;

  height: number;

  quality?: number;

  transparentBackground: boolean;
}): Promise<ExportOutputResult> {
  const started = Date.now();

  switch (input.format) {
    case "png": {
      const buffer = await sharp(input.sourcePng)
        .png({
          compressionLevel: 9,
          adaptiveFiltering: true,
        })
        .toBuffer();

      return {
        buffer,
        contentType: "image/png",
        extension: "png",
        width: input.width,
        height: input.height,
        sizeBytes: buffer.byteLength,
        warnings: [],
      };
    }

    case "jpeg": {
      const buffer = await sharp(input.sourcePng)
        .flatten({
          background:
            MAGIC_LAYERS_EXPORT_POLICY.formats.jpeg.flattenBackground,
        })
        .jpeg({
          quality:
            input.quality ??
            MAGIC_LAYERS_EXPORT_POLICY.formats.jpeg.defaultQuality,
          mozjpeg: true,
        })
        .toBuffer();

      return {
        buffer,
        contentType: "image/jpeg",
        extension: "jpg",
        width: input.width,
        height: input.height,
        sizeBytes: buffer.byteLength,
        warnings: input.transparentBackground
          ? ["jpeg_does_not_support_transparency_flattened"]
          : [],
      };
    }

    case "webp": {
      const pipeline = sharp(input.sourcePng);

      const buffer = await pipeline
        .webp({
          quality:
            input.quality ??
            MAGIC_LAYERS_EXPORT_POLICY.formats.webp.defaultQuality,
        })
        .toBuffer();

      return {
        buffer,
        contentType: "image/webp",
        extension: "webp",
        width: input.width,
        height: input.height,
        sizeBytes: buffer.byteLength,
        warnings: [],
      };
    }

    default:
      throw new Error(`Unsupported raster postprocess format: ${input.format}`);
  }
}
```

Sharp supports output controls for PNG, JPEG, WebP, and other formats, so it is the correct post-processing layer after the browser/Fabric render. citeturn531538search7

# 26.15 Flattened PDF export

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/export/create-flattened-pdf-export.ts
```

```ts
import {
  chromium,
} from "playwright";

import {
  MAGIC_LAYERS_EXPORT_POLICY,
} from "./export-policy";

export async function createFlattenedPdfExport(input: {
  pngBuffer: Buffer;

  width: number;

  height: number;
}): Promise<Buffer> {
  const html = `
    <!doctype html>
    <html>
      <head>
        <meta charset="utf-8" />
        <style>
          html, body {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            width: ${input.width}px;
            height: ${input.height}px;
            background: transparent;
            -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
            print-color-adjust: exact;
          }

          img {
            display: block;
            width: ${input.width}px;
            height: ${input.height}px;
          }
        </style>
      </head>
      <body>
        <img src="data:image/png;base64,${input.pngBuffer.toString("base64")}" />
      </body>
    </html>
  `;

  const browser = await chromium.launch({
    args: ["--no-sandbox"],
  });

  try {
    const page = await browser.newPage({
      viewport: {
        width: input.width,
        height: input.height,
      },
      deviceScaleFactor: 1,
    });

    await page.setContent(html, {
      waitUntil: "load",
    });

    if (MAGIC_LAYERS_EXPORT_POLICY.pdf.emulateScreenMedia) {
      await page.emulateMedia({
        media: "screen",
      });
    }

    return page.pdf({
      printBackground:
        MAGIC_LAYERS_EXPORT_POLICY.pdf.printBackground,

      width: `${input.width}px`,
      height: `${input.height}px`,

      margin: {
        top: "0px",
        right: "0px",
        bottom: "0px",
        left: "0px",
      },
    });
  } finally {
    await browser.close();
  }
}
```

This creates a flattened raster PDF. It is not an editable vector PDF.

# 26.16 Best-effort SVG export

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/export/create-best-effort-svg-export.ts
```

```ts
import {
  renderFabricRuntimeToSvg,
} from "./playwright-export-renderer";

import type {
  AiFabricRuntimeManifest,
} from "../fabric-generator/fabric-generator.types";

export async function createBestEffortSvgExport(input: {
  runtimeManifest: AiFabricRuntimeManifest;

  includeLockedReference: boolean;

  includeHiddenLayers: boolean;
}) {
  const svg = await renderFabricRuntimeToSvg({
    runtimeManifest: input.runtimeManifest,
    includeLockedReference: input.includeLockedReference,
    includeHiddenLayers: input.includeHiddenLayers,
  });

  const warnings: string[] = [
    "svg_export_best_effort_not_canonical",
  ];

  const hasRasterObjects = input.runtimeManifest.fabricJson.objects.some(
    (object) =>
      String(object.type).toLowerCase().includes("image")
  );

  if (hasRasterObjects) {
    warnings.push("svg_contains_raster_image_references");
  }

  return {
    buffer: Buffer.from(svg, "utf8"),
    contentType: "image/svg+xml",
    extension: "svg" as const,
    sizeBytes: Buffer.byteLength(svg, "utf8"),
    warnings,
  };
}
```

SVG is useful but not trusted as a canonical export because Fabric says SVG and Canvas export/import do not round-trip perfectly. citeturn570662view2

```ts
import type {
  FabricRuntimeJson,
} from "../fabric-generator/fabric-generator.types";

import {
  stripRuntimeUrlsFromFabricJson,
} from "../autosave/strip-runtime-urls-from-fabric-json";

export function createRuntimeJsonExport(input: {
  fabricRuntimeJson: FabricRuntimeJson;
}) {
  const durable = stripRuntimeUrlsFromFabricJson(
    input.fabricRuntimeJson
  );

  const buffer = Buffer.from(
    JSON.stringify(durable, null, 2),
    "utf8"
  );

  return {
    buffer,
    contentType: "application/json",
    extension: "json" as const,
    sizeBytes: buffer.byteLength,
    warnings: [],
  };
}
```

The export JSON must be durable, so signed URLs are stripped to `magic-asset://`.

# 26.18 Run export request

Create:

```txt

```

```ts
import {
  FieldValue,
  getFirestore,
} from "firebase-admin/firestore";

import {
  AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,
  AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
} from "../schema/constants";

import {
  bucketForMagicStorageRole,
} from "../storage/storage-buckets";

import {
  exportOutputAssetPath,
  exportRequestReportPath,
} from "../storage/storage-paths";

import {
  writeAiAsset,
} from "../storage/write-ai-asset";

import {
  resolveExportSource,
} from "./resolve-export-source";

import {
  renderFabricRuntimeToPng,
} from "./playwright-export-renderer";

import {
  postprocessExportOutput,
} from "./postprocess-export-output";

import {
  createFlattenedPdfExport,
} from "./create-flattened-pdf-export";

import {
  createBestEffortSvgExport,
} from "./create-best-effort-svg-export";

import {
  createRuntimeJsonExport,
} from "./create-runtime-json-export";

import type {
  ExportPass,
  ExportResult,
  MagicExportFormat,
} from "./export.types";

export async function runExportRequest(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  exportRequestId: string;
}): Promise<ExportResult> {
  const db = getFirestore();

  const exportRef = db.doc(
    `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/exportRequests/${input.exportRequestId}`
  );

  const exportSnap = await exportRef.get();

  if (!exportSnap.exists) {
    throw new Error("export_request_not_found");
  }

  const exportDoc = exportSnap.data()!;

  await exportRef.update({
    status: "running",
    "progress.percent": 10,
    "progress.label": "Preparing export",
    updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
  });

  const startedAt = Date.now();

  try {
    const source = await resolveExportSource({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      exportRequestId: input.exportRequestId,
    });

    const format = exportDoc.format as MagicExportFormat;

    const scale = exportDoc.input.scale;

    validateExportPixelBudget({
      width: source.runtimeManifest.canvas.width,
      height: source.runtimeManifest.canvas.height,
      scale,
    });

    await exportRef.update({
      "progress.percent": 35,
      "progress.label": "Rendering export",
      updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });

    let output;
    let previewAsset;
    let renderMs = 0;
    let postprocessStarted = Date.now();

    if (format === "svg_best_effort") {
      output = await createBestEffortSvgExport({
        runtimeManifest: source.runtimeManifest,
        includeLockedReference:
          exportDoc.input.includeLockedReference,
        includeHiddenLayers:
          exportDoc.input.includeHiddenLayers,
      });
    } else if (format === "fabric_runtime_json") {
      const runtimeJson =
        source.fabricRuntimeJson ??
        source.runtimeManifest.fabricJson;

      output = createRuntimeJsonExport({
        fabricRuntimeJson: runtimeJson,
      });
    } else {
      const rendered = await renderFabricRuntimeToPng({
        runtimeManifest: source.runtimeManifest,
        scale,
        includeLockedReference:
          exportDoc.input.includeLockedReference,
        includeHiddenLayers:
          exportDoc.input.includeHiddenLayers,
      });

      renderMs = rendered.renderMs;

      if (format === "pdf_flattened") {
        const pdfBuffer = await createFlattenedPdfExport({
          pngBuffer: rendered.pngBuffer,
          width: rendered.width,
          height: rendered.height,
        });

        output = {
          buffer: pdfBuffer,
          contentType: "application/pdf",
          extension: "pdf" as const,
          width: rendered.width,
          height: rendered.height,
          sizeBytes: pdfBuffer.byteLength,
          warnings: ["pdf_flattened_raster_output"],
        };
      } else {
        output = await postprocessExportOutput({
          format,
          sourcePng: rendered.pngBuffer,
          width: rendered.width,
          height: rendered.height,
          quality: exportDoc.input.quality ?? undefined,
          transparentBackground:
            exportDoc.input.transparentBackground,
        });
      }

      const previewAssetId = stableAssetId(
        input.exportRequestId,
        "export-preview-render"
      );

      previewAsset = await writeAiAsset({
        storageRole: "assets",
        bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("assets"),
        storagePath: exportOutputAssetPath({
          workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
          designId: input.designId,
          exportRequestId: input.exportRequestId,
          assetId: previewAssetId,
          extension: "png",
        }),

        bytes: rendered.pngBuffer,

        assetId: previewAssetId,
        kind: "export_render_png" as any,

        contentType: "image/png",

        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,

        source: "export_renderer",

        width: rendered.width,
        height: rendered.height,

        schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

        cacheControl:
          "private, max-age=31536000, immutable",
      });
    }

    await exportRef.update({
      "progress.percent": 70,
      "progress.label": "Writing export",
      updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });

    const exportAssetId = stableAssetId(
      input.exportRequestId,
      `export-final-${format}`
    );

    const exportAssetKind = exportKindForFormat(format);

    const exportAsset = await writeAiAsset({
      storageRole: "assets",
      bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("assets"),
      storagePath: exportOutputAssetPath({
        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        exportRequestId: input.exportRequestId,
        assetId: exportAssetId,
        extension: output.extension,
      }),

      bytes: output.buffer,

      assetId: exportAssetId,
      kind: exportAssetKind as any,

      contentType: output.contentType,

      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,

      source: "export_renderer",

      width: output.width,
      height: output.height,

      schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

      sourceAssetId:
        source.sourceRuntimeAssetId ??
        source.sourceManifestTemplateAssetId,

      cacheControl:
        "private, max-age=31536000, immutable",
    });

    const totalMs = Date.now() - startedAt;

    const pass: ExportPass = {
      schemaVersion: "ai-export-pass.v1",

      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      exportRequestId: input.exportRequestId,
      userId: exportDoc.userId,

      format,

      input: {
        revision: source.revision,
        scale,
        transparentBackground:
          exportDoc.input.transparentBackground,
        includeLockedReference:
          exportDoc.input.includeLockedReference,
        includeHiddenLayers:
          exportDoc.input.includeHiddenLayers,
        sourceRuntimeAssetId: source.sourceRuntimeAssetId,
        sourceManifestTemplateAssetId:
          source.sourceManifestTemplateAssetId,
      },

      output: {
        exportAssetId: exportAsset.id,
        previewAssetId: previewAsset?.id,
        contentType: output.contentType,
        extension: output.extension,
        width: output.width,
        height: output.height,
        sizeBytes: output.sizeBytes,
      },

      metrics: {
        renderMs,
        postprocessMs: Date.now() - postprocessStarted,
        totalMs,
        objectCount: source.runtimeManifest.fabricJson.objects.length,
      },

      warnings: output.warnings,

      createdAt: Date.now(),
    };

    const reportAssetId = stableAssetId(
      input.exportRequestId,
      "export-report"
    );

    const reportAsset = await writeAiAsset({
      storageRole: "source",
      bucket: bucketForMagicStorageRole("source"),
      storagePath: exportRequestReportPath({
        workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
        designId: input.designId,
        exportRequestId: input.exportRequestId,
        assetId: reportAssetId,
      }),

      bytes: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(pass, null, 2), "utf8"),

      assetId: reportAssetId,
      kind: "export_request_report_json" as any,

      contentType: "application/json",

      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,

      source: "export_renderer",

      schemaVersion: AI_RECONSTRUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      pipelineVersion: AI_PIPELINE_VERSION,

      sourceAssetId: exportAsset.id,

      cacheControl: "private, no-cache",
    });

    await exportRef.update({
      status: "completed",

      output: {
        exportAssetId: exportAsset.id,
        previewAssetId: previewAsset?.id ?? null,
        reportAssetId: reportAsset.id,
        mimeType: output.contentType,
        width: output.width ?? null,
        height: output.height ?? null,
        sizeBytes: output.sizeBytes,
      },

      metrics: {
        renderMs,
        totalMs,
        objectCount: source.runtimeManifest.fabricJson.objects.length,
        outputBytes: output.sizeBytes,
      },

      "progress.percent": 100,
      "progress.label": "Export completed",

      completedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });

    return {
      exportAsset,
      previewAsset,
      exportPass: pass,
      exportPassAsset: reportAsset,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    await exportRef.update({
      status: "failed",

      error: {
        code: "export_failed",
        message:
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown export error",
        retryable: true,
      },

      "progress.label": "Export failed",

      updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });

    throw error;
  }
}

function validateExportPixelBudget(input: {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  scale: number;
}) {
  const pixels =
    input.width * input.height * input.scale * input.scale;

  if (pixels > 80_000_000) {
    throw new Error("export_pixel_budget_exceeded");
  }
}

function exportKindForFormat(format: MagicExportFormat) {
  switch (format) {
    case "png":
      return "export_final_png";
    case "jpeg":
      return "export_final_jpeg";
    case "webp":
      return "export_final_webp";
    case "pdf_flattened":
      return "export_final_pdf";
    case "svg_best_effort":
      return "export_best_effort_svg";
    case "fabric_runtime_json":
      return "export_runtime_json";
  }
}

function stableAssetId(exportRequestId: string, label: string) {
  return `asset_${exportRequestId}_${label}_${crypto.randomUUID()}`
    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "_")
    .toLowerCase();
}
```

Remove `as any` after patching your asset enum.

---

# 26.19 Export worker deployment

Use a separate export worker, not your Next.js API route.

Recommended:

```txt
Next.js API
→ creates exportRequest doc
→ enqueues job
→ returns exportRequestId

Cloud Run Job / worker service
→ reads exportRequest
→ renders export
→ writes output assets
→ updates Firestore
```

Export rendering can exceed normal request limits and has heavy browser memory usage. Cloud Run Jobs are a better fit for long-running or isolated work; Cloud Run Jobs task timeout can be configured beyond the 10-minute default, up to 168 hours for non-GPU tasks, while GPU tasks have a 1-hour maximum. citeturn570662view4

Day-one worker choices:

```txt
small exports
  Cloud Run service endpoint called by task queue

large exports
  Cloud Run Job

scheduled cleanup
  Cloud Run Job
```

---

```txt
GET /api/workspaces/{workspaceId}/designs/{designId}/exports/{exportRequestId}
```

Response:

```ts
type ExportStatusResponse = {

    retryable: boolean;

```

Only return `downloadUrl` when completed.

Use signed URL for download. Signed URLs give time-limited access and should not be persisted as durable state. citeturn570662view3

# 26.21 Download URL generation

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/export/resolve-export-download-url.ts
```

```ts
import {
  loadAssetRef,
} from "../storage/load-asset-ref";

import {
  resolveAiAssetSignedUrl,
} from "../storage/resolve-ai-asset-url";

export async function resolveExportDownloadUrl(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  exportAssetId: string;
}) {
  const asset = await loadAssetRef({
    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    assetId: input.exportAssetId,
  });

  const resolved = await resolveAiAssetSignedUrl({
    asset,
    expiresInMs: 60 * 60 * 1000,
    responseDisposition: `attachment; filename="${downloadNameForAsset(asset)}"`,
  });

  return {
    assetId: asset.id,
    url: resolved.url,
    urlExpiresAt: resolved.urlExpiresAt,
  };
}

function downloadNameForAsset(asset: any) {
  const extension =
    asset.mimeType === "image/png"
      ? "png"
      : asset.mimeType === "image/jpeg"
        ? "jpg"
        : asset.mimeType === "image/webp"
          ? "webp"
          : asset.mimeType === "application/pdf"
            ? "pdf"
            : asset.mimeType === "image/svg+xml"
              ? "svg"
              : "bin";

  return `design-export-${asset.id}.${extension}`;
}
```

# 26.22 Client export trigger

Client flow:

```ts
export async function exportCurrentDesign(input: {
  autosaveManager: {
    flush: () => Promise<void>;
    getRevision: () => number;
  };

  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;

  format: "png" | "jpeg" | "webp" | "pdf_flattened" | "svg_best_effort";

  scale: number;

  getIdToken: () => Promise<string>;
  getAppCheckToken: () => Promise<string>;
}) {
  await input.autosaveManager.flush();

  const idToken = await input.getIdToken();
  const appCheckToken = await input.getAppCheckToken();

  const response = await fetch(
    `/api/workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/exports`,
    {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        Authorization: `Bearer ${idToken}`,
        "x-firebase-appcheck": appCheckToken,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        format: input.format,
        scale: input.scale,
        baseRevision: input.autosaveManager.getRevision(),
        transparentBackground: input.format === "png",
        includeLockedReference: false,
        includeHiddenLayers: false,
      }),
    }
  );

  const body = await response.json();

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(body.error ?? "export_request_failed");
  }

  return body as {
    exportRequestId: string;
  };
}
```

Do not export unsaved state.

# 26.23 Export validation

Every export must validate:

```txt
source runtime exists or generated manifest exists
baseRevision matches current design revision
all image objects have aiSourceAssetId
all magic-asset:// URLs are hydrated before render
runtime image URLs are HTTPS
crossOrigin = anonymous
canvas dimensions are valid
scale is within policy
pixel budget is within policy
output buffer is non-empty
output MIME matches requested format
output asset is written to GCS
export request doc is completed only after output asset exists
```

Reject if:

```txt
client sent Fabric JSON for final export
base revision mismatch
output pixel budget exceeded
missing asset
asset belongs to another design/workspace
render shell fails
font load timeout
canvas export returns empty blob
PDF buffer is empty
SVG requested but Fabric SVG export fails
```

---

# 26.24 Export quality notes

Do not rerun Step 19 visual validation for every export by default.

Step 19 validates reconstruction quality.

Step 26 validates export mechanics.

Optional export QA:

```txt
render output dimensions
output non-empty
MIME correct
file size sane
object count rendered
font load completed
```

For paid/critical print exports, add:

```txt
export proof render
export diff against current runtime screenshot
font substitution report
```

Not day-one.

---

# 26.25 PDF truth boundary

Day-one PDF is:

```txt
flattened raster PDF
```

Not:

```txt
editable PDF
vector PDF
CMYK PDF
PDF/X
print-certified output
```

This is the right v1 because your scene contains:

```txt
raster cutouts
text fallbacks
inpainted backgrounds
mixed Fabric objects
browser fonts
```

A true print pipeline requires:

```txt
font embedding
vector path fidelity
CMYK conversion
bleed/safe margins
PDF/X checks
color profiles
```

Do not claim that until you build it.

---

# 26.26 SVG truth boundary

Day-one SVG is:

```txt
best-effort visual SVG
```

Not:

```txt
source of truth
lossless export
guaranteed editable SVG
round-trip format
```

Fabric itself warns that SVG and Canvas are not identical and import/export is not one-to-one. citeturn570662view2

Use SVG for:

```txt
simple vector-heavy designs
developer/debug export
user who accepts approximation
```

Do not use SVG as the canonical persisted editor state.

---

# 26.27 Export security requirements

Every export endpoint must verify:

```txt
Firebase Auth
Firebase App Check
workspace access
design access
base revision
asset ownership
format allowlist
pixel budget
```

Reject:

```txt
foreign asset IDs
signed URLs submitted as asset IDs
base64 Fabric JSON images
unknown export formats
unbounded scale
locked reference included unless explicitly requested
```

---

# 26.28 Export cost controls

Main cost drivers:

```txt
headless Chromium CPU/memory
high-resolution PNG buffers
large GCS output files
repeated exports
PDF generation
signed URL downloads
```

Controls:

```txt
cap scale
cap output pixels
queue exports
deduplicate identical export requests
rate-limit per user/workspace
reuse current runtime asset
keep previews separate from final exports
expire temporary export requests
retain final version exports only when user saves/downloads
```

Do not allow:

```txt
unlimited 8x exports
unbounded PDF sizes
per-keystroke export previews
```

---

# 26.29 Export lifecycle

Export request states:

```txt
queued
running
completed
failed
cancelled
```

Output assets:

```txt
completed exports:
  retain at least 30 days or until user deletes

failed exports:
  keep report for debugging
  no output asset required

preview render:
  can expire earlier than final output
```

Recommended:

```txt
final exports:
  private, max-age=31536000, immutable

reports:
  private, no-cache

download URLs:
  signed, short-lived
```

---

# 26.30 What Step 26 must not do

Do not:

```txt
mutate AiReconstructionDocument
mutate AiFabricManifestTemplate
repair bad layers
autosave unsaved client state
trust client Fabric JSON for final export
store signed URLs
store base64 images inside export JSON
claim SVG/PDF are fully editable or print-certified
mark design quality better/worse
run AI models
```

Step 26 is output generation only.

# 26.32 Non-negotiable invariants

Step 26 is valid only if:

```txt
Final export reads saved server runtime state.

Client must flush autosave before export.

Base revision must match current design revision.

Server never trusts client Fabric JSON for final export.

Runtime URLs are hydrated from asset IDs.

Signed URLs are not persisted.

Raster exports are server-rendered.

PDF export is labeled flattened.

SVG export is labeled best-effort.

Output assets are immutable.

Export request completes only after output asset exists.

Export report is stored.

Download URL is generated on demand.

AiReconstructionDocument is not mutated.

AiFabricManifestTemplate is not mutated.

Repair is not performed.

Export failures are explicit.
```

# 26.33 Definition of done

Step 26 is complete when:

```txt
Export request API exists.

Export worker exists.

Server resolves current runtime state.

Server hydrates asset URLs.

Headless Fabric export renderer outputs PNG.

PNG export works.

JPEG export works.

WebP export works.

Flattened PDF export works.

Best-effort SVG export works.

Runtime JSON export works.

Export assets are written to GCS.

Export request report is written to GCS.

Firestore export request status updates correctly.

Download URL endpoint returns signed URL.

Client flushes autosave before export.

No signed URL is persisted.

No canonical reconstruction mutation occurs.
```

Locked Step 26 architecture:

```txt
Saved FabricRuntimeJson
or generated FabricManifestTemplate
→ runtime hydration
→ controlled headless Fabric render
→ format-specific postprocess
→ immutable export asset
→ export request report
→ signed download URL
```

Next is Step 27: **Observability, cost controls, evaluation loops, and production hardening**.

# Step 26 — Exports, server rendering, and production output pipeline

Step 26 turns the current editable design into production output files.

The locked rule:

```txt
Official exports are rendered server-side from the saved Fabric runtime state.
Client-side exports are preview-only.
```

This matters because browser state is user/device-dependent, signed URLs can expire, fonts can differ, and canvas CORS problems can break exports. Fabric exposes canvas export helpers such as `toDataURL`, but that is suitable for quick client previews, not your authoritative production output. Fabric’s utility `toDataURL` returns a data URL from an HTML canvas element and supports formats like PNG/JPEG/WebP depending on browser support. citeturn483849view1

---

# 26.1 What Step 26 owns

Step 26 owns:

```txt
export request API
export job Firestore docs
server-side render worker
runtime Fabric JSON hydration
signed URL hydration for render
PNG/JPEG/WebP/PDF output generation
export asset storage
download URL issuance
export progress updates
export version checkpointing
```

Step 26 does **not** own:

```txt
AI reconstruction
repair
autosave
visual validation
text safety validation
layer panel behavior
canonical AiReconstructionDocument mutation
```

Exports read the current design state. They do not modify reconstruction truth.

---

# 26.2 Export source rule

Export source priority:

```txt
1. explicit versionId
2. design.current.fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId
3. generated Fabric manifest template
```

Meaning:

```txt
Export a version if user selected one.
Otherwise export latest saved editor runtime.
If no user edits exist, export generated Magic Layers manifest.
```

Do not export directly from the live browser canvas as the official file.

Correct:

```txt
saved FabricRuntimeJson
→ hydrate asset URLs
→ server render
→ export asset
```

Wrong:

```txt
client canvas.toDataURL()
→ official customer download
```

---

# 26.3 Renderer rule

Use the same headless browser render shell from Step 19 for official exports.

Reason:

```txt
Step 19 visual validation proves the browser Fabric render path.
Step 26 should use the same render path to avoid renderer drift.
```

Playwright can capture screenshots from pages/elements, which is appropriate for PNG/JPEG/WebP generation. It also exposes `page.pdf()`, which returns a PDF buffer and renders with print CSS media by default. citeturn483849view2

---

# 26.4 Export formats

Day-one supported formats:

```txt
png
jpeg
webp
pdf
```

Later optional formats:

```txt
svg
pdf_vector
psd
```

Strong recommendation:

```txt
Do not ship SVG/PSD as official exports until you have separate validators.
```

Why:

```txt
Fabric canvas features do not always round-trip cleanly to SVG.
PSD export introduces layer semantics, blend modes, text fidelity, and font packaging issues.
```

For day one:

```txt
PNG/JPEG/WebP = rendered pixels
PDF = rendered page, raster-backed for fidelity
```

---

# 26.5 Export job architecture

Use this flow:

```txt
POST /exports
→ create exportRequests/{exportId}
→ enqueue export worker
→ worker loads runtime state
→ worker hydrates assets
→ worker renders output
→ worker writes output asset
→ Firestore marks completed
→ client requests signed download URL
```

For short exports, use Cloud Tasks to call a Cloud Run HTTP worker. Cloud Tasks can dispatch HTTP target tasks to Cloud Run or other HTTP endpoints, which fits export work that should not block the user request. citeturn566776search1

For heavy batch or high-resolution exports, use Cloud Run Jobs. Cloud Run Jobs default to 10-minute task timeout and can be configured up to 168 hours, with GPU task timeout capped at 1 hour. citeturn483849view4

```ts
export function exportRequestRootPath(
  input: WorkspaceDesignPathInput & {
    exportId: string;

) {

    "workspaces",
    input.workspaceId,
    "designs",

export function exportOutputAssetPath(
  input: WorkspaceDesignPathInput & {
    exportId: string;
    assetId: string;
    extension:
      | "png"
      | "jpg"
      | "webp"
      | "pdf"
      | "svg"

export function exportRequestReportPath(
  input: WorkspaceDesignPathInput & {
    exportId: string;
    assetId: string;
  }
) {
  return joinPath([
    exportRequestRootPath(input),
    `${input.assetId}.export-report.json`,
  ]);
}
```

Export assets should be immutable:

```txt
Cache-Control: private, max-age=31536000, immutable
```

Download delivery should use signed URLs, not public objects. Google Cloud Storage signed URLs provide time-limited access to a specific resource. citeturn566776search0

```ts
import type {
  AiAssetRef,
} from "../schema/reconstruction.types";

import type {
  AiFabricRuntimeManifest,
  FabricRuntimeJson,
} from "../fabric-generator/fabric-generator.types";

export const AI_EXPORT_REQUEST_REPORT_SCHEMA_VERSION =
  "ai-export-request-report.v1" as const;

export type MagicExportFormat =
  | "png"
  | "jpeg"
  | "webp"
  | "pdf";

export type MagicExportOptions = {
  format: MagicExportFormat;

  width?: number;
  height?: number;

  multiplier?: number;

  quality?: number;

  transparentBackground?: boolean;

  pdf?: {
    pageSize:
      | "canvas"
      | "a4"
      | "letter";

    orientation:
      | "portrait"
      | "landscape";

    printBackground: boolean;
  };
};

export type MagicExportSource =
  | {
      type: "current_runtime";
      fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId: string;
      revision: number;
    }
  | {
      type: "version";
      versionId: string;
      fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId: string;
      revision: number;
    }
  | {
      type: "generated_manifest";
      fabricManifestTemplateAssetId: string;
    };

export type MagicExportRequestReport = {
  schemaVersion: typeof AI_EXPORT_REQUEST_REPORT_SCHEMA_VERSION;

  exportId: string;

  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  userId: string;

  source: MagicExportSource;

  options: MagicExportOptions;

  outputAssetId: string;

  outputMimeType: string;

  renderer: {
    name: string;
    width: number;
    height: number;
    multiplier: number;
  };

  warnings: string[];

  createdAt: number;
};

export type MagicExportRenderInput = {
  runtimeManifest: AiFabricRuntimeManifest;

  options: MagicExportOptions;
};

export type MagicExportRenderResult = {
  buffer: Buffer;

  mimeType: string;

  extension:
    | "png"
    | "jpg"
    | "webp"
    | "pdf";

  width?: number;
  height?: number;

  rendererName: string;
};
```

# 26.11 Export request API

Create:

```txt
src/app/api/workspaces/[workspaceId]/designs/[designId]/exports/route.ts
```

```ts
import {
  NextRequest,
  NextResponse,
} from "next/server";

import {
  FieldValue,
  getFirestore,
} from "firebase-admin/firestore";

import {
  getAuth,
} from "firebase-admin/auth";

import {
  getAppCheck,
} from "firebase-admin/app-check";

import type {
  MagicExportOptions,
} from "@/lib/magic-layers/export/export.types";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

export async function POST(
  req: NextRequest,
  context: {
    params: Promise<{
      workspaceId: string;
      designId: string;
    }>;
  }
) {
  const {
    workspaceId,
    designId,
  } = await context.params;

  const userId = await verifyAuthAndAppCheck(req);

  await assertWorkspaceAccess({
    workspaceId,
    userId,
  });

  const body = await req.json();

  const options = normalizeExportOptions(body.options);

  const db = getFirestore();

  const designSnap = await db
    .doc(`workspaces/${workspaceId}/designs/${designId}`)
    .get();

  if (!designSnap.exists) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "design_not_found" },
      { status: 404 }
    );
  }

  const design = designSnap.data()!;

  const source = resolveExportSource({
    design,
    requestedVersionId: body.versionId,
  });

  const exportRef = db
    .collection(
      `workspaces/${workspaceId}/designs/${designId}/exportRequests`
    )
    .doc();

  await exportRef.set({
    id: exportRef.id,

    workspaceId,
    designId,
    userId,

    status: "queued",

    source,

    options,

    progress: {
      percent: 0,
      label: "Export queued",
    },

    createdAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
  });

  await enqueueExportWorker({
    workspaceId,
    designId,
    exportId: exportRef.id,
  });

  return NextResponse.json({
    exportId: exportRef.id,
  });
}

function normalizeExportOptions(
  options: Partial<MagicExportOptions>
): MagicExportOptions {
  const format = options.format ?? "png";

  if (!["png", "jpeg", "webp", "pdf"].includes(format)) {
    throw new Error("unsupported_export_format");
  }

  return {
    format: format as MagicExportOptions["format"],

    width: options.width,
    height: options.height,

    multiplier: options.multiplier ?? 1,

    quality: options.quality,

    transparentBackground: options.transparentBackground,

    pdf: options.pdf ?? {
      pageSize: "canvas",
      orientation: "portrait",
      printBackground: true,
    },
  };
}

function resolveExportSource(input: {
  design: any;
  requestedVersionId?: string;
}) {
  if (input.requestedVersionId) {
    return {
      type: "version",
      versionId: input.requestedVersionId,
    };
  }

  if (input.design.current?.fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId) {
    return {
      type: "current_runtime",
      fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId:
        input.design.current.fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId,
      revision: input.design.current.revision ?? 0,
    };
  }

  if (input.design.source?.currentFabricManifestAssetId) {
    return {
      type: "generated_manifest",
      fabricManifestTemplateAssetId:
        input.design.source.currentFabricManifestAssetId,
    };
  }

  throw new Error("no_exportable_source_available");
}

async function verifyAuthAndAppCheck(req: NextRequest) {
  const authHeader = req.headers.get("authorization") ?? "";

  const idToken = authHeader.startsWith("Bearer ")
    ? authHeader.slice("Bearer ".length)
    : undefined;

  if (!idToken) {
    throw new Error("missing_auth_token");
  }

  const decoded = await getAuth().verifyIdToken(idToken);

  const appCheckToken = req.headers.get("x-firebase-appcheck");

  if (!appCheckToken) {
    throw new Error("missing_app_check_token");
  }

  await getAppCheck().verifyToken(appCheckToken);

  return decoded.uid;
}
```

`enqueueExportWorker(...)` can be Cloud Tasks. Cloud Tasks is specifically designed to dispatch asynchronous HTTP work to targets such as Cloud Run. citeturn566776search1

# 26.12 Export worker source loader

Create:

```txt
src/lib/magic-layers/export/load-export-runtime-source.ts
```

```ts
import type {
  AiFabricRuntimeManifest,
} from "../fabric-generator/fabric-generator.types";

import {
  downloadJsonAsset,
} from "../storage/download-json-asset";

import {
  loadAssetRef,
} from "../storage/load-asset-ref";

import {
  hydrateFabricRuntimeManifest,
} from "../fabric-generator/hydrate-fabric-runtime-manifest";

import {
  hydrateSavedFabricRuntimeJson,
} from "../autosave/hydrate-saved-fabric-runtime-json";

import {
  resolveAiAssetSignedUrl,
} from "../storage/resolve-ai-asset-url";

export async function loadExportRuntimeSource(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;

  source: any;

  design: any;
}): Promise<AiFabricRuntimeManifest> {
  if (input.source.type === "generated_manifest") {
    const templateAsset = await loadAssetRef({
      workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
      designId: input.designId,
      assetId: input.source.fabricManifestTemplateAssetId,
    });

    const template = await downloadJsonAsset(templateAsset);

    return hydrateFabricRuntimeManifest({
      template,
      resolveAssetUrl: async (asset) => {
        const resolved = await resolveAiAssetSignedUrl({
          asset,
          expiresInMs: 60 * 60 * 1000,
        });

        return {
          url: resolved.url,
          urlExpiresAt: resolved.urlExpiresAt,
        };
      },
    });
  }

  const runtimeAssetId =
    input.source.type === "version"
      ? await loadVersionRuntimeAssetId(input)
      : input.source.fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId;

  const runtimeAsset = await loadAssetRef({
    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    assetId: runtimeAssetId,
  });

  const runtimeJson = await downloadJsonAsset(runtimeAsset);

  const manifestTemplateAssetId =
    input.design.source?.currentFabricManifestAssetId;

  if (!manifestTemplateAssetId) {
    throw new Error("missing_fabric_manifest_template_for_export");
  }

  const templateAsset = await loadAssetRef({
    workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
    designId: input.designId,
    assetId: manifestTemplateAssetId,
  });

  const template = await downloadJsonAsset(templateAsset);

  const hydratedRuntimeJson =
    await hydrateSavedFabricRuntimeJson({
      fabricRuntimeJson: runtimeJson,
      assets: template.assets,
      resolveAssetUrl: async (asset) => {
        const resolved = await resolveAiAssetSignedUrl({
          asset,
          expiresInMs: 60 * 60 * 1000,
        });

        return {
          url: resolved.url,
          urlExpiresAt: resolved.urlExpiresAt,
        };
      },
    });

  return {
    ...template,

    schemaVersion: "ai-fabric-runtime-manifest.v1",

    mode: "runtime_hydrated",

    fabricJson: hydratedRuntimeJson,
  };
}

async function loadVersionRuntimeAssetId(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  designId: string;
  source: {
    versionId: string;
  };
}) {
  const {
    getFirestore,
  } = await import("firebase-admin/firestore");

  const db = getFirestore();

  const snap = await db
    .doc(
      `workspaces/${input.workspaceId}/designs/${input.designId}/versions/${input.source.versionId}`
    )
    .get();

  if (!snap.exists) {
    throw new Error("version_not_found");
  }

  return snap.data()!.fabricRuntimeJsonAssetId;
}
```
